000924 |     pub(crate) fn copy_verified(&self, from: &Path, to: &Path) -> io::Result<String> {
000925 |         let source_identity = identity(from)?;
000926 |         let source_metadata = copy_metadata(from)?;
000927 |         let (hash, bytes) = self.fingerprint(from)?;
000928 |         ensure_space(
000929 |             to.parent().unwrap(),
000930 |             bytes
000931 |                 .checked_add(1024 * 1024)
000932 |                 .ok_or_else(|| invalid("account size overflow"))?,
000933 |         )?;
000934 |         if to.try_exists()? {
000935 |             return Err(invalid("copy destination already exists"));
000936 |         }
000937 |         let output = Command::new("/usr/bin/ditto")
000938 |             .args(["--rsrc", "--extattr", "--acl"])
000939 |             .arg(from)
000940 |             .arg(to)
000941 |             .env_clear()
000942 |             .env("LC_ALL", "C")
000943 |             .output()?;
000944 |         if !output.status.success() {
000945 |             return Err(io::Error::other(
000946 |                 "account copy failed; staged data retained",
000947 |             ));
000948 |         }
000949 |         #[cfg(test)]
000950 |         simulate_copy_provenance(from, to)?;
000951 |         let target_identity = identity(to)?;
000952 |         if source_identity == target_identity {
000953 |             return Err(invalid("copy destination reuses the source identity"));
000954 |         }
000955 |         // Bind the actual destination before proving its relation to the source.
000956 |         let target_fingerprint = self.fingerprint(to)?;
000957 |         let target_metadata = copy_metadata(to)?;
000958 |         verify_copy_tree(from, to)?;
000959 |         #[cfg(test)]
000960 |         COPY_AFTER_PROOF.with(|hook| hook.take().map_or(Ok(()), |hook| hook(to)))?;
000961 |         if self.fingerprint(to)? != target_fingerprint
000962 |             || copy_metadata(to)? != target_metadata
000963 |             || self.fingerprint(from)?.0 != hash
000964 |             || copy_metadata(from)? != source_metadata
000965 |             || identity(from)? != source_identity
000966 |             || identity(to)? != target_identity
000967 |         {
000968 |             return Err(invalid("copy source or destination changed during proof"));
000969 |         }
000970 |         sync_tree(to)?;
000971 |         storage::sync_directory(to.parent().unwrap())?;
000972 |         Ok(target_fingerprint.0)
000973 |     }
000974 |     pub(crate) fn fingerprint(&self, path: &Path) -> io::Result<(String, u64)> {
000975 |         self.check_directory(path)?;
000976 |         let mut hasher = Sha256::new();
000977 |         let mut bytes = 0u64;
000978 |         self.scan(path, path, &mut hasher, &mut bytes, 0)?;
000979 |         Ok((
000980 |             hasher
000981 |                 .finalize()
000982 |                 .iter()
000983 |                 .map(|byte| format!("{byte:02x}"))
000984 |                 .collect::<String>(),
000985 |             bytes,
000986 |         ))
000987 |     }
000988 |     fn scan(
000989 |         &self,
000990 |         root: &Path,
000991 |         path: &Path,
000992 |         hasher: &mut Sha256,
000993 |         bytes: &mut u64,
000994 |         migration_source: u32,
000995 |     ) -> io::Result<()> {
000996 |         let relative_path = path.strip_prefix(root).map_err(io::Error::other)?;
000997 |         if migration_source != 0
000998 |             && (relative_path == Path::new("v2/migration")
000999 |                 || relative_path == Path::new("v2/lifecycle.lock"))
001000 |         {
001001 |             return Ok(());
001002 |         }
001003 |         let metadata = fs::symlink_metadata(path)?;
001004 |         if metadata.file_type().is_symlink()
001005 |             || (!metadata.is_dir() && !metadata.is_file())
001006 |             || metadata.uid() != self.owner
001007 |             || metadata.mode() & 0o022 != 0
001008 |             || metadata.dev() != identity(&self.root)?.device
001009 |             || (metadata.is_file() && metadata.nlink() != 1)
001010 |         {
001011 |             return Err(denied("unsafe account tree entry"));
001012 |         }
001013 |         if migration_source != 0 && relative_path == Path::new("v2/guardian-snapshot.lock") {
001014 |             access_control(path)?;
001015 |             if !metadata.is_file() || metadata.mode() & 0o077 != 0 || metadata.len() != 0 {
001016 |                 return Err(denied("unsafe Guardian snapshot lock"));
001017 |             }
001018 |             return Ok(());
001019 |         }
001020 |         let relative = path
001021 |             .strip_prefix(root)
001022 |             .map_err(io::Error::other)?
001023 |             .as_os_str()
001024 |             .as_bytes();
001025 |         hasher.update((relative.len() as u64).to_le_bytes());
001026 |         hasher.update(relative);
001027 |         hasher.update([u8::from(metadata.is_dir())]);
001028 |         hasher.update((metadata.mode() & 0o7777).to_le_bytes());
001029 |         hasher.update(metadata.uid().to_le_bytes());
001030 |         let acl = access_control(path)?;
001031 |         hasher.update((acl.len() as u64).to_le_bytes());
001032 |         *bytes = bytes
001033 |             .checked_add(acl.len() as u64)
001034 |             .and_then(|value| value.checked_add(4096))
001035 |             .ok_or_else(|| invalid("account metadata size overflow"))?;
001036 |         hasher.update(acl);
001037 |         let attrs = extended_attributes(path)?;
001038 |         let encoded =
001039 |             serde_json::to_vec(&attrs.into_iter().collect::<Vec<_>>()).map_err(io::Error::other)?;
001040 |         hasher.update((encoded.len() as u64).to_le_bytes());
001041 |         *bytes = bytes
001042 |             .checked_add(encoded.len() as u64)
001043 |             .ok_or_else(|| invalid("account attribute size overflow"))?;
001044 |         hasher.update(encoded);
001045 |         // Only the exact live-root health payload is volatile. Metadata, ACL and xattrs bind.
001046 |         if migration_source == 2 && relative_path == Path::new("v2/guardian-health.json") {
001047 |             if !metadata.is_file() || metadata.mode() & 0o077 != 0 {
001048 |                 return Err(denied("unsafe Guardian health"));
001049 |             }
001050 |             let file = std::fs::OpenOptions::new()
001051 |                 .read(true)
001052 |                 .custom_flags(libc::O_NOFOLLOW | libc::O_NONBLOCK | libc::O_CLOEXEC)
001053 |                 .open(path)?;
001054 |             let opened = file.metadata()?;
001055 |             if opened.ino() != metadata.ino()
001056 |                 || opened.dev() != metadata.dev()
001057 |                 || opened.mode() != metadata.mode()
001058 |                 || opened.uid() != metadata.uid()
001059 |                 || opened.nlink() != 1
001060 |             {
001061 |                 return Err(invalid("Guardian health changed during scan"));
001062 |             }
001063 |             return Ok(());
001064 |         }
001065 |         if metadata.is_dir() {
001066 |             let mut children = fs::read_dir(path)?.collect::<Result<Vec<_>, _>>()?;
001067 |             children.sort_by_key(|entry| entry.file_name());
001068 |             for entry in children {
001069 |                 self.scan(root, &entry.path(), hasher, bytes, migration_source)?;
001070 |             }
001071 |         } else {
001072 |             *bytes = bytes
001073 |                 .checked_add(metadata.len())
001074 |                 .ok_or_else(|| invalid("account size overflow"))?;
001075 |             let mut file = std::fs::OpenOptions::new()
001076 |                 .read(true)
001077 |                 .custom_flags(libc::O_NOFOLLOW | libc::O_CLOEXEC)
001078 |                 .open(path)?;
001079 |             let opened = file.metadata()?;
001080 |             if opened.ino() != metadata.ino() || opened.dev() != metadata.dev() {
001081 |                 return Err(invalid("account file changed during scan"));
001082 |             }
001083 |             hasher.update(metadata.len().to_le_bytes());
001084 |             let mut buffer = [0u8; 65536];
001085 |             loop {
001086 |                 let count = file.read(&mut buffer)?;
001087 |                 if count == 0 {
001088 |                     break;
001089 |                 }
001090 |                 hasher.update(&buffer[..count]);
001091 |             }
001092 |         }
001093 |         Ok(())
001094 |     }
001095 | }

001098 | /// Ask Claude to quit and wait up to 15 seconds before any account directory write.
001099 | pub fn quit_claude(owner: u32) -> io::Result<()> {
001100 |     quit_claude_with(
001101 |         &|| ensure_claude_stopped(owner),
001102 |         &|| {
001103 |             let mut child = Command::new("/usr/bin/osascript")
001104 |                 .args(["-e", "tell application \"Claude\" to quit"])
001105 |                 .stdin(std::process::Stdio::null())
001106 |                 .stdout(std::process::Stdio::null())
001107 |                 .stderr(std::process::Stdio::null())
001108 |                 .spawn()?;
001109 |             // AppleScript may wait for an unresponsive application. Bound that request too.
001110 |             let deadline = std::time::Instant::now() + std::time::Duration::from_secs(15);
001111 |             while child.try_wait()?.is_none() {
001112 |                 if std::time::Instant::now() >= deadline {
001113 |                     let _ = child.kill();
001114 |                     let _ = child.wait();
001115 |                     break;
001116 |                 }
001117 |                 std::thread::sleep(std::time::Duration::from_millis(50));
001118 |             }
001119 |             Ok(())
001120 |         },
001121 |         &|| std::thread::sleep(std::time::Duration::from_secs(1)),
001122 |     )
001123 | }
001124 | fn quit_claude_with(
001125 |     stopped: &dyn Fn() -> io::Result<()>,
001126 |     request: &dyn Fn() -> io::Result<()>,
001127 |     wait: &dyn Fn(),
001128 | ) -> io::Result<()> {
001129 |     match stopped() {
001130 |         Ok(()) => return Ok(()),
001131 |         Err(error) if error.kind() == io::ErrorKind::WouldBlock => {}
001132 |         Err(error) => return Err(error),
001133 |     }
001134 |     let deadline = std::time::Instant::now() + std::time::Duration::from_secs(15);
001135 |     request()?;
001136 |     for _ in 0..15 {
001137 |         match stopped() {
001138 |             Ok(()) => return Ok(()),
001139 |             Err(error) if error.kind() == io::ErrorKind::WouldBlock => {}
001140 |             Err(error) => return Err(error),
001141 |         }
001142 |         if std::time::Instant::now() >= deadline {
001143 |             break;
001144 |         }
001145 |         wait();
001146 |     }
001147 |     stopped()
001148 | }

001150 | /// Fail closed on process-enumeration failure. No credentials or process arguments are read.
001151 | pub fn ensure_claude_stopped(owner: u32) -> io::Result<()> {
001152 |     let output = Command::new("/bin/ps")
001153 |         .args(["-ww", "-axo", "uid=,comm="])
001154 |         .env_clear()
001155 |         .env("LC_ALL", "C")
001156 |         .output()?;
001157 |     if !output.status.success() {
001158 |         return Err(io::Error::other("cannot inspect Claude processes"));
001159 |     }
001160 |     ensure_claude_stopped_listing(owner, &output.stdout)
001161 | }

001163 | // Share the production parser with isolated tests; tests never create or run an app bundle.
001164 | fn ensure_claude_stopped_listing(owner: u32, listing: &[u8]) -> io::Result<()> {
001165 |     let listing = std::str::from_utf8(listing).map_err(|_| invalid("invalid process metadata"))?;
001166 |     for line in listing.lines() {
001167 |         let line = line.trim_start();
001168 |         let split = line
001169 |             .find(char::is_whitespace)
001170 |             .ok_or_else(|| invalid("invalid process record"))?;
001171 |         let uid: u32 = line[..split]
001172 |             .parse()
001173 |             .map_err(|_| invalid("invalid process owner"))?;
001174 |         let command = line[split..].trim_start();
001175 |         if uid == owner && (command.contains("/Claude.app/Contents/") || command == "Claude") {
001176 |             return Err(io::Error::new(
001177 |                 io::ErrorKind::WouldBlock,
001178 |                 "Claude must be completely stopped before account changes",
001179 |             ));
001180 |         }
001181 |     }
001182 |     Ok(())
001183 | }
001184 | fn path_cstring(path: &Path) -> io::Result<CString> {
001185 |     CString::new(path.as_os_str().as_bytes()).map_err(|_| invalid("NUL in path"))
001186 | }
001187 | #[cfg(target_os = "macos")]
001188 | fn exchange(left: &Path, right: &Path) -> io::Result<()> {
001189 |     let left = path_cstring(left)?;
001190 |     let right = path_cstring(right)?;
001191 |     // Both paths were checked for ownership, symlinks and a shared device. The kernel exchanges entries atomically.
001192 |     let result = unsafe { libc::renamex_np(left.as_ptr(), right.as_ptr(), libc::RENAME_SWAP) };
001193 |     if result == 0 {
001194 |         Ok(())
001195 |     } else {
001196 |         Err(io::Error::last_os_error())
001197 |     }
001198 | }
001199 | #[cfg(not(target_os = "macos"))]
001200 | fn exchange(_: &Path, _: &Path) -> io::Result<()> {
001201 |     Err(io::Error::new(
001202 |         io::ErrorKind::Unsupported,
001203 |         "atomic account exchange requires macOS",
001204 |     ))
001205 | }
001206 | fn ensure_space(directory: &Path, required: u64) -> io::Result<()> {
001207 |     let path = path_cstring(directory)?;
001208 |     let mut statistics = std::mem::MaybeUninit::<libc::statvfs>::uninit();
001209 |     if unsafe { libc::statvfs(path.as_ptr(), statistics.as_mut_ptr()) } != 0 {
001210 |         return Err(io::Error::last_os_error());
001211 |     }
001212 |     let statistics = unsafe { statistics.assume_init() };
001213 |     let available = (statistics.f_bavail as u64)
001214 |         .checked_mul(statistics.f_frsize)
001215 |         .ok_or_else(|| invalid("free space overflow"))?;
001216 |     if available < required {
001217 |         return Err(io::Error::new(
001218 |             io::ErrorKind::StorageFull,
001219 |             "insufficient space for staged account copy",
001220 |         ));
001221 |     }
001222 |     Ok(())
001223 | }
001224 | // The ordinary account digest is unchanged; copy proof also binds metadata and identities.
001225 | #[derive(Debug, PartialEq, Eq)]
001226 | struct CopyMetadata {
001227 |     relative: PathBuf,
001228 |     device: u64,
001229 |     inode: u64,
001230 |     gid: u32,
001231 |     links: u64,
001232 |     mtime: i64,
001233 |     mtime_nsec: i64,
001234 | }
001235 | fn copy_metadata(path: &Path) -> io::Result<Vec<CopyMetadata>> {
001236 |     fn walk(root: &Path, path: &Path, output: &mut Vec<CopyMetadata>) -> io::Result<()> {
001237 |         let metadata = fs::symlink_metadata(path)?;
001238 |         if metadata.file_type().is_symlink() {
001239 |             return Err(invalid("copy source symlink"));
001240 |         }
001241 |         output.push(CopyMetadata {
001242 |             relative: path.strip_prefix(root).unwrap().to_owned(),
001243 |             device: metadata.dev(),
001244 |             inode: metadata.ino(),
001245 |             gid: metadata.gid(),
001246 |             links: metadata.nlink(),
001247 |             mtime: metadata.mtime(),
001248 |             mtime_nsec: metadata.mtime_nsec(),
001249 |         });
001250 |         if metadata.is_dir() {
001251 |             let mut children = fs::read_dir(path)?
001252 |                 .map(|entry| entry.map(|entry| entry.path()))
001253 |                 .collect::<io::Result<Vec<_>>>()?;
001254 |             children.sort();
001255 |             for child in children {
001256 |                 walk(root, &child, output)?;
001257 |             }
001258 |         }
001259 |         Ok(())
001260 |     }
001261 |     let mut output = Vec::new();
001262 |     walk(path, path, &mut output)?;
001263 |     Ok(output)
001264 | }
001265 | 
001266 | /// A one-time proof for a freshly created, distinct-inode copy. Never use as a durable binding.
001267 | fn verify_copy_tree(from: &Path, to: &Path) -> io::Result<()> {
001268 |     let left = fs::symlink_metadata(from)?;
001269 |     let right = fs::symlink_metadata(to)?;
001270 |     if left.file_type().is_symlink()
001271 |         || right.file_type().is_symlink()
001272 |         || (!left.is_dir() && !left.is_file())
001273 |         || left.is_dir() != right.is_dir()
001274 |         || left.dev() != right.dev()
001275 |         || left.ino() == right.ino()
001276 |         || left.mode() != right.mode()
001277 |         || left.uid() != right.uid()
001278 |         || left.gid() != right.gid()
001279 |         || left.mtime() != right.mtime()
001280 |         || left.mtime_nsec() != right.mtime_nsec()
001281 |         || (left.is_file()
001282 |             && (left.nlink() != 1 || right.nlink() != 1 || left.len() != right.len()))
001283 |         || access_control(from)? != access_control(to)?
001284 |     {
001285 |         return Err(invalid("account copy metadata differs"));
001286 |     }
001287 |     let source_attrs = extended_attributes(from)?;
001288 |     let mut target_attrs = extended_attributes(to)?;
001289 |     if !source_attrs.contains_key(b"com.apple.provenance".as_slice()) {
001290 |         target_attrs.remove(b"com.apple.provenance".as_slice());
001291 |     }
001292 |     if source_attrs != target_attrs {
001293 |         return Err(invalid("account copy attributes differ"));
001294 |     }
001295 |     if left.is_dir() {
001296 |         let mut sources = fs::read_dir(from)?.collect::<io::Result<Vec<_>>>()?;
001297 |         let mut targets = fs::read_dir(to)?.collect::<io::Result<Vec<_>>>()?;
001298 |         sources.sort_by_key(|entry| entry.file_name());
001299 |         targets.sort_by_key(|entry| entry.file_name());
001300 |         if sources.len() != targets.len() {
001301 |             return Err(invalid("account copy paths differ"));
001302 |         }
001303 |         for (source, target) in sources.into_iter().zip(targets) {
001304 |             if source.file_name() != target.file_name() {
001305 |                 return Err(invalid("account copy paths differ"));
001306 |             }
001307 |             verify_copy_tree(&source.path(), &target.path())?;
001308 |         }
001309 |     } else {
001310 |         let open = |path: &Path, metadata: &fs::Metadata| -> io::Result<File> {
001311 |             let file = fs::OpenOptions::new()
001312 |                 .read(true)
001313 |                 .custom_flags(libc::O_NOFOLLOW | libc::O_CLOEXEC)
001314 |                 .open(path)?;
001315 |             let opened = file.metadata()?;
001316 |             if opened.dev() != metadata.dev() || opened.ino() != metadata.ino() {
001317 |                 return Err(invalid("account copy file replaced during proof"));
001318 |             }
001319 |             Ok(file)
001320 |         };
001321 |         let mut source = open(from, &left)?;
001322 |         let mut target = open(to, &right)?;
001323 |         let mut a = [0; 65536];
001324 |         let mut b = [0; 65536];
001325 |         loop {
001326 |             let count = source.read(&mut a)?;
001327 |             if count == 0 {
001328 |                 if target.read(&mut b[..1])? != 0 {
001329 |                     return Err(invalid("account copy content differs"));
001330 |                 }
001331 |                 break;
001332 |             }
001333 |             target.read_exact(&mut b[..count])?;
001334 |             if a[..count] != b[..count] {
001335 |                 return Err(invalid("account copy content differs"));
001336 |             }
001337 |         }
001338 |     }
001339 |     Ok(())
001340 | }
001341 | fn sync_tree(path: &Path) -> io::Result<()> {
001342 |     let metadata = fs::symlink_metadata(path)?;
001343 |     if metadata.is_dir() {
001344 |         for entry in fs::read_dir(path)? {
001345 |             sync_tree(&entry?.path())?;
001346 |         }
001347 |         storage::sync_directory(path)
001348 |     } else {
001349 |         File::open(path)?.sync_all()
001350 |     }
001351 | }
001352 | #[cfg(target_os = "macos")]
001353 | pub(crate) fn extended_attributes(path: &Path) -> io::Result<BTreeMap<Vec<u8>, Vec<u8>>> {
001354 |     const LIMIT: usize = 16 * 1024 * 1024;
001355 |     let path = path_cstring(path)?;
001356 |     let count =
001357 |         unsafe { libc::listxattr(path.as_ptr(), std::ptr::null_mut(), 0, libc::XATTR_NOFOLLOW) };
001358 |     if count < 0 {
001359 |         return Err(io::Error::last_os_error());
001360 |     }
001361 |     if count as usize > LIMIT {
001362 |         return Err(invalid("extended attributes too large"));
001363 |     }
001364 |     let mut names = vec![0u8; count as usize];
001365 |     let actual = unsafe {
001366 |         libc::listxattr(
001367 |             path.as_ptr(),
001368 |             names.as_mut_ptr().cast(),
001369 |             names.len(),
001370 |             libc::XATTR_NOFOLLOW,
001371 |         )
001372 |     };
001373 |     if actual < 0 || actual as usize != names.len() {
001374 |         return Err(invalid("extended attributes changed during scan"));
001375 |     }
001376 |     let mut attrs = BTreeMap::new();
001377 |     let mut attribute_bytes = names.len();
001378 |     for name in names
001379 |         .split(|byte| *byte == 0)
001380 |         .filter(|name| !name.is_empty())
001381 |     {
001382 |         let c_name = CString::new(name).map_err(io::Error::other)?;
001383 |         let count = unsafe {
001384 |             libc::getxattr(
001385 |                 path.as_ptr(),
001386 |                 c_name.as_ptr(),
001387 |                 std::ptr::null_mut(),
001388 |                 0,
001389 |                 0,
001390 |                 libc::XATTR_NOFOLLOW,
001391 |             )
001392 |         };
001393 |         if count < 0 {
001394 |             return Err(io::Error::last_os_error());
001395 |         }
001396 |         attribute_bytes = attribute_bytes
001397 |             .checked_add(count as usize)
001398 |             .ok_or_else(|| invalid("extended attributes size overflow"))?;
001399 |         if attribute_bytes > LIMIT {
001400 |             return Err(invalid("extended attributes too large"));
001401 |         }
001402 |         let mut value = vec![0u8; count as usize];
001403 |         let actual = unsafe {
001404 |             libc::getxattr(
001405 |                 path.as_ptr(),
001406 |                 c_name.as_ptr(),
001407 |                 value.as_mut_ptr().cast(),
001408 |                 value.len(),
001409 |                 0,
001410 |                 libc::XATTR_NOFOLLOW,
001411 |             )
001412 |         };
001413 |         if actual < 0 || actual as usize != value.len() {
001414 |             return Err(invalid("extended attribute changed during scan"));
001415 |         }
001416 |         attrs.insert(name.to_vec(), value);
001417 |     }
001418 |     #[cfg(test)]
001419 |     COPY_PROVENANCE.with(|value| {
001420 |         if let Some(map) = value.borrow().as_ref() {
001421 |             attrs.remove(b"com.apple.provenance".as_slice());
001422 |             let path = Path::new(std::ffi::OsStr::from_bytes(path.as_bytes()));
001423 |             let metadata = fs::symlink_metadata(path).unwrap();
001424 |             if let Some(attribute) = map.get(&(metadata.dev(), metadata.ino())) {
001425 |                 attrs.insert(b"com.apple.provenance".to_vec(), attribute.clone());
001426 |             }
001427 |         }
001428 |     });
001429 |     Ok(attrs)
001430 | }
001431 | #[cfg(not(target_os = "macos"))]
001432 | pub(crate) fn extended_attributes(_: &Path) -> io::Result<BTreeMap<Vec<u8>, Vec<u8>>> {
001433 |     Err(io::Error::new(
001434 |         io::ErrorKind::Unsupported,
001435 |         "account metadata copying requires macOS",
001436 |     ))
001437 | }

001439 | /// Narrow Darwin ACL FFI. Read-only and deny ACLs are preserved; write-grant ACLs require manual review.
001440 | #[cfg(target_os = "macos")]
001441 | pub(crate) fn access_control(path: &Path) -> io::Result<Vec<u8>> {
001442 |     use std::ffi::c_void;
001443 |     unsafe extern "C" {
001444 |         fn acl_get_link_np(path: *const libc::c_char, kind: libc::c_int) -> *mut c_void;
001445 |         fn acl_free(value: *mut c_void) -> libc::c_int;
001446 |         fn acl_valid(acl: *mut c_void) -> libc::c_int;
001447 |         fn acl_get_entry(
001448 |             acl: *mut c_void,
001449 |             index: libc::c_int,
001450 |             entry: *mut *mut c_void,
001451 |         ) -> libc::c_int;
001452 |         fn acl_get_tag_type(entry: *mut c_void, tag: *mut libc::c_int) -> libc::c_int;
001453 |         fn acl_get_permset_mask_np(entry: *mut c_void, mask: *mut u64) -> libc::c_int;
001454 |         fn acl_to_text(acl: *mut c_void, length: *mut libc::ssize_t) -> *mut libc::c_char;
001455 |     }
001456 |     struct Allocation(*mut c_void);
001457 |     impl Drop for Allocation {
001458 |         fn drop(&mut self) {
001459 |             if !self.0.is_null() {
001460 |                 unsafe {
001461 |                     acl_free(self.0);
001462 |                 }
001463 |             }
001464 |         }
001465 |     }
001466 |     let c_path = path_cstring(path)?;
001467 |     let acl = Allocation(unsafe { acl_get_link_np(c_path.as_ptr(), 0x100) }); // ACL_TYPE_EXTENDED, sys/acl.h.
001468 |     if acl.0.is_null() {
001469 |         let error = io::Error::last_os_error();
001470 |         // Darwin reports ENOENT for an existing object without an extended ACL.
001471 |         if error.raw_os_error() == Some(libc::ENOENT) {
001472 |             let metadata = fs::symlink_metadata(path)?;
001473 |             if !metadata.file_type().is_symlink() && (metadata.is_file() || metadata.is_dir()) {
001474 |                 return Ok(Vec::new());
001475 |             }
001476 |         }
001477 |         return Err(error);
001478 |     }
001479 |     if unsafe { acl_valid(acl.0) } != 0 {
001480 |         return Err(invalid("invalid account ACL"));
001481 |     }
001482 |     let mut index = 0; // ACL_FIRST_ENTRY. Darwin returns EINVAL at the end of a valid ACL.
001483 |     loop {
001484 |         let mut entry = std::ptr::null_mut();
001485 |         if unsafe { acl_get_entry(acl.0, index, &mut entry) } != 0 {
001486 |             let error = io::Error::last_os_error();
001487 |             if error.raw_os_error() == Some(libc::EINVAL) {
001488 |                 break;
001489 |             }
001490 |             return Err(error);
001491 |         }
001492 |         index = -1; // ACL_NEXT_ENTRY.
001493 |         let mut tag = 0;
001494 |         let mut mask = 0u64;
001495 |         if unsafe { acl_get_tag_type(entry, &mut tag) } != 0
001496 |             || unsafe { acl_get_permset_mask_np(entry, &mut mask) } != 0
001497 |         {
001498 |             return Err(io::Error::last_os_error());
001499 |         }
001500 |         const MUTATING: u64 = (1 << 2)
001501 |             | (1 << 4)
001502 |             | (1 << 5)
001503 |             | (1 << 6)
001504 |             | (1 << 8)
001505 |             | (1 << 10)
001506 |             | (1 << 12)
001507 |             | (1 << 13);
001508 |         if tag != 1 && tag != 2 {
001509 |             return Err(invalid("unsupported account ACL entry"));
001510 |         }
001511 |         if tag == 1 && mask & MUTATING != 0 {
001512 |             return Err(denied(
001513 |                 "account ACL grants mutation; manual permission review required",
001514 |             ));
001515 |         }
001516 |     }
001517 |     let mut length = 0;
001518 |     let text = Allocation(unsafe { acl_to_text(acl.0, &mut length) }.cast());
001519 |     if text.0.is_null() {
001520 |         return Err(io::Error::last_os_error());
001521 |     }
001522 |     if !(0..=65536).contains(&length) {
001523 |         return Err(invalid("account ACL text too large"));
001524 |     }
001525 |     Ok(unsafe { std::slice::from_raw_parts(text.0.cast::<u8>(), length as usize) }.to_vec())
001526 | }
001527 | #[cfg(not(target_os = "macos"))]
001528 | pub(crate) fn access_control(_: &Path) -> io::Result<Vec<u8>> {
001529 |     Err(io::Error::new(
001530 |         io::ErrorKind::Unsupported,
001531 |         "account ACL validation requires macOS",
001532 |     ))
001533 | }

001852 |     fn killed_process_recovers_every_durable_and_physical_checkpoint() {
001853 |         use std::os::unix::process::ExitStatusExt;
001854 |         struct ChildGuard(std::process::Child);
001855 |         impl Drop for ChildGuard {
001856 |             fn drop(&mut self) {
001857 |                 let _ = self.0.kill();
001858 |                 let _ = self.0.wait();
001859 |             }
001860 |         }
001861 |         for point in PROCESS_CRASH_POINTS {
001862 |             let fixture = Fixture::new();
001863 |             fixture.initialize();

001880 |                         libc::setxattr(

001884 |                             value.len(),

001920 |             while !ready.exists() {

001922 |                     child.0.try_wait().unwrap().is_none(),
001923 |                     "child exited before {point}"
001924 |                 );
001925 |                 assert!(
001926 |                     std::time::Instant::now() < deadline,
001927 |                     "child timed out before {point}"
001928 |                 );
001929 |                 std::thread::sleep(std::time::Duration::from_millis(10));
001930 |             }
001931 |             assert_eq!(fs::read(&ready).unwrap(), point.as_bytes());

001933 |             assert_eq!(journal.original, original);
001934 |             assert_eq!(
001935 |                 LifecycleLock::try_acquire(&fixture.store.v2())

001937 |                     .kind(),
001938 |                 io::ErrorKind::WouldBlock
001939 |             );

001941 |             let status = child.0.wait().unwrap();
001942 |             assert_eq!(status.signal(), Some(libc::SIGKILL), "{point}");
001943 |             // Reopen after process death: no in-memory account state or lock survives.

001945 |                 &fixture.store.root,
001946 |                 &fixture.store.active,
001947 |                 fixture.store.owner,
001948 |             )

002199 |     fn restore_copy_times(path: &Path, before: &fs::Metadata) -> io::Result<()> {
002200 |         let times = [
002201 |             libc::timespec {
002202 |                 tv_sec: before.atime(),
002203 |                 tv_nsec: before.atime_nsec(),
002204 |             },
002205 |             libc::timespec {
002206 |                 tv_sec: before.mtime(),
002207 |                 tv_nsec: before.mtime_nsec(),
002208 |             },
002209 |         ];
002210 |         if unsafe {
002211 |             libc::utimensat(
002212 |                 libc::AT_FDCWD,
002213 |                 path_cstring(path)?.as_ptr(),
002214 |                 times.as_ptr(),
002215 |                 libc::AT_SYMLINK_NOFOLLOW,
002216 |             )
002217 |         } != 0
002218 |         {
002219 |             return Err(io::Error::last_os_error());
002220 |         }
002221 |         Ok(())
002222 |     }
002223 |     fn assert_copy_rejects_post_proof_mutation(mutate: CopyAfterProof) {

000092 | impl Drop for PendingStages {

000347 | fn copy(from: &Path, to: &Path) -> io::Result<()> {
000348 |     fn has_special(path: &Path) -> io::Result<bool> {
000349 |         let metadata = fs::symlink_metadata(path)?;
000350 |         if metadata.is_dir() {
000351 |             for child in fs::read_dir(path)? {
000352 |                 if has_special(&child?.path())? {
000353 |                     return Ok(true);
000354 |                 }
000355 |             }
000356 |             Ok(false)
000357 |         } else {
000358 |             Ok(!metadata.is_file() && !metadata.file_type().is_symlink())
000359 |         }
000360 |     }
000361 |     // Ditto can wait indefinitely on a FIFO. Let it attempt the copy, then report its timeout.
000362 |     let timeout = if has_special(from)? {
000363 |         std::time::Duration::from_secs(15)
000364 |     } else {
000365 |         std::time::Duration::from_secs(30 * 60)
000366 |     };
000367 |     copy_with_timeout(from, to, timeout)
000368 | }
000369 | fn copy_with_timeout(from: &Path, to: &Path, timeout: std::time::Duration) -> io::Result<()> {
000370 |     if to.exists() {
000371 |         return Err(invalid("copy destination exists"));
000372 |     }
000373 |     let before = fingerprint(from)?;
000374 |     let mut child = Command::new("/usr/bin/ditto")
000375 |         .args(["--rsrc", "--extattr", "--acl"])
000376 |         .arg(from)
000377 |         .arg(to)
000378 |         .env_clear()
000379 |         .env("LC_ALL", "C")
000380 |         .stdin(std::process::Stdio::null())
000381 |         .stdout(std::process::Stdio::null())
000382 |         .stderr(std::process::Stdio::null())
000383 |         .spawn()?;
000384 |     let deadline = std::time::Instant::now() + timeout;
000385 |     loop {
000386 |         match child.try_wait() {
000387 |             Ok(Some(status)) if status.success() => break,
000388 |             Ok(Some(_)) => return Err(io::Error::other("ditto could not copy account data")),
000389 |             Ok(None) if std::time::Instant::now() < deadline => {
000390 |                 std::thread::sleep(std::time::Duration::from_millis(20))
000391 |             }
000392 |             result => {
000393 |                 let _ = child.kill();
000394 |                 let _ = child.wait();
000395 |                 return Err(match result {
000396 |                     Err(error) => error,
000397 |                     _ => io::Error::new(
000398 |                         io::ErrorKind::TimedOut,
000399 |                         "ditto account copy timed out; original data preserved",
000400 |                     ),
000401 |                 });
000402 |             }
000403 |         }
000404 |     }
000405 |     if fingerprint(from)? != before || fingerprint(to)? != before {
000406 |         return Err(invalid("account copy content differs"));
000407 |     }
000408 |     sync_copy(to)
000409 | }
000410 | fn sync_copy(path: &Path) -> io::Result<()> {
000411 |     let metadata = fs::symlink_metadata(path)?;
000412 |     if metadata.is_dir() {
000413 |         for entry in fs::read_dir(path)? {
000414 |             sync_copy(&entry?.path())?;
000415 |         }
000416 |         storage::sync_directory(path)
000417 |     } else if metadata.is_file() {
000418 |         fs::OpenOptions::new()
000419 |             .read(true)
000420 |             .custom_flags(libc::O_NOFOLLOW | libc::O_CLOEXEC)
000421 |             .open(path)?
000422 |             .sync_all()
000423 |     } else {
000424 |         Ok(())
000425 |     }
000426 | }
000427 | /// Content proof, not an owner/mode/ACL policy. Never follows symbolic links or opens devices/FIFOs.
000428 | fn fingerprint(root: &Path) -> io::Result<String> {
000429 |     fn walk(root: &Path, path: &Path, digest: &mut Sha256) -> io::Result<()> {
000430 |         let metadata = fs::symlink_metadata(path)?;
000431 |         let relative = path
000432 |             .strip_prefix(root)
000433 |             .map_err(io::Error::other)?
000434 |             .as_os_str()
000435 |             .as_bytes();
000436 |         digest.update((relative.len() as u64).to_le_bytes());
000437 |         digest.update(relative);
000438 |         digest.update((metadata.mode() & u32::from(libc::S_IFMT)).to_le_bytes());
000439 |         if metadata.file_type().is_symlink() {
000440 |             let target = fs::read_link(path)?;
000441 |             let bytes = target.as_os_str().as_bytes();
000442 |             digest.update((bytes.len() as u64).to_le_bytes());
000443 |             digest.update(bytes);
000444 |         } else if metadata.is_dir() {
000445 |             let mut entries = fs::read_dir(path)?.collect::<io::Result<Vec<_>>>()?;
000446 |             entries.sort_by_key(|entry| entry.file_name());
000447 |             for entry in entries {
000448 |                 walk(root, &entry.path(), digest)?;
000449 |             }
000450 |         } else if metadata.is_file() {
000451 |             digest.update(metadata.len().to_le_bytes());
000452 |             let mut file = fs::OpenOptions::new()
000453 |                 .read(true)
000454 |                 .custom_flags(libc::O_NOFOLLOW | libc::O_CLOEXEC)
000455 |                 .open(path)?;
000456 |             let opened = file.metadata()?;
000457 |             if opened.dev() != metadata.dev() || opened.ino() != metadata.ino() {
000458 |                 return Err(invalid("account file changed while reading"));
000459 |             }
000460 |             let mut buffer = [0; 65536];
000461 |             loop {
000462 |                 let size = file.read(&mut buffer)?;
000463 |                 if size == 0 {
000464 |                     break;
000465 |                 }
000466 |                 digest.update(&buffer[..size]);
000467 |             }
000468 |         } else {
000469 |             digest.update(metadata.rdev().to_le_bytes());
000470 |         }
000471 |         Ok(())
000472 |     }
000473 |     let mut digest = Sha256::new();
000474 |     walk(root, root, &mut digest)?;
000475 |     Ok(digest
000476 |         .finalize()
000477 |         .iter()
000478 |         .map(|byte| format!("{byte:02x}"))
000479 |         .collect())
000480 | }

000894 |             "archived",

000901 |             fixture.select(AccountId::A);
000902 |             struct Child(std::process::Child);
000903 |             impl Drop for Child {
000904 |                 fn drop(&mut self) {
000905 |                     let _ = self.0.kill();
000906 |                     let _ = self.0.wait();
000907 |                 }
000908 |             }
000909 |             let mut child = Child(
000910 |                 Command::new(std::env::current_exe().unwrap())

000917 |                     .env("SWITCHER_LEGACY_CRASH_PHASE", phase)
000918 |                     .stdin(std::process::Stdio::null())
000919 |                     .stdout(std::process::Stdio::null())
000920 |                     .stderr(std::process::Stdio::null())
000921 |                     .spawn()
000922 |                     .unwrap(),
000923 |             );
000924 |             let deadline = std::time::Instant::now() + std::time::Duration::from_secs(10);

000938 |             child.0.wait().unwrap();
000939 |             let lock = LifecycleLock::try_acquire(&fixture.store.v2()).unwrap();

000118 |     fn get(&mut self, url: &Url, limit: usize) -> Result<Download> {
000119 |         let response = self
000120 |             .client
000121 |             .get(url.clone())
000122 |             .header(
000123 |                 reqwest::header::ACCEPT,
000124 |                 "application/json,image/png,image/jpeg",
000125 |             )
000126 |             .send()
000127 |             .map_err(|_| "ad_network")?;
000128 |         if response.status() != reqwest::StatusCode::OK || response.url() != url {
000129 |             return Err("ad_http_status_or_redirect");
000130 |         }
000131 |         if response
000132 |             .content_length()
000133 |             .is_some_and(|length| length > limit as u64)
000134 |         {
000135 |             return Err("ad_download_size");
000136 |         }
000137 |         let mime = response
000138 |             .headers()
000139 |             .get(reqwest::header::CONTENT_TYPE)
000140 |             .and_then(|value| value.to_str().ok())
000141 |             .map(str::to_owned);
000142 |         let final_url = response.url().clone();

000144 |         response
000145 |             .take(limit as u64 + 1)
000146 |             .read_to_end(&mut bytes)
000147 |             .map_err(|_| "ad_download")?;
000148 |         if bytes.len() > limit {
000149 |             return Err("ad_download_size");
000150 |         }
000151 |         Ok(Download {
000152 |             bytes,
000153 |             mime,
000154 |             final_url,
000155 |         })
000156 |     }

000166 | fn jitter() -> Result<u8> {
000167 |     for _ in 0..16 {
000168 |         let mut byte = 0u8;
000169 |         // SAFETY: getentropy writes exactly the single-byte buffer and uses the OS CSPRNG.
000170 |         if unsafe { libc::getentropy((&mut byte as *mut u8).cast(), 1) } != 0 {
000171 |             return Err("ad_random");
000172 |         }
000173 |         if byte < 244 {
000174 |             return Ok(byte % 61);
000175 |         }
000176 |     }
000177 |     Err("ad_random")
000178 | }

000181 |         Ok(previous) if previous == bytes => return Ok(()),

000183 |         Err(error) if error.kind() == std::io::ErrorKind::NotFound => {}
000184 |         Err(_) => return Err("ad_state_read"),
000185 |     }
000186 |     storage::atomic_write(path, bytes).map_err(|_| "ad_state_write")
000187 | }

000354 |     fn refresh_locked(
000355 |         &self,
000356 |         preferences: &AdPreferences,
000357 |         manual: bool,
000358 |         sample: ClockSample,
000359 |         supplied: Option<&mut dyn Fetcher>,
000360 |         fixed_jitter: Option<u8>,
000361 |     ) -> Result<RefreshResult> {
000362 |         let (mut state, mut clock) = self.load(&sample)?;
000363 |         let now = utc(&sample)?;

000365 |             && self.pins.as_ref().is_some_and(|pins| pins.local)
000366 |             && local::current_digest(&self.root)?.is_none();
000367 |         let reason = if local_empty {
000368 |             Some("local_ad_not_published")
000369 |         } else if !enabled(preferences) {
000370 |             Some("ads_disabled")
000371 |         } else if self.pins.is_none() {
000372 |             Some("wait_ad_content_materials")
000373 |         } else if !clock.allows_verified_refresh() {
000374 |             Some("clock_recovery_required")
000375 |         } else if !self.local_changed(&state)?
000376 |             && !state.schedule.begin(now, preferences, true, manual)

000378 |             Some("ad_refresh_not_due_or_merged")

000381 |         };

000383 |             self.save(&state, &clock)?;
000384 |             // Keep a failed local release visible as a diagnostic during backoff,
000385 |             // including when the background tick performed the first attempt.
000386 |             if reason == "ad_refresh_not_due_or_merged"
000387 |                 && self.pins.as_ref().is_some_and(|pins| pins.local)

000390 |             {
000391 |                 return Err("local_ad_previous_content_verification_failed");
000392 |             }
000393 |             return Ok(RefreshResult {
000394 |                 refreshed: false,
000395 |                 reason,
000396 |                 next_check_at: state.schedule.next_check_at,
000397 |             });
000398 |         }
000399 |         // Only an actual refresh advances the normal observation baseline.
000400 |         clock.observe(sample.clone());
000401 |         if self.pins.as_ref().is_some_and(|pins| pins.local) {
000402 |             state.local_attempt_hash = local::current_digest(&self.root)?;
000403 |         }
000404 |         self.save(&state, &clock)?;

000421 |                 Some(value) => value,

000535 |         confirmed: bool,

000537 |     ) -> Result<ClickDecision> {

000545 |     fn click_locked(
000546 |         &self,
000547 |         slot: AdSlot,
000548 |         confirmed: bool,
000549 |         preferences: &AdPreferences,
000550 |         sample: &ClockSample,
000551 |     ) -> Result<ClickDecision> {
000552 |         let (mut state, mut clock) = self.load(sample)?;
000553 |         clock.observe(sample.clone());
000554 |         let now = utc(sample)?;
000555 |         // A rejected click must still persist a detected clock anomaly.
000556 |         self.save(&state, &clock)?;
000557 |         let visible = self
000558 |             .visible(&state, &clock, preferences, now)
000559 |             .ok_or("ad_not_current")?;
000560 |         let campaign = visible
000561 |             .slots
000562 |             .iter()
000563 |             .find(|content| content.slot == slot)
000564 |             .and_then(|content| content.campaigns.first())
000565 |             .ok_or("ad_not_current")?;
000566 |         let (url, host) = ads::normalize_merchant_url(&campaign.target_url)?;
000567 |         if ads::click_requires_confirmation(&state.consents, slot, campaign)? {
000568 |             let matches = state.confirmations.iter().any(|confirmation| {
000569 |                 confirmation.slot == slot
000570 |                     && confirmation.merchant_id == campaign.merchant_id
000571 |                     && confirmation.normalized_host == host
000572 |                     && confirmation.campaign_id == campaign.campaign_id
000573 |                     && confirmation.release_id == visible.release_id
000574 |                     && confirmation.requested_at <= now
000575 |                     && now < confirmation.requested_at.saturating_add(300)
000576 |             });
000577 |             if !confirmed || !matches {
000578 |                 state
000579 |                     .confirmations
000580 |                     .retain(|confirmation| confirmation.slot != slot);
000581 |                 state.confirmations.push(Confirmation {
000582 |                     slot,
000583 |                     merchant_id: campaign.merchant_id.clone(),
000584 |                     normalized_host: host.clone(),
000585 |                     campaign_id: campaign.campaign_id.clone(),
000586 |                     release_id: visible.release_id,
000587 |                     requested_at: now,
000588 |                 });
000589 |                 self.save(&state, &clock)?;
000590 |                 return Ok(ClickDecision::NeedsConfirmation {
000591 |                     merchant_name: campaign.merchant_name.clone(),
000592 |                     normalized_host: host,
000593 |                 });
000594 |             }
000595 |             ads::record_click_consent(&mut state.consents, slot, campaign)?;
000596 |         }
000597 |         state
000598 |             .confirmations
000599 |             .retain(|confirmation| confirmation.slot != slot);
000600 |         self.save(&state, &clock)?;
000601 |         Ok(ClickDecision::Ready { url })
000602 |     }

000011 |    独立 CA:TRUE 根证书签发带 DNS SAN、serverAuth 和 CA:FALSE 的叶证书。
000012 |    客户端只增加该测试根证书，固定域名解析到 loopback。清单与 PNG 完成下载、签名与素材校验并可展示。
000013 | 3. 同一 HTTPS 测试拒绝未信任 CA、HTTP 重定向、签名篡改与超限响应。
000014 |    捕获的两次成功请求只有固定 production 路径，没有 query、认证、Cookie、Referer、User-Agent 或账号/设备标识头。
000015 | 4. 其余测试验证共享时钟恢复、离线期限、单广告位素材门控、调度持久化、失败素材保留最高序号、商家确认和缓存防重放。
000016 | 
000017 | 测试不使用 `danger_accept_invalid_certs` 或禁用主机名校验。
000018 | 测试证书、签名密钥和 DNS 覆盖只存在于 `#[cfg(test)]` 模块。
000019 | 测试使用本机 OpenSSL 和 Python 生成合成 TLS 服务。服务在 fixture 析构时终止，临时目录随后删除。
000020 | 
000021 | 生产 `ContentPins::production()` 仍为 `None`。
000022 | 生产零请求等待不能替代已配置源的全关证明；两条路径有独立测试。
000023 | 此证据不覆盖真实托管、真实生产证书链、真实 Keychain、远端 CAS 和线上持续运行验收。
000024 | 实际单服务适配器所需材料见 Personal 发布器的 `publisher/README.md`。

000005 | #[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Eq, Serialize, Deserialize)]
000006 | #[serde(deny_unknown_fields)]
000007 | pub struct LocalTrust {
000008 |     pub schema: u32,
000009 |     pub key_id: String,
000010 |     pub public_key: [u8; 32],
000011 | }
000012 | impl LocalTrust {
000013 |     pub fn validate(&self) -> Result<()> {
000014 |         if self.schema != 1 || self.key_id != "ads-personal-v1" {
000015 |             return Err("local_ad_trust_scope");
000016 |         }
000017 |         VerifyingKey::from_bytes(&self.public_key).map_err(|_| "local_ad_trust_key")?;
000018 |         Ok(())
000019 |     }
000020 | }
000021 | pub fn directory(application_root: &Path) -> PathBuf {
000022 |     application_root.join("v2/local-ads")
000023 | }
000024 | pub fn validate_directory(path: &Path) -> Result<()> {
000025 |     storage::validate_no_symlinks(path).map_err(|_| "local_ad_directory")?;
000026 |     let metadata = std::fs::metadata(path).map_err(|_| "local_ad_directory")?;
000027 |     if !metadata.is_dir()
000028 |         || metadata.uid() != unsafe { libc::geteuid() }
000029 |         || metadata.mode() & 0o077 != 0
000030 |     {
000031 |         return Err("local_ad_directory");
000032 |     }
000033 |     Ok(())
000034 | }
000035 | fn read(root: &Path, key: &str, limit: usize) -> Result<Vec<u8>> {
000036 |     validate_directory(root)?;
000037 |     validate_directory(root.parent().ok_or("local_ad_directory")?)?;
000038 |     let path = root.join(key);
000039 |     if let Some(channel) = key.split('/').next().filter(|_| key.contains('/')) {
000040 |         validate_directory(&root.join(channel))?;
000041 |     }
000042 |     validate_directory(path.parent().ok_or("local_ad_directory")?)?;
000043 |     storage::read_private_bytes(&path, limit).map_err(|_| "local_ad_read")
000044 | }
000045 | pub(super) fn pins(application_root: &Path) -> Result<Option<ContentPins>> {
000046 |     let root = directory(application_root);
000047 |     match std::fs::symlink_metadata(&root) {
000048 |         Err(error) if error.kind() == io::ErrorKind::NotFound => return Ok(None),
000049 |         Err(_) => return Err("local_ad_directory"),
000050 |         Ok(_) => {}
000051 |     }
000052 |     validate_directory(&root)?;
000053 |     let bytes = match storage::read_private_bytes(&root.join("trust.json"), 4096) {
000054 |         Ok(bytes) => bytes,
000055 |         Err(error) if error.kind() == io::ErrorKind::NotFound => return Ok(None),
000056 |         Err(_) => return Err("local_ad_trust_read"),
000057 |     };
000058 |     let trust: LocalTrust = signed::strict_json(&bytes, 4096)?;
000059 |     trust.validate()?;
000060 |     Ok(Some(ContentPins {
000061 |         source: ContentSource::new(ROUTING_BASE)?,
000062 |         key: VerifyingKey::from_bytes(&trust.public_key).map_err(|_| "local_ad_trust_key")?,
000063 |         key_id: trust.key_id,
000064 |         channel: AdChannel::Production,
000065 |         local: true,
000066 |     }))
000067 | }
000068 | pub(super) struct LocalFetcher {
000069 |     pub root: PathBuf,
000070 | }
000071 | impl Fetcher for LocalFetcher {
000072 |     fn get(&mut self, url: &Url, limit: usize) -> Result<Download> {
000073 |         let source = ContentSource::new(ROUTING_BASE)?;
000074 |         if !source.permits_response_url(url, url) {
000075 |             return Err("local_ad_key");
000076 |         }
000077 |         let key = url
000078 |             .as_str()
000079 |             .strip_prefix(ROUTING_BASE)
000080 |             .ok_or("local_ad_key")?;
000081 |         if !key.starts_with("production/") {
000082 |             return Err("local_ad_environment");
000083 |         }
000084 |         let mime = if key.ends_with(".json") {
000085 |             "application/json"
000086 |         } else if key.ends_with(".png") {
000087 |             "image/png"
000088 |         } else {
000089 |             "image/jpeg"
000090 |         };
000091 |         Ok(Download {
000092 |             bytes: read(&self.root, key, limit)?,
000093 |             mime: Some(mime.into()),
000094 |             final_url: url.clone(),
000095 |         })
000096 |     }
000097 | }
000098 | /// No writes and no network access. Missing publication is an ordinary local WAIT.
000099 | pub fn configured(application_root: &Path) -> bool {
000100 |     matches!(pins(application_root), Ok(Some(_)))
000101 | }
000102 | pub(super) fn current_digest(root: &Path) -> Result<Option<String>> {
000103 |     let root = directory(root);
000104 |     validate_directory(&root)?;
000105 |     validate_directory(&root.join("production"))?;
000106 |     match storage::read_private_bytes(
000107 |         &root.join("production/current.json"),
000108 |         ads::MAX_MANIFEST_BYTES,
000109 |     ) {
000110 |         Ok(bytes) => Ok(Some(signed::digest(&bytes))),
000111 |         Err(error) if error.kind() == io::ErrorKind::NotFound => Ok(None),
000112 |         Err(_) => Err("local_ad_current_read"),
000113 |     }
000114 | }

000354 | fn response_once(response: &'static [u8]) -> (Url, std::thread::JoinHandle<String>) {
000355 |     use std::io::{Read, Write};
000356 |     let listener = std::net::TcpListener::bind("127.0.0.1:0").unwrap();
000357 |     let address = listener.local_addr().unwrap();
000358 |     let handle = std::thread::spawn(move || {
000359 |         let (mut stream, _) = listener.accept().unwrap();
000360 |         stream
000361 |             .set_read_timeout(Some(Duration::from_secs(2)))
000362 |             .unwrap();
000363 |         let mut buffer = [0u8; 4096];
000364 |         let count = stream.read(&mut buffer).unwrap();
000365 |         stream.write_all(response).unwrap();
000366 |         String::from_utf8_lossy(&buffer[..count]).into_owned()
000367 |     });
000368 |     (
000369 |         Url::parse(&format!("http://{address}/content/")).unwrap(),
000370 |         handle,
000371 |     )
000372 | }

000756 | fn passive_file_snapshot(path: &std::path::Path) -> (Vec<u8>, u64, i64, i64) {
000757 |     use std::os::unix::fs::MetadataExt;
000758 |     let m = std::fs::symlink_metadata(path).unwrap();
000759 |     (
000760 |         std::fs::read(path).unwrap(),
000761 |         m.ino(),
000762 |         m.mtime(),
000763 |         m.mtime_nsec(),
000764 |     )
000765 | }

000030 |         && !value.chars().any(char::is_control)
000031 | }
000032 | 
000033 | fn valid_id(value: &str) -> bool {
000034 |     !value.is_empty()
000035 |         && value.len() <= 128
000036 |         && value
000037 |             .bytes()
000038 |             .all(|b| b.is_ascii_alphanumeric() || matches!(b, b'-' | b'_'))
000039 | }
000040 | 
000041 | fn valid_hash(value: &str) -> bool {
000042 |     value.len() == 64
000043 |         && value
000044 |             .bytes()
000045 |             .all(|b| b.is_ascii_digit() || (b'a'..=b'f').contains(&b))
000046 | }
000047 | 
000048 | fn valid_dimensions(width: u32, height: u32) -> bool {
000049 |     width > 0 && height > 0 && u64::from(width) * u64::from(height) <= MAX_IMAGE_PIXELS
000050 | }

000052 | pub fn validate_asset(asset: &ImageAsset) -> Result<(), &'static str> {
000053 |     if !valid_hash(&asset.sha256) {
000054 |         return Err("image_hash");
000055 |     }
000056 |     if !matches!(asset.mime.as_str(), "image/png" | "image/jpeg") {
000057 |         return Err("image_mime");
000058 |     }
000059 |     if asset.bytes == 0 || asset.bytes as usize > MAX_IMAGE_BYTES {
000060 |         return Err("image_size");
000061 |     }
000062 |     if !valid_dimensions(asset.width, asset.height) {
000063 |         return Err("image_dimensions");
000064 |     }
000065 |     Ok(())
000066 | }

000068 | /// Canonical browser target and the exact host shown before the first click.
000069 | pub fn normalize_merchant_url(raw: &str) -> Result<(String, String), &'static str> {
000070 |     if raw.len() > 2048 || raw.trim() != raw || raw.chars().any(char::is_control) {
000071 |         return Err("merchant_url");
000072 |     }
000073 |     let authority = raw
000074 |         .split_once("://")
000075 |         .map(|(_, tail)| tail.split(['/', '?', '#']).next().unwrap_or_default())
000076 |         .ok_or("merchant_url")?;
000077 |     if authority.contains('@') {
000078 |         return Err("merchant_userinfo");
000079 |     }
000080 |     let mut url = Url::parse(raw).map_err(|_| "merchant_url")?;
000081 |     if url.scheme() != "https" {
000082 |         return Err("merchant_scheme");
000083 |     }
000084 |     if !url.username().is_empty() || url.password().is_some() {
000085 |         return Err("merchant_userinfo");
000086 |     }
000087 |     if url.port_or_known_default() != Some(443) {
000088 |         return Err("merchant_port");
000089 |     }
000090 |     let host = match url.host() {
000091 |         Some(Host::Domain(host)) => host.trim_end_matches('.').to_ascii_lowercase(),
000092 |         _ => return Err("merchant_host"),
000093 |     };
000094 |     let labels: Vec<_> = host.split('.').collect();
000095 |     if host.len() > 253
000096 |         || labels.len() < 2
000097 |         || labels.iter().any(|label| {
000098 |             label.is_empty()
000099 |                 || label.len() > 63
000100 |                 || label.starts_with('-')
000101 |                 || label.ends_with('-')
000102 |                 || !label
000103 |                     .bytes()
000104 |                     .all(|b| b.is_ascii_alphanumeric() || b == b'-')
000105 |         })
000106 |     {
000107 |         return Err("merchant_host");
000108 |     }
000109 |     let tld = *labels.last().ok_or("merchant_host")?;
000110 |     if !tld.bytes().any(|b| b.is_ascii_alphabetic())
000111 |         || [
000112 |             "localhost",
000113 |             "local",
000114 |             "localdomain",
000115 |             "internal",
000116 |             "home",
000117 |             "lan",
000118 |             "test",
000119 |             "invalid",
000120 |             "example",
000121 |             "onion",
000122 |             "alt",
000123 |             "arpa",
000124 |         ]
000125 |         .contains(&tld)
000126 |     {
000127 |         return Err("merchant_host");
000128 |     }
000129 |     url.set_host(Some(&host)).map_err(|_| "merchant_host")?;
000130 |     Ok((url.into(), host))
000131 | }

000140 |         consent.slot == slot
000141 |             && consent.merchant_id == campaign.merchant_id
000142 |             && consent.normalized_host == host

000161 | pub fn validate_manifest(
000162 |     manifest: &AdManifest,
000163 |     channel: AdChannel,
000164 |     key_id: &str,
000165 |     now: u64,
000166 | ) -> Result<(), &'static str> {
000167 |     if manifest.schema_version != 1 {
000168 |         return Err("manifest_schema");
000169 |     }
000170 |     if manifest.channel != channel || manifest.key_id != key_id {
000171 |         return Err("manifest_scope");
000172 |     }
000173 |     if !valid_id(&manifest.key_id) || !valid_id(&manifest.release_id) {
000174 |         return Err("manifest_id");
000175 |     }
000176 |     if manifest.content_revision == 0 || manifest.content_revision > MAX_SAFE_INTEGER {
000177 |         return Err("manifest_revision");
000178 |     }
000179 |     if manifest.issued_at > now
000180 |         || manifest.expires_at <= now
000181 |         || manifest.expires_at <= manifest.issued_at
000182 |         || manifest.expires_at - manifest.issued_at > MAX_MANIFEST_LIFETIME
000183 |         || manifest.expires_at > MAX_SAFE_INTEGER
000184 |     {
000185 |         return Err("manifest_time");
000186 |     }
000187 |     if manifest.slots.len() != 3 {
000188 |         return Err("manifest_slots");
000189 |     }
000190 |     let mut seen_slots = [false; 3];
000191 |     let mut ids = HashSet::new();
000192 |     for slot in &manifest.slots {
000193 |         let index = slot_index(slot.slot);
000194 |         if seen_slots[index] {
000195 |             return Err("manifest_slots");
000196 |         }
000197 |         seen_slots[index] = true;
000198 |         if slot.campaigns.len() > 2 {
000199 |             return Err("campaign_count");
000200 |         }
000201 |         for campaign in &slot.campaigns {
000202 |             if !valid_id(&campaign.campaign_id)
000203 |                 || !valid_id(&campaign.merchant_id)
000204 |                 || !ids.insert(&campaign.campaign_id)
000205 |             {
000206 |                 return Err("campaign_id");
000207 |             }
000208 |             if !bounded_text(&campaign.merchant_name, 128)
000209 |                 || !bounded_text(&campaign.title, 80)
000210 |                 || !bounded_text(&campaign.description, 500)
000211 |                 || !bounded_text(&campaign.button_text, 40)
000212 |             {
000213 |                 return Err("campaign_text");
000214 |             }
000215 |             if campaign.starts_at >= campaign.ends_at || campaign.ends_at > MAX_SAFE_INTEGER {
000216 |                 return Err("campaign_time");
000217 |             }
000218 |             normalize_merchant_url(&campaign.target_url)?;
000219 |             validate_asset(&campaign.image)?;
000220 |         }
000221 |         if let [first, second] = slot.campaigns.as_slice()
000222 |             && first.starts_at < second.ends_at
000223 |             && second.starts_at < first.ends_at
000224 |         {
000225 |             return Err("campaign_overlap");
000226 |         }
000227 |     }
000228 |     Ok(())
000229 | }
000230 | 
000231 | pub fn verify_manifest(
000232 |     wire: &[u8],
000233 |     key: &VerifyingKey,
000234 |     channel: AdChannel,
000235 |     key_id: &str,
000236 |     now: u64,
000237 |     time_trusted: bool,
000238 | ) -> Result<(AdManifest, String), &'static str> {
000239 |     if !time_trusted {
000240 |         return Err("clock_untrusted");
000241 |     }
000242 |     let (manifest, hash) = signed::verify(wire, key, MAX_MANIFEST_BYTES)?;
000243 |     validate_manifest(&manifest, channel, key_id, now)?;
000244 |     Ok((manifest, hash))
000245 | }

000247 | #[derive(Debug, Default, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize)]
000248 | #[serde(deny_unknown_fields)]
000249 | pub struct AdCache {
000250 |     pub highest_revision: u64,
000251 |     pub highest_payload_hash: Option<String>,
000252 |     pub last_success: Option<u64>,
000253 |     pub cached_wire: Option<Vec<u8>>,
000254 |     #[serde(skip)]
000255 |     manifest: Option<AdManifest>,
000256 | }
000257 | 
000258 | impl AdCache {
000259 |     pub fn accept(
000260 |         &mut self,
000261 |         wire: &[u8],
000262 |         key: &VerifyingKey,
000263 |         channel: AdChannel,
000264 |         key_id: &str,
000265 |         now: u64,
000266 |         time_trusted: bool,
000267 |     ) -> Result<(), &'static str> {
000268 |         let (manifest, hash) = verify_manifest(wire, key, channel, key_id, now, time_trusted)?;
000269 |         if manifest.content_revision < self.highest_revision {
000270 |             return Err("old_revision");
000271 |         }
000272 |         if manifest.content_revision == self.highest_revision
000273 |             && self.highest_payload_hash.as_deref() != Some(&hash)
000274 |         {
000275 |             return Err("revision_conflict");
000276 |         }
000277 |         self.highest_revision = manifest.content_revision;
000278 |         self.highest_payload_hash = Some(hash);
000279 |         self.last_success = Some(now);
000280 |         self.cached_wire = Some(wire.to_vec());
000281 |         self.manifest = Some(manifest);
000282 |         Ok(())
000283 |     }
000284 | 
000285 |     /// Restoring disk cache never extends the offline deadline.
000286 |     pub fn restore_verified(
000287 |         &mut self,
000288 |         key: &VerifyingKey,
000289 |         channel: AdChannel,
000290 |         key_id: &str,
000291 |         now: u64,
000292 |         time_trusted: bool,
000293 |     ) -> Result<(), &'static str> {
000294 |         self.manifest = None;
000295 |         if self.last_success.is_none_or(|last| last > now) {
000296 |             return Err("cache_time");
000297 |         }
000298 |         let wire = self.cached_wire.as_deref().ok_or("cache_empty")?;
000299 |         let (manifest, hash) = verify_manifest(wire, key, channel, key_id, now, time_trusted)?;
000300 |         if manifest.content_revision != self.highest_revision
000301 |             || self.highest_payload_hash.as_deref() != Some(&hash)
000302 |         {
000303 |             return Err("cache_revision");
000304 |         }
000305 |         self.manifest = Some(manifest);
000306 |         Ok(())
000307 |     }

000310 |         self.manifest.as_ref()
000311 |     }

000316 |         now: u64,
000317 |         preferences: &AdPreferences,
000318 |         time_trusted: bool,
000319 |     ) -> Option<&Campaign> {
000320 |         if !time_trusted
000321 |             || !preferences.request_purpose_acknowledged

000325 |         }

000330 |         }

000340 |             .find(|content| content.slot == slot && content.enabled)?;

000343 |         })

000368 | 
000369 | impl RefreshSchedule {
000370 |     /// Returns one request permit. All-disabled and concurrent calls get no permit.
000371 |     pub fn begin(
000372 |         &mut self,
000373 |         now: u64,
000374 |         preferences: &AdPreferences,
000375 |         time_trusted: bool,
000376 |         manual: bool,
000377 |     ) -> bool {
000378 |         if self.in_flight
000379 |             || !time_trusted

000381 |             || !preferences.slots_enabled.iter().any(|enabled| *enabled)

000389 |             {

000391 |             }

000393 |         } else if self.next_check_at.is_some_and(|next| now < next) {
000394 |             return false;
000395 |         }
000396 |         self.in_flight = true;
000397 |         true
000398 |     }

000400 |     pub fn complete_success(&mut self, now: u64, jitter_seconds: u8) -> Result<(), &'static str> {
000401 |         if jitter_seconds > 60 {
000402 |             return Err("refresh_jitter");
000403 |         }
000404 |         let next = now
000405 |             .checked_add(15 * 60 + u64::from(jitter_seconds))
000406 |             .ok_or("refresh_time")?;
000407 |         self.next_check_at = Some(next);
000408 |         self.failures = 0;
000409 |         self.in_flight = false;
000410 |         Ok(())
000411 |     }
000412 | 
000413 |     pub fn complete_failure(&mut self, now: u64) -> Result<(), &'static str> {
000414 |         const BACKOFF: [u64; 5] = [60, 300, 900, 1800, 3600];
000415 |         let delay = BACKOFF[usize::from(self.failures).min(BACKOFF.len() - 1)];
000416 |         self.next_check_at = Some(now.checked_add(delay).ok_or("refresh_time")?);
000417 |         self.failures = self.failures.saturating_add(1);
000418 |         self.in_flight = false;
000419 |         Ok(())
000420 |     }
000421 | }

000515 | fn png_is_static(bytes: &[u8]) -> Result<(), &'static str> {
000516 |     let mut offset = 8usize;
000517 |     let mut first = true;
000518 |     while offset < bytes.len() {
000519 |         let header = bytes
000520 |             .get(offset..offset.checked_add(8).ok_or("image_chunk")?)
000521 |             .ok_or("image_chunk")?;
000522 |         let length =
000523 |             u32::from_be_bytes(header[..4].try_into().map_err(|_| "image_chunk")?) as usize;
000524 |         let kind = &header[4..8];
000525 |         if first && (kind != b"IHDR" || length != 13) {
000526 |             return Err("image_chunk");
000527 |         }
000528 |         first = false;
000529 |         if matches!(kind, b"acTL" | b"fcTL" | b"fdAT") {
000530 |             return Err("image_animation");
000531 |         }
000532 |         offset = offset
000533 |             .checked_add(12)
000534 |             .and_then(|n| n.checked_add(length))
000535 |             .ok_or("image_chunk")?;
000536 |         if offset > bytes.len() {
000537 |             return Err("image_chunk");
000538 |         }
000539 |         if kind == b"IEND" {
000540 |             return if length == 0 && offset == bytes.len() {
000541 |                 Ok(())
000542 |             } else {
000543 |                 Err("image_chunk")
000544 |             };
000545 |         }
000546 |     }
000547 |     Err("image_chunk")
000548 | }

000550 | fn decode_image(bytes: &[u8], mime: &str) -> Result<DynamicImage, &'static str> {
000551 |     if bytes.is_empty() || bytes.len() > MAX_IMAGE_BYTES {
000552 |         return Err("image_size");
000553 |     }
000554 |     let format = match mime {
000555 |         "image/png" if bytes.starts_with(b"\x89PNG\r\n\x1a\n") => {
000556 |             png_is_static(bytes)?;
000557 |             ImageFormat::Png
000558 |         }
000559 |         "image/jpeg" if bytes.starts_with(b"\xff\xd8\xff") => ImageFormat::Jpeg,
000560 |         _ => return Err("image_mime"),
000561 |     };
000562 |     let mut header = ImageReader::with_format(Cursor::new(bytes), format);
000563 |     let mut header_limits = Limits::default();
000564 |     header_limits.max_image_width = Some(MAX_IMAGE_PIXELS as u32);
000565 |     header_limits.max_image_height = Some(MAX_IMAGE_PIXELS as u32);
000566 |     header_limits.max_alloc = Some(32 * 1024 * 1024);
000567 |     header.limits(header_limits);
000568 |     let (width, height) = header.into_dimensions().map_err(|_| "image_header")?;
000569 |     if !valid_dimensions(width, height) {
000570 |         return Err("image_dimensions");
000571 |     }
000572 |     let mut reader = ImageReader::with_format(Cursor::new(bytes), format);
000573 |     let mut limits = Limits::default();
000574 |     limits.max_image_width = Some(width);
000575 |     limits.max_image_height = Some(height);
000576 |     limits.max_alloc = Some(32 * 1024 * 1024);
000577 |     reader.limits(limits);
000578 |     reader.decode().map_err(|_| "image_decode")
000579 | }

000581 | pub fn validate_image(bytes: &[u8], asset: &ImageAsset) -> Result<(), &'static str> {
000582 |     validate_asset(asset)?;
000583 |     if bytes.len() != asset.bytes as usize || bytes.len() > MAX_IMAGE_BYTES {
000584 |         return Err("image_size");
000585 |     }
000586 |     if signed::digest(bytes) != asset.sha256 {
000587 |         return Err("image_hash");
000588 |     }
000589 |     let _guard = IMAGE_DECODE
000590 |         .lock()
000591 |         .map_err(|_| "image_decoder_unavailable")?;
000592 |     let decoded = decode_image(bytes, &asset.mime)?;
000593 |     if decoded.dimensions() != (asset.width, asset.height) {
000594 |         return Err("image_dimensions");
000595 |     }
000596 |     Ok(())
000597 | }

000599 | /// Decode and re-encode pixels, so input EXIF/text/profile metadata is not copied.
000600 | pub fn normalize_image(bytes: &[u8], mime: &str) -> Result<(Vec<u8>, ImageAsset), &'static str> {
000601 |     let _guard = IMAGE_DECODE
000602 |         .lock()
000603 |         .map_err(|_| "image_decoder_unavailable")?;
000604 |     let decoded = decode_image(bytes, mime)?;
000605 |     let (width, height) = decoded.dimensions();
000606 |     let format = if mime == "image/png" {
000607 |         ImageFormat::Png
000608 |     } else {
000609 |         ImageFormat::Jpeg
000610 |     };
000611 |     let pixels = if format == ImageFormat::Png {
000612 |         DynamicImage::ImageRgba8(decoded.into_rgba8())
000613 |     } else {
000614 |         DynamicImage::ImageRgb8(decoded.into_rgb8())
000615 |     };
000616 |     let mut normalized = Vec::new();
000617 |     pixels
000618 |         .write_to(&mut Cursor::new(&mut normalized), format)
000619 |         .map_err(|_| "image_encode")?;
000620 |     if normalized.len() > MAX_IMAGE_BYTES {
000621 |         return Err("image_size");
000622 |     }
000623 |     let asset = ImageAsset {
000624 |         sha256: signed::digest(&normalized),
000625 |         mime: mime.into(),
000626 |         bytes: normalized.len() as u32,
000627 |         width,
000628 |         height,
000629 |     };
000630 |     Ok((normalized, asset))
000631 | }

001155 |     #[test]
001156 |     fn png_jpeg_normalization_and_hash_mime_dimensions_are_enforced() {
001157 |         for (format, mime) in [
001158 |             (ImageFormat::Png, "image/png"),
001159 |             (ImageFormat::Jpeg, "image/jpeg"),
001160 |         ] {
001161 |             let bytes = tiny_image(format);
001162 |             let (normalized, mut asset) = normalize_image(&bytes, mime).unwrap();
001163 |             assert_eq!((asset.width, asset.height), (2, 3));
001164 |             validate_image(&normalized, &asset).unwrap();
001165 |             asset.sha256 = "0".repeat(64);
001166 |             assert_eq!(validate_image(&normalized, &asset), Err("image_hash"));
001167 |             asset.sha256 = signed::digest(&normalized);
001168 |             asset.width = 3;
001169 |             assert_eq!(validate_image(&normalized, &asset), Err("image_dimensions"));
001170 |             asset.width = 2;
001171 |             asset.mime = if mime == "image/png" {
001172 |                 "image/jpeg".into()
001173 |             } else {
001174 |                 "image/png".into()
001175 |             };
001176 |             assert_eq!(validate_image(&normalized, &asset), Err("image_mime"));
001177 |         }
001178 |     }

000022 | pub fn evaluate_launch(report: &CheckReport, _now: u64, _generation: &str) -> LaunchDecision {
000023 |     let mut reasons = Vec::new();
000024 |     if report.schema_version != 1 {
000025 |         reasons.push("检查报告版本无效".into());
000026 |     }
000027 |     let mut seen = HashSet::new();
000028 |     for row in &report.checks {
000029 |         if !seen.insert(row.id) {
000030 |             reasons.push("检查报告包含重复项".into());
000031 |         }
000032 |         if row.status != CheckStatus::Pass
000033 |             && (row.id.required() || row.status != CheckStatus::Warning)
000034 |         {
000035 |             reasons.push(format!("{}未通过", row.id.name()));
000036 |         }
000037 |     }
000038 |     if report.checks.len() != CheckId::ALL.len() || CheckId::ALL.iter().any(|id| !seen.contains(id))
000039 |     {
000040 |         reasons.push("检查报告缺少必需项目".into());
000041 |     }
000042 |     let expected = summarize(&report.checks);
000043 |     if report.summary.passed != expected.passed
000044 |         || report.summary.advisory != expected.advisory
000045 |         || report.summary.blocking != expected.blocking
000046 |     {
000047 |         reasons.push("检查摘要与逐项结果不一致".into());
000048 |     }
000049 |     reasons.sort();
000050 |     reasons.dedup();
000051 |     LaunchDecision {
000052 |         allowed: reasons.is_empty(),
000053 |         reasons,
000054 |     }
000055 | }

000225 | #[derive(Default, serde::Serialize, serde::Deserialize)]
000226 | struct EgressHistory {
000227 |     previous: Option<String>,
000228 |     entries: Vec<(String, u64)>,
000229 | }
000230 | impl EgressHistory {
000231 |     fn record(&mut self, hash: String, now: u64) -> Outcome {
000232 |         let changed = self
000233 |             .previous
000234 |             .as_ref()
000235 |             .is_some_and(|previous| previous != &hash);
000236 |         self.previous = Some(hash.clone());
000237 |         self.entries
000238 |             .retain(|(_, time)| *time >= now.saturating_sub(172_800));
000239 |         self.entries.push((hash, now));
000240 |         let distinct = self
000241 |             .entries
000242 |             .iter()
000243 |             .map(|(hash, _)| hash)
000244 |             .collect::<HashSet<_>>()
000245 |             .len();
000246 |         if distinct >= 3 {
000247 |             result(
000248 |                 CheckStatus::Warning,
000249 |                 "48 小时内出口地址达到三个，请固定节点",
000250 |             )
000251 |         } else if changed {
000252 |             result(CheckStatus::Warning, "出口地址与上次不同")
000253 |         } else {
000254 |             result(CheckStatus::Pass, "出口地址一致或首次记录")
000255 |         }
000256 |     }
000257 | }
000258 | fn egress_hash(ip: IpAddr) -> String {
000259 |     Sha256::digest(ip.to_string().as_bytes())
000260 |         .iter()
000261 |         .map(|byte| format!("{byte:02x}"))
000262 |         .collect()
000263 | }
000264 | fn legacy_history(home: &std::path::Path) -> EgressHistory {
000265 |     use std::{io::Read, os::unix::fs::OpenOptionsExt};
000266 |     let read = |name: &str| -> Option<String> {
000267 |         let file = std::fs::OpenOptions::new()
000268 |             .read(true)
000269 |             .custom_flags(libc::O_NOFOLLOW | libc::O_NONBLOCK)
000270 |             .open(home.join(".claude-switcher").join(name))
000271 |             .ok()?;
000272 |         if !file.metadata().ok()?.is_file() {
000273 |             return None;
000274 |         }
000275 |         let mut text = String::new();
000276 |         file.take(1024 * 1024).read_to_string(&mut text).ok()?;
000277 |         Some(text)
000278 |     };
000279 |     EgressHistory {
000280 |         previous: read("lastip")
000281 |             .and_then(|text| text.trim().parse().ok())
000282 |             .map(egress_hash),
000283 |         entries: read("iphistory.log")
000284 |             .unwrap_or_default()
000285 |             .lines()
000286 |             .filter_map(|line| {
000287 |                 let mut fields = line.split_whitespace();
000288 |                 Some((
000289 |                     egress_hash(fields.next()?.parse().ok()?),
000290 |                     fields.next()?.parse().ok()?,
000291 |                 ))
000292 |             })
000293 |             .collect(),
000294 |     }
000295 | }
000296 | fn record_egress(ip: IpAddr, previous: Option<&str>) -> Outcome {
000297 |     let Ok(home) = crate::config::home_dir() else {
000298 |         return result(CheckStatus::Warning, "无法保存出口历史");
000299 |     };
000300 |     record_egress_at(&home, ip, previous)
000301 | }
000302 | fn record_egress_at(home: &std::path::Path, ip: IpAddr, previous: Option<&str>) -> Outcome {
000303 |     let path = home.join(".claude-switcher/v2/egress-history.json");
000304 |     let mut history: EgressHistory = crate::storage::read_private_bytes(&path, 1024 * 1024)
000305 |         .ok()
000306 |         .and_then(|data| serde_json::from_slice(&data).ok())
000307 |         .unwrap_or_else(|| legacy_history(home));
000308 |     if history.previous.is_none() {
000309 |         history.previous = previous.map(str::to_owned);
000310 |     }
000311 |     let hash = egress_hash(ip);
000312 |     let outcome = history.record(hash, unix_now());
000313 |     let save = || -> std::io::Result<()> {
000314 |         crate::storage::prepare_data_root(&home.join(".claude-switcher"))?;
000315 |         crate::storage::create_private_directory(path.parent().unwrap())?;
000316 |         crate::storage::atomic_json(&path, &history)
000317 |     };
000318 |     if save().is_err() {
000319 |         return result(CheckStatus::Warning, "无法保存出口历史");
000320 |     }
000321 |     outcome
000322 | }

000325 |     use CheckId::*;

000339 |             if geo.country.is_none() {
000340 |                 geo = context.geo_details().await;
000341 |             }
000342 |             match (&context.config.country_target, geo.country) {
000343 |                 (Some(target), Some(country)) if country == *target && country != "CN" => {
000344 |                     result(CheckStatus::Pass, "出口地区符合已保存目标")
000345 |                 }
000346 |                 (Some(_), Some(_)) => result(CheckStatus::Fail, "出口地区与已保存目标不一致"),
000347 |                 _ => result(CheckStatus::Unknown, "出口地区或地区目标无法确认"),
000348 |             }

000350 |         IpContinuity => match context.geo().await.ip {
000351 |             Some(ip) => record_egress(ip, context.config.previous_egress_hash.as_deref()),
000352 |             None => result(CheckStatus::Fail, "未获取到出口地址"),

000356 |                 .ok()

000376 |                 ),

000378 |             }
000379 |         }
000380 |         Ipv6Policy => {
000381 |             match macos::read_command("/usr/sbin/networksetup", &["-getinfo", "Wi-Fi"]).await {
000382 |                 Ok(s) => compare(
