000384 |                         line.trim().to_ascii_lowercase().starts_with("ipv6:")
000385 |                             && line.to_ascii_lowercase().contains("off")
000386 |                     })),
000387 |                     "所选网络服务已关闭 IPv6",
000388 |                     "所选网络服务未关闭 IPv6",
000389 |                 ),
000390 |                 Err(_) => result(CheckStatus::Unknown, "无法确认 IPv6 策略"),
000391 |             }

000393 |         DnsRoute => match macos::dns_addresses("claude.ai").await {
000394 |             Ok(addresses) => compare(
000395 |                 Ok(addresses.first().is_some_and(fake_ip)),
000396 |                 "claude.ai 首个解析结果为 Fake-IP",
000397 |                 "claude.ai 首个解析结果未走隧道",
000398 |             ),
000399 |             Err(_) => result(CheckStatus::Fail, "无法取得 claude.ai 首个解析结果"),
000400 |         },
000401 |         StunPath => {
000402 |             // STUN has its own bounded probes. No exposed address needs no geo comparison.
000403 |             let results = network::stun_all().await;
000404 |             if results.iter().all(Result::is_err) {
000405 |                 stun_outcome(&results, None)

000471 |         },

000505 | pub fn stun_outcome(
000506 |     results: &[Result<IpAddr, network::StunError>],
000507 |     egress: Option<IpAddr>,
000508 | ) -> Outcome {
000509 |     let successful: Vec<_> = results.iter().filter_map(|r| r.as_ref().ok()).collect();
000510 |     let finish = |status, reason| {
000511 |         let evidence = vec![
000512 |             format!("有效 STUN 响应：{}", successful.len()),
000513 |             format!(
000514 |                 "STUN 超时：{}",
000515 |                 results
000516 |                     .iter()
000517 |                     .filter(|r| matches!(r, Err(network::StunError::Timeout)))
000518 |                     .count()
000519 |             ),
000520 |             format!(
000521 |                 "STUN 网络或 DNS 失败：{}",
000522 |                 results
000523 |                     .iter()
000524 |                     .filter(|r| matches!(r, Err(network::StunError::Dns | network::StunError::Io)))
000525 |                     .count()
000526 |             ),
000527 |             format!(
000528 |                 "STUN 来源、事务或解析失败：{}",
000529 |                 results
000530 |                     .iter()
000531 |                     .filter(|r| matches!(
000532 |                         r,
000533 |                         Err(network::StunError::WrongSource
000534 |                             | network::StunError::Header
000535 |                             | network::StunError::Transaction
000536 |                             | network::StunError::Length
000537 |                             | network::StunError::AddressFamily
000538 |                             | network::StunError::MissingAddress)
000539 |                     ))
000540 |                     .count()
000541 |             ),
000542 |         ];
000543 |         (status, reason, evidence)
000544 |     };
000545 |     if successful.is_empty() {
000546 |         return finish(CheckStatus::Pass, "STUN 未返回出口地址，UDP 无暴露");
000547 |     }
000548 |     let Some(egress) = egress else {
000549 |         return finish(
000550 |             CheckStatus::Unknown,
000551 |             "缺少 HTTPS 出口地址，无法比较 STUN 路径",
000552 |         );
000553 |     };
000554 |     if successful.iter().any(|ip| **ip != egress) {
000555 |         return finish(CheckStatus::Fail, "STUN 出口与 HTTPS 出口不一致");
000556 |     }
000557 |     finish(CheckStatus::Pass, "已返回 STUN 出口均与 HTTPS 出口一致")
000558 | }

000560 | pub fn summarize(checks: &[CheckResult]) -> CheckSummary {
000561 |     CheckSummary {
000562 |         passed: checks
000563 |             .iter()
000564 |             .filter(|r| r.status == CheckStatus::Pass)
000565 |             .count() as u32,
000566 |         advisory: checks
000567 |             .iter()
000568 |             .filter(|r| !r.id.required() && r.status == CheckStatus::Warning)
000569 |             .count() as u32,
000570 |         blocking: checks
000571 |             .iter()
000572 |             .filter(|r| {
000573 |                 r.status != CheckStatus::Pass
000574 |                     && (r.id.required() || r.status != CheckStatus::Warning)
000575 |             })
000576 |             .count() as u32,
000577 |     }
000578 | }
000579 | 
000580 | async fn collect_reports(
000581 |     mut tasks: tokio::task::JoinSet<CheckResult>,
000582 |     deadline: Option<tokio::time::Instant>,
000583 |     observed_at: u64,
000584 |     generation: &str,
000585 | ) -> Vec<CheckResult> {
000586 |     let mut checks = Vec::new();
000587 |     while !tasks.is_empty() {
000588 |         let next = match deadline {
000589 |             Some(deadline) => tokio::time::timeout_at(deadline, tasks.join_next()).await,
000590 |             None => Ok(tasks.join_next().await),
000591 |         };
000592 |         match next {
000593 |             Ok(Some(Ok(row))) => checks.push(row),
000594 |             Ok(Some(Err(_))) => {}
000595 |             _ => {
000596 |                 tasks.abort_all();
000597 |                 break;
000598 |             }
000599 |         }
000600 |     }
000601 |     for id in CheckId::ALL {
000602 |         if !checks.iter().any(|r| r.id == id) {
000603 |             checks.push(CheckResult {
000604 |                 id,
000605 |                 status: CheckStatus::Timeout,
000606 |                 reason: "检查到达总截止时间或任务未完成".into(),
000607 |                 observed_at,
000608 |                 duration_ms: 30_000,
000609 |                 valid_until: observed_at + EVIDENCE_TTL_SECONDS,
000610 |                 network_generation: generation.into(),
000611 |                 evidence: vec![],
000612 |             });
000613 |         }
000614 |     }
000615 |     checks.sort_by_key(|r| CheckId::ALL.iter().position(|id| *id == r.id));
000616 |     checks
000617 | }

000619 | pub async fn run_checks(config: CheckConfig) -> CheckReport {
000620 |     let start = Instant::now();
000621 |     let observed_at = unix_now();
000622 |     let generation = "legacy-check".to_string();
000623 |     let valid = config.validate().is_ok();
000624 |     let context = Arc::new(Context {
000625 |         config,
000626 |         client: network::inherited_client().ok(),
000627 |         geo: OnceCell::new(),
000628 |         geo_details: OnceCell::new(),
000629 |         dns: OnceCell::new(),
000630 |     });
000631 |     let mut tasks = tokio::task::JoinSet::new();
000632 |     for id in CheckId::ALL {
000633 |         let context = context.clone();
000634 |         let generation = generation.clone();
000635 |         tasks.spawn(async move {
000636 |             let start = Instant::now();
000637 |             let observed = unix_now();
000638 |             let (status, reason, evidence) = if valid {
000639 |                 observe(id, &context).await
000640 |             } else {
000641 |                 result(CheckStatus::Unknown, "保存的检查配置无效")
000642 |             };
000643 |             CheckResult {
000644 |                 id,
000645 |                 status,
000646 |                 reason: reason.into(),
000647 |                 observed_at: observed,
000648 |                 duration_ms: start.elapsed().as_millis() as u64,
000649 |                 valid_until: observed.saturating_add(EVIDENCE_TTL_SECONDS),
000650 |                 network_generation: generation,
000651 |                 evidence,
000652 |             }
000653 |         });
000654 |     }
000655 |     let checks = collect_reports(tasks, None, observed_at, &generation).await;
000656 |     let summary = summarize(&checks);
000657 |     let mut report = CheckReport {
000658 |         schema_version: 1,
000659 |         observed_at,
000660 |         completed_at: unix_now(),
000661 |         duration_ms: start.elapsed().as_millis() as u64,
000662 |         network_generation: generation.clone(),
000663 |         checks,
000664 |         summary,
000665 |         launch: LaunchDecision {
000666 |             allowed: false,
000667 |             reasons: vec![],
000668 |         },
000669 |     };
000670 |     report.launch = evaluate_launch(&report, unix_now(), &generation);
000671 |     report
000672 | }

000042 | impl CheckConfig {
000043 |     pub fn validate(&self) -> Result<(), &'static str> {
000044 |         if self.country_target.as_ref().is_some_and(|v| {
000045 |             v.len() != 2 || !v.bytes().all(|b| b.is_ascii_uppercase()) || v == "CN"
000046 |         }) {
000047 |             return Err("country_target_invalid");
000048 |         }
000049 |         if self
000050 |             .timezone_target
000051 |             .as_ref()
000052 |             .is_some_and(|v| !valid_timezone(v))
000053 |         {
000054 |             return Err("timezone_target_invalid");
000055 |         }
000056 |         if self.locale_target.as_ref().is_some_and(|v| {
000057 |             v.len() > 32
000058 |                 || !v
000059 |                     .bytes()
000060 |                     .all(|b| b.is_ascii_alphanumeric() || matches!(b, b'_' | b'-' | b'@' | b'='))
000061 |         }) {
000062 |             return Err("locale_target_invalid");
000063 |         }
000064 |         if !matches!(
000065 |             self.proxy_mode.as_str(),
000066 |             "auto" | "clash-verge" | "0dcloud" | "shadowrocket" | "sing-box" | "clashx" | "surge"
000067 |         ) {
000068 |             return Err("proxy_mode_invalid");
000069 |         }
000070 |         if self.network_service.is_empty()
000071 |             || self.network_service.len() > 128
000072 |             || self.network_service.chars().any(char::is_control)
000073 |         {
000074 |             return Err("network_service_invalid");
000075 |         }
000076 |         if self
000077 |             .previous_egress_hash
000078 |             .as_ref()
000079 |             .is_some_and(|s| s.len() != 64 || !s.bytes().all(|b| b.is_ascii_hexdigit()))
000080 |         {
000081 |             return Err("previous_egress_hash_invalid");
000082 |         }
000083 |         Ok(())
000084 |     }
000085 | }

000087 | pub fn valid_timezone(zone: &str) -> bool {
000088 |     !zone.is_empty()
000089 |         && zone.len() <= 80
000090 |         && !zone.starts_with('/')
000091 |         && !zone
000092 |             .split('/')
000093 |             .any(|s| s == ".." || s == "." || s.is_empty())
000094 |         && zone
000095 |             .bytes()
000096 |             .all(|b| b.is_ascii_alphanumeric() || matches!(b, b'/' | b'_' | b'-' | b'+'))
000097 |         && Path::new("/usr/share/zoneinfo").join(zone).is_file()
000098 | }

000166 | pub(crate) fn literal_assignment(line: &str, key: &str) -> Option<String> {
000167 |     let source = line.strip_prefix(key)?.strip_prefix('=')?;
000168 |     let (value, tail) = if source.starts_with('\'') {
000169 |         // Decode only the single-quoted literal form emitted by the local installer.
000170 |         let mut remaining = source;
000171 |         let mut value = String::new();
000172 |         loop {
000173 |             let quoted = remaining.strip_prefix('\'')?;
000174 |             let (part, tail) = quoted.split_once('\'')?;
000175 |             value.push_str(part);
000176 |             if let Some(next) = tail.strip_prefix("\\'") {
000177 |                 value.push('\'');
000178 |                 remaining = next;
000179 |             } else {
000180 |                 break (value, tail);
000181 |             }
000182 |         }
000183 |     } else {
000184 |         let (value, tail) = source.strip_prefix('"')?.split_once('"')?;
000185 |         if key != "PROXY_GROUP" && value.contains(['$', '`', '\\']) {
000186 |             return None;
000187 |         }
000188 |         (value.to_owned(), tail)
000189 |     };
000190 |     if !tail.trim_start().is_empty() && !tail.trim_start().starts_with('#') {
000191 |         return None;
000192 |     }
000193 |     Some(value)
000194 | }

000013 |     pub fn parse(value: &str) -> Result<Self, &'static str> {
000014 |         let value = value.trim();
000015 |         if value.is_empty() || value.chars().any(|c| c.is_control() || c.is_whitespace()) {
000016 |             return Err("invalid_or_missing_proxy");
000017 |         }
000018 |         let url = url::Url::parse(value).map_err(|_| "invalid_or_missing_proxy")?;
000019 |         if !matches!(url.scheme(), "http" | "https" | "socks5" | "socks5h")
000020 |             || url.host_str().is_none()
000021 |             || !matches!(url.path(), "" | "/")
000022 |             || url.query().is_some()
000023 |             || url.fragment().is_some()
000024 |         {
000025 |             return Err("invalid_or_missing_proxy");
000026 |         }
000027 |         let authority = value
000028 |             .split_once("://")
000029 |             .ok_or("invalid_or_missing_proxy")?
000030 |             .1
000031 |             .split('/')
000032 |             .next()
000033 |             .ok_or("invalid_or_missing_proxy")?;
000034 |         let port = authority
000035 |             .rsplit_once(':')
000036 |             .and_then(|(_, port)| port.parse::<u16>().ok())
000037 |             .filter(|n| *n > 0)
000038 |             .ok_or("proxy_explicit_port_required")?;
000039 |         if url.port_or_known_default() != Some(port) {
000040 |             return Err("invalid_or_missing_proxy");
000041 |         }
000042 |         let host = url.host_str().unwrap_or_default().trim_matches(['[', ']']);
000043 |         let loopback = host.eq_ignore_ascii_case("localhost")
000044 |             || host.parse::<IpAddr>().is_ok_and(|ip| ip.is_loopback());
000045 |         let dns = match url.scheme() {
000046 |             "socks5" => "local",
000047 |             "socks5h" => "remote",
000048 |             _ => "proxy_connect",
000049 |         };
000050 |         Ok(Self {
000051 |             url: value.into(),
000052 |             description: ProxyDescription {
000053 |                 scheme: url.scheme().into(),
000054 |                 host_scope: if loopback { "loopback" } else { "remote" }.into(),
000055 |                 dns: dns.into(),
000056 |             },
000057 |         })
000058 |     }

000100 | /// Apply the same redaction to preview, persistence and export. Avoid raw platform output in the first place.
000101 | pub fn redact(text: &str) -> String {
000102 |     text.lines()
000103 |         .map(|line| {
000104 |             let lower = line.to_ascii_lowercase();
000105 |             if [
000106 |                 "authorization",
000107 |                 "cookie",
000108 |                 "password",
000109 |                 "secret",
000110 |                 "token",
000111 |                 "api_key",
000112 |                 "proxy_url",
000113 |             ]
000114 |             .iter()
000115 |             .any(|key| lower.contains(key))
000116 |             {
000117 |                 return "[敏感字段已隐藏]".into();
000118 |             }
000119 |             let mut line = line.to_owned();
000120 |             if let Some(home) = std::env::var_os("HOME") {
000121 |                 let home = home.to_string_lossy();
000122 |                 if !home.is_empty() {
000123 |                     line = line.replace(home.as_ref(), "[本机目录]");
000124 |                 }
000125 |             }
000126 |             line.split_whitespace()
000127 |                 .map(|word| {
000128 |                     if word.contains("://") {
000129 |                         if let Ok(url) = url::Url::parse(word.trim_matches(['(', ')', ',', ';'])) {
000130 |                             let public = matches!(
000131 |                                 url.host_str(),
000132 |                                 Some(
000133 |                                     "claude.ai"
000134 |                                         | "api.anthropic.com"
000135 |                                         | "ipinfo.io"
000136 |                                         | "ipwho.is"
000137 |                                         | "api.ip.sb"
000138 |                                         | "www.cloudflare.com"
000139 |                                 )
000140 |                             );
000141 |                             if !public
000142 |                                 || !url.username().is_empty()
000143 |                                 || url.query().is_some()
000144 |                                 || url.fragment().is_some()
000145 |                             {
000146 |                                 return "[网络地址已隐藏]".to_owned();
000147 |                             }
000148 |                         } else {
000149 |                             return "[网络地址已隐藏]".to_owned();
000150 |                         }
000151 |                     }
000152 |                     let trimmed = word.trim_matches(['[', ']', '(', ')', ',', ';']);
000153 |                     if trimmed.parse::<IpAddr>().is_ok()
000154 |                         || trimmed.parse::<std::net::SocketAddr>().is_ok()
000155 |                         || word
000156 |                             .split(['=', '/', ',', ';', '(', ')', '→'])
000157 |                             .any(|s| s.trim_matches(['[', ']']).parse::<IpAddr>().is_ok())
000158 |                     {
000159 |                         "[网络地址已隐藏]".to_owned()
000160 |                     } else {
000161 |                         redact_ip_literals(word)
000162 |                     }
000163 |                 })
000164 |                 .collect::<Vec<_>>()
000165 |                 .join(" ")
000166 |         })
000167 |         .collect::<Vec<_>>()
000168 |         .join("\n")
000169 | }
000170 | 
000171 | fn redact_ip_literals(value: &str) -> String {
000172 |     let mut output = String::new();
000173 |     let mut token = String::new();
000174 |     let flush = |token: &mut String, output: &mut String| {
000175 |         if token.is_empty() {
000176 |             return;
000177 |         }
000178 |         let candidate = token.trim_matches(['[', ']']).trim_end_matches('.');
000179 |         if candidate.parse::<IpAddr>().is_ok() || token.parse::<std::net::SocketAddr>().is_ok() {
000180 |             output.push_str("[网络地址已隐藏]");
000181 |         } else {
000182 |             output.push_str(token);
000183 |         }
000184 |         token.clear();
000185 |     };
000186 |     for character in value.chars() {
000187 |         if character.is_ascii_hexdigit() || matches!(character, ':' | '.' | '[' | ']') {
000188 |             token.push(character);
000189 |         } else {
000190 |             flush(&mut token, &mut output);
000191 |             output.push(character);
000192 |         }
000193 |     }
000194 |     flush(&mut token, &mut output);
000195 |     output
000196 | }

000109 |     pub reason: &'static str,

000111 | pub struct Guardian {
000112 |     owner_uid: u32,

000114 | }
000115 | impl Guardian {
000116 |     pub fn new(owner_uid: u32) -> Result<Self, &'static str> {
000117 |         if owner_uid == 0 {
000118 |             return Err("guardian_owner_root");
000119 |         }
000120 |         Ok(Self {
000121 |             owner_uid,
000122 |             report: None,
000123 |         })
000124 |     }
000125 |     pub fn update(&mut self, report: CheckReport) {
000126 |         self.report = Some(report);
000127 |     }
000128 |     pub fn evaluate(
000129 |         &mut self,
000130 |         event: ProtectionEvent,
000131 |         now: u64,
000132 |         generation: &str,
000133 |     ) -> Option<StopRequest> {
000134 |         let _ = (event, now, generation);
000135 |         // The legacy bodyguard only acts on an observed proxy or TUN failure.
000136 |         let failed = self.report.as_ref().is_some_and(|report| {
000137 |             report.checks.iter().any(|row| {
000138 |                 matches!(
000139 |                     row.id,
000140 |                     switcher_domain::checks::CheckId::ProxyProcess
000141 |                         | switcher_domain::checks::CheckId::TunRoute
000142 |                 ) && row.status == switcher_domain::checks::CheckStatus::Fail
000143 |             })
000144 |         });
000145 |         failed.then_some(StopRequest {
000146 |             owner_uid: self.owner_uid,
000147 |             reason: "proxy_or_tun_offline",
000148 |         })
000149 |     }
000150 | }
000151 | /// Concrete independent stop consumer. Never accepts a caller-supplied identity boolean.
000152 | /// Production callers must be the user-session guardian, not the root helper.
000153 | pub fn stop_verified_claude(request: &StopRequest) -> Result<usize, &'static str> {
000154 |     if unsafe { libc::geteuid() } != request.owner_uid || request.owner_uid == 0 {
000155 |         return Err("stop_owner_uid");
000156 |     }
000157 |     let mut inventory = std::process::Command::new("/bin/ps");
000158 |     inventory
000159 |         .args(["-axo", "pid=,command="])
000160 |         .env_clear()
000161 |         .env("LC_ALL", "C");
000162 |     let output = bounded_inventory(&mut inventory, Duration::from_secs(1))?;
000163 |     if !output.status.success() {
000164 |         return Err("process_inventory");
000165 |     }
000166 |     signal_legacy_claude(&String::from_utf8_lossy(&output.stdout), |pid| {
000167 |         if unsafe { libc::kill(pid, libc::SIGTERM) } == 0
000168 |             || std::io::Error::last_os_error().raw_os_error() == Some(libc::ESRCH)
000169 |         {
000170 |             Ok(())
000171 |         } else {
000172 |             Err("stop_signal_failed")
000173 |         }
000174 |     })
000175 | }
000176 | 
000177 | fn signal_legacy_claude(
000178 |     inventory: &str,
000179 |     mut terminate: impl FnMut(i32) -> Result<(), &'static str>,
000180 | ) -> Result<usize, &'static str> {
000181 |     let mut stopped = 0;
000182 |     let mut failure = None;
000183 |     for line in inventory.lines() {
000184 |         let line = line.trim_start();
000185 |         let Some((pid, command)) = line.split_once(char::is_whitespace) else {
000186 |             continue;
000187 |         };
000188 |         let Some(pid) = pid.parse::<i32>().ok().filter(|pid| *pid > 1) else {
000189 |             continue;
000190 |         };
000191 |         if command.contains("/Applications/Claude.app/Contents/MacOS/Claude") {
000192 |             match terminate(pid) {
000193 |                 Ok(()) => stopped += 1,
000194 |                 Err(error) => failure = Some(error),
000195 |             }
000196 |         }
000197 |     }
000198 |     failure.map_or(Ok(stopped), Err)
000199 | }

000201 | /// Poll the exact inventory child with nonblocking stdout and a size/deadline budget.
000202 | /// After SIGKILL, OS reaping is still synchronous; the single stop slot supervises that boundary too.
000203 | fn bounded_inventory(
000204 |     command: &mut std::process::Command,
000205 |     budget: Duration,
000206 | ) -> Result<std::process::Output, &'static str> {
000207 |     use std::{io::Read, os::fd::AsRawFd, process::Stdio};
000208 |     let mut child = command
000209 |         .stdin(Stdio::null())
000210 |         .stdout(Stdio::piped())
000211 |         .stderr(Stdio::null())
000212 |         .spawn()
000213 |         .map_err(|_| "process_inventory")?;
000214 |     let mut stdout = child.stdout.take().ok_or("process_inventory")?;
000215 |     let descriptor = stdout.as_raw_fd();
000216 |     let flags = unsafe { libc::fcntl(descriptor, libc::F_GETFL) };
000217 |     if flags < 0 || unsafe { libc::fcntl(descriptor, libc::F_SETFL, flags | libc::O_NONBLOCK) } < 0
000218 |     {
000219 |         let _ = child.kill();
000220 |         let _ = child.wait();
000221 |         return Err("process_inventory");
000222 |     }
000223 |     let deadline = std::time::Instant::now() + budget;
000224 |     let mut bytes = Vec::new();
000225 |     let mut eof = false;
000226 |     loop {
000227 |         let mut chunk = [0u8; 4096];
000228 |         let mut idle = false;
000229 |         match stdout.read(&mut chunk) {
000230 |             Ok(0) => {
000231 |                 eof = true;
000232 |                 idle = true;
000233 |             }
000234 |             Ok(length) => bytes.extend_from_slice(&chunk[..length]),
000235 |             Err(error)
000236 |                 if matches!(
000237 |                     error.kind(),
000238 |                     std::io::ErrorKind::WouldBlock | std::io::ErrorKind::Interrupted
000239 |                 ) =>
000240 |             {
000241 |                 idle = true;
000242 |             }
000243 |             Err(_) => {
000244 |                 let _ = child.kill();
000245 |                 let _ = child.wait();
000246 |                 return Err("process_inventory");
000247 |             }
000248 |         }
000249 |         if bytes.len() > 1024 * 1024 || std::time::Instant::now() >= deadline {
000250 |             let _ = child.kill();
000251 |             let _ = child.wait();
000252 |             return Err("process_inventory_budget");
000253 |         }
000254 |         match child.try_wait() {
000255 |             Ok(Some(status)) if eof => {
000256 |                 return Ok(std::process::Output {
000257 |                     status,
000258 |                     stdout: bytes,
000259 |                     stderr: Vec::new(),
000260 |                 });
000261 |             }
000262 |             Ok(_) => {}
000263 |             Err(_) => {
000264 |                 let _ = child.kill();
000265 |                 let _ = child.wait();
000266 |                 return Err("process_inventory");
000267 |             }
000268 |         }
000269 |         if idle {
000270 |             std::thread::sleep(Duration::from_millis(5));
000271 |         }
000272 |     }
000273 | }
000274 | #[cfg(target_os = "macos")]
000275 | fn verify_process_requirement(
000276 |     pid: i32,
000277 |     uid: u32,
000278 |     requirement: &str,
000279 |     path: Option<&str>,
000280 | ) -> Result<(), &'static str> {
000281 |     use std::ffi::{CString, c_void};
000282 |     type Obj = *mut c_void;
000283 |     #[link(name = "proc")]
000284 |     unsafe extern "C" {
000285 |         fn proc_pidpath(pid: i32, buf: *mut c_void, size: u32) -> i32;
000286 |         fn proc_pidinfo(pid: i32, flavor: i32, arg: u64, buf: *mut c_void, size: i32) -> i32;
000287 |     }
000288 |     #[link(name = "CoreFoundation", kind = "framework")]
000289 |     unsafe extern "C" {
000290 |         fn CFNumberCreate(a: Obj, t: i32, v: *const c_void) -> Obj;
000291 |         fn CFStringCreateWithCString(a: Obj, s: *const i8, e: u32) -> Obj;
000292 |         fn CFDictionaryCreate(
000293 |             a: Obj,
000294 |             k: *const Obj,
000295 |             v: *const Obj,
000296 |             n: isize,
000297 |             kcb: Obj,
000298 |             vcb: Obj,
000299 |         ) -> Obj;
000300 |         fn CFRelease(o: Obj);
000301 |     }
000302 |     #[link(name = "Security", kind = "framework")]
000303 |     unsafe extern "C" {
000304 |         static kSecGuestAttributePid: Obj;
000305 |         fn SecCodeCopyGuestWithAttributes(
000306 |             host: Obj,
000307 |             attributes: Obj,
000308 |             flags: u32,
000309 |             code: *mut Obj,
000310 |         ) -> i32;
000311 |         fn SecRequirementCreateWithString(s: Obj, flags: u32, r: *mut Obj) -> i32;
000312 |         fn SecCodeCheckValidity(code: Obj, flags: u32, r: Obj) -> i32;
000313 |     }
000314 |     if pid <= 1 {
000315 |         return Err("process_pid");
000316 |     }
000317 |     // PROC_PIDTBSDINFO: fixed Darwin proc_bsdinfo prefix includes real/effective UID.
000318 |     let mut bsd = [0u8; 136];
000319 |     let len = unsafe { proc_pidinfo(pid, 3, 0, bsd.as_mut_ptr().cast(), bsd.len() as i32) };
000320 |     if len < 24 || u32::from_ne_bytes(bsd[20..24].try_into().unwrap()) != uid {
000321 |         return Err("process_owner");
000322 |     }
000323 |     if let Some(expected) = path {
000324 |         let mut buf = [0u8; 4096];
000325 |         let n = unsafe { proc_pidpath(pid, buf.as_mut_ptr().cast(), buf.len() as u32) };
000326 |         if n <= 0 || buf.split(|b| *b == 0).next() != Some(expected.as_bytes()) {
000327 |             return Err("process_path");
000328 |         }
000329 |     }
000330 |     unsafe {
000331 |         let number = CFNumberCreate(std::ptr::null_mut(), 3, (&pid as *const i32).cast());
000332 |         if number.is_null() {
000333 |             return Err("process_identity");
000334 |         }
000335 |         let attrs = CFDictionaryCreate(
000336 |             std::ptr::null_mut(),
000337 |             &kSecGuestAttributePid,
000338 |             &number,
000339 |             1,
000340 |             std::ptr::null_mut(),
000341 |             std::ptr::null_mut(),
000342 |         );
000343 |         let mut code = std::ptr::null_mut();
000344 |         let status = SecCodeCopyGuestWithAttributes(std::ptr::null_mut(), attrs, 0, &mut code);
000345 |         CFRelease(attrs);
000346 |         CFRelease(number);
000347 |         if status != 0 || code.is_null() {
000348 |             return Err("process_identity");
000349 |         }
000350 |         let text = CString::new(requirement).map_err(|_| "process_requirement")?;
000351 |         let string = CFStringCreateWithCString(std::ptr::null_mut(), text.as_ptr(), 0x08000100);
000352 |         let mut req = std::ptr::null_mut();
000353 |         let made = SecRequirementCreateWithString(string, 0, &mut req);
000354 |         CFRelease(string);
000355 |         let valid = made == 0 && !req.is_null() && SecCodeCheckValidity(code, 0, req) == 0;
000356 |         if !req.is_null() {
000357 |             CFRelease(req);
000358 |         }
000359 |         CFRelease(code);
000360 |         if valid {
000361 |             Ok(())
000362 |         } else {
000363 |             Err("process_signature")
000364 |         }
000365 |     }
000366 | }

000371 |     _: &str,
000372 |     _: Option<&str>,
000373 | ) -> Result<(), &'static str> {

000419 | /// A snapshot binds both policy values and the exact committed configuration file.
000420 | /// File identity also invalidates an A -> B -> A replacement between observations.
000421 | #[derive(Debug, Clone)]
000422 | pub(crate) struct PolicySnapshot {
000423 |     pub(crate) config: crate::config::CheckConfig,
000424 |     fingerprint: String,
000425 | }
000426 | impl PolicySnapshot {
000427 |     pub(crate) fn load(v2: &Path) -> Result<Self, &'static str> {
000428 |         use sha2::{Digest, Sha256};
000429 |         use std::{
000430 |             io::Read,
000431 |             os::unix::fs::{MetadataExt, OpenOptionsExt},
000432 |         };
000433 |         crate::storage::validate_no_symlinks(v2).map_err(|_| "guardian_configuration_directory")?;
000434 |         let directory = std::fs::metadata(v2).map_err(|_| "guardian_configuration_directory")?;
000435 |         if directory.uid() != unsafe { libc::geteuid() } || directory.mode() & 0o077 != 0 {
000436 |             return Err("guardian_configuration_directory");
000437 |         }
000438 |         if crate::regions::recovery_pending_v2(v2)? {
000439 |             return Err("guardian_repair_pending");
000440 |         }
000441 |         let file = std::fs::OpenOptions::new()
000442 |             .read(true)
000443 |             .custom_flags(libc::O_NOFOLLOW | libc::O_NONBLOCK | libc::O_CLOEXEC)
000444 |             .open(v2.join("config.json"))
000445 |             .map_err(|_| "guardian_configuration_missing")?;
000446 |         let metadata = file
000447 |             .metadata()
000448 |             .map_err(|_| "guardian_configuration_metadata")?;
000449 |         if !metadata.is_file()
000450 |             || metadata.uid() != unsafe { libc::geteuid() }
000451 |             || metadata.mode() & 0o077 != 0
000452 |             || metadata.len() > 16 * 1024
000453 |         {
000454 |             return Err("guardian_configuration_permissions");
000455 |         }
000456 |         let mut bytes = Vec::new();
000457 |         (&file)
000458 |             .take(16 * 1024 + 1)
000459 |             .read_to_end(&mut bytes)
000460 |             .map_err(|_| "guardian_configuration_read")?;
000461 |         if bytes.len() > 16 * 1024 {
000462 |             return Err("guardian_configuration_size");
000463 |         }
000464 |         let config: crate::config::CheckConfig =
000465 |             serde_json::from_slice(&bytes).map_err(|_| "guardian_configuration_invalid")?;
000466 |         config.validate()?;
000467 |         if config.country_target.is_none()
000468 |             || config.timezone_target.is_none()
000469 |             || config
000470 |                 .locale_target
000471 |                 .as_ref()
000472 |                 .is_none_or(|value| value.is_empty())
000473 |         {
000474 |             return Err("guardian_configuration_incomplete");
000475 |         }
000476 |         let identity = |m: &std::fs::Metadata| {
000477 |             (
000478 |                 m.dev(),
000479 |                 m.ino(),
000480 |                 m.len(),
000481 |                 m.mtime(),
000482 |                 m.mtime_nsec(),
000483 |                 m.ctime(),
000484 |                 m.ctime_nsec(),
000485 |             )
000486 |         };
000487 |         let after = file
000488 |             .metadata()
000489 |             .map_err(|_| "guardian_configuration_metadata")?;
000490 |         let named = std::fs::symlink_metadata(v2.join("config.json"))
000491 |             .map_err(|_| "guardian_configuration_missing")?;
000492 |         if identity(&metadata) != identity(&after)
000493 |             || identity(&metadata) != identity(&named)
000494 |             || named.file_type().is_symlink()
000495 |             || crate::regions::recovery_pending_v2(v2)?
000496 |         {
000497 |             return Err("guardian_configuration_changed");
000498 |         }
000499 |         let mut digest = Sha256::new();
000500 |         digest.update(format!("{:?}", identity(&metadata)).as_bytes());
000501 |         digest.update(&bytes);
000502 |         Ok(Self {
000503 |             config,
000504 |             fingerprint: digest
000505 |                 .finalize()
000506 |                 .iter()
000507 |                 .map(|byte| format!("{byte:02x}"))
000508 |                 .collect(),
000509 |         })
000510 |     }
000511 | }

000526 | /// Runs the guardian in its owner session. Configuration always comes from fixed v2/config.json.
000527 | /// Stop work runs independently from checks and the lifecycle writer lock.
000528 | pub async fn run(
000529 |     config: crate::config::CheckConfig,
000530 |     state_path: &Path,
000531 |     events: tokio::sync::mpsc::Receiver<ProtectionEvent>,
000532 |     shutdown: tokio::sync::watch::Receiver<bool>,
000533 | ) -> Result<(), &'static str> {
000534 |     let timezone_guard = crate::timezone_guard::spawn(state_path, shutdown.clone())?;
000535 |     let mut installation_probe = crate::installation_health::GuardianProbe::default();
000536 |     let result = run_driver(
000537 |         (state_path, config),
000538 |         events,
000539 |         shutdown,
000540 |         DriverTiming::PRODUCTION,
000541 |         observe_legacy_guardian,
000542 |         stop_verified_claude,

000545 |                 tokio::time::timeout(Duration::from_secs(1), crate::macos::network_generation())
000546 |                     .await
000547 |                     .ok()
000548 |                     .and_then(Result::ok)
000549 |                     .unwrap_or_default()
000550 |             },
000551 |             move |sequence| installation_probe.tick(sequence),
000552 |         ),
000553 |     )
000554 |     .await;
000555 |     timezone_guard.abort();
000556 |     result
000557 | }

000579 | type StopConsumer = dyn Fn(&StopRequest) -> Result<usize, &'static str> + Send + Sync;
000580 | struct StopJob {
000581 |     epoch: u64,
000582 |     request: StopRequest,
000583 |     deadline: tokio::time::Instant,
000584 |     timed_out: bool,
000585 |     handle: tokio::task::JoinHandle<Result<usize, &'static str>>,
000586 | }
000587 | struct StopCompletion {
000588 |     epoch: u64,
000589 |     request: StopRequest,
000590 |     timed_out: bool,
000591 |     result: Result<usize, &'static str>,
000592 | }
000593 | /// Exactly one blocking execution slot. Timeout revokes health; it does not cancel an OS thread.
000594 | /// A timed-out synchronous Security call keeps this slot occupied until it actually returns.
000595 | struct StopSupervisor {
000596 |     consumer: std::sync::Arc<StopConsumer>,
000597 |     job: Option<StopJob>,
000598 |     pending: Option<(u64, StopRequest)>,
000599 |     confirmed_epoch: Option<u64>,
000600 |     failed: bool,
000601 |     timeout: Duration,
000602 |     retry: Duration,
000603 |     retry_at: tokio::time::Instant,
000604 | }
000605 | impl StopSupervisor {
000606 |     fn new(
000607 |         consumer: impl Fn(&StopRequest) -> Result<usize, &'static str> + Send + Sync + 'static,
000608 |         timeout: Duration,
000609 |         retry: Duration,
000610 |     ) -> Self {
000611 |         Self {
000612 |             consumer: std::sync::Arc::new(consumer),
000613 |             job: None,
000614 |             pending: None,
000615 |             confirmed_epoch: None,
000616 |             failed: false,
000617 |             timeout,
000618 |             retry,
000619 |             retry_at: tokio::time::Instant::now(),
000620 |         }
000621 |     }
000622 |     fn request(&mut self, epoch: u64, request: StopRequest) {
000623 |         self.confirmed_epoch = None;
000624 |         if self.job.as_ref().is_some_and(|job| job.epoch == epoch) {
000625 |             return;
000626 |         }
000627 |         self.pending = Some((epoch, request));
000628 |     }
000629 |     fn start_ready(&mut self) {
000630 |         if self.job.is_some() || tokio::time::Instant::now() < self.retry_at {
000631 |             return;
000632 |         }
000633 |         if let Some((epoch, request)) = self.pending.take() {
000634 |             let consumer = self.consumer.clone();
000635 |             let operation = request.clone();
000636 |             self.job = Some(StopJob {
000637 |                 epoch,
000638 |                 request,
000639 |                 deadline: tokio::time::Instant::now() + self.timeout,
000640 |                 timed_out: false,
000641 |                 handle: tokio::task::spawn_blocking(move || consumer(&operation)),
000642 |             });
000643 |         }
000644 |     }
000645 |     async fn join(&mut self) -> StopCompletion {
000646 |         let result = (&mut self.job.as_mut().expect("active stop slot").handle)
000647 |             .await
000648 |             .unwrap_or(Err("guardian_stop_worker_join"));
000649 |         let job = self.job.take().expect("completed stop slot");
000650 |         StopCompletion {
000651 |             epoch: job.epoch,
000652 |             request: job.request,
000653 |             timed_out: job.timed_out || tokio::time::Instant::now() >= job.deadline,
000654 |             result,
000655 |         }
000656 |     }
000657 |     fn finish(&mut self, completion: StopCompletion, current_epoch: u64) -> bool {
000658 |         if !completion.timed_out
000659 |             && completion.result.is_ok()
000660 |             && completion.epoch == current_epoch
000661 |             && self.pending.is_none()
000662 |         {
000663 |             self.failed = false;
000664 |             self.confirmed_epoch = Some(current_epoch);
000665 |             true
000666 |         } else {
000667 |             self.failed = true;
000668 |             self.confirmed_epoch = None;
000669 |             // A late success from a timed-out or old epoch cannot acknowledge a newer request.
000670 |             if self.pending.is_none() && completion.epoch == current_epoch {
000671 |                 self.pending = Some((current_epoch, completion.request));
000672 |             }
000673 |             self.retry_at = tokio::time::Instant::now() + self.retry;
000674 |             false
000675 |         }
000676 |     }
000677 | }
000678 | async fn run_driver<C, CF, S, G, GF, H>(
000679 |     state: (&Path, crate::config::CheckConfig),
000680 |     mut events: tokio::sync::mpsc::Receiver<ProtectionEvent>,
000681 |     mut shutdown: tokio::sync::watch::Receiver<bool>,
000682 |     timing: DriverTiming,
000683 |     check: C,
000684 |     stop: S,
000685 |     hooks: (G, H),
000686 | ) -> Result<(), &'static str>
000687 | where
000688 |     C: Fn(crate::config::CheckConfig) -> CF,
000689 |     CF: std::future::Future<Output = CheckReport> + Send + 'static,
000690 |     S: Fn(&StopRequest) -> Result<usize, &'static str> + Send + Sync + 'static,
000691 |     G: Fn() -> GF,
000692 |     GF: std::future::Future<Output = String>,
000693 |     H: FnMut(u64),
000694 | {
000695 |     let (state_path, mut config) = state;
000696 |     let (_, mut installation_tick) = hooks;
000697 |     let uid = unsafe { libc::geteuid() };
000698 |     let v2 = state_path.parent().ok_or("guardian_state_directory")?;
000699 |     let mut guardian = Guardian::new(uid)?;
000700 |     let mut ticker = tokio::time::interval(timing.tick);
000701 |     ticker.set_missed_tick_behavior(tokio::time::MissedTickBehavior::Skip);
000702 |     let mut checks = tokio::task::JoinSet::new();
000703 |     let mut stop = StopSupervisor::new(stop, timing.stop_timeout, timing.retry);
000704 |     let started = crate::checks::unix_now();
000705 |     let mut sequence = 0;
000706 |     let mut events_open = true;
000707 |     let mut fingerprint = String::new();
000708 |     #[cfg(all(target_os = "macos", not(test)))]
000709 |     let mut update_checked = 0;
000710 |     loop {
000711 |         let stop_running = stop.job.is_some();
000712 |         let event = tokio::select! {
000713 |             result = shutdown.changed() => {
000714 |                 if result.is_err() || *shutdown.borrow() { checks.abort_all(); return Ok(()); }
000715 |                 continue;
000716 |             },
000717 |             report = checks.join_next(), if !checks.is_empty() => {
000718 |                 if let Some(Ok(report)) = report {
000719 |                     guardian.update(report);
000720 |                     if let Some(request) = guardian.evaluate(ProtectionEvent::Timer, 0, "") {
000721 |                         stop.request(0, request);
000722 |                     } else {
000723 |                         stop.pending = None;
000724 |                     }
000725 |                 }
000726 |                 false
000727 |             },
000728 |             result = stop.join(), if stop_running => {
000729 |                 stop.finish(result, 0);
000730 |                 if guardian.evaluate(ProtectionEvent::Timer, 0, "").is_none() { stop.pending = None; }
000731 |                 false
000732 |             },
000733 |             event = events.recv(), if events_open => {
000734 |                 if event.is_none() { events_open = false; continue; }
000735 |                 true
000736 |             },
000737 |             _ = ticker.tick() => {
000738 |                 sequence += 1;
000739 |                 installation_tick(sequence);
000740 |                 #[cfg(all(target_os = "macos", not(test)))]
000741 |                 {
000742 |                     let now = crate::checks::unix_now();
000743 |                     if now.saturating_sub(update_checked) >= 60 {
000744 |                         update_checked = now;
000745 |                         tokio::task::spawn_blocking(spawn_public_update_check);
000746 |                     }
000747 |                 }
000748 |                 true
000749 |             },
000750 |         };
000751 |         if event && checks.is_empty() {
000752 |             // Keep the previous proxy mode if configuration is temporarily unavailable.
000753 |             if let Some(home) = v2.parent().and_then(Path::parent)
000754 |                 && (home.join(".claude-switcher/v2/config.json").exists()
000755 |                     || home.join(".local/bin/claude-switch.sh").exists())
000756 |                 && let Ok(current) = crate::config::load_read_only(home)
000757 |             {
000758 |                 config = current;
000759 |                 // The snapshot is optional heartbeat diagnostics, never a refresh gate.
000760 |                 fingerprint = PolicySnapshot::load(v2)
000761 |                     .map(|snapshot| snapshot.fingerprint)
000762 |                     .unwrap_or_default();
000763 |             }
000764 |             let future = check(config.clone());
000765 |             checks.spawn(future);
000766 |         }
000767 |         stop.start_ready();
000768 |         let health = GuardianHealth {
000769 |             owner_uid: uid,
000770 |             pid: std::process::id() as i32,
000771 |             heartbeat_at: crate::checks::unix_now(),
000772 |             started_at: started,
000773 |             policy: config.clone(),
000774 |             policy_fingerprint: fingerprint.clone(),
000775 |             degraded: stop.failed,
000776 |         };
000777 |         // Heartbeats are diagnostics. Snapshot contention cannot disable the bodyguard.
000778 |         if let Ok(_lock) = crate::storage::GuardianSnapshotLock::try_acquire(v2, true) {
000779 |             let _ = crate::storage::atomic_json(state_path, &health);
000780 |         }
000781 |     }
000782 | }

000855 | /// Invalidate before attempting the bounded notification queue. Overflow may
000856 | /// coalesce guardian work, but it must never preserve old launch evidence.
000857 | #[cfg(any(target_os = "macos", test))]
000858 | fn publish_native_event(
000859 |     sender: &tokio::sync::mpsc::Sender<ProtectionEvent>,
000860 |     event: ProtectionEvent,
000861 |     invalidate: impl FnOnce(),
000862 | ) {
000863 |     invalidate();
000864 |     let _ = sender.try_send(event);
000865 | }

000867 | #[cfg(target_os = "macos")]
000868 | pub struct NativeEvents {
000869 |     stop: std::sync::Arc<std::sync::atomic::AtomicBool>,
000870 |     thread: Option<std::thread::JoinHandle<()>>,
000871 | }
000872 | #[cfg(target_os = "macos")]
000873 | impl NativeEvents {
000874 |     pub(crate) fn is_running(&self) -> bool {
000875 |         self.thread
000876 |             .as_ref()
000877 |             .is_some_and(|thread| !thread.is_finished())
000878 |     }
000879 | }
000880 | #[cfg(target_os = "macos")]
000881 | impl Drop for NativeEvents {
000882 |     fn drop(&mut self) {
000883 |         self.stop.store(true, std::sync::atomic::Ordering::Release);
000884 |         if let Some(thread) = self.thread.take() {
000885 |             let _ = thread.join();
000886 |         }
000887 |     }
000888 | }
000889 | #[cfg(target_os = "macos")]
000890 | pub fn native_events()
000891 | -> Result<(NativeEvents, tokio::sync::mpsc::Receiver<ProtectionEvent>), &'static str> {
000892 |     use std::ffi::c_void;
000893 |     type Obj = *mut c_void;
000894 |     #[repr(C)]
000895 |     struct StoreContext {
000896 |         version: isize,
000897 |         info: Obj,
000898 |         retain: Obj,
000899 |         release: Obj,
000900 |         copy_description: Obj,
000901 |     }
000902 |     struct PowerContext {
000903 |         sender: tokio::sync::mpsc::Sender<ProtectionEvent>,
000904 |         port: u32,
000905 |     }
000906 |     #[link(name = "CoreFoundation", kind = "framework")]
000907 |     unsafe extern "C" {
000908 |         static kCFRunLoopDefaultMode: Obj;
000909 |         fn CFRunLoopGetCurrent() -> Obj;
000910 |         fn CFRunLoopAddSource(runloop: Obj, source: Obj, mode: Obj);
000911 |         fn CFRunLoopRemoveSource(runloop: Obj, source: Obj, mode: Obj);
000912 |         fn CFRunLoopRunInMode(mode: Obj, seconds: f64, return_after_source: bool) -> i32;
000913 |         fn CFStringCreateWithCString(a: Obj, s: *const i8, e: u32) -> Obj;
000914 |         fn CFArrayCreate(a: Obj, values: *const Obj, count: isize, callbacks: Obj) -> Obj;
000915 |         fn CFRelease(o: Obj);
000916 |     }
000917 |     #[link(name = "SystemConfiguration", kind = "framework")]
000918 |     unsafe extern "C" {
000919 |         fn SCDynamicStoreCreate(
000920 |             a: Obj,
000921 |             name: Obj,
000922 |             callback: unsafe extern "C" fn(Obj, Obj, Obj),
000923 |             context: *mut StoreContext,
000924 |         ) -> Obj;
000925 |         fn SCDynamicStoreSetNotificationKeys(store: Obj, keys: Obj, patterns: Obj) -> bool;
000926 |         fn SCDynamicStoreCreateRunLoopSource(a: Obj, store: Obj, order: isize) -> Obj;
000927 |     }
000928 |     #[link(name = "IOKit", kind = "framework")]
000929 |     unsafe extern "C" {
000930 |         fn IORegisterForSystemPower(
000931 |             context: Obj,
000932 |             notification_port: *mut Obj,
000933 |             callback: unsafe extern "C" fn(Obj, u32, u32, Obj),
000934 |             notifier: *mut u32,
000935 |         ) -> u32;
000936 |         fn IONotificationPortGetRunLoopSource(port: Obj) -> Obj;
000937 |         fn IODeregisterForSystemPower(notifier: *mut u32) -> i32;
000938 |         fn IONotificationPortDestroy(port: Obj);
000939 |         fn IOServiceClose(port: u32) -> i32;
000940 |         fn IOAllowPowerChange(port: u32, id: isize) -> i32;
000941 |     }
000942 |     unsafe extern "C" fn changed(_: Obj, _: Obj, context: Obj) {
000943 |         let sender = unsafe { &*context.cast::<tokio::sync::mpsc::Sender<ProtectionEvent>>() };
000944 |         publish_native_event(
000945 |             sender,
000946 |             ProtectionEvent::NetworkChanged,
000947 |             crate::macos::invalidate_network_generation,
000948 |         );
000949 |     }
000950 |     unsafe extern "C" fn power(context: Obj, _service: u32, kind: u32, argument: Obj) {
000951 |         let context = unsafe { &*context.cast::<PowerContext>() };
000952 |         if kind == 0xe0000300 {
000953 |             publish_native_event(
000954 |                 &context.sender,
000955 |                 ProtectionEvent::Wake,
000956 |                 crate::macos::invalidate_network_generation,
000957 |             );
000958 |         } else if kind == 0xe0000270 || kind == 0xe0000280 {
000959 |             unsafe { IOAllowPowerChange(context.port, argument as isize) };
000960 |         }
000961 |     }
000962 |     let (tx, rx) = tokio::sync::mpsc::channel(16);
000963 |     let (ready_tx, ready_rx) = std::sync::mpsc::sync_channel(1);
000964 |     let stop = std::sync::Arc::new(std::sync::atomic::AtomicBool::new(false));
000965 |     let thread_stop = stop.clone();
000966 |     let thread = std::thread::Builder::new()
000967 |         .name("switcher-network-observer".into())
000968 |         .spawn(move || unsafe {
000969 |             let null = std::ptr::null_mut();
000970 |             let name =
000971 |                 CFStringCreateWithCString(null, c"ClaudeSwitcherGuardian".as_ptr(), 0x08000100);
000972 |             let mut context = StoreContext {
000973 |                 version: 0,
000974 |                 info: (&tx as *const tokio::sync::mpsc::Sender<ProtectionEvent>)
000975 |                     .cast_mut()
000976 |                     .cast(),
000977 |                 retain: null,
000978 |                 release: null,
000979 |                 copy_description: null,
000980 |             };
000981 |             let store = SCDynamicStoreCreate(null, name, changed, &mut context);
000982 |             CFRelease(name);
000983 |             if store.is_null() {
000984 |                 let _ = ready_tx.send(Err("network_events_unavailable"));
000985 |                 return;
000986 |             }
000987 |             let keys = [
000988 |                 c"State:/Network/Global/IPv4",
000989 |                 c"State:/Network/Global/IPv6",
000990 |                 c"State:/Network/Global/DNS",
000991 |             ]
000992 |             .map(|s| CFStringCreateWithCString(null, s.as_ptr(), 0x08000100));
000993 |             let array = CFArrayCreate(null, keys.as_ptr(), keys.len() as isize, null);
000994 |             // Global route/resolver keys alone miss interface and per-service changes.
000995 |             let patterns = [
000996 |                 c"State:/Network/Interface/.*/.*",
000997 |                 c"State:/Network/Service/.*/.*",
000998 |             ]
000999 |             .map(|s| CFStringCreateWithCString(null, s.as_ptr(), 0x08000100));
001000 |             let pattern_array =
001001 |                 CFArrayCreate(null, patterns.as_ptr(), patterns.len() as isize, null);
001002 |             let configured = SCDynamicStoreSetNotificationKeys(store, array, pattern_array);
001003 |             CFRelease(pattern_array);
001004 |             for pattern in patterns {
001005 |                 CFRelease(pattern);
001006 |             }
001007 |             CFRelease(array);
001008 |             for key in keys {
001009 |                 CFRelease(key);
001010 |             }
001011 |             let source = SCDynamicStoreCreateRunLoopSource(null, store, 0);
001012 |             if !configured || source.is_null() {
001013 |                 if !source.is_null() {
001014 |                     CFRelease(source);
001015 |                 }
001016 |                 CFRelease(store);
001017 |                 let _ = ready_tx.send(Err("network_events_unavailable"));
001018 |                 return;
001019 |             }
001020 |             let mut notification_port: Obj = std::ptr::null_mut();
001021 |             let mut notifier = 0;
001022 |             let mut context = Box::new(PowerContext {
001023 |                 sender: tx.clone(),
001024 |                 port: 0,
001025 |             });
001026 |             context.port = IORegisterForSystemPower(
001027 |                 (&mut *context as *mut PowerContext).cast(),
001028 |                 &mut notification_port,
001029 |                 power,
001030 |                 &mut notifier,
001031 |             );
001032 |             if context.port == 0 || notification_port.is_null() {
001033 |                 if notifier != 0 {
001034 |                     IODeregisterForSystemPower(&mut notifier);
001035 |                 }
001036 |                 if context.port != 0 {
001037 |                     IOServiceClose(context.port);
001038 |                 }
001039 |                 if !notification_port.is_null() {
001040 |                     IONotificationPortDestroy(notification_port);
001041 |                 }
001042 |                 CFRelease(source);
001043 |                 CFRelease(store);
001044 |                 let _ = ready_tx.send(Err("power_events_unavailable"));
001045 |                 return;
001046 |             }
001047 |             let runloop = CFRunLoopGetCurrent();
001048 |             let power_source = IONotificationPortGetRunLoopSource(notification_port);
001049 |             if power_source.is_null() {
001050 |                 IODeregisterForSystemPower(&mut notifier);
001051 |                 IOServiceClose(context.port);
001052 |                 IONotificationPortDestroy(notification_port);
001053 |                 CFRelease(source);
001054 |                 CFRelease(store);
001055 |                 let _ = ready_tx.send(Err("power_events_unavailable"));
001056 |                 return;
001057 |             }
001058 |             CFRunLoopAddSource(runloop, source, kCFRunLoopDefaultMode);
001059 |             CFRunLoopAddSource(runloop, power_source, kCFRunLoopDefaultMode);
001060 |             let _ = ready_tx.send(Ok(()));
001061 |             while !thread_stop.load(std::sync::atomic::Ordering::Acquire) && !tx.is_closed() {
001062 |                 CFRunLoopRunInMode(kCFRunLoopDefaultMode, 0.25, true);
001063 |             }
001064 |             CFRunLoopRemoveSource(runloop, source, kCFRunLoopDefaultMode);
001065 |             CFRunLoopRemoveSource(runloop, power_source, kCFRunLoopDefaultMode);
001066 |             IODeregisterForSystemPower(&mut notifier);
001067 |             IOServiceClose(context.port);
001068 |             IONotificationPortDestroy(notification_port);
001069 |             CFRelease(source);
001070 |             CFRelease(store);
001071 |         })
001072 |         .map_err(|_| "native_events_thread_unavailable")?;
001073 |     let guard = NativeEvents {
001074 |         stop,
001075 |         thread: Some(thread),
001076 |     };
001077 |     ready_rx
001078 |         .recv_timeout(Duration::from_secs(3))
001079 |         .map_err(|_| "native_events_timeout")??;
001080 |     Ok((guard, rx))
001081 | }
001082 | #[cfg(target_os = "macos")]
001083 | pub async fn run_native(
001084 |     config: crate::config::CheckConfig,
001085 |     state_path: &Path,
001086 |     shutdown: tokio::sync::watch::Receiver<bool>,
001087 | ) -> Result<(), &'static str> {
001088 |     match native_events() {
001089 |         Ok((_native, events)) => run(config, state_path, events, shutdown).await,
001090 |         Err(_) => {
001091 |             // Native notifications are optional accelerators for the ten-second poll.
001092 |             let (_sender, events) = tokio::sync::mpsc::channel(1);
001093 |             run(config, state_path, events, shutdown).await
001094 |         }
001095 |     }
001096 | }

001162 | fn spawn_public_update_check() -> Result<(), &'static str> {
001163 |     let record = read_install_record()?;
001164 |     if record.owner_uid != unsafe { libc::geteuid() } {
001165 |         return Err("update_owner_uid");

001172 |     let status = std::process::Command::new("/usr/bin/codesign")
001173 |         .args([

000020 | fn safe_file(path: &Path, contents: Option<&[u8]>) -> Result<(), &'static str> {
000021 |     use std::os::unix::fs::{MetadataExt, OpenOptionsExt};
000022 |     for parent in path.ancestors().skip(1) {
000023 |         let m = std::fs::symlink_metadata(parent).map_err(|_| REINSTALL)?;
000024 |         if !m.is_dir() || m.uid() != 0 || m.mode() & 0o022 != 0 {
000025 |             return Err(REINSTALL);
000026 |         }
000027 |     }
000028 |     let file = std::fs::OpenOptions::new()
000029 |         .read(true)
000030 |         .custom_flags(libc::O_NOFOLLOW | libc::O_NONBLOCK | libc::O_CLOEXEC)
000031 |         .open(path)
000032 |         .map_err(|_| REINSTALL)?;
000033 |     let m = file.metadata().map_err(|_| REINSTALL)?;
000034 |     if !m.is_file() || m.uid() != 0 || m.mode() & 0o022 != 0 || m.nlink() != 1 {
000035 |         return Err(REINSTALL);
000036 |     }
000037 |     if let Some(expected) = contents {
000038 |         let mut bytes = Vec::new();
000039 |         file.take(expected.len() as u64 + 1)
000040 |             .read_to_end(&mut bytes)
000041 |             .map_err(|_| REINSTALL)?;
000042 |         validate_plist(&bytes)?;
000043 |     }
000044 |     Ok(())
000045 | }

000047 |     if bytes == TEMPLATE {
000048 |         Ok(())
000049 |     } else {
000050 |         Err(REINSTALL)

000053 | fn command(program: &str, args: &[&str]) -> Result<bool, &'static str> {
000054 |     use std::process::{Command, Stdio};
000055 |     let mut child = Command::new(program)
000056 |         .args(args)
000057 |         .env_clear()
000058 |         .env("PATH", "/usr/bin:/bin:/usr/sbin:/sbin")
000059 |         .env("LC_ALL", "C")
000060 |         .stdin(Stdio::null())
000061 |         .stdout(Stdio::null())
000062 |         .stderr(Stdio::null())
000063 |         .spawn()

000065 |     let deadline = Instant::now() + Duration::from_secs(3);
000066 |     loop {
000067 |         match child.try_wait() {
000068 |             Ok(Some(status)) => return Ok(status.success()),
000069 |             Ok(None) if Instant::now() < deadline => std::thread::sleep(Duration::from_millis(20)),
000070 |             _ => {
000071 |                 let _ = child.kill();
000072 |                 let _ = child.wait();
000073 |                 return Err(INCOMPLETE);
000074 |             }
000075 |         }
000076 |     }

000100 | fn bound_health<R: PartialEq>(
000101 |     expected: &R,
000102 |     mut current: impl FnMut() -> Result<R, &'static str>,
000103 |     healthy: impl FnOnce() -> bool,
000104 | ) -> Result<bool, &'static str> {
000105 |     if current()? != *expected {
000106 |         return Err(INCOMPLETE);
000107 |     }

000115 | fn repair_with<T>(
000116 |     validate: impl FnOnce() -> Result<T, &'static str>,
000117 |     mut healthy: impl FnMut() -> bool,
000118 |     registered: impl FnOnce() -> Result<bool, &'static str>,
000119 |     restart: impl FnOnce(bool) -> Result<(), &'static str>,
000120 |     mut wait: impl FnMut() -> bool,
000121 | ) -> Result<(), &'static str> {
000122 |     let guard = validate().map_err(|_| INCOMPLETE)?;
000123 |     if healthy() {
000124 |         return Ok(());
000125 |     }
000126 |     restart(registered().map_err(|_| INCOMPLETE)?).map_err(|_| INCOMPLETE)?;
000127 |     drop(guard); // Guardian needs the lifecycle lock to publish current health.
000128 |     loop {
000129 |         if healthy() {
000130 |             return Ok(());
000131 |         }
000132 |         if !wait() {
000133 |             return Err(INCOMPLETE);
000134 |         }
000135 |     }
000136 | }
000137 | /// Caller has committed and released the lifecycle lock before waiting for health.
000138 | pub(crate) fn restore_after_commit(edition: Edition) -> Result<(), &'static str> {
000139 |     let uid = unsafe { libc::geteuid() };
000140 |     let domain = format!("gui/{uid}");
000141 |     let target = format!("{domain}/{GUARDIAN_LABEL}");
000142 |     let deadline = Instant::now() + Duration::from_secs(10);
000143 |     let expected = std::cell::RefCell::new(None);
000144 |     let identity_changed = std::cell::Cell::new(false);
000145 |     repair_with(
000146 |         || {
000147 |             let home = crate::migration::account_home(uid).map_err(|_| INCOMPLETE)?;
000148 |             let lock =
000149 |                 crate::storage::LifecycleLock::try_acquire(&home.join(".claude-switcher/v2"))
000150 |                     .map_err(|_| INCOMPLETE)?;
000151 |             *expected.borrow_mut() = Some(validate(edition)?);
000152 |             Ok(lock)
000153 |         },
000154 |         || {
000155 |             if identity_changed.get() {
000156 |                 return false;
000157 |             }
000158 |             expected.borrow().as_ref().is_some_and(|record| {
000159 |                 bound_health(record, crate::guardian::read_install_record, || {
000160 |                     crate::install::validate_installed_health(uid).is_ok()
000161 |                 })
000162 |                 .unwrap_or_else(|_| {
000163 |                     identity_changed.set(true);
000164 |                     false
000165 |                 })
000166 |             })
000167 |         },
000168 |         || {
000169 |             if identity_changed.get() {
000170 |                 Err(INCOMPLETE)
000171 |             } else {
000172 |                 command("/bin/launchctl", &["print", &target])
000173 |             }
000174 |         },
000175 |         |registered| {
000176 |             let ok = if registered {
000177 |                 command("/bin/launchctl", &["kickstart", "-k", &target])?
000178 |             } else {
000179 |                 command("/bin/launchctl", &["bootstrap", &domain, PLIST])?
000180 |             };
000181 |             if ok { Ok(()) } else { Err(INCOMPLETE) }
000182 |         },
000183 |         || {
000184 |             if identity_changed.get() || Instant::now() >= deadline {
000185 |                 false
000186 |             } else {
000187 |                 std::thread::sleep(Duration::from_millis(100));
000188 |                 true
000189 |             }
000190 |         },
000191 |     )
000192 | }

000340 | /// Restore only existing root-owned daemon plists and fixed protected executables.
000341 | /// Missing artifacts are reported; no user-writable program is copied or elevated.
000342 | pub(crate) fn legacy_admin_commands() -> (Vec<String>, bool) {
000343 |     legacy_admin_commands_with(
000344 |         |label| command("/bin/launchctl", &["print", &format!("system/{label}")]),
000345 |         |plist, executable, template| {
000346 |             if !Path::new(plist).exists() {
000347 |                 return Ok(false);
000348 |             }
000349 |             safe_file(Path::new(plist), None)?;
000350 |             if std::fs::read(plist).map_err(|_| REINSTALL)? != template {
000351 |                 return Err(REINSTALL);
000352 |             }
000353 |             safe_file(Path::new(executable), None)?;
000354 |             Ok(true)
000355 |         },
000356 |         || {
000357 |             if !Path::new(PLIST).exists() {
000358 |                 return Ok(false);
000359 |             }
000360 |             safe_file(Path::new(PLIST), Some(TEMPLATE))?;
000361 |             safe_file(Path::new(BINARY), None)?;
000362 |             let domain = format!("gui/{}", unsafe { libc::geteuid() });
000363 |             let target = format!("{domain}/{GUARDIAN_LABEL}");
000364 |             if command("/bin/launchctl", &["print", &target])?
000365 |                 || command("/bin/launchctl", &["bootstrap", &domain, PLIST])?
000366 |             {
000367 |                 Ok(true)
000368 |             } else {
000369 |                 Err(REINSTALL)
000370 |             }
000371 |         },
000372 |     )
000373 | }
000374 | 
000375 | fn legacy_admin_commands_with(
000376 |     mut registered: impl FnMut(&str) -> Result<bool, &'static str>,
000377 |     mut components: impl FnMut(&str, &str, &[u8]) -> Result<bool, &'static str>,
000378 |     user_guardian: impl FnOnce() -> Result<bool, &'static str>,
000379 | ) -> (Vec<String>, bool) {
000380 |     let mut commands = Vec::new();
000381 |     let mut bodyguard_available = false;
000382 |     let mut failed = false;
000383 |     for (label, plist, executable, template) in [
000384 |         (
000385 |             "local.claude-bodyguard",
000386 |             "/Library/LaunchDaemons/local.claude-bodyguard.plist",
000387 |             "/Library/Application Support/claude-switcher/claude-bodyguard.sh",
000388 |             &include_bytes!("../../../daemons/local.claude-bodyguard.plist")[..],
000389 |         ),
000390 |         (
000391 |             "local.tz-watchdog",
000392 |             "/Library/LaunchDaemons/local.tz-watchdog.plist",
000393 |             "/Library/Application Support/claude-switcher/tz-watchdog.sh",
000394 |             &include_bytes!("../../../daemons/local.tz-watchdog.plist")[..],
000395 |         ),
000396 |     ] {
000397 |         let available = match registered(label) {
000398 |             Ok(true) => true,
000399 |             result => {
000400 |                 failed |= result.is_err();
000401 |                 match components(plist, executable, template) {
000402 |                     Ok(true) => {
000403 |                         commands.push(format!("/bin/launchctl bootstrap system '{plist}'"));
000404 |                         true
000405 |                     }
000406 |                     Ok(false) => false,
000407 |                     Err(_) => {
000408 |                         failed = true;
000409 |                         false
000410 |                     }
000411 |                 }
000412 |             }
000413 |         };
000414 |         if label == "local.claude-bodyguard" {
000415 |             bodyguard_available = available;
000416 |         }
000417 |     }
000418 |     let user_available = match user_guardian() {
000419 |         Ok(available) => available,
000420 |         Err(_) => {
000421 |             failed = true;
000422 |             false
000423 |         }
000424 |     };
000425 |     (commands, !failed && (bodyguard_available || user_available))
000426 | }

000478 | pub(crate) fn legacy_watchdog_command(timezone: &str) -> Option<String> {

000480 |         return None;
000481 |     }

000485 |     if source.lines().any(|line| {
000486 |         line.strip_prefix("TARGET=")
000487 |             .is_some_and(|value| value.trim_matches('"') == timezone)
000488 |     }) {
000489 |         return None;
000490 |     }
000491 |     Some(format!(
000492 |         "/usr/bin/sed -i '' 's|^TARGET=.*|TARGET={timezone}|' '/Library/Application Support/claude-switcher/tz-watchdog.sh'"
000493 |     ))
000494 | }

000095 |             owner_uid,
000096 |             intent,

000110 |         storage::atomic_json(&self.journal_path(), journal).map_err(|_| "install_journal_write")
000111 |     }
000112 |     pub fn inspect(&self) -> Result<InstallJournal, &'static str> {

000115 |         if journal.schema_version != 1 {

000118 |         Ok(journal)

000120 |     /// Cancel before authorization. An interrupted transaction must be recovered instead.
000121 |     pub fn cancel(&self, preview: InstallPreview) -> Result<InstallJournal, &'static str> {
000122 |         let _lock = LifecycleLock::try_acquire(&self.directory).map_err(|_| "lifecycle_busy")?;
000123 |         self.ensure_no_pending()?;
000124 |         let journal = InstallJournal {
000125 |             schema_version: 1,
000126 |             preview,
000127 |             stage: Stage::Cancelled,
000128 |             completed: vec![],
000129 |             pending: None,
000130 |             errors: vec![],
000131 |         };
000132 |         self.save(&journal)?;
000133 |         Ok(journal)
000134 |     }
000135 |     fn ensure_no_pending(&self) -> Result<(), &'static str> {
000136 |         if self.journal_path().exists() {
000137 |             let journal = self.inspect()?;
000138 |             if !matches!(
000139 |                 journal.stage,
000140 |                 Stage::Committed | Stage::Recovered | Stage::Cancelled
000141 |             ) {
000142 |                 return Err("installation_recovery_required");
000143 |             }
000144 |         }

000147 |     pub fn execute(
000148 |         &self,
000149 |         preview: InstallPreview,
000150 |         backend: &mut impl InstallBackend,
000151 |     ) -> Result<InstallJournal, &'static str> {
000152 |         let _lock = LifecycleLock::try_acquire(&self.directory).map_err(|_| "lifecycle_busy")?;
000153 |         self.ensure_no_pending()?;
000154 |         // Rebuild the preview from fixed fields; never trust serialized lists of privileged paths.
000155 |         let expected = self.preview(
000156 |             preview.owner_uid,
000157 |             preview.edition,
000158 |             preview.previous_edition,
000159 |             preview.intent,
000160 |         )?;
000161 |         if serde_json::to_vec(&expected).ok() != serde_json::to_vec(&preview).ok() {
000162 |             return Err("install_preview_changed");
000163 |         }

000165 |             schema_version: 1,
000166 |             preview,
000167 |             stage: Stage::Preview,
000168 |             completed: vec![],
000169 |             pending: Some("authorize".into()),
000170 |             errors: vec![],
000171 |         };
000172 |         self.save(&journal)?;
000173 |         if let Err(code) = backend.authorize() {
000174 |             journal.stage = Stage::Cancelled;
000175 |             journal.pending = None;
000176 |             journal.errors.push(code.into());

000178 |             return Ok(journal);
000179 |         }
000180 |         journal.stage = Stage::Authorized;
000181 |         self.save(&journal)?;
000182 |         for (operation, stage) in [
000183 |             ("backup", Stage::BackupSaved),
000184 |             ("stage", Stage::ComponentsStaged),
000185 |             ("health", Stage::HealthVerified),
000186 |             ("commit", Stage::Committed),
000187 |         ] {
000188 |             journal.pending = Some(operation.into());

000191 |                 "backup" => backend.backup(),
000192 |                 "stage" => backend.stage_signed_components(&journal.preview),
000193 |                 "health" => backend.verify_health(&journal.preview),
000194 |                 "commit" => backend.commit_root_record(&journal.preview),
000195 |                 _ => unreachable!(),
000196 |             };
000197 |             if let Err(code) = result {
000198 |                 if operation == "commit" && backend.is_committed(&journal.preview)? {
000199 |                     journal.stage = Stage::Committed;
000200 |                     journal.pending = None;
000201 |                     self.save(&journal)?;
000202 |                     return Ok(journal);
000203 |                 }
000204 |                 journal.errors.push(code.into());

000206 |                 self.save(&journal)?;
000207 |                 return self.rollback(journal, backend);
000208 |             }
000209 |             journal.completed.push(operation.into());
000210 |             journal.pending = None;
000211 |             journal.stage = stage;
000212 |             self.save(&journal)?;
000213 |         }
000214 |         Ok(journal)
000215 |     }
000216 |     fn rollback(
000217 |         &self,
000218 |         mut journal: InstallJournal,
000219 |         backend: &mut impl InstallBackend,
000220 |     ) -> Result<InstallJournal, &'static str> {
000221 |         // Even a partially completed backup must support idempotent restore.
000222 |         journal.pending = Some("restore".into());
000223 |         self.save(&journal)?;
000224 |         match backend.restore_backup(&journal.preview) {
000225 |             Ok(()) => {
000226 |                 journal.stage = Stage::Recovered;
000227 |                 journal.pending = None;
000228 |             }
000229 |             Err(code) => {
000230 |                 journal.stage = Stage::RecoveryRequired;
000231 |                 journal.errors.push(code.into());
000232 |             }
000233 |         }
000234 |         self.save(&journal)?;
000235 |         Ok(journal)
000236 |     }
000237 |     pub fn recover(
000238 |         &self,
000239 |         backend: &mut impl InstallBackend,
000240 |     ) -> Result<InstallJournal, &'static str> {
000241 |         let _lock = LifecycleLock::try_acquire(&self.directory).map_err(|_| "lifecycle_busy")?;
000242 |         let mut journal = self.inspect()?;
000243 |         if journal.pending.as_deref() == Some("commit") && backend.is_committed(&journal.preview)? {
000244 |             journal.stage = Stage::Committed;
000245 |             journal.pending = None;
000246 |             self.save(&journal)?;
000247 |             return Ok(journal);
000248 |         }
000249 |         if matches!(
000250 |             journal.stage,
000251 |             Stage::Committed | Stage::Recovered | Stage::Cancelled
000252 |         ) {
000253 |             return Ok(journal);
000254 |         }
000255 |         self.rollback(journal, backend)
000256 |     }
000257 |     pub fn directory(&self) -> &Path {
000258 |         &self.directory
000259 |     }
000260 | }
