000616 | /// Production backend. Both forward and recovery PKGs must be signed by the pinned team.
000617 | /// No mutation occurs during construction or package verification.
000618 | pub struct SignedPkgBackend {
000619 |     package: PathBuf,
000620 |     recovery_package: PathBuf,
000621 |     team: String,
000622 |     state: PathBuf,
000623 |     authorization: usize,
000624 |     window: Option<switcher_helper::root_operation::RootWindow>,
000625 |     expected_hash: Option<String>,
000626 |     previous: Option<Edition>,
000627 |     target: Option<Edition>,
000628 |     uid: u32,
000629 | }
000630 | impl SignedPkgBackend {
000631 |     pub fn new(
000632 |         package: PathBuf,
000633 |         recovery_package: PathBuf,
000634 |         team: String,
000635 |         state: PathBuf,
000636 |     ) -> Result<Self, &'static str> {
000637 |         if team.len() != 10
000638 |             || !team
000639 |                 .bytes()
000640 |                 .all(|b| b.is_ascii_uppercase() || b.is_ascii_digit())
000641 |         {
000642 |             return Err("installer_team");
000643 |         }
000644 |         if !package.is_absolute() || !recovery_package.is_absolute() || package == recovery_package
000645 |         {
000646 |             return Err("installer_package_path");
000647 |         }
000648 |         storage::create_private_directory(&state).map_err(|_| "installer_state")?;
000649 |         Ok(Self {
000650 |             package,
000651 |             recovery_package,
000652 |             team,
000653 |             state,
000654 |             authorization: 0,
000655 |             window: None,
000656 |             expected_hash: None,
000657 |             previous: None,
000658 |             target: None,
000659 |             uid: unsafe { libc::geteuid() },
000660 |         })
000661 |     }
000662 |     pub fn verify_package(path: &Path, team: &str) -> Result<(), &'static str> {
000663 |         let meta = std::fs::symlink_metadata(path).map_err(|_| "package_missing")?;
000664 |         if !meta.is_file() || meta.file_type().is_symlink() {
000665 |             return Err("package_type");
000666 |         }
000667 |         let output = std::process::Command::new("/usr/sbin/pkgutil")
000668 |             .arg("--check-signature")
000669 |             .arg(path)
000670 |             .env("LC_ALL", "C")
000671 |             .output()
000672 |             .map_err(|_| "package_signature_unavailable")?;
000673 |         let text = String::from_utf8_lossy(&output.stdout);
000674 |         if !output.status.success()
000675 |             || !text.lines().any(|s| {
000676 |                 s.contains("Developer ID Installer:") && s.trim().ends_with(&format!("({team})"))
000677 |             })
000678 |         {
000679 |             return Err("package_signature");
000680 |         }
000681 |         let status = std::process::Command::new("/usr/sbin/spctl")
000682 |             .args(["--assess", "--type", "install"])
000683 |             .arg(path)
000684 |             .status()
000685 |             .map_err(|_| "package_assessment_unavailable")?;
000686 |         if status.success() {
000687 |             Ok(())
000688 |         } else {
000689 |             Err("package_notarization")
000690 |         }
000691 |     }
000692 |     fn install_package(&self, path: &Path) -> Result<(), &'static str> {
000693 |         Self::verify_package(path, &self.team)?;
000694 |         run_root_operation(
000695 |             &switcher_helper::root_operation::RootOperation::InstallPackage {
000696 |                 source: path.to_owned(),
000697 |                 team: self.team.clone(),
000698 |                 window: self.window.clone(),
000699 |                 sha256: self.expected_hash.clone(),
000700 |             },
000701 |             &self.team,
000702 |         )
000703 |     }
000704 | }
000705 | #[cfg(target_os = "macos")]
000706 | #[link(name = "Security", kind = "framework")]
000707 | unsafe extern "C" {
000708 |     fn AuthorizationCreate(
000709 |         rights: *const std::ffi::c_void,
000710 |         environment: *const std::ffi::c_void,
000711 |         flags: u32,
000712 |         authorization: *mut *mut std::ffi::c_void,
000713 |     ) -> i32;
000714 |     fn AuthorizationFree(authorization: *mut std::ffi::c_void, flags: u32) -> i32;
000715 | }
000716 | impl InstallBackend for SignedPkgBackend {
000717 |     fn authorize(&mut self) -> Result<(), &'static str> {
000718 |         Self::verify_package(&self.package, &self.team)?;
000719 |         Self::verify_package(&self.recovery_package, &self.team)?;
000720 |         #[cfg(target_os = "macos")]
000721 |         {
000722 |             #[repr(C)]
000723 |             struct Item {
000724 |                 name: *const i8,
000725 |                 len: usize,
000726 |                 value: *mut std::ffi::c_void,
000727 |                 flags: u32,
000728 |             }
000729 |             #[repr(C)]
000730 |             struct Rights {
000731 |                 count: u32,
000732 |                 items: *mut Item,
000733 |             }
000734 |             let mut item = Item {
000735 |                 name: c"system.install.software".as_ptr(),
000736 |                 len: 0,
000737 |                 value: std::ptr::null_mut(),
000738 |                 flags: 0,
000739 |             };
000740 |             let rights = Rights {
000741 |                 count: 1,
000742 |                 items: &mut item,
000743 |             };
000744 |             let mut auth = std::ptr::null_mut();
000745 |             let status = unsafe {
000746 |                 AuthorizationCreate(
000747 |                     (&rights as *const Rights).cast(),
000748 |                     std::ptr::null(),
000749 |                     1 | 2 | 16,
000750 |                     &mut auth,
000751 |                 )
000752 |             };
000753 |             if status != 0 || auth.is_null() {
000754 |                 return Err("authorization_cancelled_or_denied");
000755 |             }
000756 |             self.authorization = auth as usize;
000757 |             Ok(())
000758 |         }
000759 |         #[cfg(not(target_os = "macos"))]
000760 |         {
000761 |             Err("macos_required")
000762 |         }

000922 | fn read_update_transaction(path: &Path) -> std::io::Result<UpdateTransaction> {
000923 |     let limit = crate::updates::STATE_LIMIT + 16384;
000924 |     let bytes = storage::read_private_bytes(path, limit)?;
000925 |     crate::signed::strict_json(&bytes, limit).map_err(std::io::Error::other)

000927 | #[cfg(target_os = "macos")]
000928 | fn run_root_operation(
000929 |     op: &switcher_helper::root_operation::RootOperation,
000930 |     team: &str,
000931 | ) -> Result<(), &'static str> {
000932 |     let installed = Path::new("/Library/PrivilegedHelperTools/local.claudeswitcher.helper");
000933 |     let binary = if installed.exists() {
000934 |         installed.to_owned()
000935 |     } else {
000936 |         std::env::current_exe()
000937 |             .map_err(|_| "wait_signed_bootstrap")?
000938 |             .parent()
000939 |             .and_then(|p| p.parent())
000940 |             .ok_or("wait_signed_bootstrap")?
000941 |             .join("Resources/components/switcher-helper")
000942 |     };
000943 |     if !binary.is_file() {
000944 |         return Err("wait_signed_bootstrap");
000945 |     }
000946 |     verify_binary_signature(&binary, team, switcher_domain::system::HELPER_LABEL)?;
000947 |     let body = serde_json::to_string(op).map_err(|_| "root_operation_encoding")?;
000948 |     if body.len() > 16384 {
000949 |         return Err("root_operation_size");
000950 |     }
000951 |     run_administrator(&root_operation_script(&binary, &body, team)?)
000952 | }
000953 | #[cfg(target_os = "macos")]
000954 | fn root_operation_script(binary: &Path, body: &str, team: &str) -> Result<String, &'static str> {
000955 |     let requirement = format!(
000956 |         "=anchor apple generic and certificate leaf[subject.OU] = \"{team}\" and identifier \"local.claudeswitcher.helper\""
000957 |     );
000958 |     let script = format!(
000959 |         r#"set -eu
000960 | base='/Library/Application Support/claude-switcher'
000961 | for p in '/Library' '/Library/Application Support' "$base"; do
000962 | [ ! -L "$p" ] || exit 72
000963 | if [ -e "$p" ]; then
000964 | [ "$(/usr/bin/stat -f %u "$p")" = 0 ] || exit 73
000965 | /usr/bin/find "$p" -maxdepth 0 -perm +022 | /usr/bin/grep -q . && exit 74
000966 | fi
000967 | done
000968 | /bin/mkdir -p "$base"
000969 | /usr/sbin/chown root:wheel "$base"
000970 | /bin/chmod 755 "$base"
000971 | stage=$(/usr/bin/mktemp -d "$base/.bootstrap-XXXXXX")
000972 | /bin/chmod 700 "$stage"
000973 | trap '/bin/rm -rf "$stage"' EXIT
000974 | /bin/cp {} "$stage/runner"
000975 | /usr/sbin/chown root:wheel "$stage/runner"
000976 | /bin/chmod 700 "$stage/runner"
000977 | /usr/bin/codesign --verify --strict --test-requirement {} "$stage/runner"
000978 | "$stage/runner" --root-operation {}
000979 | "#,
000980 |         shell_literal(binary.to_str().ok_or("bootstrap_path_encoding")?),
000981 |         shell_literal(&requirement),
000982 |         shell_literal(body)
000983 |     );
000984 |     Ok(script)
000985 | }
000986 | /// A lock capability is retained for the complete native update transaction.
000987 | /// The desktop adapter persists its aggregate state; this journal survives its process dying.
000988 | #[cfg(target_os = "macos")]
000989 | pub struct NativeUpdateCoordinator<'a> {
000990 |     root: PathBuf,
000991 |     lock: &'a LifecycleLock,
000992 |     clock: crate::time::ClockState,
000993 | }
000994 | #[derive(Clone, Serialize, Deserialize)]
000995 | #[serde(deny_unknown_fields)]
000996 | struct UpdateTransaction {
000997 |     schema: u32,
000998 |     edition: Edition,
000999 |     team: String,
001000 |     old_app: String,
001001 |     old_helper: String,
001002 |     app: String,
001003 |     helper_changed: bool,
001004 |     helper_pending: bool,
001005 |     app_pending: bool,
001006 |     committed: bool,
001007 |     updates: crate::updates::UpdateState,
001008 | }
001009 | #[cfg(target_os = "macos")]
001010 | impl<'a> NativeUpdateCoordinator<'a> {
001011 |     pub fn new(
001012 |         root: &Path,
001013 |         lock: &'a LifecycleLock,
001014 |         clock: crate::time::ClockState,
001015 |     ) -> Result<Self, &'static str> {
001016 |         if !lock.protects(root) {
001017 |             return Err("lifecycle_lock_required");
001018 |         }
001019 |         Ok(Self {
001020 |             root: root.to_owned(),
001021 |             lock,
001022 |             clock,
001023 |         })
001024 |     }
001025 |     fn path(&self) -> PathBuf {
001026 |         self.root.join("update-install-transaction.json")
001027 |     }
001028 |     fn save(&self, journal: &UpdateTransaction) -> Result<(), &'static str> {
001029 |         if !self.lock.protects(&self.root) {
001030 |             return Err("lifecycle_lock_required");
001031 |         }
001032 |         let bytes = serde_json::to_vec(journal).map_err(|_| "update_transaction_encoding")?;
001033 |         if bytes.len() > crate::updates::STATE_LIMIT + 16384 {
001034 |             return Err("update_transaction_size");
001035 |         }
001036 |         storage::atomic_write(&self.path(), &bytes).map_err(|_| "update_transaction_write")
001037 |     }
001038 |     /// Real recovery keeps RecoveryRequired until both old signed components verify.
001039 |     /// Call under the same lock before accepting another candidate.
001040 |     pub fn recover(&mut self, state: &mut crate::updates::UpdateState) -> Result<(), &'static str> {
001041 |         let mut journal: UpdateTransaction = match read_update_transaction(&self.path()) {
001042 |             Ok(j) => j,
001043 |             Err(e) if e.kind() == std::io::ErrorKind::NotFound => return Ok(()),
001044 |             Err(_) => return Err("update_transaction_read"),
001045 |         };
001046 |         if journal.schema != 1 {
001047 |             return Err("update_transaction_schema");
001048 |         }
001049 |         if journal.committed {
001050 |             if state.candidate.as_ref().map(|c| &c.payload_hash)
001051 |                 == journal.updates.candidate.as_ref().map(|c| &c.payload_hash)
001052 |             {
001053 |                 *state = journal.updates;
001054 |             }
001055 |             return Ok(());
001056 |         }
001057 |         let uid = unsafe { libc::geteuid() };
001058 |         crate::accounts::ensure_claude_stopped(uid).map_err(|_| "claude_running")?;
001059 |         let record = switcher_helper::platform::load_root_record(Path::new(INSTALL_RECORD))?;
001060 |         if record.owner_uid != uid
001061 |             || record.edition != journal.edition
001062 |             || record.developer_team()? != journal.team
001063 |         {
001064 |             return Err("update_recovery_identity");
001065 |         }
001066 |         if self
001067 |             .root
001068 |             .join("account-journal.json")
001069 |             .try_exists()
001070 |             .map_err(|_| "account_journal")?
001071 |         {
001072 |             return Err("account_recovery_required");
001073 |         }
001074 |         journal.updates.recover_interrupted();
001075 |         self.save(&journal)?;
001076 |         if journal.helper_pending
001077 |             && (record.helper_version != journal.old_helper
001078 |                 || Path::new(switcher_domain::system::SYSTEM_ROOT)
001079 |                     .join("component-pending")
001080 |                     .exists())
001081 |         {
001082 |             let old = switcher_helper::platform::load_root_record(
001083 |                 &Path::new(switcher_domain::system::SYSTEM_ROOT)
001084 |                     .join("component-backup/install.json"),
001085 |             )?;
001086 |             if old.helper_version != journal.old_helper
001087 |                 || old.edition != journal.edition
001088 |                 || old.developer_team()? != journal.team
001089 |                 || old.owner_uid != uid
001090 |             {
001091 |                 return Err("update_recovery_snapshot");
001092 |             }
001093 |             let recovery = self.recovery_pkg(journal.edition);
001094 |             let backend = SignedPkgBackend::new(
001095 |                 self.root.join("unused-forward.pkg"),
001096 |                 recovery.clone(),
001097 |                 journal.team.clone(),
001098 |                 self.root.clone(),
001099 |             )?;
001100 |             backend.install_package(&recovery)?;
001101 |         }
001102 |         if journal.app_pending {
001103 |             run_root_operation(
001104 |                 &switcher_helper::root_operation::RootOperation::RestoreApp {
001105 |                     edition: journal.edition,
001106 |                     team: journal.team.clone(),
001107 |                     old: journal.old_app.clone(),
001108 |                     new: journal.app.clone(),
001109 |                 },
001110 |                 &journal.team,
001111 |             )?;
001112 |         }
001113 |         let restored = wait_installed(journal.edition, uid)?;
001114 |         if restored.helper_version != journal.old_helper {
001115 |             return Err("update_recovery_helper_version");
001116 |         }
001117 |         verify_app_version(
001118 |             &installed_app(journal.edition),
001119 |             &journal.team,
001120 |             record.bundle_id(switcher_domain::system::ClientRole::Gui),
001121 |             &journal.old_app,
001122 |         )?;
001123 |         if journal
001124 |             .updates
001125 |             .candidate
001126 |             .as_ref()
001127 |             .is_some_and(|c| c.stage == crate::updates::InstallStage::RecoveryRequired)
001128 |         {
001129 |             journal.updates.advance_install(
001130 |                 crate::updates::InstallStage::RecoveryRequired,
001131 |                 crate::updates::InstallStage::RolledBack,
001132 |             )?;
001133 |         }
001134 |         *state = journal.updates.clone();
001135 |         journal.committed = true;
001136 |         self.save(&journal)
001137 |     }
001138 |     fn fresh_gate(
001139 |         &mut self,
001140 |         metadata: &crate::updates::Metadata,
001141 |         uid: u32,
001142 |     ) -> Result<u64, &'static str> {
001143 |         if !self.lock.protects(&self.root) {
001144 |             return Err("lifecycle_lock_required");
001145 |         }
001146 |         let sample = crate::time::sample()?;
001147 |         self.clock.observe(sample.clone());
001148 |         let now: u64 = sample.utc_secs.try_into().map_err(|_| "update_clock")?;
001149 |         validate_update_time(&self.clock, metadata.issued_at, metadata.expires_at, now)?;
001150 |         crate::accounts::ensure_claude_stopped(uid).map_err(|_| "claude_running")?;
001151 |         if self
001152 |             .root
001153 |             .join("account-journal.json")
001154 |             .try_exists()
001155 |             .map_err(|_| "account_journal")?
001156 |         {
001157 |             return Err("account_recovery_required");
001158 |         }
001159 |         Ok(now)
001160 |     }
001161 |     fn recovery_pkg(&self, edition: Edition) -> PathBuf {
001162 |         self.root
001163 |             .join(match edition {
001164 |                 Edition::Personal => "personal",
001165 |                 Edition::Public => "public",
001166 |             })
001167 |             .join("update-recovery/helper.pkg")
001168 |     }
001169 | }
001170 | #[cfg(target_os = "macos")]
001171 | impl crate::updates::UpdateInstallCoordinator for NativeUpdateCoordinator<'_> {
001172 |     fn install(
001173 |         &mut self,
001174 |         prepared: &crate::updates::PreparedInstallation,
001175 |         state: &mut crate::updates::UpdateState,
001176 |     ) -> Result<(), &'static str> {
001177 |         use crate::updates::{InstallOrder, InstallReadiness, InstallStage as UStage};
001178 |         if !self.lock.protects(&self.root) {
001179 |             return Err("lifecycle_lock_required");
001180 |         }
001181 |         if self.path().exists() {
001182 |             let previous: UpdateTransaction =
001183 |                 read_update_transaction(&self.path()).map_err(|_| "update_transaction_read")?;
001184 |             if !previous.committed {
001185 |                 return Err("update_recovery_required");
001186 |             }
001187 |         }
001188 |         let sample = crate::time::sample()?;
001189 |         self.clock.observe(sample.clone());
001190 |         if !self.clock.trusted() {
001191 |             return Err("clock_recovery_required");
001192 |         }
001193 |         let uid = unsafe { libc::geteuid() };
001194 |         let metadata = prepared.candidate().metadata();
001195 |         let installed = validate_installed_identity(metadata.edition, uid)?;
001196 |         let installed_team = installed.developer_team()?.to_owned();
001197 |         validate_installed_health(uid)?;
001198 |         if self
001199 |             .root
001200 |             .join("account-journal.json")
001201 |             .try_exists()
001202 |             .map_err(|_| "account_journal")?
001203 |         {
001204 |             return Err("account_recovery_required");
001205 |         }
001206 |         crate::accounts::ensure_claude_stopped(uid).map_err(|_| "claude_running")?;
001207 |         let app = installed_app(metadata.edition);
001208 |         verify_binary_signature(
001209 |             &app,
001210 |             &installed_team,
001211 |             installed.bundle_id(switcher_domain::system::ClientRole::Gui),
001212 |         )?;
001213 |         let old_app = app_version(&app)?;
001214 |         let _app_version = semver::Version::parse(&old_app).map_err(|_| "installed_app_version")?;
001215 |         let helper_version = semver::Version::parse(&installed.helper_version)
001216 |             .map_err(|_| "installed_helper_version")?;
001217 |         let final_helper = metadata
001218 |             .helper
001219 |             .as_ref()
001220 |             .map(|h| &h.version)
001221 |             .unwrap_or(&helper_version);
001222 |         if metadata.app.team_id != installed_team
001223 |             || !metadata.app.compatible_with.matches(final_helper)
001224 |             || metadata.helper.as_ref().is_some_and(|h| {
001225 |                 h.team_id != installed_team || !h.compatible_with.matches(&metadata.app.version)
001226 |             })
001227 |         {
001228 |             return Err("components_incompatible");
001229 |         }
001230 |         let recovery = self.recovery_pkg(metadata.edition);
001231 |         if prepared.helper_path().is_some() {
001232 |             if !recovery.is_file() {
001233 |                 return Err("wait_update_recovery_pkg");
001234 |             }
001235 |             SignedPkgBackend::verify_package(&recovery, &installed_team)?;
001236 |         }
001237 |         let mut pkg = prepared
001238 |             .helper_path()
001239 |             .map(|p| {
001240 |                 SignedPkgBackend::new(
001241 |                     p.to_owned(),
001242 |                     recovery.clone(),
001243 |                     installed_team.clone(),
001244 |                     self.root.clone(),
001245 |                 )
001246 |             })
001247 |             .transpose()?;
001248 |         // Authorize before changing the update stage or touching the old healthy App.
001249 |         if let Some(pkg) = &mut pkg {
001250 |             pkg.authorize()?;
001251 |         } else {
001252 |             run_administrator(":")?;
001253 |         }
001254 |         verify_app_version(
001255 |             prepared.app_path(),
001256 |             &installed_team,
001257 |             &metadata.app.bundle_id,
001258 |             &metadata.app.version.to_string(),
001259 |         )?;
001260 |         let now = self.fresh_gate(metadata, uid)?;
001261 |         let mut stage = prepared.begin(
001262 |             state,
001263 |             InstallReadiness {
001264 |                 clock_trusted: self.clock.trusted(),
001265 |                 claude_exited: true,
001266 |                 account_idle: true,
001267 |                 components_compatible: true,
001268 |                 now,
001269 |             },
001270 |         )?;
001271 |         let mut journal = UpdateTransaction {
001272 |             schema: 1,
001273 |             edition: metadata.edition,
001274 |             team: installed_team.clone(),
001275 |             old_app,
001276 |             old_helper: installed.helper_version.clone(),
001277 |             app: metadata.version.to_string(),
001278 |             helper_changed: pkg.is_some(),
001279 |             helper_pending: false,
001280 |             app_pending: false,
001281 |             committed: false,
001282 |             updates: state.clone(),
001283 |         };
001284 |         self.save(&journal)?;
001285 |         let result = (|| {
001286 |             loop {
001287 |                 self.fresh_gate(metadata, uid)?;
001288 |                 match stage {
001289 |                     UStage::InstallingHelper => {
001290 |                         journal.helper_pending = true;
001291 |                         self.save(&journal)?;
001292 |                         let package = pkg.as_mut().ok_or("update_helper_missing")?;
001293 |                         package.window = Some(update_window(metadata)?);
001294 |                         package.expected_hash = metadata.helper.as_ref().map(|h| h.sha256.clone());
001295 |                         package.install_package(
001296 |                             prepared.helper_path().ok_or("update_helper_missing")?,
001297 |                         )?;
001298 |                         let next = if prepared.candidate().install_order()
001299 |                             == InstallOrder::HelperThenApp
001300 |                         {
001301 |                             UStage::InstallingApp
001302 |                         } else {
001303 |                             UStage::AwaitingHealth
001304 |                         };
001305 |                         state.advance_install(stage, next)?;
001306 |                         stage = next;
001307 |                     }
001308 |                     UStage::InstallingApp => {
001309 |                         journal.app_pending = true;
001310 |                         self.save(&journal)?;
001311 |                         run_root_operation(
001312 |                             &switcher_helper::root_operation::RootOperation::ReplaceApp {
001313 |                                 source: prepared.app_path().to_owned(),
001314 |                                 cdhash: prepared.app_cdhash().to_owned(),
001315 |                                 edition: journal.edition,
001316 |                                 team: journal.team.clone(),
001317 |                                 old: journal.old_app.clone(),
001318 |                                 new: journal.app.clone(),
001319 |                                 window: update_window(metadata)?,
001320 |                             },
001321 |                             &journal.team,
001322 |                         )?;
001323 |                         let next = if prepared.candidate().install_order()
001324 |                             == InstallOrder::AppThenHelper
001325 |                         {
001326 |                             UStage::InstallingHelper
001327 |                         } else {
001328 |                             UStage::AwaitingHealth
001329 |                         };
001330 |                         state.advance_install(stage, next)?;
001331 |                         stage = next;
001332 |                     }
001333 |                     UStage::AwaitingHealth => break,
001334 |                     _ => return Err("update_install_stage"),
001335 |                 }
001336 |                 journal.updates = state.clone();
001337 |                 self.save(&journal)?;
001338 |             }
001339 |             let healthy = wait_installed(metadata.edition, uid)?;
001340 |             if healthy.helper_version != final_helper.to_string() {
001341 |                 return Err("updated_helper_version");
001342 |             }
001343 |             verify_app_version(
001344 |                 &app,
001345 |                 &installed_team,
001346 |                 &metadata.app.bundle_id,
001347 |                 &metadata.version.to_string(),
001348 |             )?;
001349 |             if let Some(pkg) = &mut pkg {
001350 |                 let installer = Installer::new(self.root.clone())?;
001351 |                 let preview = installer.preview(
001352 |                     uid,
001353 |                     metadata.edition,
001354 |                     Some(metadata.edition),
001355 |                     InstallIntent::Install,
001356 |                 )?;
001357 |                 pkg.commit_root_record(&preview)?;
001358 |             }
001359 |             state.advance_install(UStage::AwaitingHealth, UStage::Healthy)?;
001360 |             journal.updates = state.clone();
001361 |             journal.committed = true;
001362 |             self.save(&journal)
001363 |         })();
001364 |         if let Err(reason) = result {
001365 |             state.record_failure(prepared.candidate(), reason, now)?;
001366 |             journal.updates = state.clone();
001367 |             self.save(&journal)?;
001368 |             // The rollback is real, not a state-only success. Failure leaves the journal pending.
001369 |             let _ = self.recover(state);
001370 |             return Err(reason);
001371 |         }
001372 |         Ok(())
001373 |     }
001374 | }
001375 | #[cfg(target_os = "macos")]
001376 | fn wait_installed(
001377 |     edition: Edition,
001378 |     uid: u32,
001379 | ) -> Result<switcher_domain::system::InstallRecord, &'static str> {
001380 |     let deadline = std::time::Instant::now() + std::time::Duration::from_secs(10);
001381 |     loop {
001382 |         match validate_installed(edition, uid) {
001383 |             Ok(record) => return Ok(record),
001384 |             Err(reason) if std::time::Instant::now() >= deadline => return Err(reason),
001385 |             Err(_) => std::thread::sleep(std::time::Duration::from_millis(250)),
001386 |         }
001387 |     }
001388 | }

000024 |     use std::path::Path;
000025 |     use switcher_domain::system::INSTALL_RECORD;
000026 |     let record = switcher_helper::platform::load_root_record(Path::new(INSTALL_RECORD))?;
000027 |     let challenge = switcher_helper::installation_health::load_challenge()?;

000049 |     let response = client.call(HelperAction::InstallationHealth {
000050 |         generation: challenge.generation,

000061 | /// A fixed GUI-role probe. stdout from the caller is diagnostic, never a commit receipt.
000062 | pub fn gui_probe(edition: Edition, generation: &str, nonce: &str) -> Result<(), &'static str> {
000063 |     #[cfg(target_os = "macos")]
000064 |     {
000065 |         let challenge = load_context(Some(edition))?;
000066 |         if challenge.generation != generation || challenge.nonce != nonce {
000067 |             return Err("installation_health_challenge_mismatch");
000068 |         }
000069 |         report(challenge, switcher_domain::system::ClientRole::Gui, 0)
000070 |     }
000071 |     #[cfg(not(target_os = "macos"))]
000072 |     {
000073 |         let _ = (edition, generation, nonce);
000074 |         Err("macos_required")
000075 |     }
000076 | }

000078 | #[cfg(target_os = "macos")]
000079 | fn guardian_challenge(loop_sequence: u64) -> Result<InstallHealthChallenge, &'static str> {
000080 |     use std::{os::unix::fs::MetadataExt, path::Path};
000081 |     use switcher_domain::system::SOURCE_LOCAL_TRANSACTION;
000082 |     if loop_sequence == 0 {
000083 |         return Err("installation_health_loop_sequence");
000084 |     }
000085 |     let pending = std::fs::symlink_metadata(Path::new(SOURCE_LOCAL_TRANSACTION))
000086 |         .map_err(|_| "installation_health_not_pending")?;
000087 |     if !pending.is_file()
000088 |         || pending.uid() != 0
000089 |         || pending.mode() & 0o7777 != 0o600
000090 |         || pending.nlink() != 1
000091 |     {
000092 |         return Err("installation_health_pending_permissions");
000093 |     }
000094 |     load_context(None)
000095 | }

000097 | /// A fixed Guardian-role probe. Only the driver's actual timer tick supplies this sequence.
000098 | pub fn guardian_tick(loop_sequence: u64) -> Result<(), &'static str> {
000099 |     if loop_sequence == 0 {
000100 |         return Err("installation_health_loop_sequence");
000101 |     }
000102 |     #[cfg(target_os = "macos")]
000103 |     {
000104 |         report(
000105 |             guardian_challenge(loop_sequence)?,
000106 |             switcher_domain::system::ClientRole::Guardian,
000107 |             loop_sequence,
000108 |         )
000109 |     }
000110 |     #[cfg(not(target_os = "macos"))]
000111 |     Err("macos_required")
000112 | }

000114 | /// At most one bounded XPC call may be in flight. A slow helper cannot block protection ticks.
000115 | #[derive(Default)]
000116 | pub(crate) struct GuardianProbe {
000117 |     flight: Option<tokio::task::JoinHandle<()>>,
000118 |     next_attempt: Option<std::time::Instant>,
000119 | }
000120 | impl GuardianProbe {
000121 |     pub(crate) fn tick(&mut self, sequence: u64) {
000122 |         self.tick_at(sequence, std::time::Instant::now(), move |sequence| {
000123 |             #[cfg(target_os = "macos")]
000124 |             {
000125 |                 // A successful response only acknowledges one role. Keep reporting while
000126 |                 // pending, so a restarted helper can collect both roles again.
000127 |                 let _ = guardian_tick(sequence);
000128 |             }
000129 |             #[cfg(not(target_os = "macos"))]
000130 |             let _ = sequence;
000131 |         });
000132 |     }
000133 |     fn tick_at<F>(&mut self, sequence: u64, now: std::time::Instant, report: F)
000134 |     where
000135 |         F: FnOnce(u64) + Send + 'static,
000136 |     {
000137 |         if self.next_attempt.is_some_and(|next| now < next) {
000138 |             return;
000139 |         }
000140 |         self.next_attempt = Some(now + std::time::Duration::from_secs(10));
000141 |         self.tick_with(sequence, report);
000142 |     }
000143 |     fn tick_with<F>(&mut self, sequence: u64, report: F)
000144 |     where
000145 |         F: FnOnce(u64) + Send + 'static,
000146 |     {
000147 |         if self
000148 |             .flight
000149 |             .as_ref()
000150 |             .is_some_and(|flight| !flight.is_finished())
000151 |         {
000152 |             return;
000153 |         }
000154 |         self.flight = Some(tokio::task::spawn_blocking(move || report(sequence)));
000155 |     }
000156 | }

000044 | struct NativeLaunch;
000045 | impl LaunchEnvironment for NativeLaunch {
000046 |     type Lock = LifecycleLock;
000047 |     fn installed(&self, _edition: Edition) -> Result<PathBuf, &'static str> {
000048 |         crate::migration::account_home(unsafe { libc::geteuid() }).map_err(|_| "用户目录无法读取")
000049 |     }
000050 |     fn lock(&self, home: &Path) -> Result<Self::Lock, &'static str> {
000051 |         for directory in [
000052 |             home.join(".claude-switcher"),
000053 |             home.join(".claude-switcher/v2"),
000054 |         ] {
000055 |             if !directory.exists() {
000056 |                 crate::storage::create_private_directory(&directory)
000057 |                     .map_err(|_| "无法创建账号锁目录")?;
000058 |             }
000059 |         }
000060 |         LifecycleLock::try_acquire(&home.join(".claude-switcher/v2"))
000061 |             .map_err(|_| "生命周期锁被占用或目录身份无效")
000062 |     }
000063 |     fn account_ready(&self, home: &Path, lock: &Self::Lock) -> Result<AccountId, &'static str> {
000064 |         let root = home.join(".claude-switcher");
000065 |         if !lock.protects(&root.join("v2")) {
000066 |             return Err("生命周期锁身份已变化");
000067 |         }
000068 |         let active = home.join("Library/Application Support/Claude");
000069 |         let status = AccountStore::inspect(&root, &active, unsafe { libc::geteuid() })
000070 |             .map_err(|_| "账号状态无法验证")?;
000071 |         if status.recovery_pending {
000072 |             return Err("账号事务尚未恢复完成");
000073 |         }
000074 |         Ok(status.current.unwrap_or(AccountId::A))
000075 |     }
000076 |     async fn check(&self, home: &Path) -> Result<CheckReport, &'static str> {
000077 |         let configuration = config::load_read_only(home).map_err(|_| "地区目标配置无效")?;
000078 |         Ok(checks::run_checks(configuration).await)
000079 |     }
000080 |     fn now(&self) -> u64 {
000081 |         checks::unix_now()
000082 |     }
000083 |     async fn select(&self, edition: Edition, target: AccountId) -> Result<(), &'static str> {
000084 |         tokio::task::spawn_blocking(move || {
000085 |             let coordinator = crate::migration::MigrationCoordinator::for_current_user(edition)
000086 |                 .map_err(|_| "账号目录不可用")?;
000087 |             match target {
000088 |                 AccountId::A => coordinator.select_a(),
000089 |                 AccountId::B => coordinator.select_b(),
000090 |             }
000091 |             .map_err(|_| "Claude 未能退出或账号事务未完成；资料已保留")
000092 |         })
000093 |         .await
000094 |         .map_err(|_| "账号切换任务中断")?
000095 |     }
000096 |     async fn open(&self) -> Result<(), &'static str> {
000097 |         // The application and executable selectors are fixed. No shell, URL, or caller path.
000098 |         bounded_status("/usr/bin/open", &["-a", "Claude"], Duration::from_secs(5)).await
000099 |     }
000100 | }

000136 |         );

000139 |         return blocked(
000140 |             Some(report),
000141 |             message,
000142 |             "退出 Claude 后重试；未完成事务会自动恢复",

000147 | fn verify_account<E: LaunchEnvironment>(
000148 |     environment: &E,
000149 |     home: &Path,
000150 |     lock: &E::Lock,
000151 |     expected: Option<AccountId>,
000152 | ) -> Result<(), &'static str> {

000154 |     if expected.is_some_and(|account| account != current) {

000159 | async fn launch_expected_with<E: LaunchEnvironment>(
000160 |     environment: &E,
000161 |     edition: Edition,
000162 |     expected: Option<AccountId>,
000163 | ) -> LaunchOutcome {
000164 |     let home = match environment.installed(edition) {
000165 |         Ok(home) => home,
000166 |         Err(_) => {
000167 |             return blocked(None, "无法读取当前用户目录", "检查当前用户目录后重试");
000168 |         }
000169 |     };
000170 |     let lock = match environment.lock(&home) {
000171 |         Ok(lock) => lock,
000172 |         Err(message) => return blocked(None, message, "等待账号、安装或更新事务完成后重试"),
000173 |     };
000174 |     if let Err(message) = verify_account(environment, &home, &lock, expected) {
000175 |         return blocked(None, message, "等待账号事务完成后重试");
000176 |     }
000177 |     let mut report = match environment.check(&home).await {
000178 |         Ok(report) => report,
000179 |         Err(message) => return blocked(None, message, "修复地区配置后重新执行完整检查"),
000180 |     };
000181 |     let generation = report.network_generation.clone();
000182 |     report.launch = checks::evaluate_launch(&report, environment.now(), &generation);
000183 |     if !report.launch.allowed {
000184 |         return blocked(
000185 |             Some(report),
000186 |             "环境检查未授予启动许可",
000187 |             "修复阻塞项后重新执行完整检查",
000188 |         );
000189 |     }
000190 |     if expected.is_some()
000191 |         && let Err(message) = verify_account(environment, &home, &lock, expected)
000192 |     {
000193 |         return blocked(
000194 |             Some(report),
000195 |             message,
000196 |             "重新选择目标账号，再执行完整检查与启动",
000197 |         );
000198 |     }
000199 |     match environment.open().await {
000200 |         Ok(()) => LaunchOutcome {
000201 |             report: Some(report),
000202 |             outcome: outcome(true, "已向系统提交 Claude 启动请求", None),
000203 |         },
000204 |         Err(_) => blocked(
000205 |             Some(report),
000206 |             "系统启动请求失败或超时",
000207 |             "检查 Claude 应用与系统响应，再执行完整检查",
000208 |         ),
000209 |     }
000210 | }

000359 | async fn run_desktop_update(
000360 |     executable: &Path,
000361 |     home: &Path,
000362 |     action: ManualUpdate,
000363 | ) -> Result<OperationOutcome, &'static str> {
000364 |     use tokio::io::AsyncReadExt;
000365 |     let mut child = tokio::process::Command::new(executable)
000366 |         .args(["--update-manual", action.argument()])
000367 |         .env_clear()
000368 |         .env("PATH", "/usr/bin:/bin:/usr/sbin:/sbin")
000369 |         .env("LC_ALL", "C")
000370 |         .env("HOME", home)
000371 |         .stdin(Stdio::null())
000372 |         .stdout(Stdio::piped())
000373 |         .stderr(Stdio::null())
000374 |         .kill_on_drop(true)
000375 |         .spawn()
000376 |         .map_err(|_| "桌面更新任务无法执行")?;
000377 |     let stdout = child.stdout.take().ok_or("桌面更新响应不可用")?;
000378 |     let task = async {
000379 |         let mut bytes = Vec::new();
000380 |         stdout
000381 |             .take(16385)
000382 |             .read_to_end(&mut bytes)
000383 |             .await
000384 |             .map_err(|_| "桌面更新响应不可用")?;
000385 |         if bytes.len() > 16384 {
000386 |             return Err("桌面更新响应超过限制");
000387 |         }
000388 |         let status = child.wait().await.map_err(|_| "桌面更新任务无法确认")?;
000389 |         let result: OperationOutcome =
000390 |             crate::signed::strict_json(&bytes, 16384).map_err(|_| "桌面更新响应无效")?;
000391 |         if status.success() != result.completed
000392 |             || result.message.len() > 4096
000393 |             || result
000394 |                 .recovery
000395 |                 .as_ref()
000396 |                 .is_some_and(|value| value.len() > 4096)
000397 |         {
000398 |             return Err("桌面更新状态不一致");
000399 |         }
000400 |         Ok(result)
000401 |     };
000402 |     match tokio::time::timeout(Duration::from_secs(15 * 60), task).await {
000403 |         Ok(Ok(result)) => Ok(result),
000404 |         _ => {
000405 |             let _ = child.kill().await;
000406 |             let _ = child.wait().await;
000407 |             Err("桌面更新失败、响应无效或超时")
000408 |         }
000409 |     }
000410 | }

000014 |         &mut self,

000017 |     ) -> Result<String, &'static str> {

000044 | /// A process keeps its registration and receiver for its entire lifetime. A failed
000045 | /// registration is sticky: evidence must never outlive the observer that protects it.
000046 | struct ProcessObserver<T> {
000047 |     registration: std::sync::OnceLock<Result<T, &'static str>>,
000048 | }
000049 | impl<T> ProcessObserver<T> {
000050 |     const fn new() -> Self {
000051 |         Self {
000052 |             registration: std::sync::OnceLock::new(),
000053 |         }
000054 |     }
000055 |     fn ensure(
000056 |         &self,
000057 |         register: impl FnOnce() -> Result<T, &'static str>,
000058 |         healthy: impl FnOnce(&T) -> bool,
000059 |     ) -> Result<(), &'static str> {
000060 |         let registration = self
000061 |             .registration
000062 |             .get_or_init(register)
000063 |             .as_ref()
000064 |             .map_err(|e| *e)?;
000065 |         if !healthy(registration) {
000066 |             return Err("network_observer_stopped");
000067 |         }
000068 |         Ok(())
000069 |     }
000070 | }

000174 | /// Opaque network generation. Interface, route and resolver changes invalidate old evidence.
000175 | pub async fn network_generation() -> Result<String, &'static str> {
000176 |     ensure_network_observation()?;
000177 |     let revision = NETWORK_GENERATION
000178 |         .lock()
000179 |         .map_err(|_| "network_generation_unavailable")?
000180 |         .revision;
000181 |     let (interfaces, route, dns) = tokio::join!(
000182 |         read_command("/usr/sbin/scutil", &["--nwi"]),
000183 |         read_command("/sbin/route", &["-n", "get", "1.1.1.1"]),
000184 |         read_command("/usr/sbin/scutil", &["--dns"])
000185 |     );
000186 |     let mut hash = Sha256::new();
000187 |     for value in [interfaces?, route?, dns?] {
000188 |         hash.update(value.as_bytes());
000189 |         hash.update([0]);
000190 |     }
000191 |     let fingerprint = hash.finalize().iter().map(|b| format!("{b:02x}")).collect();
000192 |     ensure_network_observation()?;
000193 |     NETWORK_GENERATION
000194 |         .lock()
000195 |         .map_err(|_| "network_generation_unavailable")?
000196 |         .observe(fingerprint, revision)
000197 | }

000376 | /// Isolated subscription backend. Events go only to registered process states;
000377 | /// sampling the same route never invents an event or registers a listener.

000381 |     use std::sync::atomic::{AtomicBool, AtomicU64, AtomicUsize, Ordering};
000382 |     pub(crate) struct Observer {
000383 |         process: ProcessObserver<AtomicU64>,
000384 |         failed: bool,
000385 |         alive: AtomicBool,
000386 |         registrations: AtomicUsize,
000387 |     }
000388 |     impl Observer {

000390 |             Self {
000391 |                 process: ProcessObserver::new(),

000397 |         pub(crate) fn ensure(&self) -> Result<(), &'static str> {
000398 |             self.process.ensure(
000399 |                 || {
000400 |                     self.registrations.fetch_add(1, Ordering::SeqCst);
000401 |                     if self.failed {
000402 |                         Err("network_events_unavailable")

000404 |                         Ok(AtomicU64::new(0))
000405 |                     }
000406 |                 },

000408 |             )
000409 |         }
000410 |         pub(crate) fn generation(&self) -> Result<String, &'static str> {
000411 |             if !self.alive.load(Ordering::SeqCst) {
000412 |                 return Err("network_observer_stopped");
000413 |             }

000415 |                 .process
000416 |                 .registration

000422 |             } else {
000423 |                 format!("{epoch}:route-a")

000425 |         }

000427 |             if event != crate::guardian::ProtectionEvent::Timer
000428 |                 && let Some(Ok(epoch)) = self.process.registration.get()
000429 |             {
000430 |                 // ABA returns to route A without changing the sampled fingerprint.
000431 |                 epoch.fetch_add(1, Ordering::SeqCst);
000432 |             }
000433 |         }

000230 |     fn recover_in_place(&self, store: &AccountStore, lock: &LifecycleLock) -> Result<()> {
000231 |         let path = self.root.join("v2/migration/in-place-journal.json");
000232 |         #[derive(Deserialize)]
000233 |         struct PreviousJournal {
000234 |             intent: MigrationIntent,
000235 |             initialization_copy: Option<InitializationCopy>,
000236 |         }
000237 |         let journal: PreviousJournal = match storage::read_json(&path) {
000238 |             Ok(journal) => journal,
000239 |             Err(error) if error.kind() == io::ErrorKind::NotFound => return Ok(()),
000240 |             Err(_) => {
000241 |                 return Err(MigrationError::Operation(
000242 |                     "旧账号事务记录无法读取，已保留资料",
000243 |                 ));
000244 |             }
000245 |         };
000246 |         if !matches!(
000247 |             journal.intent,
000248 |             MigrationIntent::InitializeA | MigrationIntent::AssociateA
000249 |         ) {
000250 |             return Err(MigrationError::Operation("旧账号事务类型不明，已保留资料"));
000251 |         }
000252 |         if let Some(copy) = journal.initialization_copy {
000253 |             store
000254 |                 .finish_initialization(
000255 |                     lock,
000256 |                     &copy,
000257 |                     &|| self.environment.stopped(self.owner),
000258 |                     &mut |_| Ok(()),
000259 |                 )
000260 |                 .map_err(|_| MigrationError::Operation("旧账号 A 存档事务恢复失败，已保留资料"))?;
000261 |         }
000262 |         // In-place journals never exchange the live directory. Retire the old permit after copy completion.
000263 |         fs::remove_file(&path).map_err(|_| MigrationError::Operation("旧事务记录无法收尾"))?;
000264 |         storage::sync_directory(path.parent().unwrap())
000265 |             .map_err(|_| MigrationError::Operation("旧事务记录无法同步"))
000266 |     }

000273 | pub(crate) fn account_home(owner: u32) -> io::Result<PathBuf> {
000274 |     let mut record = std::mem::MaybeUninit::<libc::passwd>::uninit();
000275 |     let mut result = std::ptr::null_mut();
000276 |     let mut buffer = vec![0u8; 65536];
000277 |     let status = unsafe {
000278 |         libc::getpwuid_r(
000279 |             owner,
000280 |             record.as_mut_ptr(),
000281 |             buffer.as_mut_ptr().cast(),
000282 |             buffer.len(),
000283 |             &mut result,
000284 |         )
000285 |     };
000286 |     if status != 0 || result.is_null() {
000287 |         return Err(io::Error::other("system home lookup failed"));
000288 |     }
000289 |     let record = unsafe { record.assume_init() };
000290 |     if record.pw_dir.is_null() {
000291 |         return Err(io::Error::other("system home missing"));
000292 |     }
000293 |     use std::os::unix::ffi::OsStrExt;
000294 |     let home = PathBuf::from(std::ffi::OsStr::from_bytes(
000295 |         unsafe { std::ffi::CStr::from_ptr(record.pw_dir) }.to_bytes(),
000296 |     ));
000297 |     storage::validate_no_symlinks(&home)?;
000298 |     Ok(home)
000299 | }

000029 | pub fn client(proxy: Option<&str>) -> Result<Client, &'static str> {
000030 |     let mut builder = Client::builder()
000031 |         .no_proxy()
000032 |         .redirect(Policy::none())
000033 |         .connect_timeout(Duration::from_secs(4))
000034 |         .timeout(Duration::from_secs(8))
000035 |         .user_agent("ClaudeSwitcher/0.2");
000036 |     if let Some(proxy) = proxy {
000037 |         builder = builder.proxy(reqwest::Proxy::all(proxy).map_err(|_| "proxy_invalid")?);
000038 |     }
000039 |     builder.build().map_err(|_| "network_context_unavailable")
000040 | }

000042 | /// Ordinary legacy checks inherit environment proxies. Explicit diagnostics use client().
000043 | pub fn inherited_client() -> Result<Client, &'static str> {
000044 |     let mut builder = Client::builder()
000045 |         .no_proxy()
000046 |         .redirect(Policy::none())
000047 |         .connect_timeout(Duration::from_secs(4))
000048 |         .timeout(Duration::from_secs(8))
000049 |         .user_agent("ClaudeSwitcher/0.2");
000050 |     for (lower, upper, scheme) in [
000051 |         ("https_proxy", "HTTPS_PROXY", "https"),
000052 |         ("http_proxy", "HTTP_PROXY", "http"),
000053 |         ("all_proxy", "ALL_PROXY", "all"),
000054 |     ] {
000055 |         let value = std::env::var(lower)
000056 |             .ok()
000057 |             .filter(|s| !s.is_empty())
000058 |             .or_else(|| std::env::var(upper).ok().filter(|s| !s.is_empty()));
000059 |         if let Some(value) = value {
000060 |             let proxy = match scheme {
000061 |                 "https" => reqwest::Proxy::https(&value),
000062 |                 "http" => reqwest::Proxy::http(&value),
000063 |                 _ => reqwest::Proxy::all(&value),
000064 |             }
000065 |             .map_err(|_| "proxy_invalid")?
000066 |             .no_proxy(reqwest::NoProxy::from_env());
000067 |             builder = builder.proxy(proxy);
000068 |         }
000069 |     }
000070 |     builder.build().map_err(|_| "network_context_unavailable")
000071 | }

000073 | pub async fn limited_get(
000074 |     client: &Client,
000075 |     url: &str,
000076 |     limit: usize,
000077 | ) -> Result<Vec<u8>, TransportState> {
000078 |     #[cfg(test)]
000079 |     let test_url = test_support::endpoint(url);
000080 |     #[cfg(test)]
000081 |     let url = test_url.as_deref().unwrap_or(url);
000082 |     let mut response = client
000083 |         .get(url)
000084 |         .send()
000085 |         .await
000086 |         .map_err(|e| classify_error(&e))?;
000087 |     if !response.status().is_success() {
000088 |         return Err(TransportState::InvalidResponse);
000089 |     }
000090 |     if response.content_length().is_some_and(|v| v > limit as u64) {
000091 |         return Err(TransportState::InvalidResponse);
000092 |     }
000093 |     let mut body = Vec::new();
000094 |     while let Some(chunk) = response.chunk().await.map_err(|e| classify_error(&e))? {
000095 |         if chunk.len() > limit.saturating_sub(body.len()) {
000096 |             return Err(TransportState::InvalidResponse);
000097 |         }
000098 |         body.extend_from_slice(&chunk);
000099 |     }
000100 |     Ok(body)
000101 | }

000103 | pub fn access_state(status: u16) -> AccessState {
000104 |     match status {
000105 |         401 => AccessState::AuthenticationRequired,
000106 |         403 | 407 => AccessState::Restricted,
000107 |         300..=399 => AccessState::Redirected,
000108 |         500..=599 => AccessState::ServerError,
000109 |         100..=499 => AccessState::Available,
000110 |         _ => AccessState::Unknown,
000111 |     }
000112 | }
000113 | 
000114 | pub fn classify_error(error: &reqwest::Error) -> TransportState {
000115 |     if error.is_timeout() {
000116 |         return TransportState::Timeout;
000117 |     }
000118 |     if error.is_dns() {
000119 |         return TransportState::DnsFailure;
000120 |     }
000121 |     let mut chain = String::new();
000122 |     let mut current: Option<&(dyn Error + 'static)> = Some(error);
000123 |     while let Some(e) = current {
000124 |         chain.push_str(&e.to_string().to_ascii_lowercase());
000125 |         current = e.source();
000126 |     }
000127 |     // Error detail stays in memory. Reports only expose the fixed enum.
000128 |     if chain.contains("could not resolve to acceptable address type") {
000129 |         TransportState::DnsFailure
000130 |     } else if chain.contains("407")
000131 |         || chain.contains("proxy authentication")
000132 |         || chain.contains("proxy authorization required")
000133 |         || chain.contains("credentials not accepted")
000134 |         || chain.contains("user/pass authentication")
000135 |         || chain.contains("server implements authentication incorrectly")
000136 |     {
000137 |         TransportState::ProxyAuthentication
000138 |     } else if ["certificate", "tls", "ssl", "certnotvalid", "unknownissuer"]
000139 |         .iter()
000140 |         .any(|s| chain.contains(s))
000141 |     {
000142 |         TransportState::TlsFailure
000143 |     } else if error.is_connect() {
000144 |         TransportState::ConnectFailure
000145 |     } else {
000146 |         TransportState::InvalidResponse
000147 |     }
000148 | }

000150 | pub async fn transport_probe(client: &Client, name: &str, url: &str) -> TransportProbe {
000151 |     let start = Instant::now();
000152 |     let mut result = TransportProbe {
000153 |         endpoint: name.into(),
000154 |         transport: TransportState::InvalidResponse,
000155 |         access: AccessState::Unknown,
000156 |         http_status: None,
000157 |         tls_verified: false,
000158 |         duration_ms: 0,
000159 |     };
000160 |     match client.get(url).send().await {
000161 |         Ok(response) => {
000162 |             let status = response.status().as_u16();
000163 |             result.http_status = Some(status);
000164 |             if status == 407 {
000165 |                 result.transport = TransportState::ProxyAuthentication;
000166 |             } else if url.starts_with("https://") {
000167 |                 result.transport = TransportState::Reached;
000168 |                 result.tls_verified = true;
000169 |                 result.access = access_state(status);
000170 |             }
000171 |         }
000172 |         Err(error) => result.transport = classify_error(&error),
000173 |     }
000174 |     result.duration_ms = start.elapsed().as_millis().min(u64::MAX as u128) as u64;
000175 |     result
000176 | }

000186 | pub fn parse_geo(bytes: &[u8]) -> Option<GeoInfo> {
000187 |     let data: Value = serde_json::from_slice(bytes).ok()?;
000188 |     if data.get("success") == Some(&Value::Bool(false)) {
000189 |         return None;
000190 |     }
000191 |     let country = data
000192 |         .get("country_code")
000193 |         .or_else(|| data.get("country"))?
000194 |         .as_str()?;
000195 |     if country.len() != 2 || !country.bytes().all(|b| b.is_ascii_uppercase()) {
000196 |         return None;
000197 |     }
000198 |     let timezone = data
000199 |         .get("timezone")
000200 |         .and_then(|v| v.as_str().or_else(|| v.get("id")?.as_str()))
000201 |         .map(str::to_owned);
000202 |     let ip = data.get("ip")?.as_str()?.parse().ok()?;
000203 |     let organization = data
000204 |         .get("org")
000205 |         .or_else(|| data.get("organization"))
000206 |         .or_else(|| data.get("connection").and_then(|v| v.get("org")))
000207 |         .and_then(Value::as_str)
000208 |         .filter(|s| s.len() <= 256)
000209 |         .map(str::to_owned);
000210 |     Some(GeoInfo {
000211 |         ip: Some(ip),
000212 |         country: Some(country.into()),
000213 |         timezone,
000214 |         organization,
000215 |     })
000216 | }

000218 | /// Obtain the egress identity without waiting for advisory ASN enrichment.
000219 | pub(crate) async fn lookup_egress(client: &Client) -> GeoInfo {
000220 |     let mut info = GeoInfo::default();
000221 |     // Cloudflare supplies the egress decision; the remaining sources are bounded fallbacks.
000222 |     if let Ok(bytes) = limited_get(client, "https://www.cloudflare.com/cdn-cgi/trace", 8192).await
000223 |         && let Ok(text) = std::str::from_utf8(&bytes)
000224 |     {
000225 |         for line in text.lines() {
000226 |             if let Some(ip) = line.strip_prefix("ip=") {
000227 |                 info.ip = ip.parse().ok();
000228 |             }
000229 |             if let Some(country) = line.strip_prefix("loc=")
000230 |                 && country.len() == 2
000231 |                 && country.bytes().all(|b| b.is_ascii_uppercase())
000232 |             {
000233 |                 info.country = Some(country.into());
000234 |             }
000235 |         }
000236 |     }
000237 |     if info.ip.is_some() {
000238 |         return info;
000239 |     }
000240 |     // A country without its source IP cannot be attached to another source's identity.
000241 |     lookup_geo_details(client, GeoInfo::default()).await
000242 | }
000243 | 
000244 | /// Enrich only the same observed egress. Existing fields retain their source's precedence.
000245 | pub(crate) async fn lookup_geo_details(client: &Client, mut info: GeoInfo) -> GeoInfo {
000246 |     if info.country.is_some() && info.timezone.is_some() && info.organization.is_some() {
000247 |         return info;
000248 |     }
000249 |     for endpoint in GEO_ENDPOINTS {
000250 |         if let Ok(bytes) = limited_get(client, endpoint, MAX_RESPONSE_BYTES).await
000251 |             && let Some(fallback) = parse_geo(&bytes)
000252 |         {
000253 |             // Do not attach ASN/timezone from a different egress address.
000254 |             if info.ip.is_some() && info.ip != fallback.ip {
000255 |                 continue;
000256 |             }
000257 |             info.ip = info.ip.or(fallback.ip);
000258 |             info.country = info.country.or(fallback.country);
000259 |             info.timezone = info.timezone.or(fallback.timezone);
000260 |             info.organization = info.organization.or(fallback.organization);
000261 |             break;
000262 |         }
000263 |     }
000264 |     info
000265 | }
000266 | 
000267 | /// Complete geo lookup retained for callers that need region and advisory information.
000268 | pub async fn lookup_geo(client: &Client) -> GeoInfo {
000269 |     lookup_geo_details(client, lookup_egress(client).await).await
000270 | }

000275 |     Dns,
000276 |     Io,
000277 |     WrongSource,
000278 |     Header,
000279 |     Transaction,
000280 |     Length,
000281 |     AddressFamily,

000285 | pub fn parse_stun(
000286 |     bytes: &[u8],
000287 |     transaction: &[u8; 12],
000288 |     expected: SocketAddr,
000289 |     source: SocketAddr,
000290 | ) -> Result<IpAddr, StunError> {
000291 |     if expected != source {
000292 |         return Err(StunError::WrongSource);
000293 |     }
000294 |     if bytes.len() < 20 || bytes[0..2] != [1, 1] || bytes[4..8] != [0x21, 0x12, 0xa4, 0x42] {
000295 |         return Err(StunError::Header);
000296 |     }
000297 |     if bytes[8..20] != transaction[..] {
000298 |         return Err(StunError::Transaction);
000299 |     }
000300 |     let len = u16::from_be_bytes([bytes[2], bytes[3]]) as usize;
000301 |     if !len.is_multiple_of(4) || len + 20 != bytes.len() {
000302 |         return Err(StunError::Length);
000303 |     }
000304 |     let mut offset = 20;
000305 |     let mut mapped = None;
000306 |     while offset < bytes.len() {
000307 |         if offset + 4 > bytes.len() {
000308 |             return Err(StunError::Length);
000309 |         }
000310 |         let kind = u16::from_be_bytes([bytes[offset], bytes[offset + 1]]);
000311 |         let size = u16::from_be_bytes([bytes[offset + 2], bytes[offset + 3]]) as usize;
000312 |         let end = offset
000313 |             .checked_add(4)
000314 |             .and_then(|n| n.checked_add(size))
000315 |             .ok_or(StunError::Length)?;
000316 |         if end > bytes.len() {
000317 |             return Err(StunError::Length);
000318 |         }
000319 |         let value = &bytes[offset + 4..end];
000320 |         if kind == 0x0020 || kind == 0x0001 {
000321 |             if value.len() < 4 || value[0] != 0 {
000322 |                 return Err(StunError::AddressFamily);
000323 |             }
000324 |             let xor = kind == 0x0020;
000325 |             let ip = match (value[1], value.len()) {
000326 |                 (1, 8) => {
000327 |                     let mut octets: [u8; 4] =
000328 |                         value[4..8].try_into().map_err(|_| StunError::Length)?;
000329 |                     if xor {
000330 |                         for (n, key) in octets.iter_mut().zip([0x21, 0x12, 0xa4, 0x42]) {
000331 |                             *n ^= key;
000332 |                         }
000333 |                     }
000334 |                     IpAddr::V4(Ipv4Addr::from(octets))
000335 |                 }
000336 |                 (2, 20) => {
000337 |                     let mut octets: [u8; 16] =
000338 |                         value[4..20].try_into().map_err(|_| StunError::Length)?;
000339 |                     if xor {
000340 |                         let mut mask = [0; 16];
000341 |                         mask[..4].copy_from_slice(&[0x21, 0x12, 0xa4, 0x42]);
000342 |                         mask[4..].copy_from_slice(transaction);
000343 |                         for (n, key) in octets.iter_mut().zip(mask) {
000344 |                             *n ^= key;
000345 |                         }
000346 |                     }
000347 |                     IpAddr::V6(Ipv6Addr::from(octets))
000348 |                 }
000349 |                 _ => return Err(StunError::AddressFamily),
000350 |             };
000351 |             if mapped.is_some_and(|old| old != ip) {
000352 |                 return Err(StunError::AddressFamily);
000353 |             }
000354 |             mapped = Some(ip);
000355 |         }
000356 |         offset = end
000357 |             .checked_add((4 - size % 4) % 4)
000358 |             .ok_or(StunError::Length)?;
000359 |         if offset > bytes.len() {
000360 |             return Err(StunError::Length);
000361 |         }
000362 |     }
000363 |     mapped.ok_or(StunError::MissingAddress)
000364 | }

000366 | pub async fn stun_probe(host: &str, port: u16) -> Result<IpAddr, StunError> {
000367 |     tokio::time::timeout(Duration::from_secs(3), async {
000368 |         let mut addrs = tokio::net::lookup_host((host, port))
000369 |             .await
000370 |             .map_err(|_| StunError::Dns)?;
000371 |         let target = addrs.find(SocketAddr::is_ipv4).ok_or(StunError::Dns)?;
000372 |         let socket = tokio::net::UdpSocket::bind("0.0.0.0:0")
000373 |             .await
000374 |             .map_err(|_| StunError::Io)?;
000375 |         let mut transaction = [0; 12];
000376 |         std::fs::File::open("/dev/urandom")
000377 |             .and_then(|mut f| f.read_exact(&mut transaction))
000378 |             .map_err(|_| StunError::Io)?;
000379 |         let mut request = vec![0, 1, 0, 0, 0x21, 0x12, 0xa4, 0x42];
000380 |         request.extend_from_slice(&transaction);
000381 |         socket
000382 |             .send_to(&request, target)
000383 |             .await
000384 |             .map_err(|_| StunError::Io)?;
000385 |         let mut bytes = [0; 2048];
000386 |         let (len, source) = socket
000387 |             .recv_from(&mut bytes)
000388 |             .await
000389 |             .map_err(|_| StunError::Io)?;
000390 |         parse_stun(&bytes[..len], &transaction, target, source)
000391 |     })
000392 |     .await
000393 |     .unwrap_or(Err(StunError::Timeout))
000394 | }

000396 | pub async fn stun_all() -> Vec<Result<IpAddr, StunError>> {
000397 |     let mut tasks = tokio::task::JoinSet::new();
000398 |     let servers: Vec<_> = STUN_SERVERS
000399 |         .into_iter()
000400 |         .map(|(host, port)| (host.to_owned(), port))
000401 |         .collect();
000402 |     #[cfg(test)]
000403 |     let servers = test_support::SETTINGS
000404 |         .try_with(|s| s.stun_servers.clone())
000405 |         .unwrap_or(servers);
000406 |     for (host, port) in servers {
000407 |         tasks.spawn(async move { stun_probe(&host, port).await });
000408 |     }
000409 |     let mut results = Vec::new();
000410 |     let deadline = tokio::time::Instant::now() + Duration::from_secs(10);
000411 |     while !tasks.is_empty() {
000412 |         match tokio::time::timeout_at(deadline, tasks.join_next()).await {
000413 |             Ok(Some(Ok(result))) => results.push(result),
000414 |             Ok(Some(Err(_))) => results.push(Err(StunError::Io)),
000415 |             _ => {
000416 |                 for _ in 0..tasks.len() {
000417 |                     results.push(Err(StunError::Timeout));
000418 |                 }
000419 |                 tasks.abort_all();
000420 |                 break;
000421 |             }
000422 |         }
000423 |     }
000424 |     results
000425 | }

000610 |         let mut packet = vec![1, 1, 0, 32, 0x21, 0x12, 0xa4, 0x42];

000620 |             Ok(IpAddr::V6(ip))

000622 |         packet[4] = 0;

000029 | fn scalar(value: &str) -> io::Result<&str> {
000030 |     let value = value.trim();
000031 |     let value = if value.starts_with('"') && value.ends_with('"') && value.len() >= 2
000032 |         || value.starts_with('\'') && value.ends_with('\'') && value.len() >= 2
000033 |     {
000034 |         &value[1..value.len() - 1]
000035 |     } else {
000036 |         value
000037 |     };
000038 |     if value.is_empty()
000039 |         || value.starts_with(['?', '-', '@', '`', '|', '>', '%'])
000040 |         || matches!(
000041 |             value.to_ascii_lowercase().as_str(),
000042 |             "true" | "false" | "null" | "yes" | "no" | "on" | "off"
000043 |         )
000044 |         || value.parse::<f64>().is_ok()
000045 |         || value.contains([
000046 |             '\n', '\r', '\\', '"', '\'', ',', '#', '[', ']', '{', '}', '&', '*', '!', ':',
000047 |         ])
000048 |         || value.chars().any(char::is_control)
000049 |     {
000050 |         return Err(unsupported());
000051 |     }
000052 |     Ok(value)
000053 | }

000055 | pub(super) fn first_select_group(bytes: &[u8]) -> io::Result<String> {
000056 |     let text = std::str::from_utf8(bytes).map_err(|_| unsupported())?;
000057 |     let mut in_groups = false;
000058 |     let mut groups = 0;
000059 |     let mut name: Option<String> = None;
000060 |     let mut group_type: Option<String> = None;
000061 |     let mut first_select: Option<String> = None;
000062 |     let mut entries = 0;
000063 |     let mut seen_name = false;
000064 |     let mut seen_type = false;
000065 |     let mut nested_field = false;
000066 |     for line in text.lines() {
000067 |         let line = line.trim_end_matches('\r');
000068 |         let trimmed = line.trim();
000069 |         if trimmed.is_empty() || trimmed.starts_with('#') {
000070 |             continue;
000071 |         }
000072 |         if line.starts_with(['%', '-', '{', '['])
000073 |             || line.contains("<<:")
000074 |             || (in_groups && line.contains(['&', '*', '!', '{', '}', '[', ']']))
000075 |         {
000076 |             return Err(unsupported());
000077 |         }
000078 |         if !line.starts_with(char::is_whitespace) {
000079 |             if in_groups {
000080 |                 if group_type.as_deref() == Some("select") && first_select.is_none() {
000081 |                     first_select = Some(name.take().ok_or_else(unsupported)?);
000082 |                 }
000083 |                 in_groups = false;
000084 |             }
000085 |             if line == "proxy-groups:" {
000086 |                 groups += 1;
000087 |                 in_groups = true;
000088 |             }
000089 |             continue;
000090 |         }
000091 |         if !in_groups {
000092 |             continue;
000093 |         }
000094 |         let property = if let Some(rest) = line.strip_prefix("  - ") {
000095 |             if group_type.as_deref() == Some("select") && first_select.is_none() {
000096 |                 first_select = Some(name.take().ok_or_else(unsupported)?);
000097 |             }
000098 |             entries += 1;
000099 |             name = None;
000100 |             group_type = None;
000101 |             seen_name = false;
000102 |             seen_type = false;
000103 |             rest
000104 |         } else if entries > 0 && line.starts_with("    ") && !line[4..].starts_with(' ') {
000105 |             &line[4..]
000106 |         } else if entries > 0 && line.starts_with("      ") {
000107 |             if !nested_field {
000108 |                 return Err(unsupported());
000109 |             }
000110 |             continue;
000111 |         } else {
000112 |             return Err(unsupported());
000113 |         };
000114 |         if property.contains(['&', '*', '!', '{', '}', '[', ']']) {
000115 |             return Err(unsupported());
000116 |         }
000117 |         let (key, raw) = property.split_once(':').ok_or_else(unsupported)?;
000118 |         match key {
000119 |             "name" => {
000120 |                 if seen_name {
000121 |                     return Err(unsupported());
000122 |                 }
000123 |                 name = Some(scalar(raw)?.to_owned());
000124 |                 seen_name = true;
000125 |                 nested_field = false;
000126 |             }
000127 |             "type" => {
000128 |                 if seen_type {
000129 |                     return Err(unsupported());
000130 |                 }
000131 |                 group_type = Some(scalar(raw)?.to_owned());
000132 |                 seen_type = true;
000133 |                 nested_field = false;
000134 |             }
000135 |             _ if !key.is_empty()
000136 |                 && key
000137 |                     .bytes()
000138 |                     .all(|b| b.is_ascii_alphanumeric() || b == b'-' || b == b'_') =>
000139 |             {
000140 |                 nested_field = true;
000141 |             }
000142 |             _ => return Err(unsupported()),
000143 |         }
000144 |     }
000145 |     if in_groups && group_type.as_deref() == Some("select") && first_select.is_none() {
000146 |         first_select = Some(name.ok_or_else(unsupported)?);
000147 |     }
000148 |     if groups != 1 {
000149 |         return Err(unsupported());
000150 |     }
000151 |     first_select.ok_or_else(unsupported)
000152 | }

000154 | fn block(group: &str, newline: &str) -> String {
000155 |     let mut output = format!("  {BEGIN}{newline}");
000156 |     for domain in DOMAINS {
000157 |         // JSON strings are valid YAML double-quoted scalars. The whole Clash rule
000158 |         // is quoted, so a group name with spaces or Unicode cannot change YAML shape.
000159 |         let rule = format!("DOMAIN-SUFFIX,{domain},{group}");
000160 |         output.push_str("  - ");
000161 |         output.push_str(&serde_json::to_string(&rule).expect("string encoding"));
000162 |         output.push_str(newline);
000163 |     }
000164 |     output.push_str(&format!("  {END}{newline}"));
000165 |     output
000166 | }

000168 | pub(super) fn propose(original: Option<&[u8]>, group: &str) -> io::Result<(Vec<u8>, bool)> {
000169 |     if group.is_empty() || group.chars().any(char::is_control) {
000170 |         return Err(unsupported());
000171 |     }
000172 |     let Some(original) = original else {
000173 |         return Ok((format!("# Profile Enhancement Merge Template for Clash Verge\n\nprofile:\n  store-selected: true\n\nprepend-rules:\n{}", block(group, "\n")).into_bytes(), true));
000174 |     };
000175 |     let text = std::str::from_utf8(original).map_err(|_| unsupported())?;
000176 |     let newline = if text.contains("\r\n") { "\r\n" } else { "\n" };
000177 |     let mut clean = String::new();
000178 |     let mut in_block = false;
000179 |     let mut current_top = String::new();
000180 |     for line in text.split_inclusive('\n') {
000181 |         if line.trim() == BEGIN || line.trim() == END {
000182 |             let raw = line.trim_end_matches(['\r', '\n']);
000183 |             if raw != line.trim()
000184 |                 && !(raw == format!("  {}", line.trim()) && current_top == "prepend-rules")
000185 |             {
000186 |                 return Err(unsupported());
000187 |             }
000188 |         }
000189 |         if !line.starts_with(char::is_whitespace)
000190 |             && !line.starts_with('#')
000191 |             && let Some((key, _)) = line.split_once(':')
000192 |         {
000193 |             current_top = key.to_owned();
000194 |         }
000195 |         if line.trim() == BEGIN {
000196 |             if in_block {
000197 |                 return Err(unsupported());
000198 |             }
000199 |             in_block = true;
000200 |         } else if line.trim() == END {
000201 |             if !in_block {
000202 |                 return Err(unsupported());
000203 |             }
000204 |             in_block = false;
000205 |         } else if !in_block {
000206 |             clean.push_str(line);
000207 |         }
000208 |     }
000209 |     // An incomplete marker could hide user content; preserve it instead of deleting it.
000210 |     if in_block {
000211 |         return Err(unsupported());
000212 |     }
000213 |     let mut result = String::new();
000214 |     let mut inserted = false;
000215 |     for line in clean.split_inclusive('\n') {
000216 |         result.push_str(line);
000217 |         if !inserted && line.trim_end_matches(['\r', '\n']) == "prepend-rules:" {
000218 |             if !line.ends_with('\n') {
000219 |                 result.push_str(newline);
000220 |             }
000221 |             result.push_str(&block(group, newline));
000222 |             inserted = true;
000223 |         }
000224 |     }
000225 |     if !inserted {
000226 |         result = format!(
000227 |             "prepend-rules:{newline}{}{newline}{clean}",
000228 |             block(group, newline)
000229 |         );
000230 |     }
000231 |     let changed = result.as_bytes() != original;
000232 |     Ok((result.into_bytes(), changed))
000233 | }

000165 |     fn running(&mut self, mode: &str) -> Result<bool, &'static str>;
000166 |     fn ready(&mut self, mode: &str) -> Result<bool, &'static str>;

000170 | fn execute_app_open_with(
000171 |     plan: &AppOpenPlan,
000172 |     backend: &mut impl AppOpener,
000173 |     now: impl Fn() -> u64,
000174 | ) -> Result<(), &'static str> {
000175 |     let current = now();
000176 |     if current < plan.issued_at
000177 |         || current >= plan.expires_at
000178 |         || plan.expires_at > plan.issued_at.saturating_add(120)
000179 |     {
000180 |         return Err(APP_OPEN_MANUAL);
000181 |     }
000182 |     let app = app_name(plan.mode).ok_or(APP_OPEN_MANUAL)?;
000183 |     let mode = mode_name(plan.mode);
000184 |     if !backend.running(mode)? {
000185 |         backend.open(app)?;
000186 |     }
000187 |     for _ in 0..40 {
000188 |         if backend.ready(mode)? {
000189 |             return Ok(());
000190 |         }
000191 |         backend.pause();
000192 |     }
000193 |     Err(APP_OPEN_MANUAL)
000194 | }

000072 | pub async fn detect(client: &Client) -> Result<DetectedRegion, &'static str> {
000073 |     let trace = network::limited_get(client, TRACE_URL, 8192).await.ok();
000074 |     let country = trace.as_deref().and_then(trace_country);
000075 |     if country == Some("CN") {
000076 |         return Err("出口国家为 CN；请先切换代理节点");
000077 |     }
000078 |     for endpoint in network::GEO_ENDPOINTS {
000079 |         let Ok(bytes) = network::limited_get(client, endpoint, network::MAX_RESPONSE_BYTES).await
000080 |         else {
000081 |             continue;
000082 |         };
000083 |         let Some(geo) = network::parse_geo(&bytes) else {
000084 |             continue;
000085 |         };
000086 |         if let Some(target) = checked_target(country, &geo)? {
000087 |             return Ok(target);
000088 |         }
000089 |     }
000090 |     Err("无法确认出口国家和时区；地区目标未更改")
000091 | }

000096 | pub fn recovery_pending_v2(v2: &Path) -> Result<bool, &'static str> {
000097 |     ["region-repair.json", "user-repairs/journal.json"]
000098 |         .iter()
000099 |         .try_fold(false, |pending, name| {
000100 |             match fs::symlink_metadata(v2.join(name)) {
000101 |                 Ok(_) => Ok(true),
000102 |                 Err(error) if error.kind() == std::io::ErrorKind::NotFound => Ok(pending),

000111 |         && state.ipv6 == policy.ipv6

000116 |         && state.network_service == original.network_service
000117 |         && state.ipv6 == original.ipv6

000120 | enum Resolution {
000121 |     Applied,
000122 |     Restored,
000123 |     Unknown,
000124 | }
000125 | 
000126 | fn resolution(journal: &RegionJournal, response: &HelperResponse) -> Resolution {
000127 |     let Some(plan) = response.plan.as_ref() else {
000128 |         return Resolution::Unknown;
000129 |     };
000130 |     let Some(state) = response.state.as_ref() else {
000131 |         return Resolution::Unknown;
000132 |     };
000133 |     if plan.id != journal.plan.id
000134 |         || !state_matches(
000135 |             &SystemState {
000136 |                 timezone: plan.target.timezone.clone(),
000137 |                 network_service: plan.target.network_service.clone(),
000138 |                 ipv6: plan.target.ipv6,
000139 |             },
000140 |             &journal.plan.target,
000141 |         )
000142 |         || !original_matches(&plan.original, &journal.plan.original)
000143 |     {
000144 |         return Resolution::Unknown;
000145 |     }
000146 |     match response.code.as_str() {
000147 |         "repair_applied" | "applied"
000148 |             if response.ok && state_matches(state, &journal.plan.target) =>
000149 |         {
000150 |             Resolution::Applied
000151 |         }
000152 |         "repair_restored" | "repair_not_started"
000153 |             if original_matches(state, &journal.plan.original) =>
000154 |         {
000155 |             Resolution::Restored
000156 |         }
000157 |         _ => Resolution::Unknown,
000158 |     }
000159 | }

000537 |     /// Consumes the in-memory plan. A failed or stale plan requires another preview.
000538 |     pub fn execute(&self, prepared: PreparedRepair) -> Result<(), &'static str> {
000539 |         if prepared.legacy_region.is_some() {
000540 |             return legacy::execute(self, prepared);
000541 |         }

000546 |             install::execute_repair_with_lock,

000549 |         crate::guardian_repair::restore_after_commit(self.edition)
000550 |     }
