000584 |     fn execute_runtime_and_app_with(
000585 |         &self,
000586 |         prepared: PreparedRepair,
000587 |         authorize: impl FnOnce(&str, &storage::LifecycleLock) -> Result<(), &'static str>,
000588 |         execute: impl FnOnce(String, &storage::LifecycleLock) -> Result<HelperResponse, &'static str>,
000589 |         runtime: &mut dyn Runtime,
000590 |         app_open: impl FnOnce(&AppOpenPlan) -> Result<(), &'static str>,
000591 |     ) -> Result<(), &'static str> {
000592 |         let v2 = self.home.join(".claude-switcher/v2");
000593 |         if !prepared.preview.can_execute {
000594 |             return Err("修复计划不可执行，请先恢复并重新预览");
000595 |         }
000596 |         if prepared.app_open_plan.is_some() && prepared.proposed_config.proxy_mode != "surge" {
000597 |             return Err("App 打开计划与代理模式不一致，请重新预览");
000598 |         }
000599 |         let system_plan = prepared.system_plan.ok_or("系统修复计划缺失，请重新预览")?;
000600 |         let lock = storage::LifecycleLock::try_acquire(&v2)
000601 |             .map_err(|_| "其他账号、修复或安装事务正在进行")?;
000602 |         if encode(&config::load_read_only(&self.home)?)? != prepared.original_config {
000603 |             return Err("地区配置已改变，请重新预览");
000604 |         }
000605 |         if recovery_pending(&self.home)? {
000606 |             return Err("上次修复尚未完成，请先恢复事务");
000607 |         }
000608 |         // The lock remains held across the native dialog and helper's independent verification.
000609 |         // Cancellation occurs before journal creation, preferences, proxy config or target writes.
000610 |         authorize(&prepared.plan_id, &lock).map_err(|_| "管理员授权取消或未通过；系统、代理、地区格式和语言均未修改，原配置已保留；请重新预览")?;
000611 |         if encode(&config::load_read_only(&self.home)?)? != prepared.original_config {
000612 |             return Err("授权期间地区配置已改变；尚未写入，请重新预览");
000613 |         }
000614 |         if system_plan.expires_at <= crate::checks::unix_now() {
000615 |             return Err("授权后修复计划已过期；尚未写入，请重新预览");
000616 |         }
000617 |         let runtime_state = if prepared.proposed_config.proxy_mode == "clash-verge" {
000618 |             Some(RuntimeState {
000619 |                 adapter: proxy_repair::Adapter::ClashVerge,
000620 |                 originally_running: runtime.running()?,
000621 |                 reload_required: prepared
000622 |                     .user_plan
000623 |                     .as_ref()
000624 |                     .is_some_and(PreparedUserRepair::changes_proxy_files),
000625 |                 phase: Phase::Intent,
000626 |             })
000627 |         } else {
000628 |             None
000629 |         };
000630 |         let user = self.user_coordinator(prepared.user_plan.is_some())?;
000631 |         let mut journal = RegionJournal {
000632 |             schema: 1,
000633 |             owner: unsafe { libc::geteuid() },
000634 |             edition: self.edition,
000635 |             stage: RepairStage::UserPending,
000636 |             original: serde_json::from_slice(&prepared.original_config)
000637 |                 .map_err(|_| "原地区配置无效")?,
000638 |             proposed: prepared.proposed_config,
000639 |             plan: system_plan,
000640 |             user_required: prepared.user_plan.is_some(),
000641 |             receipt: None,
000642 |             runtime_state,
000643 |             app_open_plan: prepared.app_open_plan,
000644 |         };
000645 |         self.save_journal(&journal)?;
000646 |         // App dispatch has durable intent, but occurs before any user configuration write.
000647 |         // A crash or recovery never repeats this action and never stops this App.
000648 |         if let Some(plan) = &journal.app_open_plan {
000649 |             if app_open(plan).is_err() {
000650 |                 // Dispatch may already have reached the OS. Only explicit recovery clears this intent.
000651 |                 return Err(
000652 |                     "App 打开预检失败或结果未确认；未写入用户配置，已保留事务，请先恢复，再手动检查代理并重新预览",
000653 |                 );
000654 |             }
000655 |             let current = config::load_read_only(&self.home).and_then(|value| encode(&value));
000656 |             if journal.plan.expires_at <= crate::checks::unix_now()
000657 |                 || current.as_deref() != Ok(prepared.original_config.as_slice())
000658 |             {
000659 |                 return Err(
000660 |                     "App 打开后计划过期或配置无法复核；未写入用户配置，已保留事务，请先恢复，再手动检查代理并重新预览",
000661 |                 );
000662 |             }
000663 |         }
000664 |         let preparation = (|| {
000665 |             if let Some(state) = &journal.runtime_state
000666 |                 && (state.reload_required || !state.originally_running)
000667 |             {
000668 |                 runtime.stop()?;
000669 |                 self.runtime_phase(&mut journal, Phase::Stopped)?;
000670 |             }
000671 |             if let (Some(coordinator), Some(plan)) = (user.as_ref(), prepared.user_plan) {
000672 |                 journal.receipt = Some(
000673 |                     coordinator
000674 |                         .execute_with_lock(plan, &lock)
000675 |                         .map_err(|_| "用户配置修复中断")?,
000676 |                 );
000677 |                 self.save_journal(&journal)?;
000678 |             }
000679 |             if let Some(state) = &journal.runtime_state {
000680 |                 if state.reload_required || !state.originally_running {
000681 |                     self.runtime_phase(&mut journal, Phase::StartingTarget)?;
000682 |                     runtime.start()?;
000683 |                 }
000684 |                 runtime.verify(
000685 |                     journal
000686 |                         .proposed
000687 |                         .country_target
000688 |                         .as_deref()
000689 |                         .ok_or("目标国家缺失")?,
000690 |                 )?;
000691 |                 self.runtime_phase(&mut journal, Phase::TargetReady)?;
000692 |             }
000693 |             if let (Some(user), Some(receipt)) = (user.as_ref(), journal.receipt.as_ref()) {
000694 |                 user.verify_receipt_with_lock(receipt, &lock, false)
000695 |                     .map_err(|_| "代理启动后配置发生变化；未执行系统修改")?;
000696 |             }
000697 |             if journal.plan.expires_at <= crate::checks::unix_now() {
000698 |                 return Err("代理验证后原授权计划已过期；请重新预览");
000699 |             }
000700 |             Ok(())
000701 |         })();
000702 |         if let Err(error) = preparation {
000703 |             if journal.runtime_state.is_none() {
000704 |                 return Err("用户配置修复中断；请先恢复事务");
000705 |             }
000706 |             self.restore_runtime(&mut journal, user.as_ref(), &lock, runtime)?;
000707 |             return Err(error);
000708 |         }
000709 |         journal.stage = RepairStage::SystemPending;
000710 |         self.save_journal(&journal)?;
000711 |         // A missing reply cannot cancel root. Keep both journals until its result is known.
000712 |         let response = execute(prepared.plan_id, &lock)
000713 |             .map_err(|_| "系统修复结果未知；已保留事务。请使用恢复入口查询结果")?;
000714 |         match resolution(&journal, &response) {
000715 |             Resolution::Applied => self.commit_runtime(&mut journal, user.as_ref(), &lock, runtime),
000716 |             Resolution::Restored => {
000717 |                 self.restore_runtime(&mut journal, user.as_ref(), &lock, runtime)?;
000718 |                 Err("系统修复未完成，原用户配置已恢复；请重新预览")
000719 |             }
000720 |             Resolution::Unknown => Err("系统修复结果尚未确认；已保留事务，请先恢复"),
000721 |         }
000722 |     }
000723 |     fn runtime_phase(&self, journal: &mut RegionJournal, phase: Phase) -> Result<(), &'static str> {
000724 |         if let Some(state) = &mut journal.runtime_state {
000725 |             state.phase = phase;
000726 |         }
000727 |         self.save_journal(journal)
000728 |     }
000729 |     fn journal_path(&self) -> PathBuf {
000730 |         self.home.join(".claude-switcher/v2/region-repair.json")
000731 |     }
000732 |     fn has_region_journal(&self) -> Result<bool, &'static str> {
000733 |         match fs::symlink_metadata(self.journal_path()) {
000734 |             Ok(_) => Ok(true),
000735 |             Err(error) if error.kind() == std::io::ErrorKind::NotFound => Ok(false),
000736 |             Err(_) => Err("无法读取地区修复状态"),
000737 |         }
000738 |     }
000739 |     fn save_journal(&self, journal: &RegionJournal) -> Result<(), &'static str> {
000740 |         storage::atomic_json(&self.journal_path(), journal)
000741 |             .map_err(|_| "地区修复记录保存失败；请保留现场并恢复")
000742 |     }
000743 |     fn read_journal(&self) -> Result<RegionJournal, &'static str> {
000744 |         let journal: RegionJournal = storage::read_json(&self.journal_path())
000745 |             .map_err(|_| "地区修复记录无法安全读取；请保留备份")?;
000746 |         journal.original.validate()?;
000747 |         journal.proposed.validate()?;
000748 |         if journal.runtime_state.is_some()
000749 |             && (journal.proposed.proxy_mode != "clash-verge"
000750 |                 || journal.original.proxy_mode != "clash-verge")
000751 |         {
000752 |             return Err("代理运行记录与配置不一致");
000753 |         }
000754 |         if journal.app_open_plan.is_some()
000755 |             && (journal.proposed.proxy_mode != "surge"
000756 |                 || journal.original.proxy_mode != "surge"
000757 |                 || journal.runtime_state.is_some())
000758 |         {
000759 |             return Err("App 打开记录与代理配置不一致");
000760 |         }
000761 |         if journal.schema != 1
000762 |             || journal.owner != unsafe { libc::geteuid() }
000763 |             || journal.edition != self.edition
000764 |             || journal.plan.id.is_empty()
000765 |             || journal.plan.id.len() > 160
000766 |             || journal.plan.target.timezone
000767 |                 != journal.proposed.timezone_target.as_deref().unwrap_or("")
000768 |             || journal.plan.target.network_service != journal.proposed.network_service
000769 |             || journal.plan.original.network_service != journal.plan.target.network_service
000770 |             || journal.plan.target.ipv6 != Ipv6Policy::Off
000771 |             || (journal.stage != RepairStage::UserPending
000772 |                 && journal.user_required
000773 |                 && journal.receipt.is_none())
000774 |         {
000775 |             return Err("地区修复记录与当前用户或目标不一致");
000776 |         }
000777 |         Ok(journal)
000778 |     }
000779 |     fn remove_journal(&self) -> Result<(), &'static str> {
000780 |         fs::remove_file(self.journal_path()).map_err(|_| "地区修复记录清理失败，请重试恢复")?;
000781 |         storage::sync_directory(&self.home.join(".claude-switcher/v2"))
000782 |             .map_err(|_| "地区修复记录同步未完成，请重试恢复")
000783 |     }
000784 |     fn user_coordinator(
000785 |         &self,
000786 |         required: bool,
000787 |     ) -> Result<Option<UserRepairCoordinator>, &'static str> {
000788 |         if required {
000789 |             UserRepairCoordinator::for_current_user(self.edition)
000790 |                 .map(Some)
000791 |                 .map_err(|_| "无法确认用户修复目录")
000792 |         } else {
000793 |             Ok(None)
000794 |         }

000796 |     fn commit_runtime(
000797 |         &self,
000798 |         journal: &mut RegionJournal,
000799 |         user: Option<&UserRepairCoordinator>,
000800 |         lock: &storage::LifecycleLock,
000801 |         runtime: &mut dyn Runtime,
000802 |     ) -> Result<(), &'static str> {
000803 |         let current = encode(&config::load_read_only(&self.home)?)?;
000804 |         let target = encode(&journal.proposed)?;
000805 |         if current != encode(&journal.original)? && current != target {
000806 |             return Err("地区目标发生外部变化；请保留事务并核对冲突");
000807 |         }
000808 |         // Persist the decision before either local target or user journal is committed.
000809 |         journal.stage = RepairStage::CommitIntent;
000810 |         self.save_journal(journal)?;
000811 |         let config_path = self.home.join(".claude-switcher/v2/config.json");
000812 |         let missing = match fs::symlink_metadata(&config_path) {
000813 |             Ok(metadata) if metadata.is_file() => false,
000814 |             Ok(_) => return Err("已提交目标配置路径不安全；请保留事务"),
000815 |             Err(error) if error.kind() == std::io::ErrorKind::NotFound => true,
000816 |             Err(_) => return Err("无法确认已提交目标配置路径；请保留事务"),
000817 |         };
000818 |         // Legacy fallback can equal the target without a durable v2 policy for Guardian.
000819 |         if current != target || missing {
000820 |             storage::atomic_json(&config_path, &journal.proposed)
000821 |                 .map_err(|_| "系统修复已完成；地区目标保存中断，请恢复事务继续提交")?;
000822 |         }
000823 |         if let (Some(user), Some(receipt)) = (user, journal.receipt.as_ref()) {
000824 |             user.commit_with_lock(receipt, lock)
000825 |                 .map_err(|_| "系统与地区目标已提交；用户配置提交待恢复")?;
000826 |         }
000827 |         if journal.runtime_state.is_some() {
000828 |             let country = journal
000829 |                 .proposed
000830 |                 .country_target
000831 |                 .as_deref()
000832 |                 .ok_or("目标国家缺失")?;
000833 |             if runtime.verify(country).is_err() {
000834 |                 // Applied is irreversible here: repair the target runtime, never original files.
000835 |                 runtime
000836 |                     .stop()
000837 |                     .and_then(|_| runtime.start())
000838 |                     .and_then(|_| runtime.verify(country))
000839 |                     .map_err(|_| "系统与用户配置已提交；代理运行状态尚未恢复，已保留事务")?;
000840 |             }
000841 |         }
000842 |         if let (Some(user), Some(receipt)) = (user, journal.receipt.as_ref()) {
000843 |             user.verify_receipt_with_lock(receipt, lock, false)
000844 |                 .map_err(|_| "系统已提交，但代理启动后配置发生变化；已保留事务")?;
000845 |         }
000846 |         self.remove_journal()
000847 |     }
000848 |     fn restore_runtime(
000849 |         &self,
000850 |         journal: &mut RegionJournal,
000851 |         user: Option<&UserRepairCoordinator>,
000852 |         lock: &storage::LifecycleLock,
000853 |         runtime: &mut dyn Runtime,
000854 |     ) -> Result<(), &'static str> {
000855 |         if journal.stage == RepairStage::CommitIntent {
000856 |             return Err("事务已有提交决议；请核对系统状态，不能回滚用户配置");
000857 |         }
000858 |         if encode(&config::load_read_only(&self.home)?)? != encode(&journal.original)? {
000859 |             return Err("地区目标发生外部变化；请保留事务并核对冲突");
000860 |         }
000861 |         let files_restored = journal
000862 |             .runtime_state
000863 |             .as_ref()
000864 |             .is_some_and(|state| state.phase == Phase::RestoringRuntime);
000865 |         if journal.runtime_state.is_some() && !files_restored {
000866 |             self.runtime_phase(journal, Phase::RestoringFiles)?;
000867 |             runtime
000868 |                 .stop()
000869 |                 .map_err(|_| "代理未退出，不能安全恢复文件；事务与备份已保留")?;
000870 |         }
000871 |         if !files_restored && let Some(user) = user {
000872 |             if let Some(receipt) = journal.receipt.as_ref() {
000873 |                 user.restore_with_lock(receipt, lock)
000874 |                     .map_err(|_| "原用户配置恢复未完成；请保留事务并核对冲突")?;
000875 |             } else if let Some(receipt) = user
000876 |                 .pending_receipt_with_lock(lock)
000877 |                 .map_err(|_| "中断的用户配置记录无法验证")?
000878 |             {
000879 |                 journal.receipt = Some(receipt.clone());
000880 |                 self.save_journal(journal)?;
000881 |                 user.restore_with_lock(&receipt, lock)
000882 |                     .map_err(|_| "中断的用户配置恢复未完成；请保留事务")?;
000883 |             }
000884 |         }
000885 |         if journal.runtime_state.is_some() {
000886 |             self.runtime_phase(journal, Phase::RestoringRuntime)?;
000887 |             let originally_running = journal.runtime_state.as_ref().unwrap().originally_running;
000888 |             // Retry always stops first, so a process started before a crash cannot be mistaken
000889 |             // for confirmation that the restored files were loaded.
000890 |             runtime
000891 |                 .stop()
000892 |                 .map_err(|_| "原文件已恢复，代理运行状态待恢复；事务已保留")?;
000893 |             if let (Some(user), Some(receipt)) = (user, journal.receipt.as_ref()) {
000894 |                 user.verify_receipt_with_lock(receipt, lock, true)
000895 |                     .map_err(|_| "原配置曾恢复，但文件已改变；未重新启动代理，事务已保留")?;
000896 |             }
000897 |             if originally_running {
000898 |                 runtime
000899 |                     .start()
000900 |                     .map_err(|_| "原文件已恢复，代理启动待恢复；事务已保留")?;
000901 |                 if !runtime.running()? {
000902 |                     return Err("原文件已恢复，代理启动未确认；事务已保留");
000903 |                 }
000904 |             }
000905 |         }
000906 |         if let (Some(user), Some(receipt)) = (user, journal.receipt.as_ref()) {
000907 |             user.verify_receipt_with_lock(receipt, lock, true)
000908 |                 .map_err(|_| "原配置曾恢复，但代理启动后文件发生变化；事务已保留，请核对冲突")?;
000909 |         }
000910 |         self.remove_journal()
000911 |     }
000912 |     pub fn recover_user_repair(&self) -> Result<bool, &'static str> {
000913 |         #[cfg(target_os = "macos")]
000914 |         {
000915 |             self.recover_validated_finishing_with(
000916 |                 || {
000917 |                     install::validate_installed_identity(self.edition, unsafe { libc::geteuid() })
000918 |                         .map(|_| ())
000919 |                 },
000920 |                 switcher_helper::native_authorization::Authorization::acquire,
000921 |                 |plan_id, authorization| {
000922 |                     let status = install::repair_status(plan_id.clone())?;
000923 |                     if status.code == "repair_recovery_required" {
000924 |                         install::recover_repair_authorized(plan_id, authorization)
000925 |                     } else {
000926 |                         Ok(status)
000927 |                     }
000928 |                 },
000929 |                 || crate::guardian_repair::restore_after_commit(self.edition),
000930 |             )
000931 |         }
000932 |         #[cfg(not(target_os = "macos"))]
000933 |         {
000934 |             Err("macos_required")
000935 |         }
000936 |     }
000937 |     #[cfg(test)]
000938 |     fn recover_validated_with<A>(
000939 |         &self,
000940 |         identity: impl FnOnce() -> Result<(), &'static str>,
000941 |         authorize: impl FnOnce() -> Result<A, &'static str>,
000942 |         status: impl FnOnce(String, &A) -> Result<HelperResponse, &'static str>,
000943 |     ) -> Result<bool, &'static str> {
000944 |         self.recover_validated_finishing_with(identity, authorize, status, || Ok(()))
000945 |     }
000946 |     fn recover_validated_finishing_with<A>(
000947 |         &self,
000948 |         identity: impl FnOnce() -> Result<(), &'static str>,
000949 |         authorize: impl FnOnce() -> Result<A, &'static str>,
000950 |         status: impl FnOnce(String, &A) -> Result<HelperResponse, &'static str>,
000951 |         after_commit: impl FnOnce() -> Result<(), &'static str>,
000952 |     ) -> Result<bool, &'static str> {
000953 |         identity().map_err(|_| "正式系统组件尚未安装并验证")?;
000954 |         let lock = storage::LifecycleLock::try_acquire(&self.home.join(".claude-switcher/v2"))
000955 |             .map_err(|_| "其他账号、修复或安装事务正在进行")?;
000956 |         let outcome = self.recover_authorized_with(&lock, authorize, status)?;
000957 |         drop(lock);
000958 |         if outcome == RecoveryOutcome::Committed {
000959 |             after_commit()?;
000960 |         }
000961 |         Ok(outcome != RecoveryOutcome::NoWork)
000962 |     }
000963 |     fn recover_authorized_with<A>(
000964 |         &self,
000965 |         lock: &storage::LifecycleLock,
000966 |         authorize: impl FnOnce() -> Result<A, &'static str>,
000967 |         status: impl FnOnce(String, &A) -> Result<HelperResponse, &'static str>,
000968 |     ) -> Result<RecoveryOutcome, &'static str> {
000969 |         let authorization =
000970 |             authorize().map_err(|_| "恢复授权取消或未通过；全部事务和备份已保留")?;
000971 |         self.recover_outcome_with(lock, |plan_id| status(plan_id, &authorization))
000972 |     }
000973 |     #[cfg(test)]
000974 |     fn recover_with(
000975 |         &self,
000976 |         lock: &storage::LifecycleLock,
000977 |         status: impl FnOnce(String) -> Result<HelperResponse, &'static str>,
000978 |     ) -> Result<bool, &'static str> {
000979 |         self.recover_outcome_with(lock, status)
000980 |             .map(|outcome| outcome != RecoveryOutcome::NoWork)
000981 |     }
000982 |     fn recover_outcome_with(
000983 |         &self,
000984 |         lock: &storage::LifecycleLock,
000985 |         status: impl FnOnce(String) -> Result<HelperResponse, &'static str>,
000986 |     ) -> Result<RecoveryOutcome, &'static str> {
000987 |         self.recover_runtime_with(lock, status, &mut proxy_repair::Native)
000988 |     }
000989 |     fn recover_runtime_with(
000990 |         &self,
000991 |         lock: &storage::LifecycleLock,
000992 |         status: impl FnOnce(String) -> Result<HelperResponse, &'static str>,
000993 |         runtime: &mut dyn Runtime,
000994 |     ) -> Result<RecoveryOutcome, &'static str> {
000995 |         if !self.has_region_journal()? {
000996 |             let user_path = self
000997 |                 .home
000998 |                 .join(".claude-switcher/v2/user-repairs/journal.json");
000999 |             match fs::symlink_metadata(&user_path) {
001000 |                 Ok(_) => {
001001 |                     // Do not let the user coordinator's existence check hide an unsafe marker.
001002 |                     storage::read_json::<serde_json::Value>(&user_path)
001003 |                         .map_err(|_| "用户配置修复记录无法安全读取；请保留事务与备份")?;
001004 |                 }
001005 |                 Err(error) if error.kind() == std::io::ErrorKind::NotFound => {}
001006 |                 Err(_) => return Err("无法读取用户配置修复状态"),
001007 |             }
001008 |             return UserRepairCoordinator::for_current_user(self.edition)
001009 |                 .map_err(|_| "无法确认用户修复目录")?
001010 |                 .recover_with_lock(lock)
001011 |                 .map(|recovered| {
001012 |                     if recovered {
001013 |                         RecoveryOutcome::Restored
001014 |                     } else {
001015 |                         RecoveryOutcome::NoWork
001016 |                     }
001017 |                 })
001018 |                 .map_err(|_| "用户配置恢复未完成；请保留事务与备份并核对冲突");
001019 |         }
001020 |         let mut journal = self.read_journal()?;
001021 |         let user = self.user_coordinator(journal.user_required)?;
001022 |         if journal.stage == RepairStage::UserPending {
001023 |             self.restore_runtime(&mut journal, user.as_ref(), lock, runtime)?;
001024 |             return Ok(RecoveryOutcome::Restored);
001025 |         }
001026 |         let response = status(journal.plan.id.clone())
001027 |             .map_err(|_| "系统组件仍在执行或结果未知；已保留事务，请稍后重试恢复")?;
001028 |         match resolution(&journal, &response) {
001029 |             Resolution::Applied => {
001030 |                 self.commit_runtime(&mut journal, user.as_ref(), lock, runtime)?;
001031 |                 Ok(RecoveryOutcome::Committed)
001032 |             }
001033 |             Resolution::Restored => {
001034 |                 self.restore_runtime(&mut journal, user.as_ref(), lock, runtime)?;
001035 |                 Ok(RecoveryOutcome::Restored)
001036 |             }
001037 |             Resolution::Unknown => Err("系统修复尚未得到确定结果；已保留全部事务与备份"),
001038 |         }
001039 |     }
001040 | }

001584 |     fn app_open_post_dispatch_expiry_and_config_conflicts_keep_intent() {
001585 |         for reason in ["expired", "changed", "unreadable"] {
001586 |             let (home, coordinator) = fixture();
001587 |             let mut prepared = surge_plan(&coordinator, &home);
001588 |             if reason == "expired" {
001589 |                 prepared.system_plan.as_mut().unwrap().expires_at = crate::checks::unix_now() + 1;
001590 |             }
001591 |             let path = home.join(".claude-switcher/v2/config.json");
001592 |             let original = config::load_read_only(&home).unwrap();
001593 |             let calls = std::cell::Cell::new(0);
001594 |             let result = coordinator.execute_runtime_and_app_with(
001595 |                 prepared,
001596 |                 |_, _| Ok(()),
001597 |                 |_, _| panic!("post-open conflict must precede root"),
001598 |                 &mut proxy_repair::Native,
001599 |                 |_| {
001600 |                     calls.set(calls.get() + 1);
001601 |                     match reason {
001602 |                         "expired" => std::thread::sleep(std::time::Duration::from_secs(2)),
001603 |                         "changed" => {
001604 |                             let mut changed = original.clone();
001605 |                             changed.network_service = "Ethernet".into();
001606 |                             storage::atomic_json(&path, &changed).unwrap();
001607 |                         }
001608 |                         _ => storage::atomic_write(&path, b"{").unwrap(),
001609 |                     }
001610 |                     Ok(())
001611 |                 },
001612 |             );
001613 |             assert!(result.unwrap_err().contains("请先恢复"));
001614 |             assert_eq!(
001615 |                 coordinator.read_journal().unwrap().stage,
001616 |                 RepairStage::UserPending
001617 |             );
001618 |             let lock =
001619 |                 storage::LifecycleLock::try_acquire(&home.join(".claude-switcher/v2")).unwrap();
001620 |             if reason != "expired" {
001621 |                 assert!(
001622 |                     coordinator
001623 |                         .recover_with(&lock, |_| panic!("must not call root"))
001624 |                         .is_err()
001625 |                 );
001626 |                 assert!(recovery_pending(&home).unwrap());
001627 |                 // Resolve only the test's injected external conflict, then retry explicit recovery.
001628 |                 storage::atomic_json(&path, &original).unwrap();
001629 |             }
001630 |             assert!(
001631 |                 coordinator
001632 |                     .recover_with(&lock, |_| panic!("UserPending must not call root"))
001633 |                     .unwrap()
001634 |             );
001635 |             assert_eq!(calls.get(), 1);
001636 |             assert!(!recovery_pending(&home).unwrap());
001637 |             assert_eq!(
001638 |                 encode(&config::load_read_only(&home).unwrap()).unwrap(),
001639 |                 encode(&original).unwrap()
001640 |             );
001641 |             drop(lock);
001642 |             fs::remove_dir_all(home).unwrap();
001643 |         }
001644 |     }

001684 |     fn repair_backup_images(directory: &Path) -> std::collections::BTreeMap<PathBuf, Vec<u8>> {
001685 |         let mut images = std::collections::BTreeMap::new();
001686 |         for entry in fs::read_dir(directory).unwrap() {
001687 |             let path = entry.unwrap().path();
001688 |             if path.is_symlink() {
001689 |                 continue; // Marker targets are checked separately without following them.
001690 |             }
001691 |             if path.is_dir() {
001692 |                 images.extend(repair_backup_images(&path));
001693 |             } else {
001694 |                 images.insert(path.clone(), fs::read(path).unwrap());
001695 |             }
001696 |         }
001697 |         images
001698 |     }

002407 | 
002408 |     struct FakeRuntime {
002409 |         home: PathBuf,
002410 |         original: Vec<Vec<u8>>,
002411 |         running: bool,
002412 |         stops: usize,
002413 |         starts: usize,
002414 |         verifies: usize,
002415 |         fail_stop: Option<usize>,
002416 |         fail_start: Option<usize>,
002417 |         fail_verify: Option<usize>,
002418 |         delay_verify: bool,
002419 |         mutate_on_start: Option<usize>,
002420 |     }
002421 |     impl FakeRuntime {
002422 |         fn new(fixture: &Fixture, running: bool) -> Self {
002423 |             Self {
002424 |                 home: fixture.root.clone(),
002425 |                 original: images(&fixture.root),
002426 |                 running,
002427 |                 stops: 0,
002428 |                 starts: 0,
002429 |                 verifies: 0,
002430 |                 fail_stop: None,
002431 |                 fail_start: None,
002432 |                 fail_verify: None,
002433 |                 delay_verify: false,
002434 |                 mutate_on_start: None,
002435 |             }
002436 |         }
002437 |         fn journal(&self) -> RegionJournal {
002438 |             storage::read_json(&self.home.join(".claude-switcher/v2/region-repair.json")).unwrap()
002439 |         }
002440 |     }
002441 |     impl Runtime for FakeRuntime {
002442 |         fn running(&mut self) -> Result<bool, &'static str> {
002443 |             Ok(self.running)
002444 |         }
002445 |         fn stop(&mut self) -> Result<(), &'static str> {
002446 |             let journal = self.journal(); // every mutation must already have durable intent
002447 |             let phase = journal.runtime_state.unwrap().phase;
002448 |             if phase == Phase::Intent {
002449 |                 assert_eq!(images(&self.home), self.original);
002450 |             }
002451 |             self.stops += 1;
002452 |             if self.fail_stop == Some(self.stops) {
002453 |                 return Err("injected stop failure");
002454 |             }
002455 |             self.running = false;
002456 |             Ok(())
002457 |         }
002458 |         fn start(&mut self) -> Result<(), &'static str> {
002459 |             let phase = self.journal().runtime_state.unwrap().phase;
002460 |             assert!(!self.running);
002461 |             if phase == Phase::RestoringRuntime {
002462 |                 assert_eq!(images(&self.home), self.original);
002463 |             } else {
002464 |                 assert_ne!(images(&self.home), self.original);
002465 |             }
002466 |             self.starts += 1;
002467 |             if self.fail_start == Some(self.starts) {
002468 |                 return Err("injected start failure");
002469 |             }
002470 |             self.running = true;
002471 |             if self.mutate_on_start == Some(self.starts) {
002472 |                 fs::write(
002473 |                     self.home.join(USER_FILES[2]),
002474 |                     b"external: rewrite\nenable_tun_mode: true\n",
002475 |                 )
002476 |                 .unwrap();
002477 |             }
002478 |             Ok(())
002479 |         }
002480 |         fn verify(&mut self, country: &str) -> Result<(), &'static str> {
002481 |             assert_eq!(country, "US");
002482 |             self.verifies += 1;
002483 |             if self.delay_verify {
002484 |                 std::thread::sleep(std::time::Duration::from_secs(2));
002485 |             }
002486 |             if self.fail_verify == Some(self.verifies) {
002487 |                 Err("country or TUN mismatch")
002488 |             } else if self.running {
002489 |                 Ok(())
002490 |             } else {
002491 |                 Err("not running")

000173 | fn execute_with(

000182 |     }

000184 |         return Err("地区配置已改变，请重新预览");
000185 |     }

000190 |         .ok_or("目标地区格式无效")?;

000008 | pub enum RepairCommand {
000009 |     Fix { apply: bool },
000010 |     DetectRegion { apply: bool },
000011 |     SetRegion { preset: RegionPreset, apply: bool },
000012 | }

000014 | impl RepairCommand {
000015 |     pub fn parse(args: &[String]) -> Result<Self, String> {
000016 |         match args {
000017 |             [command] if command == "fix" => Ok(Self::Fix { apply: true }),
000018 |             [command, flag] if command == "fix" && flag == "--preview" => {
000019 |                 Ok(Self::Fix { apply: false })
000020 |             }
000021 |             [command, flag] if command == "fix" && flag == "--apply" => {
000022 |                 Ok(Self::Fix { apply: true })
000023 |             }
000024 |             [command] if command == "set-region" => Ok(Self::DetectRegion { apply: true }),
000025 |             [command, flag] if command == "set-region" && flag == "--preview" => {
000026 |                 Ok(Self::DetectRegion { apply: false })
000027 |             }
000028 |             [command, flag] if command == "set-region" && flag == "--apply" => {
000029 |                 Ok(Self::DetectRegion { apply: true })
000030 |             }
000031 |             [command, name] | [command, name, _]
000032 |                 if command == "set-region"
000033 |                     && (args.len() == 2 || matches!(args[2].as_str(), "--apply" | "--preview")) =>
000034 |             {
000035 |                 let preset = serde_json::from_value(serde_json::Value::String(name.clone()))
000036 |                     .map_err(|_| "地区只接受已列出的固定国家枚举")?;
000037 |                 Ok(Self::SetRegion {
000038 |                     preset,
000039 |                     apply: args.len() == 2 || args[2] == "--apply",
000040 |                 })
000041 |             }
000042 |             _ => Err("invalid_command".into()),
000043 |         }
000044 |     }
000045 | 
000046 |     pub fn args(self) -> Vec<String> {
000047 |         match self {
000048 |             Self::Fix { apply } => with_apply(vec!["fix".into()], apply),
000049 |             Self::DetectRegion { apply } => with_apply(vec!["set-region".into()], apply),
000050 |             Self::SetRegion { preset, apply } => with_apply(
000051 |                 vec![
000052 |                     "set-region".into(),
000053 |                     serde_json::to_value(preset)
000054 |                         .expect("fixed region enum")
000055 |                         .as_str()
000056 |                         .expect("region string")
000057 |                         .into(),
000058 |                 ],
000059 |                 apply,
000060 |             ),
000061 |         }
000062 |     }
000063 | }

000065 | fn with_apply(mut args: Vec<String>, apply: bool) -> Vec<String> {
000066 |     if !apply {
000067 |         args.push("--preview".into());
000068 |     }
000069 |     args

000072 | pub async fn run(command: RepairCommand, edition: Edition) -> Result<i32, String> {
000073 |     let coordinator = crate::regions::RegionCoordinator::for_current_user(edition)?;
000074 |     let prepared = match command {
000075 |         RepairCommand::Fix { .. } => coordinator.preview(None)?,
000076 |         RepairCommand::SetRegion { preset, .. } => coordinator.preview(Some(preset))?,
000077 |         RepairCommand::DetectRegion { .. } => {
000078 |             let client = crate::network::inherited_client()?;
000079 |             let detected = crate::region_detection::detect(&client).await?;
000080 |             coordinator.preview_detected(detected)?
000081 |         }
000082 |     };
000083 |     print_json(&prepared.preview)?;
000084 |     if matches!(
000085 |         command,
000086 |         RepairCommand::Fix { apply: true }
000087 |             | RepairCommand::SetRegion { apply: true, .. }
000088 |             | RepairCommand::DetectRegion { apply: true }
000089 |     ) {
000090 |         coordinator.execute(prepared)?;
000091 |         print_json(
000092 |             &serde_json::json!({"completed":true,"message":"系统修复已完成并保存地区目标；请重新检查环境与地区格式","recovery":null}),
000093 |         )?;
000094 |     }
000095 |     Ok(0)
000096 | }

000100 |     println!("{output}");
000101 |     Ok(())

000111 | /// Validate the installed identity before launching the fixed GUI binary.
000112 | /// The helper performs its own code-identity check on the new process.
000113 | #[cfg(target_os = "macos")]
000114 | pub fn installed_gui(edition: Edition) -> Result<PathBuf, &'static str> {
000115 |     let uid = unsafe { libc::geteuid() };
000116 |     let record = crate::install::validate_installed_identity(edition, uid)?;
000117 |     match std::fs::symlink_metadata(SOURCE_LOCAL_TRANSACTION) {
000118 |         Ok(_) => return Err("installation_replacement_pending"),
000119 |         Err(error) if error.kind() == std::io::ErrorKind::NotFound => {}
000120 |         Err(_) => return Err("installation_replacement_unknown"),
000121 |     }
000122 |     let app = app(edition);
000123 |     let requirement = gui_requirement(edition, &record)?;
000124 |     verify_gui(&app, &requirement, |path, requirement| {
000125 |         std::process::Command::new("/usr/bin/codesign")
000126 |             .args([
000127 |                 "--verify",
000128 |                 "--strict",
000129 |                 "--test-requirement",
000130 |                 &format!("={requirement}"),
000131 |             ])
000132 |             .arg(path)
000133 |             .output()
000134 |             .map(|output| output.status.success())
000135 |             .map_err(|_| "installed_gui_signature_unavailable")
000136 |     })
000137 | }
000138 | 
000139 | #[cfg(target_os = "macos")]
000140 | fn gui_requirement(edition: Edition, record: &InstallRecord) -> Result<String, &'static str> {
000141 |     if record.edition != edition || record.owner_uid != unsafe { libc::geteuid() } {
000142 |         return Err("installed_owner_or_edition");
000143 |     }
000144 |     record.client_requirement(ClientRole::Gui)
000145 | }

000148 | fn verify_gui(

000150 |     requirement: &str,
000151 |     verify: impl FnOnce(&Path, &str) -> Result<bool, &'static str>,
000152 | ) -> Result<PathBuf, &'static str> {
000153 |     if !verify(app, requirement)? {
000154 |         return Err("installed_gui_identity");

000156 |     let executable = app.join("Contents/MacOS/switcher-desktop");

000001 | //! Signed UTF-8 payloads. Verify the exact bytes before deserializing data.
000002 | use ed25519_dalek::{Signature, VerifyingKey};
000003 | use serde::{
000004 |     Deserialize, Serialize,
000005 |     de::{self, DeserializeOwned, MapAccess, SeqAccess, Visitor},
000006 | };
000007 | use sha2::{Digest, Sha256};
000008 | 
000009 | #[derive(Debug, Serialize, Deserialize)]
000010 | #[serde(deny_unknown_fields)]
000011 | pub struct Envelope {
000012 |     pub payload: String,
000013 |     pub signature: Vec<u8>,
000014 | }
000015 | 
000016 | pub fn digest(bytes: &[u8]) -> String {
000017 |     // ponytail: the standard byte formatter avoids a hex dependency.
000018 |     Sha256::digest(bytes)
000019 |         .iter()
000020 |         .map(|byte| format!("{byte:02x}"))
000021 |         .collect()
000022 | }
000023 | 
000024 | pub fn verify<T: DeserializeOwned>(
000025 |     wire: &[u8],
000026 |     key: &VerifyingKey,
000027 |     limit: usize,
000028 | ) -> Result<(T, String), &'static str> {
000029 |     if wire.len() > limit {
000030 |         return Err("envelope_too_large");
000031 |     }
000032 |     let envelope: Envelope = serde_json::from_slice(wire).map_err(|_| "envelope_json")?;
000033 |     let signature = Signature::from_slice(&envelope.signature).map_err(|_| "signature_shape")?;
000034 |     key.verify_strict(envelope.payload.as_bytes(), &signature)
000035 |         .map_err(|_| "signature")?;
000036 |     let data = strict_json(envelope.payload.as_bytes(), limit)?;
000037 |     Ok((data, digest(envelope.payload.as_bytes())))
000038 | }
000039 | 
000040 | /// All nested DTOs must also use `deny_unknown_fields`.
000041 | /// Parsing through this visitor rejects duplicate keys before serde can discard them.
000042 | pub fn strict_json<T: DeserializeOwned>(bytes: &[u8], limit: usize) -> Result<T, &'static str> {
000043 |     if bytes.len() > limit {
000044 |         return Err("payload_too_large");
000045 |     }
000046 |     let value: UniqueValue = serde_json::from_slice(bytes).map_err(|_| "payload_json")?;
000047 |     serde_json::from_value(value.0).map_err(|_| "payload_json")
000048 | }
000049 | 
000050 | struct UniqueValue(serde_json::Value);
000051 | 
000052 | impl<'de> Deserialize<'de> for UniqueValue {
000053 |     fn deserialize<D: de::Deserializer<'de>>(deserializer: D) -> Result<Self, D::Error> {
000054 |         struct UniqueVisitor;
000055 |         impl<'de> Visitor<'de> for UniqueVisitor {
000056 |             type Value = UniqueValue;
000057 |             fn expecting(&self, f: &mut std::fmt::Formatter<'_>) -> std::fmt::Result {
000058 |                 f.write_str("JSON without duplicate keys")
000059 |             }
000060 |             fn visit_bool<E: de::Error>(self, value: bool) -> Result<Self::Value, E> {
000061 |                 Ok(UniqueValue(value.into()))
000062 |             }
000063 |             fn visit_i64<E: de::Error>(self, value: i64) -> Result<Self::Value, E> {
000064 |                 Ok(UniqueValue(value.into()))
000065 |             }
000066 |             fn visit_u64<E: de::Error>(self, value: u64) -> Result<Self::Value, E> {
000067 |                 Ok(UniqueValue(value.into()))
000068 |             }
000069 |             fn visit_f64<E: de::Error>(self, value: f64) -> Result<Self::Value, E> {
000070 |                 serde_json::Number::from_f64(value)
000071 |                     .map(|n| UniqueValue(n.into()))
000072 |                     .ok_or_else(|| E::custom("invalid number"))
000073 |             }
000074 |             fn visit_str<E: de::Error>(self, value: &str) -> Result<Self::Value, E> {
000075 |                 Ok(UniqueValue(value.into()))
000076 |             }
000077 |             fn visit_string<E: de::Error>(self, value: String) -> Result<Self::Value, E> {
000078 |                 Ok(UniqueValue(value.into()))
000079 |             }
000080 |             fn visit_none<E: de::Error>(self) -> Result<Self::Value, E> {
000081 |                 Ok(UniqueValue(serde_json::Value::Null))
000082 |             }
000083 |             fn visit_unit<E: de::Error>(self) -> Result<Self::Value, E> {
000084 |                 Ok(UniqueValue(serde_json::Value::Null))
000085 |             }
000086 |             fn visit_seq<A: SeqAccess<'de>>(
000087 |                 self,
000088 |                 mut sequence: A,
000089 |             ) -> Result<Self::Value, A::Error> {
000090 |                 let mut values = Vec::new();
000091 |                 while let Some(value) = sequence.next_element::<UniqueValue>()? {
000092 |                     values.push(value.0);
000093 |                 }
000094 |                 Ok(UniqueValue(values.into()))
000095 |             }
000096 |             fn visit_map<A: MapAccess<'de>>(self, mut map: A) -> Result<Self::Value, A::Error> {
000097 |                 let mut values = serde_json::Map::new();
000098 |                 while let Some(key) = map.next_key::<String>()? {
000099 |                     if values.contains_key(&key) {
000100 |                         return Err(de::Error::custom("duplicate key"));
000101 |                     }
000102 |                     values.insert(key, map.next_value::<UniqueValue>()?.0);
000103 |                 }
000104 |                 Ok(UniqueValue(values.into()))
000105 |             }
000106 |         }
000107 |         deserializer.deserialize_any(UniqueVisitor)
000108 |     }
000109 | }

000111 | #[derive(Debug, Clone, Default, PartialEq, Eq, Serialize, Deserialize)]
000112 | #[serde(deny_unknown_fields)]
000113 | pub struct Sequence {
000114 |     pub highest: u64,
000115 |     pub payload_hash: Option<String>,
000116 | }
000117 | 
000118 | impl Sequence {
000119 |     pub fn check(&self, sequence: u64, hash: &str) -> Result<(), &'static str> {
000120 |         if sequence == 0 || sequence < self.highest {
000121 |             return Err("old_sequence");
000122 |         }
000123 |         if sequence == self.highest && self.payload_hash.as_deref() != Some(hash) {
000124 |             return Err("sequence_conflict");
000125 |         }
000126 |         Ok(())
000127 |     }
000128 |     pub fn remember(&mut self, sequence: u64, hash: String) -> Result<(), &'static str> {
000129 |         self.check(sequence, &hash)?;
000130 |         self.highest = sequence;
000131 |         self.payload_hash = Some(hash);
000132 |         Ok(())
000133 |     }
000134 | }

000012 | /// Held for account writes, launch and installation. Stop requests never take this lock.
000013 | #[derive(Debug)]
000014 | pub struct LifecycleLock {
000015 |     _file: File,
000016 |     directory: PathBuf,
000017 |     directory_identity: (u64, u64),
000018 |     name: &'static str,
000019 | }
000020 | 
000021 | impl Drop for LifecycleLock {
000022 |     fn drop(&mut self) {
000023 |         // Explicit unlock also releases a descriptor briefly inherited by another thread's fork/exec.
000024 |         let _ = self._file.unlock();
000025 |     }
000026 | }
000027 | 
000028 | impl LifecycleLock {
000029 |     pub fn try_acquire(directory: &Path) -> io::Result<Self> {
000030 |         Self::try_named(directory, "lifecycle.lock", true)
000031 |     }
000032 | 
000033 |     fn try_named(directory: &Path, name: &'static str, create: bool) -> io::Result<Self> {
000034 |         validate_no_symlinks(directory)?;
000035 |         let directory = directory.canonicalize()?;
000036 |         let metadata = fs::metadata(&directory)?;
000037 |         if !metadata.is_dir()
000038 |             || metadata.uid() != unsafe { libc::geteuid() }
000039 |             || metadata.mode() & 0o022 != 0
000040 |         {
000041 |             return Err(io::Error::new(
000042 |                 io::ErrorKind::PermissionDenied,
000043 |                 "unsafe lifecycle directory",
000044 |             ));
000045 |         }
000046 |         let directory_identity = (metadata.dev(), metadata.ino());
000047 |         let file = OpenOptions::new()
000048 |             .read(true)
000049 |             .write(true)
000050 |             .create(create)
000051 |             .mode(0o600)
000052 |             .custom_flags(libc::O_NOFOLLOW | libc::O_CLOEXEC)
000053 |             .open(directory.join(name))?;
000054 |         let metadata = file.metadata()?;
000055 |         if !metadata.is_file()
000056 |             || metadata.nlink() != 1
000057 |             || metadata.uid() != unsafe { libc::geteuid() }
000058 |             || metadata.mode() & 0o077 != 0
000059 |         {
000060 |             return Err(io::Error::new(
000061 |                 io::ErrorKind::PermissionDenied,
000062 |                 "unsafe lifecycle lock",
000063 |             ));
000064 |         }
000065 |         if name != "lifecycle.lock" {
000066 |             crate::accounts::access_control(&directory)?;
000067 |             crate::accounts::access_control(&directory.join(name))?;
000068 |         }
000069 |         file.try_lock().map_err(|error| match error {
000070 |             std::fs::TryLockError::WouldBlock => {
000071 |                 io::Error::new(io::ErrorKind::WouldBlock, "lifecycle busy")
000072 |             }
000073 |             std::fs::TryLockError::Error(error) => error,
000074 |         })?;
000075 |         let lock = Self {
000076 |             _file: file,
000077 |             directory,
000078 |             directory_identity,
000079 |             name,
000080 |         };
000081 |         if !lock.protects(&lock.directory) {
000082 |             return Err(io::Error::new(
000083 |                 io::ErrorKind::PermissionDenied,
000084 |                 "lifecycle directory or lock was replaced",
000085 |             ));
000086 |         }
000087 |         Ok(lock)
000088 |     }

000090 |     pub fn protects(&self, directory: &Path) -> bool {
000091 |         if validate_no_symlinks(directory).is_err()
000092 |             || !directory
000093 |                 .canonicalize()
000094 |                 .is_ok_and(|path| path == self.directory)
000095 |         {
000096 |             return false;
000097 |         }
000098 |         let Ok(metadata) = fs::metadata(directory) else {
000099 |             return false;
000100 |         };
000101 |         let Ok(on_disk) = fs::symlink_metadata(directory.join(self.name)) else {
000102 |             return false;
000103 |         };
000104 |         let Ok(held) = self._file.metadata() else {
000105 |             return false;
000106 |         };
000107 |         (metadata.dev(), metadata.ino()) == self.directory_identity
000108 |             && (on_disk.dev(), on_disk.ino()) == (held.dev(), held.ino())
000109 |             && on_disk.is_file()
000110 |             && !on_disk.file_type().is_symlink()
000111 |             && on_disk.nlink() == 1
000112 |             && on_disk.uid() == unsafe { libc::geteuid() }
000113 |             && on_disk.mode() & 0o077 == 0
000114 |             && (self.name == "lifecycle.lock"
000115 |                 || crate::accounts::access_control(&directory.join(self.name)).is_ok())
000116 |     }

000261 |     if bytes.len() as u64 > METADATA_LIMIT {
000262 |         return Err(io::Error::new(
000263 |             io::ErrorKind::InvalidData,
000264 |             "metadata too large",
000265 |         ));
000266 |     }
000267 |     atomic_write(path, &bytes)
000268 | }
000269 | 
000270 | pub fn read_json<T: DeserializeOwned>(path: &Path) -> io::Result<T> {
000271 |     let bytes = read_private_bytes(path, METADATA_LIMIT as usize)?;
000272 |     crate::signed::strict_json(&bytes, METADATA_LIMIT as usize).map_err(io::Error::other)
000273 | }
000274 | 
000275 | /// Bounded private-file reader for larger signed update state. Callers choose their protocol limit.
000276 | pub fn read_private_bytes(path: &Path, limit: usize) -> io::Result<Vec<u8>> {
000277 |     let read_limit = u64::try_from(limit)
000278 |         .ok()
000279 |         .and_then(|value| value.checked_add(1))
000280 |         .ok_or_else(|| io::Error::new(io::ErrorKind::InvalidInput, "invalid private file limit"))?;
000281 |     validate_no_symlinks(
000282 |         path.parent()
000283 |             .ok_or_else(|| io::Error::new(io::ErrorKind::InvalidInput, "missing parent"))?,
000284 |     )?;
000285 |     let file = OpenOptions::new()
000286 |         .read(true)
000287 |         .custom_flags(libc::O_NOFOLLOW | libc::O_CLOEXEC | libc::O_NONBLOCK)
000288 |         .open(path)?;
000289 |     let metadata = file.metadata()?;
000290 |     if !metadata.is_file()
000291 |         || metadata.nlink() != 1
000292 |         || metadata.uid() != unsafe { libc::geteuid() }
000293 |         || metadata.mode() & 0o077 != 0
000294 |     {
000295 |         return Err(io::Error::new(
000296 |             io::ErrorKind::PermissionDenied,
000297 |             "unsafe private file source",
000298 |         ));
000299 |     }
000300 |     if metadata.len() >= read_limit {
000301 |         return Err(io::Error::new(
000302 |             io::ErrorKind::InvalidData,
000303 |             "private file too large",
000304 |         ));
000305 |     }
000306 |     let mut bytes = Vec::new();
000307 |     file.take(read_limit).read_to_end(&mut bytes)?;
000308 |     if bytes.len() > limit {
000309 |         return Err(io::Error::new(
000310 |             io::ErrorKind::InvalidData,
000311 |             "private file too large",
000312 |         ));
000313 |     }
000314 |     Ok(bytes)
000315 | }

000571 |     fn three_process_writers_contend_and_os_releases_killed_holder() {
000572 |         use std::os::unix::process::ExitStatusExt;
000573 |         struct TemporaryHome(PathBuf);
000574 |         impl Drop for TemporaryHome {
000575 |             fn drop(&mut self) {
000576 |                 let _ = fs::remove_dir_all(&self.0);
000577 |             }
000578 |         }
000579 |         struct ChildGuard(std::process::Child);
000580 |         impl Drop for ChildGuard {
000581 |             fn drop(&mut self) {
000582 |                 let _ = self.0.kill();
000583 |                 let _ = self.0.wait();
000584 |             }
000585 |         }
000586 |         fn spawn(home: &Path, role: &str) -> ChildGuard {
000587 |             ChildGuard(
000588 |                 std::process::Command::new(std::env::current_exe().unwrap())
000589 |                     .args([
000590 |                         "--exact",
000591 |                         "storage::tests::lifecycle_contention_child_fixture",
000592 |                         "--nocapture",
000593 |                     ])
000594 |                     .env("HOME", home)
000595 |                     .env("SWITCHER_CONTENTION_HOME", home)
000596 |                     .env("SWITCHER_CONTENTION_ROLE", role)
000597 |                     .stdin(std::process::Stdio::null())
000598 |                     .stdout(std::process::Stdio::null())
000599 |                     .spawn()
000600 |                     .unwrap(),
000601 |             )
000602 |         }
000603 |         fn wait_success(child: &mut ChildGuard) {
000604 |             let deadline = std::time::Instant::now() + std::time::Duration::from_secs(10);
000605 |             loop {
000606 |                 if let Some(status) = child.0.try_wait().unwrap() {
000607 |                     assert!(status.success());
000608 |                     return;
000609 |                 }
000610 |                 assert!(std::time::Instant::now() < deadline, "child exit deadline");
000611 |                 std::thread::sleep(std::time::Duration::from_millis(10));
000612 |             }
000613 |         }
000614 |         let home = TemporaryHome(std::env::temp_dir().canonicalize().unwrap().join(format!(
000615 |             "switcher-lock-contention-{}-{}",
000616 |             std::process::id(),
000617 |             NEXT_FILE.fetch_add(1, Ordering::Relaxed)
000618 |         )));
000619 |         create_private_directory(&home.0).unwrap();
000620 |         create_private_directory(&home.0.join(".claude-switcher")).unwrap();
000621 |         let v2 = home.0.join(".claude-switcher/v2");
000622 |         create_private_directory(&v2).unwrap();
000623 |         let mut gui = spawn(&home.0, "gui");
000624 |         contention_wait(&v2.join("gui-held"));
000625 |         let mut cli = spawn(&home.0, "cli");
000626 |         let mut update = spawn(&home.0, "update");
000627 |         assert_ne!(gui.0.id(), cli.0.id());
000628 |         assert_ne!(gui.0.id(), update.0.id());
000629 |         assert_ne!(cli.0.id(), update.0.id());
000630 |         contention_wait(&v2.join("cli-denied-by-gui"));
000631 |         contention_wait(&v2.join("update-denied-by-gui"));
000632 |         assert_eq!(fs::read(v2.join("shared-state")).unwrap(), b"gui");
000633 |         assert_eq!(
000634 |             LifecycleLock::try_acquire(&v2).unwrap_err().kind(),
000635 |             io::ErrorKind::WouldBlock
000636 |         );
000637 |         println!("phase=gui-held cli=WouldBlock update=WouldBlock shared=gui");
000638 |         gui.0.kill().unwrap();
000639 |         assert_eq!(gui.0.wait().unwrap().signal(), Some(libc::SIGKILL));
000640 |         atomic_write(&v2.join("retry-cli"), b"retry").unwrap();
000641 |         contention_wait(&v2.join("cli-held"));
000642 |         assert_eq!(fs::read(v2.join("shared-state")).unwrap(), b"cli");
000643 |         atomic_write(&v2.join("retry-update-denied"), b"retry").unwrap();
000644 |         contention_wait(&v2.join("update-denied-by-cli"));
000645 |         assert_eq!(fs::read(v2.join("shared-state")).unwrap(), b"cli");
000646 |         assert_eq!(
000647 |             LifecycleLock::try_acquire(&v2).unwrap_err().kind(),
000648 |             io::ErrorKind::WouldBlock
000649 |         );
000650 |         println!("phase=gui-SIGKILL cli=acquired update=WouldBlock shared=cli");
000651 |         atomic_write(&v2.join("release-cli"), b"release").unwrap();
000652 |         wait_success(&mut cli);
000653 |         atomic_write(&v2.join("retry-update-acquire"), b"retry").unwrap();
000654 |         contention_wait(&v2.join("update-acquired"));
000655 |         wait_success(&mut update);
000656 |         assert_eq!(fs::read(v2.join("shared-state")).unwrap(), b"update");
000657 |         let lock = LifecycleLock::try_acquire(&v2).unwrap();
000658 |         assert!(lock.protects(&v2));
000659 |         drop(lock);
000660 |         println!("phase=cli-released update=acquired final-lock=available shared=update");
000661 |     }

000040 | impl ClockState {
000041 |     pub fn trusted(&self) -> bool {
000042 |         self.status == ClockStatus::Trusted
000043 |     }
000044 | 
000045 |     /// A manually established baseline permits a signed refresh, but still blocks installation.
000046 |     pub fn allows_verified_refresh(&self) -> bool {
000047 |         !matches!(self.status, ClockStatus::NeedsRecovery { .. })
000048 |     }
000049 | 
000050 |     pub fn observe(&mut self, sample: ClockSample) -> &ClockStatus {
000051 |         let mut difference_ms = 0i128;
000052 |         if let Some(previous) = &self.previous {
000053 |             if previous.boot_id == sample.boot_id {
000054 |                 if sample.continuous_ms < previous.continuous_ms {
000055 |                     difference_ms = -CLOCK_TOLERANCE_MS - 1_000;
000056 |                 } else {
000057 |                     difference_ms = (i128::from(sample.utc_secs) - i128::from(previous.utc_secs))
000058 |                         * 1_000
000059 |                         - i128::from(sample.continuous_ms - previous.continuous_ms);
000060 |                 }
000061 |             } else if let Some(last_success) = self.last_success_utc {
000062 |                 let rollback_ms = (i128::from(sample.utc_secs) - i128::from(last_success)) * 1_000;
000063 |                 if rollback_ms < -CLOCK_TOLERANCE_MS {
000064 |                     difference_ms = rollback_ms;
000065 |                 }
000066 |             }
000067 |         } else if let Some(last_success) = self.last_success_utc {
000068 |             let rollback_ms = (i128::from(sample.utc_secs) - i128::from(last_success)) * 1_000;
000069 |             if rollback_ms < -CLOCK_TOLERANCE_MS {
000070 |                 difference_ms = rollback_ms;
000071 |             }
000072 |         }
000073 |         // Repeated small rollback steps must not evade the last verified UTC anchor.
000074 |         // A user-established baseline can replace that anchor only after a signed refresh.
000075 |         if self.status != ClockStatus::AwaitingVerifiedRefresh
000076 |             && let Some(last_success) = self.last_success_utc
000077 |         {
000078 |             let rollback_ms = (i128::from(sample.utc_secs) - i128::from(last_success)) * 1_000;
000079 |             if rollback_ms < -CLOCK_TOLERANCE_MS {
000080 |                 difference_ms = rollback_ms;
000081 |             }
000082 |         }
000083 |         if difference_ms.abs() > CLOCK_TOLERANCE_MS {
000084 |             self.status = ClockStatus::NeedsRecovery {
000085 |                 difference_secs: (difference_ms / 1_000)
000086 |                     .clamp(i128::from(i64::MIN), i128::from(i64::MAX))
000087 |                     as i64,
000088 |             };
000089 |         }
000090 |         self.previous = Some(sample);
000091 |         &self.status
000092 |     }
000093 | 
000094 |     /// Display reads keep a stable baseline while still checking cumulative clock drift.
000095 |     pub fn observe_passive(&mut self, sample: ClockSample) -> &ClockStatus {
000096 |         let previous = self.previous.clone();
000097 |         let status = self.status.clone();
000098 |         let same_boot = previous
000099 |             .as_ref()
000100 |             .is_some_and(|value| value.boot_id == sample.boot_id);
000101 |         self.observe(sample);
000102 |         if same_boot && self.status == status {
000103 |             self.previous = previous;
000104 |         }
000105 |         &self.status
000106 |     }
000107 | 
000108 |     /// Explicit local action after the user fixes system time. This alone does not resume anything.
000109 |     pub fn establish_baseline(&mut self, sample: ClockSample) {
000110 |         self.previous = Some(sample);
000111 |         self.status = ClockStatus::AwaitingVerifiedRefresh;
000112 |     }
000113 | 
000114 |     /// Call only after the fixed source's signature, sequence and validity pass at this sample's UTC.
000115 |     /// Replay counters live outside ClockState and are deliberately not reset here.
000116 |     pub fn record_verified_success(&mut self, sample: ClockSample) -> Result<(), &'static str> {
000117 |         self.observe(sample.clone());
000118 |         if matches!(self.status, ClockStatus::NeedsRecovery { .. }) {
000119 |             return Err("clock_recovery_required");
000120 |         }
000121 |         self.status = ClockStatus::Trusted;
000122 |         self.last_success_utc = Some(sample.utc_secs);
000123 |         Ok(())
000124 |     }
000125 | }
000126 | 
000127 | /// macOS's continuous clock includes sleep; Instant is intentionally not used here.
000128 | #[cfg(target_os = "macos")]
000129 | pub fn sample() -> Result<ClockSample, &'static str> {
000130 |     #[repr(C)]
000131 |     struct Timebase {
000132 |         numerator: u32,
000133 |         denominator: u32,
000134 |     }
000135 |     unsafe extern "C" {
000136 |         fn mach_continuous_time() -> u64;
000137 |         fn mach_timebase_info(info: *mut Timebase) -> i32;
000138 |     }
000139 |     let mut timebase = Timebase {
000140 |         numerator: 0,
000141 |         denominator: 0,
000142 |     };
000143 |     // SAFETY: the system writes exactly one properly aligned Timebase.
000144 |     if unsafe { mach_timebase_info(&mut timebase) } != 0 || timebase.denominator == 0 {
000145 |         return Err("continuous_clock");
000146 |     }
000147 |     // SAFETY: mach_continuous_time has no arguments or memory side effects.
000148 |     let ticks = unsafe { mach_continuous_time() };
000149 |     let continuous_ms = u128::from(ticks) * u128::from(timebase.numerator)
000150 |         / u128::from(timebase.denominator)
000151 |         / 1_000_000;
000152 |     let boot = std::process::Command::new("/usr/sbin/sysctl")
000153 |         .args(["-n", "kern.bootsessionuuid"])
000154 |         .output()
000155 |         .map_err(|_| "boot_id")?;
000156 |     if !boot.status.success() {
000157 |         return Err("boot_id");
000158 |     }
000159 |     let boot_id = String::from_utf8(boot.stdout)
000160 |         .map_err(|_| "boot_id")?
000161 |         .trim()
000162 |         .to_owned();
000163 |     if boot_id.len() != 36 || !boot_id.bytes().all(|b| b.is_ascii_hexdigit() || b == b'-') {
000164 |         return Err("boot_id");
000165 |     }
000166 |     let utc_secs = std::time::SystemTime::now()
000167 |         .duration_since(std::time::UNIX_EPOCH)
000168 |         .map_err(|_| "utc_before_epoch")?
000169 |         .as_secs()
000170 |         .try_into()
000171 |         .map_err(|_| "utc_overflow")?;
000172 |     Ok(ClockSample {
000173 |         utc_secs,
000174 |         continuous_ms: continuous_ms
000175 |             .try_into()
000176 |             .map_err(|_| "continuous_overflow")?,
000177 |         boot_id,
000178 |     })
000179 | }

000181 | #[cfg(not(target_os = "macos"))]
000182 | pub fn sample() -> Result<ClockSample, &'static str> {
000183 |     Err("unsupported_continuous_clock")
000184 | }

000001 | //! Independent, hourly reconciliation of an administrator-authorized timezone.
000002 | use std::{
000003 |     path::{Path, PathBuf},
000004 |     time::{Duration, Instant},
000005 | };
000006 | 
000007 | const INTERVAL: Duration = Duration::from_secs(3600);
000008 | const RETRY_INTERVAL: Duration = Duration::from_secs(5);
000009 | 
000010 | /// The blocking XPC call has exactly one slot. A late call never creates a second writer.
000011 | #[derive(Default)]
000012 | struct Scheduler {
000013 |     flight: Option<tokio::task::JoinHandle<Result<(), &'static str>>>,
000014 |     next_attempt: Option<Instant>,
000015 | }
000016 | 
000017 | impl Scheduler {
000018 |     async fn tick_at<F>(&mut self, now: Instant, operation: F)
000019 |     where
000020 |         F: FnOnce() -> Result<(), &'static str> + Send + 'static,
000021 |     {
000022 |         if self
000023 |             .flight
000024 |             .as_ref()
000025 |             .is_some_and(|flight| !flight.is_finished())
000026 |         {
000027 |             return;
000028 |         }
000029 |         if let Some(flight) = self.flight.take() {
000030 |             let delay = match flight.await {
000031 |                 Ok(Err("timezone_guard_lifecycle_busy" | "timezone_guard_transaction_pending")) => {
000032 |                     RETRY_INTERVAL
000033 |                 }
000034 |                 _ => INTERVAL,
000035 |             };
000036 |             self.next_attempt = Some(now + delay);
000037 |         }
000038 |         if self.next_attempt.is_some_and(|next| now < next) {
000039 |             return;
000040 |         }
000041 |         self.flight = Some(tokio::task::spawn_blocking(operation));
000042 |     }
000043 | }
000044 | 
000045 | /// Read the configured target without waiting for unrelated lifecycle transactions.
000046 | fn reconcile_with<F>(v2: &Path, call: F) -> Result<(), &'static str>
000047 | where
000048 |     F: FnOnce(String) -> Result<(), &'static str>,

000050 |     crate::storage::validate_no_symlinks(v2).map_err(|_| "timezone_guard_configuration")?;

000052 |         std::fs::read(v2.join("config.json")).map_err(|_| "timezone_guard_policy_missing")?;
000053 |     let config: crate::config::CheckConfig =
000054 |         serde_json::from_slice(&bytes).map_err(|_| "timezone_guard_policy_invalid")?;
000055 |     let expected = config
000056 |         .timezone_target
000057 |         .filter(|zone| crate::config::valid_timezone(zone))
000058 |         .ok_or("timezone_guard_policy_missing")?;

000060 | }

000116 |         }

000131 | pub fn authenticate_candidate(
000132 |     wire: &[u8],
000133 |     key: &VerifyingKey,
000134 |     context: &PinnedContext<'_>,
000135 |     sequence: &Sequence,
000136 |     now: u64,
000137 |     time_trusted: bool,
000138 | ) -> Result<Candidate, &'static str> {
000139 |     if !time_trusted {
000140 |         return Err("clock_recovery_required");
000141 |     }
000142 |     let (metadata, payload_hash): (Metadata, _) = signed::verify(wire, key, METADATA_LIMIT)?;
000143 |     if metadata.schema_version != 1 {
000144 |         return Err("schema_version");
000145 |     }
000146 |     if metadata.edition != context.edition
000147 |         || metadata.channel != context.channel
000148 |         || metadata.platform != "macos"
000149 |         || metadata.architecture != context.architecture
000150 |         || metadata.key_id != context.key_id
000151 |     {
000152 |         return Err("release_context");
000153 |     }
000154 |     if !valid_token(&metadata.key_id)
000155 |         || !valid_token(&metadata.release_id)
000156 |         || !valid_token(&metadata.channel)
000157 |         || !matches!(metadata.architecture.as_str(), "aarch64" | "x86_64")
000158 |     {
000159 |         return Err("release_identifier");
000160 |     }
000161 |     if metadata.issued_at > now
000162 |         || metadata.expires_at <= now
000163 |         || metadata.expires_at <= metadata.issued_at
000164 |     {
000165 |         return Err("metadata_expired");
000166 |     }
000167 |     if metadata.version.cmp_precedence(context.installed_app) != Ordering::Greater {
000168 |         return Err("downgrade_or_same_version");
000169 |     }
000170 |     if metadata.app.version != metadata.version {
000171 |         return Err("app_version_mismatch");
000172 |     }
000173 |     validate_artifact(&metadata.app, ArtifactKind::App, context)?;
000174 |     let final_helper = match &metadata.helper {
000175 |         Some(helper) => {
000176 |             validate_artifact(helper, ArtifactKind::Helper, context)?;
000177 |             if context
000178 |                 .installed_helper
000179 |                 .is_some_and(|v| helper.version.cmp_precedence(v) == Ordering::Less)
000180 |             {
000181 |                 return Err("helper_downgrade");
000182 |             }
000183 |             if !helper.compatible_with.matches(&metadata.version) {
000184 |                 return Err("helper_app_incompatible");
000185 |             }
000186 |             &helper.version
000187 |         }
000188 |         None => context.installed_helper.ok_or("helper_missing")?,
000189 |     };
000190 |     if !metadata.app.compatible_with.matches(final_helper) {
000191 |         return Err("app_helper_incompatible");
000192 |     }
000193 |     // Both the final pair and the intermediate pair must be compatible.
000194 |     let install_order = match &metadata.helper {
000195 |         None => InstallOrder::AppOnly,
000196 |         Some(helper) if helper.compatible_with.matches(context.installed_app) => {
000197 |             InstallOrder::HelperThenApp
000198 |         }
000199 |         Some(_)
000200 |             if context
000201 |                 .installed_helper
000202 |                 .is_some_and(|v| metadata.app.compatible_with.matches(v)) =>
000203 |         {
000204 |             InstallOrder::AppThenHelper
000205 |         }
000206 |         Some(_) => return Err("compatible_bridge_required"),
000207 |     };
000208 |     sequence.check(metadata.sequence, &payload_hash)?;
000209 |     Ok(Candidate {
000210 |         metadata,
000211 |         payload_hash,
000212 |         wire: wire.to_vec(),
000213 |         install_order,
000214 |     })
000215 | }
000216 | 
000217 | fn valid_token(value: &str) -> bool {
000218 |     !value.is_empty()
000219 |         && value.len() <= 64
000220 |         && value
000221 |             .bytes()
000222 |             .all(|b| b.is_ascii_alphanumeric() || b"._-".contains(&b))
000223 | }
000224 | 
000225 | fn is_hash(value: &str) -> bool {
000226 |     value.len() == 64
000227 |         && value
000228 |             .bytes()
000229 |             .all(|b| b.is_ascii_digit() || (b'a'..=b'f').contains(&b))
000230 | }

000232 | fn validate_artifact(
000233 |     artifact: &Artifact,
000234 |     kind: ArtifactKind,
000235 |     context: &PinnedContext<'_>,
000236 | ) -> Result<(), &'static str> {
000237 |     if artifact.size == 0 || artifact.size > MAX_ARTIFACT_SIZE || !is_hash(&artifact.sha256) {
000238 |         return Err("artifact_bounds");
000239 |     }
000240 |     let bundle = match kind {
000241 |         ArtifactKind::App => context.app_bundle_id,
000242 |         ArtifactKind::Helper => context.helper_bundle_id,
000243 |     };
000244 |     if artifact.bundle_id != bundle || artifact.team_id != context.team_id {
000245 |         return Err("artifact_identity");
000246 |     }
000247 |     if !valid_bundle(&artifact.bundle_id) || !valid_team(&artifact.team_id) {
000248 |         return Err("artifact_identity");
000249 |     }
000250 |     let origin = Url::parse(context.artifact_origin).map_err(|_| "pinned_origin")?;
000251 |     let url = Url::parse(&artifact.url).map_err(|_| "artifact_url")?;
000252 |     if origin.scheme() != "https"
000253 |         || origin.host_str().is_none()
000254 |         || origin.username() != ""
000255 |         || origin.password().is_some()
000256 |         || origin.query().is_some()
000257 |         || origin.fragment().is_some()
000258 |         || origin.port_or_known_default() != Some(443)
000259 |         || url.scheme() != "https"
000260 |         || url.origin() != origin.origin()
000261 |         || url.username() != ""
000262 |         || url.password().is_some()
000263 |         || url.query().is_some()
000264 |         || url.fragment().is_some()
000265 |         || url.port_or_known_default() != Some(443)
000266 |         || !context.artifact_prefix.starts_with('/')
000267 |         || !context.artifact_prefix.ends_with('/')
000268 |         || !url.path().starts_with(context.artifact_prefix)
000269 |         || url.path().contains('%')
000270 |     {
000271 |         return Err("artifact_source");
000272 |     }
000273 |     if artifact.minisign_signature.len() > 4096
000274 |         || minisign_verify::Signature::decode(&artifact.minisign_signature).is_err()
000275 |     {
000276 |         return Err("minisign_shape");
000277 |     }
000278 |     Ok(())
000279 | }
000280 | 
000281 | fn valid_team(value: &str) -> bool {
000282 |     value.len() == 10
000283 |         && value
000284 |             .bytes()
000285 |             .all(|b| b.is_ascii_uppercase() || b.is_ascii_digit())
000286 | }
000287 | fn valid_bundle(value: &str) -> bool {
000288 |     value.len() <= 255 && value.contains('.') && value.split('.').all(valid_token)
000289 | }

000291 | /// The fields are private: callers cannot turn booleans into an authenticated artifact.
000292 | #[derive(Debug)]
000293 | pub struct VerifiedDownload {
000294 |     candidate_hash: String,
000295 |     artifact_hash: String,
000296 |     kind: ArtifactKind,
000297 | }
000298 | 
000299 | impl VerifiedDownload {
000300 |     pub fn sha256(&self) -> &str {
000301 |         &self.artifact_hash
000302 |     }
000303 |     pub fn kind(&self) -> ArtifactKind {
000304 |         self.kind
000305 |     }
000306 | }
000307 | 
000308 | pub fn verify_download(
000309 |     candidate: &Candidate,
000310 |     kind: ArtifactKind,
000311 |     bytes: &[u8],
000312 |     public_key_text: &str,
000313 | ) -> Result<VerifiedDownload, &'static str> {
000314 |     let artifact = candidate.artifact(kind)?;
000315 |     if bytes.len() as u64 != artifact.size {
000316 |         return Err("artifact_size");
000317 |     }
000318 |     if signed::digest(bytes) != artifact.sha256 {
000319 |         return Err("artifact_sha256");
000320 |     }
000321 |     let key = minisign_verify::PublicKey::decode(public_key_text).map_err(|_| "minisign_key")?;
000322 |     let signature = minisign_verify::Signature::decode(&artifact.minisign_signature)
000323 |         .map_err(|_| "minisign_shape")?;
000324 |     key.verify(bytes, &signature, false)
000325 |         .map_err(|_| "minisign_signature")?;
000326 |     // Only read the trusted comment after the global signature has been checked.
000327 |     let versions: Vec<_> = signature
000328 |         .trusted_comment()
000329 |         .split('\t')
000330 |         .filter_map(|field| field.strip_prefix("version:"))
000331 |         .collect();
000332 |     if versions.len() != 1
000333 |         || Version::parse(versions[0].trim_start_matches('v'))
000334 |             .ok()
000335 |             .as_ref()
000336 |             != Some(&artifact.version)
000337 |     {
000338 |         return Err("minisign_signed_version");
000339 |     }
000340 |     Ok(VerifiedDownload {
000341 |         candidate_hash: candidate.payload_hash.clone(),
000342 |         artifact_hash: artifact.sha256.clone(),
000343 |         kind,
000344 |     })
000345 | }

000355 | #[cfg(any(target_os = "macos", test))]
000356 | fn parse_app_cdhash(output: &[u8]) -> Result<String, &'static str> {
000357 |     let output = std::str::from_utf8(output).map_err(|_| "apple_app_cdhash")?;
000358 |     let mut hashes = output
000359 |         .lines()
000360 |         .filter_map(|line| line.strip_prefix("CDHash="));
000361 |     let hash = hashes.next().ok_or("apple_app_cdhash")?;
000362 |     if hashes.next().is_some() || hash.len() != 40 || !hash.bytes().all(|b| b.is_ascii_hexdigit()) {
000363 |         return Err("apple_app_cdhash");
000364 |     }
000365 |     Ok(hash.to_ascii_lowercase())
000366 | }

000369 | fn read_app_cdhash(path: &Path) -> Result<String, &'static str> {
000370 |     let output = std::process::Command::new("/usr/bin/codesign")
000371 |         .args(["--display", "--verbose=4"])
000372 |         .arg(path)
000373 |         .env("LC_ALL", "C")
000374 |         .output()
000375 |         .map_err(|_| "apple_app_cdhash")?;
000376 |     if !output.status.success() {
000377 |         return Err("apple_app_cdhash");
000378 |     }
000379 |     parse_app_cdhash(&output.stderr)
000380 | }
