000443 |             self.check_user_path(&path)?;
000444 |             let (before, bytes) = snapshot(&path, self.owner)?;
000445 |             let language_ok = kind == Kind::Language && {
000446 |                 let (_, global) = snapshot(&self.path(Kind::Locale), self.owner)?;
000447 |                 preferences::language_acceptable(bytes.as_deref(), global.as_deref())
000448 |                     .unwrap_or(false)
000449 |             };
000450 |             match preferences::propose(bytes.as_deref(), kind, value) {
000451 |                 Ok((original, proposed, changed)) => {
000452 |                     let changed = changed && !language_ok;
000453 |                     items.push(item(
000454 |                         kind,
000455 |                         if changed {
000456 |                             UserRepairState::Ready
000457 |                         } else {
000458 |                             UserRepairState::Unchanged
000459 |                         },
000460 |                         &original,
000461 |                         value,
000462 |                         "原生偏好同步后读取同一键验证；保留完整原文件备份",
000463 |                     ));
000464 |                     if changed {
000465 |                         changes.push(Change {
000466 |                             kind,
000467 |                             before,
000468 |                             backup_stamp: None,
000469 |                             group_source: None,
000470 |                             target_hash: crate::signed::digest(&proposed),
000471 |                             target: proposed,
000472 |                         });
000473 |                     }
000474 |                 }
000475 |                 Err(_) => items.push(item(
000476 |                     kind,
000477 |                     UserRepairState::Unsupported,
000478 |                     "无法安全解析",
000479 |                     value,
000480 |                     "偏好格式或类型不受支持；未生成写入计划",
000481 |                 )),
000482 |             }
000483 |         }
000484 |         if target.proxy == ProxyRepairMode::ClashVerge {
000485 |             // A missing adapter directory is unsupported; an unsafe existing path is an error.
000486 |             if self.path(Kind::Proxy).parent().is_some_and(|p| p.exists()) {
000487 |                 self.check_user_path(&self.path(Kind::Proxy))?;
000488 |             }
000489 |             match snapshot(&self.path(Kind::Proxy), self.owner) {
000490 |                 Ok((Some(before), Some(bytes))) => match proxy_proposal(&bytes) {
000491 |                     Ok((proposed, changed)) => {
000492 |                         items.push(item(
000493 |                             Kind::Proxy,
000494 |                             if changed {
000495 |                                 UserRepairState::Ready
000496 |                             } else {
000497 |                                 UserRepairState::Unchanged
000498 |                             },
000499 |                             if changed { "false" } else { "true" },
000500 |                             "true",
000501 |                             "仅保存TUN配置；不重启代理，不证明TUN已生效",
000502 |                         ));
000503 |                         if changed {
000504 |                             changes.push(Change {
000505 |                                 kind: Kind::Proxy,
000506 |                                 before: Some(before),
000507 |                                 backup_stamp: None,
000508 |                                 group_source: None,
000509 |                                 target_hash: crate::signed::digest(&proposed),
000510 |                                 target: proposed,
000511 |                             });
000512 |                         }
000513 |                     }
000514 |                     Err(_) => items.push(item(
000515 |                         Kind::Proxy,
000516 |                         UserRepairState::Unsupported,
000517 |                         "未确认",
000518 |                         "true",
000519 |                         "仅支持唯一顶层布尔enable_tun_mode；拒绝未知格式",
000520 |                     )),
000521 |                 },
000522 |                 Ok(_) => items.push(item(
000523 |                     Kind::Proxy,
000524 |                     UserRepairState::Unsupported,
000525 |                     "配置缺失",
000526 |                     "true",
000527 |                     "Clash Verge固定配置不存在",
000528 |                 )),
000529 |                 Err(error) if error.kind() == io::ErrorKind::NotFound => items.push(item(
000530 |                     Kind::Proxy,
000531 |                     UserRepairState::Unsupported,
000532 |                     "配置缺失",
000533 |                     "true",
000534 |                     "Clash Verge固定目录不存在",
000535 |                 )),
000536 |                 Err(error) => return Err(error),
000537 |             }
000538 |         } else {
000539 |             items.push(item(
000540 |                 Kind::Proxy,
000541 |                 UserRepairState::Unsupported,
000542 |                 "未确认",
000543 |                 "客户端人工配置",
000544 |                 "该代理模式没有已验证的安全写入适配器",
000545 |             ));
000546 |         }
000547 |         if rules_ok {
000548 |             items.push(item(
000549 |                 Kind::PinnedRoutes,
000550 |                 UserRepairState::Unchanged,
000551 |                 "旧版路由检查通过",
000552 |                 "Claude域名置顶规则",
000553 |                 "已有配置或行为路由通过，跳过改写与重启",
000554 |             ));
000555 |         } else {
000556 |             self.preview_pinned_routes(target.proxy, &mut items, &mut changes)?;
000557 |         }
000558 |         Ok(PreparedUserRepair {
000559 |             preview: UserRepairPreview {
000560 |                 can_execute: !recovery_pending && !changes.is_empty(),
000561 |                 items,
000562 |                 recovery_pending,
000563 |             },
000564 |             changes,
000565 |             home: self.home.clone(),
000566 |         })
000567 |     }
000568 |     fn preview_pinned_routes(
000569 |         &self,
000570 |         mode: ProxyRepairMode,
000571 |         items: &mut Vec<UserRepairItem>,
000572 |         changes: &mut Vec<Change>,
000573 |     ) -> io::Result<()> {
000574 |         let kind = Kind::PinnedRoutes;
000575 |         let unsupported = |message: &str| {
000576 |             item(
000577 |                 kind,
000578 |                 UserRepairState::Unsupported,
000579 |                 "未确认",
000580 |                 "Claude域名置顶规则",
000581 |                 message,
000582 |             )
000583 |         };
000584 |         if mode != ProxyRepairMode::ClashVerge {
000585 |             items.push(unsupported("该代理模式没有已验证的Merge.yaml写入适配器"));
000586 |             return Ok(());
000587 |         }
000588 |         let group_path = self.home.join(pinned_routes::GROUP_RELATIVE);
000589 |         self.check_user_path(&group_path)?;
000590 |         let (Some(group_source), Some(group_bytes)) = snapshot(&group_path, self.owner)? else {
000591 |             items.push(unsupported("Clash Verge代理组配置缺失"));
000592 |             return Ok(());
000593 |         };
000594 |         let group_result = legacy_proxy_group(&self.home)
000595 |             .map(Ok)
000596 |             .unwrap_or_else(|| pinned_routes::first_select_group(&group_bytes));
000597 |         let Ok(group) = group_result else {
000598 |             items.push(unsupported("代理组格式复杂或含歧义；未生成置顶规则计划"));
000599 |             return Ok(());
000600 |         };
000601 |         if String::from_utf8_lossy(&group_bytes)
000602 |             .contains(&format!("DOMAIN-SUFFIX,claude.ai,{group}"))
000603 |         {
000604 |             items.push(item(
000605 |                 kind,
000606 |                 UserRepairState::Unchanged,
000607 |                 "已有置顶配置",
000608 |                 "Claude域名置顶规则",
000609 |                 "旧版配置检查通过，跳过改写与重启",
000610 |             ));
000611 |             return Ok(());
000612 |         }
000613 |         let path = self.path(kind);
000614 |         self.check_user_path(&path)?;
000615 |         let (before, bytes) = snapshot(&path, self.owner)?;
000616 |         match pinned_routes::propose(bytes.as_deref(), &group) {
000617 |             Ok((proposed, changed)) => {
000618 |                 items.push(item(
000619 |                     kind,
000620 |                     if changed {
000621 |                         UserRepairState::Ready
000622 |                     } else {
000623 |                         UserRepairState::Unchanged
000624 |                     },
000625 |                     if before.is_some() {
000626 |                         "已有Merge.yaml"
000627 |                     } else {
000628 |                         "文件缺失"
000629 |                     },
000630 |                     "Claude域名置顶规则",
000631 |                     "仅保存Merge.yaml；代理重载及规则生效尚未验证",
000632 |                 ));
000633 |                 if changed {
000634 |                     changes.push(Change {
000635 |                         kind,
000636 |                         before,
000637 |                         backup_stamp: None,
000638 |                         group_source: Some(group_source),
000639 |                         target_hash: crate::signed::digest(&proposed),
000640 |                         target: proposed,
000641 |                     });
000642 |                 }
000643 |             }
000644 |             Err(_) => items.push(unsupported("Merge.yaml格式或标记不受支持；未生成写入计划")),
000645 |         }
000646 |         Ok(())
000647 |     }
000648 |     fn check_group_source(&self, change: &Change) -> io::Result<()> {
000649 |         if change.kind == Kind::PinnedRoutes {
000650 |             let path = self.home.join(pinned_routes::GROUP_RELATIVE);
000651 |             self.check_user_path(&path)?;
000652 |             if snapshot(&path, self.owner)?.0 != change.group_source {
000653 |                 return Err(fail("代理组配置已在预览后变化，请重新预览"));
000654 |             }
000655 |         }
000656 |         Ok(())
000657 |     }
000658 |     fn check_user_path(&self, path: &Path) -> io::Result<()> {
000659 |         let mut parent = path.parent().ok_or_else(|| fail("配置父目录缺失"))?;
000660 |         while !parent.exists() {
000661 |             parent = parent.parent().ok_or_else(|| fail("配置父目录缺失"))?;
000662 |         }
000663 |         check_directory(parent, self.owner)
000664 |     }
000665 |     fn check_lock(&self, lock: &LifecycleLock) -> io::Result<()> {
000666 |         check_directory(&self.home, self.owner)?;
000667 |         if self.owner != unsafe { libc::geteuid() } || !lock.protects(&self.v2()) {
000668 |             return Err(fail("用户修复必须持有同一v2生命周期锁"));
000669 |         }
000670 |         Ok(())
000671 |     }
000672 |     pub fn execute_with_lock(
000673 |         &self,
000674 |         prepared: PreparedUserRepair,
000675 |         lock: &LifecycleLock,
000676 |     ) -> io::Result<UserRepairReceipt> {
000677 |         #[cfg(all(test, target_os = "macos"))]
000678 |         if let Some(prefs) = test_preferences(self) {
000679 |             return self.execute_inner(prepared, lock, &|| Ok(()), &prefs);
000680 |         }
000681 |         self.execute_inner(
000682 |             prepared,
000683 |             lock,
000684 |             &|| crate::accounts::ensure_claude_stopped(self.owner),
000685 |             &NativePreferences,
000686 |         )
000687 |     }
000688 |     fn execute_inner(
000689 |         &self,
000690 |         prepared: PreparedUserRepair,
000691 |         lock: &LifecycleLock,
000692 |         stopped: &dyn Fn() -> io::Result<()>,
000693 |         prefs: &dyn PreferenceWriter,
000694 |     ) -> io::Result<UserRepairReceipt> {
000695 |         self.check_lock(lock)?;
000696 |         stopped()?;
000697 |         if prepared.home != self.home
000698 |             || !prepared.preview.can_execute
000699 |             || self.journal().try_exists()?
000700 |         {
000701 |             return Err(fail("修复计划不可执行，或存在待恢复事务"));
000702 |         }
000703 |         for change in &prepared.changes {
000704 |             self.check_user_path(&self.path(change.kind))?;
000705 |             self.check_group_source(change)?;
000706 |             if snapshot(&self.path(change.kind), self.owner)?.0 != change.before {
000707 |                 return Err(fail("配置已在预览后变化，请重新预览"));
000708 |             }
000709 |         }
000710 |         storage::create_private_directory(&self.directory())?;
000711 |         let id = format!(
000712 |             "repair-{}-{}-{}",
000713 |             std::process::id(),
000714 |             next_id(),
000715 |             SystemTime::now()
000716 |                 .duration_since(UNIX_EPOCH)
000717 |                 .map_err(io::Error::other)?
000718 |                 .as_nanos()
000719 |         );
000720 |         let backup = self.directory().join(&id);
000721 |         storage::create_private_directory(&backup)?;
000722 |         let mut journal = Journal {
000723 |             schema: 1,
000724 |             id: id.clone(),
000725 |             changes: prepared.changes,
000726 |             attempted: 0,
000727 |             after: Vec::new(),
000728 |             committed: false,
000729 |             rolled_back: false,
000730 |         };
000731 |         // Full copies precede the first durable journal and the first user setting write.
000732 |         for (index, change) in journal.changes.iter_mut().enumerate() {
000733 |             storage::atomic_write(&backup.join(format!("target-{index}")), &change.target)?;
000734 |             if let Some(before) = &change.before {
000735 |                 let source = self.path(change.kind);
000736 |                 let saved = backup.join(format!("original-{index}"));
000737 |                 copy_file(&source, &saved)?;
000738 |                 let copied = snapshot(&saved, self.owner)?
000739 |                     .0
000740 |                     .ok_or_else(|| fail("备份缺失"))?;
000741 |                 let matches = same_contents(before, &copied)
000742 |                     || (!matches!(change.kind, Kind::Proxy | Kind::PinnedRoutes)
000743 |                         && copied_with_added_provenance(
000744 |                             before,
000745 |                             &copied,
000746 |                             &metadata_digest_without_provenance(&saved)?,
000747 |                         ));
000748 |                 if !matches
000749 |                     || snapshot(&saved, self.owner)?.0.as_ref() != Some(&copied)
000750 |                     || snapshot(&source, self.owner)?.0.as_ref() != Some(before)
000751 |                 {
000752 |                     return Err(fail("配置备份验证失败或源已变化"));
000753 |                 }
000754 |                 change.backup_stamp = Some(copied);
000755 |             }
000756 |         }
000757 |         storage::atomic_json(&self.journal(), &journal)?;
000758 |         let result = (|| {
000759 |             for index in 0..journal.changes.len() {
000760 |                 self.check_lock(lock)?;
000761 |                 stopped()?;
000762 |                 let change = &journal.changes[index];
000763 |                 self.check_group_source(change)?;
000764 |                 if snapshot(&self.path(change.kind), self.owner)?.0 != change.before {
000765 |                     return Err(fail("配置在执行前变化，请恢复后重新预览"));
000766 |                 }
000767 |                 journal.attempted = index + 1;
000768 |                 storage::atomic_json(&self.journal(), &journal)?;
000769 |                 let change = &journal.changes[index];
000770 |                 self.apply(change, prefs)?;
000771 |                 if let Some(before) = &change.before {
000772 |                     let path = self.path(change.kind);
000773 |                     let (_, bytes) = snapshot(&path, self.owner)?;
000774 |                     if !matches!(change.kind, Kind::Proxy | Kind::PinnedRoutes) {
000775 |                         replace_with_template(
000776 |                             &path,
000777 |                             bytes.as_deref().ok_or_else(|| fail("偏好同步后文件缺失"))?,
000778 |                             &backup.join(format!("original-{index}")),
000779 |                             self.owner,
000780 |                         )?;
000781 |                     }
000782 |                     let after = snapshot(&path, self.owner)?
000783 |                         .0
000784 |                         .ok_or_else(|| fail("写入后配置缺失"))?;
000785 |                     if before.mode != after.mode
000786 |                         || before.uid != after.uid
000787 |                         || before.gid != after.gid
000788 |                         || change.backup_stamp.as_ref().unwrap_or(before).attributes
000789 |                             != after.attributes
000790 |                     {
000791 |                         return Err(fail("写入后配置元数据未保留"));
000792 |                     }
000793 |                 }
000794 |                 let (after, bytes) = snapshot(&self.path(change.kind), self.owner)?;
000795 |                 self.check_group_source(change)?;
000796 |                 if !matches_target(change, bytes.as_deref())? {
000797 |                     return Err(fail("写入后实际值无法确认；需要恢复"));
000798 |                 }
000799 |                 journal.after.push(after);
000800 |                 storage::atomic_json(&self.journal(), &journal)?;
000801 |             }
000802 |             Ok(())
000803 |         })();
000804 |         if let Err(error) = result {
000805 |             return match self.restore_inner(&journal, lock, stopped, prefs) {
000806 |                 Ok(()) => Err(io::Error::other(format!(
000807 |                     "用户配置修复失败，已恢复原值：{error}"
000808 |                 ))),
000809 |                 Err(_) => Err(fail(
000810 |                     "用户配置修复中断；恢复证据冲突，请保留事务并先执行恢复",
000811 |                 )),
000812 |             };
000813 |         }
000814 |         Ok(UserRepairReceipt { id })
000815 |     }
000816 |     fn apply(&self, change: &Change, prefs: &dyn PreferenceWriter) -> io::Result<()> {
000817 |         match change.kind {
000818 |             Kind::Proxy | Kind::PinnedRoutes if change.before.is_some() => {
000819 |                 replace_file(&self.path(change.kind), &change.target, self.owner)
000820 |             }
000821 |             Kind::PinnedRoutes => {
000822 |                 fs::create_dir_all(
000823 |                     self.path(change.kind)
000824 |                         .parent()
000825 |                         .ok_or_else(|| fail("配置父目录缺失"))?,
000826 |                 )?;
000827 |                 if snapshot(&self.path(change.kind), self.owner)?.0.is_some() {
000828 |                     return Err(fail("置顶规则文件在创建前出现"));
000829 |                 }
000830 |                 storage::atomic_write(&self.path(change.kind), &change.target)
000831 |             }
000832 |             kind => prefs.set(kind, &change.target),
000833 |         }
000834 |     }
000835 |     fn read_journal(&self) -> io::Result<Journal> {
000836 |         self.read_journal_at(&self.journal())
000837 |     }
000838 |     fn read_journal_at(&self, path: &Path) -> io::Result<Journal> {
000839 |         let mut journal: Journal = storage::read_json(path)?;
000840 |         if journal.schema != 1
000841 |             || journal.changes.len() > 4
000842 |             || journal.attempted > journal.changes.len()
000843 |             || journal.after.len() > journal.attempted
000844 |             || !valid_receipt_id(&journal.id)
000845 |             || (journal.committed && journal.rolled_back)
000846 |         {
000847 |             return Err(fail("用户修复恢复记录无效"));
000848 |         }
000849 |         let mut seen = Vec::new();
000850 |         for (index, change) in journal.changes.iter_mut().enumerate() {
000851 |             change.target = fs::read(
000852 |                 self.directory()
000853 |                     .join(&journal.id)
000854 |                     .join(format!("target-{index}")),
000855 |             )?;
000856 |             if crate::signed::digest(&change.target) != change.target_hash {
000857 |                 return Err(fail("用户修复目标备份校验失败"));
000858 |             }
000859 |             if seen.contains(&change.kind) {
000860 |                 return Err(fail("用户修复恢复记录含重复配置"));
000861 |             }
000862 |             seen.push(change.kind);
000863 |         }
000864 |         Ok(journal)
000865 |     }
000866 |     pub(crate) fn pending_receipt_with_lock(
000867 |         &self,
000868 |         lock: &LifecycleLock,
000869 |     ) -> io::Result<Option<UserRepairReceipt>> {
000870 |         self.check_lock(lock)?;
000871 |         if !self.journal().try_exists()? {
000872 |             return Ok(None);
000873 |         }
000874 |         Ok(Some(UserRepairReceipt {
000875 |             id: self.read_journal()?.id,
000876 |         }))
000877 |     }
000878 |     fn receipt_journal(&self, receipt: &UserRepairReceipt) -> io::Result<Journal> {
000879 |         if !valid_receipt_id(&receipt.id) {
000880 |             return Err(fail("用户修复收据标识无效"));
000881 |         }
000882 |         if self.journal().try_exists()? {
000883 |             let journal = self.read_journal()?;
000884 |             if journal.id == receipt.id {
000885 |                 return Ok(journal);
000886 |             }
000887 |         }
000888 |         let journal =
000889 |             self.read_journal_at(&self.directory().join(format!("{}.json", receipt.id)))?;
000890 |         if journal.id != receipt.id || (!journal.committed && !journal.rolled_back) {
000891 |             return Err(fail("用户修复归档收据无效"));
000892 |         }
000893 |         Ok(journal)
000894 |     }
000895 |     pub fn restore_with_lock(
000896 |         &self,
000897 |         receipt: &UserRepairReceipt,
000898 |         lock: &LifecycleLock,
000899 |     ) -> io::Result<()> {
000900 |         self.check_lock(lock)?;
000901 |         let journal = self.receipt_journal(receipt)?;
000902 |         #[cfg(all(test, target_os = "macos"))]
000903 |         if let Some(prefs) = test_preferences(self) {
000904 |             return self.restore_inner(&journal, lock, &|| Ok(()), &prefs);
000905 |         }
000906 |         self.restore_inner(
000907 |             &journal,
000908 |             lock,
000909 |             &|| crate::accounts::ensure_claude_stopped(self.owner),
000910 |             &NativePreferences,
000911 |         )
000912 |     }
000913 |     pub fn recover_with_lock(&self, lock: &LifecycleLock) -> io::Result<bool> {
000914 |         self.check_lock(lock)?;
000915 |         if !self.journal().try_exists()? {
000916 |             return Ok(false);
000917 |         }
000918 |         let journal = self.read_journal()?;
000919 |         if journal.committed || journal.rolled_back {
000920 |             self.finalize_record(&journal, lock)?;
000921 |             return Ok(true);
000922 |         }
000923 |         #[cfg(all(test, target_os = "macos"))]
000924 |         if let Some(prefs) = test_preferences(self) {
000925 |             self.restore_inner(&journal, lock, &|| Ok(()), &prefs)?;
000926 |             return Ok(true);
000927 |         }
000928 |         self.restore_inner(
000929 |             &journal,
000930 |             lock,
000931 |             &|| crate::accounts::ensure_claude_stopped(self.owner),
000932 |             &NativePreferences,
000933 |         )?;
000934 |         Ok(true)
000935 |     }
000936 |     pub fn commit_with_lock(
000937 |         &self,
000938 |         receipt: &UserRepairReceipt,
000939 |         lock: &LifecycleLock,
000940 |     ) -> io::Result<()> {
000941 |         #[cfg(all(test, target_os = "macos"))]
000942 |         if test_preferences(self).is_some() {
000943 |             return self.commit_inner(receipt, lock, &|| Ok(()));
000944 |         }
000945 |         self.commit_inner(receipt, lock, &|| {
000946 |             crate::accounts::ensure_claude_stopped(self.owner)
000947 |         })
000948 |     }
000949 |     /// Read-only receipt validation after an application restart. Does not commit or restore.
000950 |     pub(crate) fn verify_receipt_with_lock(
000951 |         &self,
000952 |         receipt: &UserRepairReceipt,
000953 |         lock: &LifecycleLock,
000954 |         restored: bool,
000955 |     ) -> io::Result<()> {
000956 |         self.check_lock(lock)?;
000957 |         let journal = self.receipt_journal(receipt)?;
000958 |         if restored != journal.rolled_back {
000959 |             return Err(fail("用户配置收据状态不一致"));
000960 |         }
000961 |         self.verify_images(&journal, restored)
000962 |     }
000963 |     fn verify_images(&self, journal: &Journal, restored: bool) -> io::Result<()> {
000964 |         if !restored && journal.after.len() != journal.changes.len() {
000965 |             return Err(fail("用户修复事务尚未完整验证"));
000966 |         }
000967 |         for (index, change) in journal.changes.iter().enumerate() {
000968 |             self.check_user_path(&self.path(change.kind))?;
000969 |             let current = snapshot(&self.path(change.kind), self.owner)?.0;
000970 |             if restored {
000971 |                 // Unattempted changes keep the exact original image. Restored
000972 |                 // copies can instead retain the exact recorded copy provenance.
000973 |                 let saved_image = match (&current, &change.before, &change.backup_stamp) {
000974 |                     (Some(current), Some(_), Some(saved)) => same_contents(current, saved),
000975 |                     _ => false,
000976 |                 };
000977 |                 if !original_image(&current, &change.before) && !saved_image {
000978 |                     return Err(fail("恢复后用户配置已改变"));
000979 |                 }
000980 |             } else {
000981 |                 self.check_group_source(change)?;
000982 |                 if current != journal.after[index] {
000983 |                     return Err(fail("用户配置在提交前变化，保留恢复事务"));
000984 |                 }
000985 |             }
000986 |         }
000987 |         Ok(())
000988 |     }
000989 |     fn commit_inner(
000990 |         &self,
000991 |         receipt: &UserRepairReceipt,
000992 |         lock: &LifecycleLock,
000993 |         stopped: &dyn Fn() -> io::Result<()>,
000994 |     ) -> io::Result<()> {
000995 |         self.check_lock(lock)?;
000996 |         let mut journal = self.receipt_journal(receipt)?;
000997 |         if receipt.id != journal.id || journal.after.len() != journal.changes.len() {
000998 |             return Err(fail("用户修复事务尚未完整验证"));
000999 |         }
001000 |         if journal.rolled_back {
001001 |             return Err(fail("用户修复已恢复，不能重新提交"));
001002 |         }
001003 |         self.verify_images(&journal, false)?;
001004 |         if journal.committed {
001005 |             return self.finalize_record(&journal, lock);
001006 |         }
001007 |         stopped()?;
001008 |         journal.committed = true;
001009 |         // This single atomic durable replacement is the commit decision.
001010 |         // A crash after this point may only finalize records, never roll user settings back.
001011 |         storage::atomic_json(&self.journal(), &journal)?;
001012 |         self.finalize_record(&journal, lock)
001013 |     }
001014 |     fn finalize_record(&self, journal: &Journal, lock: &LifecycleLock) -> io::Result<()> {
001015 |         self.check_lock(lock)?;
001016 |         if (!journal.committed && !journal.rolled_back)
001017 |             || (journal.committed && journal.after.len() != journal.changes.len())
001018 |         {
001019 |             return Err(fail("用户修复提交决议不完整"));
001020 |         }
001021 |         storage::atomic_json(
001022 |             &self.directory().join(format!("{}.json", journal.id)),
001023 |             journal,
001024 |         )?;
001025 |         if self.journal().try_exists()? && self.read_journal()?.id == journal.id {
001026 |             fs::remove_file(self.journal())?;
001027 |         }
001028 |         File::open(self.directory())?.sync_all()
001029 |     }
001030 |     fn restore_inner(
001031 |         &self,
001032 |         journal: &Journal,
001033 |         lock: &LifecycleLock,
001034 |         stopped: &dyn Fn() -> io::Result<()>,
001035 |         prefs: &dyn PreferenceWriter,
001036 |     ) -> io::Result<()> {
001037 |         self.check_lock(lock)?;
001038 |         if journal.rolled_back {
001039 |             return self.finalize_record(journal, lock);
001040 |         }
001041 |         stopped()?;
001042 |         if journal.committed {
001043 |             return Err(fail("用户修复已提交，不允许按未提交事务回滚"));
001044 |         }
001045 |         for change in &journal.changes {
001046 |             self.check_user_path(&self.path(change.kind))?;
001047 |         }
001048 |         let backup = self.directory().join(&journal.id);
001049 |         check_directory(&backup, self.owner)?;
001050 |         // Validate every source before restoring any source. Unknown changes are never overwritten.
001051 |         for (index, change) in journal.changes.iter().take(journal.attempted).enumerate() {
001052 |             let (current, bytes) = snapshot(&self.path(change.kind), self.owner)?;
001053 |             if original_image(&current, &change.before) {
001054 |                 continue;
001055 |             }
001056 |             if let Some(after) = journal.after.get(index) {
001057 |                 if &current != after {
001058 |                     let original = read_original(&backup, index, change, self.owner)?;
001059 |                     if matches!(change.kind, Kind::Proxy | Kind::PinnedRoutes)
001060 |                         || !preferences::same_key(
001061 |                             original.as_deref(),
001062 |                             bytes.as_deref(),
001063 |                             change.kind,
001064 |                         )?
001065 |                     {
001066 |                         return Err(fail("用户配置已被外部修改，拒绝覆盖恢复"));
001067 |                     }
001068 |                 }
001069 |             } else if !matches_target(change, bytes.as_deref())? {
001070 |                 let original = read_original(&backup, index, change, self.owner)?;
001071 |                 if matches!(change.kind, Kind::Proxy | Kind::PinnedRoutes)
001072 |                     || !preferences::same_key(original.as_deref(), bytes.as_deref(), change.kind)?
001073 |                 {
001074 |                     return Err(fail("中断配置无法与目标关联，拒绝猜测恢复"));
001075 |                 }
001076 |             }
001077 |             let original = read_original(&backup, index, change, self.owner)?;
001078 |             if !matches!(change.kind, Kind::Proxy | Kind::PinnedRoutes)
001079 |                 && !preferences::same_except_key(
001080 |                     original.as_deref(),
001081 |                     bytes.as_deref(),
001082 |                     change.kind,
001083 |                 )?
001084 |             {
001085 |                 return Err(fail("偏好文件含事务以外变化，拒绝覆盖恢复"));
001086 |             }
001087 |         }
001088 |         for (index, change) in journal
001089 |             .changes
001090 |             .iter()
001091 |             .take(journal.attempted)
001092 |             .enumerate()
001093 |             .rev()
001094 |         {
001095 |             stopped()?;
001096 |             self.check_lock(lock)?;
001097 |             if original_image(
001098 |                 &snapshot(&self.path(change.kind), self.owner)?.0,
001099 |                 &change.before,
001100 |             ) {
001101 |                 continue;
001102 |             }
001103 |             let original = read_original(&backup, index, change, self.owner)?;
001104 |             if !matches!(change.kind, Kind::Proxy | Kind::PinnedRoutes) {
001105 |                 prefs.restore(change.kind, original.as_deref())?;
001106 |             }
001107 |             let path = self.path(change.kind);
001108 |             match &change.before {
001109 |                 Some(before) => {
001110 |                     let before = change.backup_stamp.as_ref().unwrap_or(before);
001111 |                     let saved = backup.join(format!("original-{index}"));
001112 |                     let stage = stage_path(&path)?;
001113 |                     copy_file(&saved, &stage)?;
001114 |                     if !same_contents(
001115 |                         before,
001116 |                         &snapshot(&stage, self.owner)?
001117 |                             .0
001118 |                             .ok_or_else(|| fail("恢复暂存缺失"))?,
001119 |                     ) {
001120 |                         return Err(fail("恢复暂存元数据校验失败"));
001121 |                     }
001122 |                     fs::rename(&stage, &path)?;
001123 |                     File::open(path.parent().ok_or_else(|| fail("配置父目录缺失"))?)?.sync_all()?;
001124 |                     if !same_contents(
001125 |                         before,
001126 |                         &snapshot(&path, self.owner)?
001127 |                             .0
001128 |                             .ok_or_else(|| fail("恢复后配置缺失"))?,
001129 |                     ) {
001130 |                         return Err(fail("恢复后配置校验失败"));
001131 |                     }
001132 |                 }
001133 |                 None => {
001134 |                     if path.try_exists()? {
001135 |                         fs::remove_file(&path)?;
001136 |                         File::open(path.parent().ok_or_else(|| fail("配置父目录缺失"))?)?
001137 |                             .sync_all()?;
001138 |                     }
001139 |                 }
001140 |             }
001141 |         }
001142 |         let mut restored = journal.clone();
001143 |         restored.rolled_back = true;
001144 |         storage::atomic_json(&self.journal(), &restored)?;
001145 |         self.finalize_record(&restored, lock)
001146 |     }
001147 | }

001170 | fn original_image(current: &Option<Stamp>, before: &Option<Stamp>) -> bool {
001171 |     match (current, before) {
001172 |         (None, None) => true,
001173 |         (Some(a), Some(b)) => same_contents(a, b),
001174 |         _ => false,
001175 |     }
001176 | }
001177 | fn same_contents(a: &Stamp, b: &Stamp) -> bool {
001178 |     a.len == b.len
001179 |         && a.mode == b.mode
001180 |         && a.uid == b.uid
001181 |         && a.gid == b.gid
001182 |         && a.mtime == b.mtime
001183 |         && a.mtime_ns == b.mtime_ns
001184 |         && a.hash == b.hash
001185 |         && a.attributes == b.attributes
001186 | }
001187 | // Only an explicit cross-inode preference copy can add this system attribute.
001188 | // Comparing the filtered COPY against the FULL source digest also proves that
001189 | // the source had no provenance. Existing provenance must still match exactly.
001190 | fn copied_with_added_provenance(source: &Stamp, copy: &Stamp, filtered_copy: &str) -> bool {
001191 |     let mut normalized = copy.clone();
001192 |     normalized.attributes = filtered_copy.to_owned();
001193 |     (source.dev, source.ino) != (copy.dev, copy.ino)
001194 |         && source.attributes != copy.attributes
001195 |         && same_contents(source, &normalized)
001196 | }
001197 | fn check_directory(path: &Path, _owner: u32) -> io::Result<()> {
001198 |     if !fs::metadata(path)?.is_dir() {
001199 |         return Err(fail("配置父路径不是目录"));
001200 |     }
001201 |     Ok(())
001202 | }
001203 | fn snapshot(path: &Path, owner: u32) -> io::Result<(Option<Stamp>, Option<Vec<u8>>)> {
001204 |     let parent = path.parent().ok_or_else(|| fail("配置父目录缺失"))?;
001205 |     if parent.exists() {
001206 |         check_directory(parent, owner)?;
001207 |     }
001208 |     let file = match OpenOptions::new()
001209 |         .read(true)
001210 |         .custom_flags(libc::O_CLOEXEC | libc::O_NONBLOCK)
001211 |         .open(path)
001212 |     {
001213 |         Ok(file) => file,
001214 |         Err(error) if error.kind() == io::ErrorKind::NotFound => return Ok((None, None)),
001215 |         Err(error) => return Err(error),
001216 |     };
001217 |     let m = file.metadata()?;
001218 |     if !m.is_file() {
001219 |         return Err(fail("配置路径不是普通文件"));
001220 |     }
001221 |     let mut bytes = Vec::new();
001222 |     (&file).read_to_end(&mut bytes)?;
001223 |     let attributes = metadata_digest(path)?;
001224 |     let after = file.metadata()?;
001225 |     let named = fs::metadata(path)?;
001226 |     if (
001227 |         m.dev(),
001228 |         m.ino(),
001229 |         m.len(),
001230 |         m.mtime(),
001231 |         m.mtime_nsec(),
001232 |         m.ctime(),
001233 |         m.ctime_nsec(),
001234 |     ) != (
001235 |         after.dev(),
001236 |         after.ino(),
001237 |         after.len(),
001238 |         after.mtime(),
001239 |         after.mtime_nsec(),
001240 |         after.ctime(),
001241 |         after.ctime_nsec(),
001242 |     ) || (m.dev(), m.ino()) != (named.dev(), named.ino())
001243 |     {
001244 |         return Err(fail("配置在读取期间变化"));
001245 |     }
001246 |     Ok((
001247 |         Some(Stamp {
001248 |             dev: m.dev(),
001249 |             ino: m.ino(),
001250 |             len: m.len(),
001251 |             mode: m.mode() & 0o7777,
001252 |             uid: m.uid(),
001253 |             gid: m.gid(),
001254 |             mtime: m.mtime(),
001255 |             mtime_ns: m.mtime_nsec(),
001256 |             ctime: m.ctime(),
001257 |             ctime_ns: m.ctime_nsec(),
001258 |             hash: crate::signed::digest(&bytes),
001259 |             attributes,
001260 |         }),
001261 |         Some(bytes),
001262 |     ))
001263 | }
001264 | fn read_original(
001265 |     backup: &Path,
001266 |     index: usize,
001267 |     change: &Change,
001268 |     owner: u32,
001269 | ) -> io::Result<Option<Vec<u8>>> {
001270 |     match &change.before {
001271 |         None => Ok(None),
001272 |         Some(before) => {
001273 |             let (stamp, bytes) = snapshot(&backup.join(format!("original-{index}")), owner)?;
001274 |             if !stamp.as_ref().is_some_and(|value| {
001275 |                 same_contents(value, change.backup_stamp.as_ref().unwrap_or(before))
001276 |             }) {
001277 |                 return Err(fail("原配置备份损坏或元数据不匹配"));
001278 |             }
001279 |             Ok(bytes)
001280 |         }
001281 |     }
001282 | }
001283 | fn stage_path(path: &Path) -> io::Result<PathBuf> {
001284 |     let id = SystemTime::now()
001285 |         .duration_since(UNIX_EPOCH)
001286 |         .map_err(io::Error::other)?
001287 |         .as_nanos();
001288 |     let stage = path
001289 |         .parent()
001290 |         .ok_or_else(|| fail("配置父目录缺失"))?
001291 |         .join(format!(".claude-switcher-{}-{id}", std::process::id()));
001292 |     if stage.try_exists()? {
001293 |         return Err(fail("配置暂存路径冲突"));
001294 |     }
001295 |     Ok(stage)
001296 | }
001297 | fn copy_file(source: &Path, target: &Path) -> io::Result<()> {
001298 |     if target.try_exists()? {
001299 |         return Err(fail("备份目标已经存在"));
001300 |     }
001301 |     let result = Command::new("/usr/bin/ditto")
001302 |         .args(["--rsrc", "--extattr", "--acl"])
001303 |         .arg(source)
001304 |         .arg(target)
001305 |         .env_clear()
001306 |         .env("PATH", "/usr/bin:/bin")
001307 |         .env("LC_ALL", "C")
001308 |         .output()?;
001309 |     if !result.status.success() {
001310 |         return Err(fail("完整配置备份复制失败"));
001311 |     }
001312 |     File::open(target)?.sync_all()?;
001313 |     File::open(target.parent().ok_or_else(|| fail("备份父目录缺失"))?)?.sync_all()
001314 | }
001315 | fn replace_file(path: &Path, bytes: &[u8], owner: u32) -> io::Result<()> {
001316 |     replace_with_template(path, bytes, path, owner)
001317 | }
001318 | fn replace_with_template(path: &Path, bytes: &[u8], template: &Path, owner: u32) -> io::Result<()> {
001319 |     let before = snapshot(path, owner)?
001320 |         .0
001321 |         .ok_or_else(|| fail("原子替换源不存在"))?;
001322 |     let stage = stage_path(path)?;
001323 |     copy_file(template, &stage)?;
001324 |     let result = (|| {
001325 |         // Truncate only our private staged inode; ditto preserved its ACL/xattr/mode.
001326 |         let mut file = OpenOptions::new()
001327 |             .write(true)
001328 |             .truncate(true)
001329 |             .custom_flags(libc::O_NOFOLLOW | libc::O_CLOEXEC)
001330 |             .open(&stage)?;
001331 |         std::io::Write::write_all(&mut file, bytes)?;
001332 |         file.sync_all()?;
001333 |         if snapshot(path, owner)?.0.as_ref() != Some(&before) {
001334 |             return Err(fail("代理配置在原子替换前变化"));
001335 |         }
001336 |         fs::rename(&stage, path)?;
001337 |         File::open(path.parent().ok_or_else(|| fail("代理目录缺失"))?)?.sync_all()
001338 |     })();
001339 |     if stage.try_exists().unwrap_or(false) {
001340 |         let _ = fs::remove_file(stage);
001341 |     }
001342 |     result
001343 | }
001344 | fn proxy_proposal(bytes: &[u8]) -> io::Result<(Vec<u8>, bool)> {
001345 |     let text = std::str::from_utf8(bytes).map_err(|_| fail("代理配置不是UTF-8"))?;
001346 |     let mut changed = false;
001347 |     let output = text
001348 |         .split_inclusive('\n')
001349 |         .map(|line| {
001350 |             if let Some(rest) = line.strip_prefix("enable_tun_mode: false") {
001351 |                 changed = true;
001352 |                 format!("enable_tun_mode: true{rest}")
001353 |             } else {
001354 |                 line.to_owned()
001355 |             }
001356 |         })
001357 |         .collect::<String>();
001358 |     Ok((output.into_bytes(), changed))
001359 | }
001360 | fn matches_target(change: &Change, bytes: Option<&[u8]>) -> io::Result<bool> {
001361 |     match (change.kind, bytes) {
001362 |         (_, None) => Ok(false),
001363 |         (Kind::Proxy | Kind::PinnedRoutes, Some(bytes)) => Ok(bytes == change.target),
001364 |         (kind, Some(bytes)) => preferences::same_key(Some(bytes), Some(&change.target), kind),
001365 |     }
001366 | }
001367 | trait PreferenceWriter {
001368 |     fn set(&self, kind: Kind, target: &[u8]) -> io::Result<()>;
001369 |     fn restore(&self, kind: Kind, original: Option<&[u8]>) -> io::Result<()>;
001370 | }
001371 | struct NativePreferences;
001372 | impl PreferenceWriter for NativePreferences {
001373 |     fn set(&self, kind: Kind, target: &[u8]) -> io::Result<()> {
001374 |         preferences::validate_target(kind, target)?;
001375 |         preferences::write(kind, Some(target), true)
001376 |     }
001377 |     fn restore(&self, kind: Kind, original: Option<&[u8]>) -> io::Result<()> {
001378 |         preferences::write(kind, original, false)
001379 |     }
001380 | }

001382 | #[cfg(target_os = "macos")]
001383 | fn metadata_digest(path: &Path) -> io::Result<String> {
001384 |     metadata_digest_inner(path, false)
001385 | }
001386 | #[cfg(target_os = "macos")]
001387 | fn metadata_digest_without_provenance(path: &Path) -> io::Result<String> {
001388 |     metadata_digest_inner(path, true)
001389 | }
001390 | #[cfg(target_os = "macos")]
001391 | fn metadata_digest_inner(path: &Path, omit_provenance: bool) -> io::Result<String> {
001392 |     let path = CString::new(path.as_os_str().as_bytes()).map_err(|_| fail("配置路径无效"))?;
001393 |     let n =
001394 |         unsafe { libc::listxattr(path.as_ptr(), std::ptr::null_mut(), 0, libc::XATTR_NOFOLLOW) };
001395 |     if !(0..=16 * 1024 * 1024).contains(&n) {
001396 |         return Err(fail("配置扩展属性无法验证"));
001397 |     }
001398 |     let mut names = vec![0u8; n as usize];
001399 |     if n > 0
001400 |         && unsafe {
001401 |             libc::listxattr(
001402 |                 path.as_ptr(),
001403 |                 names.as_mut_ptr().cast(),
001404 |                 names.len(),
001405 |                 libc::XATTR_NOFOLLOW,
001406 |             )
001407 |         } != n
001408 |     {
001409 |         return Err(fail("配置扩展属性在读取期间变化"));
001410 |     }
001411 |     let mut attrs = std::collections::BTreeMap::new();
001412 |     let mut total = 0usize;
001413 |     for name in names.split(|b| *b == 0).filter(|name| !name.is_empty()) {
001414 |         let key = CString::new(name).map_err(|_| fail("扩展属性名称无效"))?;
001415 |         let len = unsafe {
001416 |             libc::getxattr(
001417 |                 path.as_ptr(),
001418 |                 key.as_ptr(),
001419 |                 std::ptr::null_mut(),
001420 |                 0,
001421 |                 0,
001422 |                 libc::XATTR_NOFOLLOW,
001423 |             )
001424 |         };
001425 |         if len < 0 || len as usize > 16 * 1024 * 1024 - total {
001426 |             return Err(fail("扩展属性过大或无法读取"));
001427 |         }
001428 |         total += len as usize;
001429 |         let mut value = vec![0; len as usize];
001430 |         if unsafe {
001431 |             libc::getxattr(
001432 |                 path.as_ptr(),
001433 |                 key.as_ptr(),
001434 |                 value.as_mut_ptr().cast(),
001435 |                 value.len(),
001436 |                 0,
001437 |                 libc::XATTR_NOFOLLOW,
001438 |             )
001439 |         } != len
001440 |         {
001441 |             return Err(fail("扩展属性读取不稳定"));
001442 |         }
001443 |         if !omit_provenance || name != b"com.apple.provenance" {
001444 |             attrs.insert(name.to_vec(), value);
001445 |         }
001446 |     }
001447 |     unsafe extern "C" {
001448 |         fn acl_get_link_np(path: *const c_char, kind: libc::c_int) -> *mut c_void;
001449 |         fn acl_free(object: *mut c_void) -> libc::c_int;
001450 |         fn acl_valid(acl: *mut c_void) -> libc::c_int;
001451 |         fn acl_get_entry(
001452 |             acl: *mut c_void,
001453 |             index: libc::c_int,
001454 |             entry: *mut *mut c_void,
001455 |         ) -> libc::c_int;
001456 |         fn acl_get_tag_type(entry: *mut c_void, tag: *mut libc::c_int) -> libc::c_int;
001457 |         fn acl_get_permset_mask_np(entry: *mut c_void, mask: *mut u64) -> libc::c_int;
001458 |         fn acl_to_text(acl: *mut c_void, length: *mut libc::ssize_t) -> *mut c_char;
001459 |     }
001460 |     let acl = unsafe { acl_get_link_np(path.as_ptr(), 0x100) };
001461 |     let mut acl_bytes = Vec::new();
001462 |     if acl.is_null() {
001463 |         if io::Error::last_os_error().raw_os_error() != Some(libc::ENOENT) {
001464 |             return Err(fail("配置ACL无法读取"));
001465 |         }
001466 |     } else {
001467 |         let result = (|| {
001468 |             if unsafe { acl_valid(acl) } != 0 {
001469 |                 return Err(fail("配置ACL无效"));
001470 |             }
001471 |             let mut index = 0;
001472 |             loop {
001473 |                 let mut entry = std::ptr::null_mut();
001474 |                 if unsafe { acl_get_entry(acl, index, &mut entry) } != 0 {
001475 |                     if io::Error::last_os_error().raw_os_error() == Some(libc::EINVAL) {
001476 |                         break;
001477 |                     }
001478 |                     return Err(fail("配置ACL条目无法验证"));
001479 |                 }
001480 |                 index = -1;
001481 |                 let mut tag = 0;
001482 |                 let mut mask = 0;
001483 |                 if unsafe { acl_get_tag_type(entry, &mut tag) } != 0
001484 |                     || unsafe { acl_get_permset_mask_np(entry, &mut mask) } != 0
001485 |                 {
001486 |                     return Err(fail("配置ACL权限无法验证"));
001487 |                 }
001488 |             }
001489 |             let mut len = 0;
001490 |             let text = unsafe { acl_to_text(acl, &mut len) };
001491 |             if text.is_null() || !(0..=65536).contains(&len) {
001492 |                 return Err(fail("配置ACL序列化失败"));
001493 |             }
001494 |             acl_bytes =
001495 |                 unsafe { std::slice::from_raw_parts(text.cast::<u8>(), len as usize) }.to_vec();
001496 |             unsafe {
001497 |                 acl_free(text.cast());
001498 |             }
001499 |             Ok(())
001500 |         })();
001501 |         unsafe {
001502 |             acl_free(acl);
001503 |         }
001504 |         result?;
001505 |     }
001506 |     let bytes = serde_json::to_vec(&(attrs.into_iter().collect::<Vec<_>>(), acl_bytes))
001507 |         .map_err(io::Error::other)?;
001508 |     Ok(crate::signed::digest(&bytes))
001509 | }

001577 |     struct Object(Cf);
001578 |     impl Drop for Object {
001579 |         fn drop(&mut self) {
001580 |             unsafe {
001581 |                 CFRelease(self.0);
001582 |             }
001583 |         }
001584 |     }
001585 |     fn object(value: Cf) -> io::Result<Object> {
001586 |         if value.is_null() {
001587 |             Err(fail("原生偏好对象创建失败"))
001588 |         } else {
001589 |             Ok(Object(value))
001590 |         }
001591 |     }
001592 |     fn string(value: &str) -> io::Result<Object> {
001593 |         let bytes = CString::new(value).map_err(|_| fail("偏好字符串无效"))?;
001594 |         object(unsafe {
001595 |             CFStringCreateWithCString(std::ptr::null_mut(), bytes.as_ptr(), 0x08000100)
001596 |         })
001597 |     }
001598 |     fn dictionary(bytes: Option<&[u8]>) -> io::Result<Object> {
001599 |         let value = if let Some(bytes) = bytes {
001600 |             let data = object(unsafe {
001601 |                 CFDataCreate(std::ptr::null_mut(), bytes.as_ptr(), bytes.len() as isize)
001602 |             })?;
001603 |             object(unsafe {
001604 |                 CFPropertyListCreateWithData(
001605 |                     std::ptr::null_mut(),
001606 |                     data.0,
001607 |                     0,
001608 |                     std::ptr::null_mut(),
001609 |                     std::ptr::null_mut(),
001610 |                 )
001611 |             })?
001612 |         } else {
001613 |             object(unsafe {
001614 |                 CFDictionaryCreateMutable(
001615 |                     std::ptr::null_mut(),
001616 |                     0,
001617 |                     std::ptr::null(),
001618 |                     std::ptr::null(),
001619 |                 )
001620 |             })?
001621 |         };
001622 |         if unsafe { CFGetTypeID(value.0) } != unsafe { CFDictionaryGetTypeID() } {
001623 |             return Err(fail("偏好根不是字典"));
001624 |         }
001625 |         Ok(value)
001626 |     }
001627 |     fn serialize(value: Cf) -> io::Result<Vec<u8>> {
001628 |         let data = object(unsafe {
001629 |             CFPropertyListCreateData(std::ptr::null_mut(), value, 200, 0, std::ptr::null_mut())
001630 |         })?;
001631 |         let len = unsafe { CFDataGetLength(data.0) };
001632 |         if len < 0 {
001633 |             return Err(fail("原生偏好序列化失败"));
001634 |         }
001635 |         Ok(unsafe { std::slice::from_raw_parts(CFDataGetBytePtr(data.0), len as usize) }.to_vec())
001636 |     }
001637 |     fn text(value: Cf) -> io::Result<String> {
001638 |         if value.is_null() || unsafe { CFGetTypeID(value) } != unsafe { CFStringGetTypeID() } {
001639 |             return Err(fail("偏好值不是字符串"));
001640 |         }
001641 |         let mut buffer = vec![0u8; 1024];
001642 |         if unsafe {
001643 |             CFStringGetCString(
001644 |                 value,
001645 |                 buffer.as_mut_ptr().cast(),
001646 |                 buffer.len() as isize,
001647 |                 0x08000100,
001648 |             )
001649 |         } == 0
001650 |         {
001651 |             return Err(fail("偏好字符串过长"));
001652 |         }
001653 |         Ok(unsafe { CStr::from_ptr(buffer.as_ptr().cast()) }
001654 |             .to_str()
001655 |             .map_err(|_| fail("偏好字符串不是UTF-8"))?
001656 |             .into())
001657 |     }
001658 |     fn describe(value: Cf, kind: Kind) -> io::Result<String> {
001659 |         if value.is_null() {
001660 |             return Ok("未设置".into());
001661 |         }
001662 |         match kind {
001663 |             Kind::Locale => {
001664 |                 let value = text(value)?;
001665 |                 if UserLocale::parse(&value).is_some() {
001666 |                     Ok(value)
001667 |                 } else {
001668 |                     Ok("其它地区格式".into())
001669 |                 }
001670 |             }
001671 |             Kind::Language => {
001672 |                 if unsafe { CFGetTypeID(value) } != unsafe { CFArrayGetTypeID() } {
001673 |                     return Err(fail("客户端语言不是数组"));
001674 |                 }
001675 |                 if unsafe { CFArrayGetCount(value) } == 0 {
001676 |                     return Ok("未设置".into());
001677 |                 }
001678 |                 let first = text(unsafe { CFArrayGetValueAtIndex(value, 0) })?;
001679 |                 // Never expose arbitrary application preference strings to UI or logs.
001680 |                 if matches!(
001681 |                     first.as_str(),
001682 |                     "en" | "en-US"
001683 |                         | "en-GB"
001684 |                         | "ja"
001685 |                         | "ja-JP"
001686 |                         | "zh"
001687 |                         | "zh-CN"
001688 |                         | "zh-TW"
001689 |                         | "zh-HK"
001690 |                         | "ko"
001691 |                         | "ko-KR"
001692 |                         | "de"
001693 |                         | "de-DE"
001694 |                         | "fr"
001695 |                         | "fr-FR"
001696 |                         | "es"
001697 |                         | "es-ES"
001698 |                         | "pt"
001699 |                         | "pt-BR"
001700 |                         | "it"
001701 |                         | "it-IT"
001702 |                         | "ru"
001703 |                         | "ru-RU"
001704 |                 ) {
001705 |                     Ok(first)
001706 |                 } else {
001707 |                     Ok("其它语言".into())
001708 |                 }
001709 |             }
001710 |             Kind::Proxy | Kind::PinnedRoutes => Err(fail("代理没有原生偏好键")),
001711 |         }
001712 |     }
001713 |     pub(super) fn language_acceptable(
001714 |         app: Option<&[u8]>,
001715 |         global: Option<&[u8]>,
001716 |     ) -> io::Result<bool> {
001717 |         let key = string("AppleLanguages")?;
001718 |         for (bytes, system) in [(app, false), (global, true)] {
001719 |             let dict = dictionary(bytes)?;
001720 |             let value = unsafe { CFDictionaryGetValue(dict.0, key.0) };
001721 |             if value.is_null() || unsafe { CFGetTypeID(value) } != unsafe { CFArrayGetTypeID() } {
001722 |                 continue;
001723 |             }
001724 |             let count = unsafe { CFArrayGetCount(value) };
001725 |             for index in 0..count {
001726 |                 let value = text(unsafe { CFArrayGetValueAtIndex(value, index) })?;
001727 |                 if (!system && value.contains("en-US"))
001728 |                     || (system && index == 0 && value.starts_with("en"))
001729 |                 {
001730 |                     return Ok(true);
001731 |                 }
001732 |             }
001733 |         }
001734 |         Ok(false)
001735 |     }
001736 |     pub(super) fn propose(
001737 |         bytes: Option<&[u8]>,
001738 |         kind: Kind,
001739 |         target: &str,
001740 |     ) -> io::Result<(String, Vec<u8>, bool)> {
001741 |         let original = dictionary(bytes)?;
001742 |         let key = string(kind.key())?;
001743 |         let current = unsafe { CFDictionaryGetValue(original.0, key.0) };
001744 |         let label = describe(current, kind)?;
001745 |         let value = string(target)?;
001746 |         let array = if kind == Kind::Language {
001747 |             Some(object(unsafe {
001748 |                 CFArrayCreate(std::ptr::null_mut(), &value.0, 1, std::ptr::null_mut())
001749 |             })?)
001750 |         } else {
001751 |             None
001752 |         };
001753 |         let desired = array.as_ref().map_or(value.0, |array| array.0);
001754 |         let changed = current.is_null() || unsafe { CFEqual(current, desired) } == 0;
001755 |         let mutable =
001756 |             object(unsafe { CFDictionaryCreateMutableCopy(std::ptr::null_mut(), 0, original.0) })?;
001757 |         unsafe {
001758 |             CFDictionarySetValue(mutable.0, key.0, desired);
001759 |         }
001760 |         Ok((label, serialize(mutable.0)?, changed))
001761 |     }
001762 |     pub(super) fn same_key(a: Option<&[u8]>, b: Option<&[u8]>, kind: Kind) -> io::Result<bool> {
001763 |         let a = dictionary(a)?;
001764 |         let b = dictionary(b)?;
001765 |         let key = string(kind.key())?;
001766 |         let av = unsafe { CFDictionaryGetValue(a.0, key.0) };
001767 |         let bv = unsafe { CFDictionaryGetValue(b.0, key.0) };
001768 |         Ok(if av.is_null() || bv.is_null() {
001769 |             av == bv
001770 |         } else {
001771 |             (unsafe { CFEqual(av, bv) }) != 0
001772 |         })
001773 |     }
001774 |     pub(super) fn same_except_key(
001775 |         a: Option<&[u8]>,
001776 |         b: Option<&[u8]>,
001777 |         kind: Kind,
001778 |     ) -> io::Result<bool> {
001779 |         let a = dictionary(a)?;
001780 |         let b = dictionary(b)?;
001781 |         let key = string(kind.key())?;
001782 |         let ac = object(unsafe { CFDictionaryCreateMutableCopy(std::ptr::null_mut(), 0, a.0) })?;
001783 |         let bc = object(unsafe { CFDictionaryCreateMutableCopy(std::ptr::null_mut(), 0, b.0) })?;
001784 |         unsafe {
001785 |             CFDictionaryRemoveValue(ac.0, key.0);
001786 |             CFDictionaryRemoveValue(bc.0, key.0);
001787 |         }
001788 |         Ok(unsafe { CFEqual(ac.0, bc.0) } != 0)
001789 |     }
001790 |     pub(super) fn validate_target(kind: Kind, bytes: &[u8]) -> io::Result<()> {
001791 |         let dictionary = dictionary(Some(bytes))?;
001792 |         let key = string(kind.key())?;
001793 |         let value = unsafe { CFDictionaryGetValue(dictionary.0, key.0) };
001794 |         let valid = match kind {
001795 |             Kind::Locale => UserLocale::parse(&text(value)?).is_some(),
001796 |             Kind::Language => {
001797 |                 !value.is_null()
001798 |                     && unsafe { CFGetTypeID(value) } == unsafe { CFArrayGetTypeID() }
001799 |                     && unsafe { CFArrayGetCount(value) } == 1
001800 |                     && text(unsafe { CFArrayGetValueAtIndex(value, 0) })? == "en-US"
001801 |             }
001802 |             Kind::Proxy | Kind::PinnedRoutes => false,
001803 |         };
001804 |         if !valid {
001805 |             return Err(fail("修复目标不在固定枚举内"));
001806 |         }
001807 |         Ok(())
001808 |     }
001809 |     pub(super) fn write(kind: Kind, bytes: Option<&[u8]>, effective: bool) -> io::Result<()> {
001810 |         let source = dictionary(bytes)?;
001811 |         let key = string(kind.key())?;
001812 |         let value = unsafe { CFDictionaryGetValue(source.0, key.0) };
001813 |         let app = string("com.anthropic.claudefordesktop")?;
001814 |         let application = if kind == Kind::Locale {
001815 |             unsafe { kCFPreferencesAnyApplication }
001816 |         } else {
001817 |             app.0
001818 |         };
001819 |         // Global API uses exact AnyApplication / CurrentUser / AnyHost scope.
001820 |         // Client language uses exactly the domain read by the existing 14 checks.
001821 |         if effective
001822 |             && kind == Kind::Language
001823 |             && unsafe { CFPreferencesAppValueIsForced(key.0, app.0) } != 0
001824 |         {
001825 |             return Err(fail("客户端语言受管理策略控制，无法自动修复"));
001826 |         }
001827 |         unsafe {
001828 |             CFPreferencesSetValue(
001829 |                 key.0,
001830 |                 value,
001831 |                 application,
001832 |                 kCFPreferencesCurrentUser,
001833 |                 kCFPreferencesAnyHost,
001834 |             );
001835 |         }
001836 |         if unsafe {
001837 |             CFPreferencesSynchronize(
001838 |                 application,
001839 |                 kCFPreferencesCurrentUser,
001840 |                 kCFPreferencesAnyHost,
001841 |             )
001842 |         } == 0
001843 |         {
001844 |             return Err(fail("原生偏好同步失败；实际值未确认"));
001845 |         }
001846 |         let actual = unsafe {
001847 |             if effective && kind == Kind::Language && !value.is_null() {
001848 |                 CFPreferencesCopyAppValue(key.0, app.0)
001849 |             } else {
001850 |                 CFPreferencesCopyValue(
001851 |                     key.0,
001852 |                     application,
001853 |                     kCFPreferencesCurrentUser,
001854 |                     kCFPreferencesAnyHost,
001855 |                 )
001856 |             }
001857 |         };
001858 |         let equal = if value.is_null() || actual.is_null() {
001859 |             value == actual
001860 |         } else {
001861 |             (unsafe { CFEqual(value, actual) }) != 0
001862 |         };
001863 |         if !actual.is_null() {
001864 |             unsafe {
001865 |                 CFRelease(actual);
001866 |             }
001867 |         }
001868 |         if !equal {
001869 |             return Err(fail("原生偏好实际值未达到目标，保持等待并恢复"));
001870 |         }
001871 |         Ok(())
001872 |     }
001873 | }

002021 |         fn set(&self, kind: Kind, target: &[u8]) -> io::Result<()> {
002022 |             self.writes.set(self.writes.get() + 1);
002023 |             if self.fail_at == Some(self.writes.get()) {
002024 |                 return Err(fail("合成写入中断"));
002025 |             }
002026 |             let path = self.home.join(kind.relative());
002027 |             if path.try_exists()? {
002028 |                 replace_file(&path, target, unsafe { libc::geteuid() })
002029 |             } else {
002030 |                 storage::atomic_write(&path, target)
002031 |             }
002032 |         }
002033 |         fn restore(&self, kind: Kind, original: Option<&[u8]>) -> io::Result<()> {
002034 |             let path = self.home.join(kind.relative());
002035 |             let bytes = original.map_or_else(|| plist(""), Vec::from);
002036 |             if path.try_exists()? {
002037 |                 replace_file(&path, &bytes, unsafe { libc::geteuid() })
002038 |             } else {
002039 |                 storage::atomic_write(&path, &bytes)
002040 |             }
002041 |         }
002042 |     }

000492 | fn assert_private_get(record: &serde_json::Value) {
000493 |     assert_eq!(record["method"], "GET");
000494 |     assert_eq!(record["body"], "");
000495 |     assert!(!record["path"].as_str().unwrap().contains('?'));

000499 |             [
000500 |                 "host",
000501 |                 "accept",
000502 |                 "accept-encoding",
000503 |                 "user-agent",
000504 |                 "connection"
000505 |             ]
000506 |             .contains(&name.to_ascii_lowercase().as_str()),
000507 |             "unexpected request header"
000508 |         );
000509 |     }
000510 |     assert_eq!(
000511 |         headers
000512 |             .iter()
000513 |             .find(|(key, _)| key.eq_ignore_ascii_case("user-agent"))
000514 |             .unwrap()
000515 |             .1,
000516 |         "ClaudeSwitcher/0.2"
000517 |     );
000518 |     let wire = serde_json::to_string(record).unwrap();

000524 | async fn redirect_controls(tls: bool) {
000525 |     let source = Capture::with_tls(tls);
000526 |     let sink = Capture::with_tls(tls);
000527 |     let client = if tls {
000528 |         source.client_trusting(Some(&sink))
000529 |     } else {
000530 |         network::client(None).unwrap()
000531 |     };
000532 |     // Both HTTPS ports use claude.ai. The source client trusts both fixture
000533 |     // certificates so a followed cross-origin redirect would reach the recorder.
000534 |     let scheme = if tls { "https" } else { "http" };
000535 |     let host = if tls { "claude.ai" } else { "127.0.0.1" };
000536 |     let origin = format!("{scheme}://{host}:{}", source.port);
000537 |     let other = format!("{scheme}://{host}:{}", sink.port);
000538 |     for status in [301, 302, 303, 307, 308] {
000539 |         for cross_origin in [false, true] {
000540 |             let destination = if cross_origin { &other } else { &origin };
000541 |             storage::atomic_json(&source.root.0.join("redirect.json"),
000542 |                 &serde_json::json!({"status":status,"location":format!("{destination}/sink?account={}", MARKERS[0])})).unwrap();
000543 |             let url = format!("{origin}/redirect/{status}/{}", u8::from(cross_origin));
000544 |             assert_eq!(
000545 |                 network::limited_get(&client, &url, 1024).await,
000546 |                 Err(TransportState::InvalidResponse)
000547 |             );
000548 |             if tls {
000549 |                 let probe = network::transport_probe(&client, "controlled_redirect", &url).await;
000550 |                 assert_eq!(probe.transport, TransportState::Reached);
000551 |                 assert_eq!(probe.access, AccessState::Redirected);
000552 |                 assert_eq!(probe.http_status, Some(status));
000553 |                 assert!(probe.tls_verified);
000554 |             }
000555 |         }
000556 |     }
000557 |     tokio::time::sleep(Duration::from_millis(150)).await;
000558 |     let first = captured_requests(&source);
000559 |     assert_eq!(first.len(), if tls { 20 } else { 10 });
000560 |     for record in &first {
000561 |         assert_private_get(record);
000562 |         assert!(record["path"].as_str().unwrap().starts_with("/redirect/"));
000563 |     }
000564 |     assert!(
000565 |         captured_requests(&sink).is_empty(),
000566 |         "redirect second hop received a request"
000567 |     );
000568 |     // Positive controls show that both same-origin and second-origin recorders
000569 |     // observe a request if the caller explicitly visits the advertised sink.
000570 |     assert_eq!(
000571 |         client
000572 |             .get(format!("{origin}/sink?account={}", MARKERS[0]))
000573 |             .send()
000574 |             .await
000575 |             .unwrap()
000576 |             .status()
000577 |             .as_u16(),
000578 |         if tls { 403 } else { 200 }
000579 |     );
000580 |     assert_eq!(
000581 |         client
000582 |             .get(format!("{other}/sink?account={}", MARKERS[0]))
000583 |             .send()
000584 |             .await
000585 |             .unwrap()
000586 |             .status()
000587 |             .as_u16(),
000588 |         if tls { 403 } else { 200 }
000589 |     );
000590 |     assert_eq!(captured_requests(&source).len(), first.len() + 1);
000591 |     let observed = captured_requests(&sink);
000592 |     assert_eq!(observed.len(), 1);
000593 |     assert!(observed[0]["path"].as_str().unwrap().contains(MARKERS[0]));
000594 | }
000595 | 
000596 | #[tokio::test]
000597 | async fn production_http_client_rejects_redirects_without_second_hop() {
000598 |     redirect_controls(false).await;
000599 | }
000600 | 
000601 | #[tokio::test]
000602 | async fn injected_tls_fixture_rejects_redirects_without_second_hop() {
000603 |     redirect_controls(true).await;

000244 | impl InstallRecord {
000245 |     pub fn app_bundle_id(&self) -> &'static str {
000246 |         match self.edition {
000247 |             Edition::Personal => "local.claudeswitcher.personal",
000248 |             Edition::Public => "local.claudeswitcher.public",
000249 |         }
000250 |     }
000251 |     pub fn bundle_id(&self, role: ClientRole) -> &str {
000252 |         match role {
000253 |             ClientRole::Gui => self.app_bundle_id(),
000254 |             ClientRole::Guardian => "local.claudeswitcher.guardian",
000255 |             ClientRole::Installer => "local.claudeswitcher.installer",
000256 |         }
000257 |     }
000258 |     pub fn validate(&self) -> Result<(), &'static str> {
000259 |         if self.schema_version != 2 || self.owner_uid == 0 {
000260 |             return Err("install_record");
000261 |         }
000262 |         match &self.trust {
000263 |             InstallTrust::DeveloperId { team_id } => {
000264 |                 if team_id.len() != 10
000265 |                     || !team_id
000266 |                         .bytes()
000267 |                         .all(|b| b.is_ascii_uppercase() || b.is_ascii_digit())
000268 |                 {
000269 |                     return Err("team_id");
000270 |                 }
000271 |             }
000272 |             InstallTrust::SourceLocal {
000273 |                 generation,
000274 |                 gui_cdhash,
000275 |                 guardian_cdhash,
000276 |                 helper_cdhash,
000277 |             } => {
000278 |                 if !lower_hex(generation, 32)
000279 |                     || [gui_cdhash, guardian_cdhash, helper_cdhash]
000280 |                         .iter()
000281 |                         .any(|v| !lower_hex(v, 40))
000282 |                 {
000283 |                     return Err("local_code_identity");
000284 |                 }
000285 |             }
000286 |         }
000287 |         for version in [&self.helper_version, &self.minimum_app_version] {
000288 |             if version.is_empty()
000289 |                 || version.len() > 48
000290 |                 || !version
000291 |                     .bytes()
000292 |                     .all(|b| b.is_ascii_alphanumeric() || b".-+".contains(&b))
000293 |             {
000294 |                 return Err("component_version");
000295 |             }
000296 |         }
000297 |         Ok(())
000298 |     }
000299 | 
000300 |     /// Branch selection only. Call `validate` before using an installation as authority.
000301 |     pub fn is_source_local(&self) -> bool {
000302 |         matches!(self.trust, InstallTrust::SourceLocal { .. })
000303 |     }
000304 | 
000305 |     pub fn developer_team(&self) -> Result<&str, &'static str> {
000306 |         self.validate()?;
000307 |         match &self.trust {
000308 |             InstallTrust::DeveloperId { team_id } => Ok(team_id),
000309 |             InstallTrust::SourceLocal { .. } => Err("source_local_rebuild_required"),
000310 |         }
000311 |     }
000312 | 
000313 |     pub fn client_requirement(&self, role: ClientRole) -> Result<String, &'static str> {
000314 |         self.validate()?;
000315 |         let pin = match (&self.trust, role) {
000316 |             (InstallTrust::SourceLocal { gui_cdhash, .. }, ClientRole::Gui) => {
000317 |                 Some(gui_cdhash.as_str())
000318 |             }
000319 |             (
000320 |                 InstallTrust::SourceLocal {
000321 |                     guardian_cdhash, ..
000322 |                 },
000323 |                 ClientRole::Guardian,
000324 |             ) => Some(guardian_cdhash.as_str()),
000325 |             (InstallTrust::SourceLocal { .. }, ClientRole::Installer) => {
000326 |                 return Err("local_installer_role_unavailable");
000327 |             }
000328 |             (InstallTrust::DeveloperId { .. }, _) => None,
000329 |         };
000330 |         self.requirement(self.bundle_id(role), pin)
000331 |     }
000332 | 
000333 |     pub fn helper_requirement(&self) -> Result<String, &'static str> {
000334 |         self.validate()?;
000335 |         let pin = match &self.trust {
000336 |             InstallTrust::SourceLocal { helper_cdhash, .. } => Some(helper_cdhash.as_str()),
000337 |             InstallTrust::DeveloperId { .. } => None,
000338 |         };
000339 |         self.requirement(HELPER_LABEL, pin)
000340 |     }
000341 | 
000342 |     fn requirement(&self, bundle: &str, pin: Option<&str>) -> Result<String, &'static str> {
000343 |         match (&self.trust, pin) {
000344 |             (InstallTrust::DeveloperId { team_id }, None) => Ok(format!(
000345 |                 "anchor apple generic and certificate leaf[subject.OU] = \"{team_id}\" and identifier \"{bundle}\""
000346 |             )),
000347 |             (InstallTrust::SourceLocal { .. }, Some(pin)) => {
000348 |                 Ok(format!("identifier \"{bundle}\" and cdhash H\"{pin}\""))
000349 |             }
000350 |             _ => Err("install_trust"),
000351 |         }
000352 |     }
000353 | }
000354 | 
000355 | fn lower_hex(value: &str, length: usize) -> bool {
000356 |     value.len() == length
000357 |         && value
000358 |             .bytes()
000359 |             .all(|b| b.is_ascii_digit() || (b'a'..=b'f').contains(&b))
000360 |         && value.bytes().any(|b| b != b'0')
000361 | }

000006 | case "$(uname -m)" in arm64) native_target=aarch64-apple-darwin;; x86_64) native_target=x86_64-apple-darwin;; *) exit 64;; esac
000007 | component_directory="$project_root/apps/desktop/src-tauri/components"

000013 | import json, pathlib, plistlib, sys
000014 | version = json.loads(pathlib.Path('apps/desktop/src-tauri/tauri.conf.json').read_text())['version']
000015 | for role in ['helper', 'guardian']:

000018 |         CFBundleShortVersionString=version, CFBundleVersion=version)))
000019 | PY
000020 | for component in helper guardian; do
000021 |   package=switcher-helper
000022 |   if [[ "$component" == guardian ]]; then package=switcher-core; fi
000023 |   cargo rustc --locked --release --target "$native_target" -p "$package" --bin "switcher-$component" -- \
000024 |     -C "link-arg=-Wl,-sectcreate,__TEXT,__info_plist,$stage/$component.plist"
000025 |   install -m 755 "$project_root/target/$native_target/release/switcher-$component" "$component_directory/switcher-$component"
000026 |   args=(--force --options runtime --sign "$signing_identity" --identifier "local.claudeswitcher.$component")
000027 |   if [[ "$signing_identity" != "-" ]]; then args+=(--timestamp); fi
000028 |   /usr/bin/codesign "${args[@]}" "$component_directory/switcher-$component"
000029 |   /usr/bin/codesign --verify --strict "$component_directory/switcher-$component"
000030 | done
000031 | 
000032 | # The compatibility entrypoint executes this Rust CLI from the installed App.
000033 | cargo build --locked --release --target "$native_target" -p switcher-core --bin claude-switcher

000016 | }
000017 | 
000018 | /// One pending UI confirmation. The request ID is not an authorization credential.
000019 | #[derive(Default)]
000020 | pub struct RepairPlanState {
000021 |     request_id: Option<String>,
000022 |     prepared: Option<regions::PreparedRepair>,
000023 | }
000024 | impl RepairPlanState {
000025 |     pub fn begin(&mut self, request_id: String) {
000026 |         self.request_id = Some(request_id);
000027 |         self.prepared = None;
000028 |     }
000029 |     pub fn matches(&self, request_id: &str) -> bool {
000030 |         self.request_id.as_deref() == Some(request_id)
000031 |     }
000032 |     pub fn cancel(&mut self, request_id: &str) {
000033 |         if self.matches(request_id) {
000034 |             *self = Self::default();
000035 |         }
000036 |     }
000037 |     pub fn complete(
000038 |         &mut self,
000039 |         request_id: &str,
000040 |         prepared: Option<regions::PreparedRepair>,
000041 |     ) -> bool {
000042 |         if !self.matches(request_id) {
000043 |             return false;
000044 |         }
000045 |         self.prepared = prepared;
000046 |         true
000047 |     }
000048 |     pub(crate) fn take(&mut self, request_id: &str) -> Option<regions::PreparedRepair> {
000049 |         if !self.matches(request_id) {
000050 |             return None;
000051 |         }
000052 |         self.request_id = None;
000053 |         self.prepared.take()
000054 |     }
000055 | }
000056 | 
000057 | pub fn completed(message: impl Into<String>) -> OperationOutcome {
000058 |     OperationOutcome {
000059 |         completed: true,
000060 |         message: message.into(),
000061 |         recovery: None,
000062 |     }
000063 | }
000064 | pub fn waiting(message: impl Into<String>, recovery: impl Into<String>) -> OperationOutcome {
000065 |     OperationOutcome {
000066 |         completed: false,
000067 |         message: message.into(),
000068 |         recovery: Some(recovery.into()),
000069 |     }
000070 | }
000071 |

000073 | pub fn account_action_failure(action: AccountAction, error: impl Into<String>) -> OperationOutcome {

000075 |         error,
000076 |         match action {
000077 |             AccountAction::Recover => "保留账号资料，核对 Claude 退出状态和中断记录后重试恢复",
000078 |             _ => "保留账号资料，按错误提示处理后重试",
000079 |         },
000080 |     )

000130 |     pub fn accounts(&self) -> Result<AccountOverview, String> {
