000579 | /// Project only fixed readiness blockers. Never expose Keychain metadata or selectors.
000580 | pub fn account_preparation_view(
000581 |     readiness: switcher_core::migration::MigrationReadiness,
000582 | ) -> AccountPreparation {
000583 |     use switcher_core::migration::DependencyAssessment;
000584 |     let mut blockers = preparation_blockers(readiness.blockers);
000585 |     if readiness.keychain.dependency_assessment != DependencyAssessment::HandlingPlanAvailable
000586 |         && !blockers
000587 |             .iter()
000588 |             .any(|item| item.code == "keychain_dependencies_unresolved")
000589 |     {
000590 |         blockers.push(PreparationBlocker {
000591 |             code: "keychain_dependencies_unresolved".into(),
000592 |             message: "当前 Claude 版本与 Keychain 依赖的处理方式尚未确定".into(),
000593 |             recovery: "核对当前 Claude 版本与 Keychain 依赖；处理方式确定后仍需实际登录验收。"
000594 |                 .into(),
000595 |         });
000596 |     }
000597 |     let backup_allowed = blockers.iter().all(|item| {
000598 |         matches!(
000599 |             item.code.as_str(),
000600 |             "backup_missing"
000601 |                 | "backup_stale_or_unverified"
000602 |                 | "backup_receipt_invalid"
000603 |                 | "backup_waits_installation"
000604 |                 | "keychain_dependencies_unresolved"
000605 |         )
000606 |     });
000607 |     AccountPreparation {
000608 |         ready: readiness.ready && blockers.is_empty(),
000609 |         backup_allowed,
000610 |         blockers,
000611 |         in_place_action: None,
000612 |         in_place_ready: false,
000613 |         in_place_blockers: Vec::new(),
000614 |     }
000615 | }
000616 | 
000617 | /// Derive the only applicable fixed action from inspected account state.
000618 | pub fn in_place_action_for_status(
000619 |     status: &switcher_core::accounts::AccountStatus,
000620 | ) -> Option<InPlaceAction> {
000621 |     if status.current.is_some() {
000622 |         None
000623 |     } else if status.a_saved {
000624 |         Some(InPlaceAction::AssociateA)
000625 |     } else {
000626 |         Some(InPlaceAction::InitializeA)
000627 |     }
000628 | }
000629 | 
000630 | /// Scoped readiness never changes the global directory-exchange gate.
000631 | pub fn with_in_place_preparation(
000632 |     mut view: AccountPreparation,
000633 |     action: Option<InPlaceAction>,
000634 |     scoped: Option<switcher_core::migration::MigrationReadiness>,
000635 | ) -> AccountPreparation {
000636 |     if let (Some(action), Some(scoped)) = (action, scoped) {
000637 |         view.in_place_blockers = preparation_blockers(scoped.blockers);
000638 |         view.in_place_ready = scoped.ready && view.in_place_blockers.is_empty();
000639 |         view.in_place_action = Some(action);
000640 |     }
000641 |     view
000642 | }
000643 | 
000644 | fn preparation_blockers(
000645 |     blockers: Vec<switcher_core::migration::MigrationBlocker>,
000646 | ) -> Vec<PreparationBlocker> {
000647 |     blockers
000648 |         .into_iter()
000649 |         .map(|item| {
000650 |             let recovery = match item.code.as_str() {
000651 |                 "installation_unverified" => {
000652 |                     "先完成正式系统组件安装与后台健康验证，再预览准备状态。"
000653 |                 }
000654 |                 "claude_running_or_unknown" => {
000655 |                     "完全退出 Claude；无法确认进程状态时先排查，再重试。"
000656 |                 }
000657 |                 "claude_application_unverified" => {
000658 |                     "核对官方 Claude 应用签名与版本；保留现有资料，不绕过应用核验。"
000659 |                 }

000689 | #[derive(Default)]
000690 | struct CheckSessionState {
000691 |     next: u64,
000692 |     active: Option<u64>,
000693 |     report: Option<CheckReport>,
000694 | }
000695 | #[derive(Default)]
000696 | struct CheckSessions(Mutex<CheckSessionState>);
000697 | struct CheckSession<'a> {
000698 |     sessions: &'a CheckSessions,
000699 |     epoch: u64,
000700 | }
000701 | impl CheckSessions {
000702 |     fn begin(&self) -> Result<CheckSession<'_>, String> {
000703 |         self.begin_initialized(|| {})
000704 |     }
000705 |     fn begin_initialized(&self, initialized: impl FnOnce()) -> Result<CheckSession<'_>, String> {
000706 |         let mut state = self.0.lock().map_err(|_| "检查状态不可用")?;
000707 |         if state.active.is_some() {
000708 |             return Err("环境检查正在进行".into());
000709 |         }
000710 |         state.next = state.next.checked_add(1).ok_or("检查代次已耗尽")?;
000711 |         let epoch = state.next;
000712 |         state.active = Some(epoch);
000713 |         state.report = None;
000714 |         initialized();
000715 |         Ok(CheckSession {
000716 |             sessions: self,
000717 |             epoch,
000718 |         })
000719 |     }
000720 |     fn report(&self) -> Result<Option<CheckReport>, String> {
000721 |         Ok(self.0.lock().map_err(|_| "检查状态不可用")?.report.clone())
000722 |     }
000723 |     fn replace(&self, report: Option<CheckReport>) -> Result<(), String> {
000724 |         let mut state = self.0.lock().map_err(|_| "检查状态不可用")?;
000725 |         state.active = None;
000726 |         state.report = report;
000727 |         Ok(())
000728 |     }
000729 |     fn cancel(&self) -> Result<bool, String> {
000730 |         let mut state = self.0.lock().map_err(|_| "检查状态不可用")?;
000731 |         let running = state.active.take().is_some();
000732 |         state.report = None;
000733 |         Ok(running)
000734 |     }
000735 | }
000736 | impl CheckSession<'_> {
000737 |     fn active(&self) -> bool {
000738 |         self.sessions
000739 |             .0
000740 |             .lock()
000741 |             .is_ok_and(|state| state.active == Some(self.epoch))
000742 |     }
000743 |     async fn wait_cancelled(&self) {
000744 |         while self.active() {
000745 |             tokio::time::sleep(std::time::Duration::from_millis(100)).await;
000746 |         }
000747 |     }
000748 |     fn publish(&self, report: CheckReport) -> Result<(), String> {
000749 |         let mut state = self.sessions.0.lock().map_err(|_| "检查状态不可用")?;
000750 |         if state.active != Some(self.epoch) {
000751 |             return Err("本次检查已取消或失效，未保存报告".into());
000752 |         }
000753 |         state.report = Some(report);
000754 |         Ok(())
000755 |     }
000756 | }
000757 | impl Drop for CheckSession<'_> {
000758 |     fn drop(&mut self) {
000759 |         if let Ok(mut state) = self.sessions.0.lock()
000760 |             && state.active == Some(self.epoch)
000761 |         {
000762 |             state.active = None;
000763 |         }
000764 |     }
000765 | }

000790 |     #[test]
000791 |     fn check_session_cancel_during_begin_initialization_cannot_be_overwritten() {
000792 |         let sessions = CheckSessions::default();
000793 |         let (ready_tx, ready_rx) = mpsc::channel();
000794 |         let (attempt_tx, attempt_rx) = mpsc::channel();
000795 |         let (done_tx, done_rx) = mpsc::channel();
000796 |         std::thread::scope(|scope| {
000797 |             let sessions = &sessions;
000798 |             scope.spawn(move || {
000799 |                 ready_rx.recv().unwrap();
000800 |                 attempt_tx.send(()).unwrap();
000801 |                 done_tx.send(sessions.cancel()).unwrap();
000802 |             });
000803 |             let session = sessions
000804 |                 .begin_initialized(|| {
000805 |                     ready_tx.send(()).unwrap();
000806 |                     attempt_rx.recv().unwrap();
000807 |                     // The cancel call is now contending with the actual begin lock.
000808 |                     assert!(matches!(done_rx.try_recv(), Err(mpsc::TryRecvError::Empty)));
000809 |                 })
000810 |                 .unwrap();
000811 |             assert!(done_rx.recv().unwrap().unwrap());
000812 |             assert!(!session.active());
000813 |             assert!(session.publish(report()).is_err());
000814 |             assert!(sessions.report().unwrap().is_none());
000815 |         });
000816 |     }
000817 |     #[test]
000818 |     fn check_session_simultaneously_ready_report_and_cancel_never_leave_a_report() {
000819 |         let sessions = CheckSessions::default();
000820 |         let session = sessions.begin().unwrap();
000821 |         let ready = Barrier::new(3);
000822 |         std::thread::scope(|scope| {
000823 |             let publish = scope.spawn(|| {
000824 |                 ready.wait();
000825 |                 session.publish(report())
000826 |             });
000827 |             let cancel = scope.spawn(|| {
000828 |                 ready.wait();
000829 |                 sessions.cancel()
000830 |             });
000831 |             ready.wait();
000832 |             let _ = publish.join().unwrap();
000833 |             assert!(cancel.join().unwrap().unwrap());
000834 |         });
000835 |         assert!(sessions.report().unwrap().is_none());
000836 |         assert!(!session.active());
000837 |         assert!(session.publish(report()).is_err());
000838 |     }
000839 |     #[test]
000840 |     fn check_session_late_cancel_clears_published_report_and_rejects_late_publish() {

000843 |         session.publish(report()).unwrap();
000844 |         assert!(sessions.report().unwrap().is_some());

000001 | //! A headless installation probe runs before Tauri, account storage or lifecycle initialization.
000002 | use switcher_domain::Edition;
000003 | 
000004 | fn parse(args: &[String]) -> Result<(&str, &str), &'static str> {
000005 |     if args.len() != 3 || args[0] != "--installation-health" {
000006 |         return Err("installation_health_arguments");
000007 |     }
000008 |     for (value, length) in [(&args[1], 32), (&args[2], 64)] {
000009 |         if value.len() != length
000010 |             || !value
000011 |                 .bytes()
000012 |                 .all(|b| b.is_ascii_digit() || (b'a'..=b'f').contains(&b))
000013 |         {
000014 |             return Err("installation_health_arguments");
000015 |         }
000016 |     }
000017 |     Ok((&args[1], &args[2]))
000018 | }
000019 | 
000020 | /// None leaves ordinary startup unchanged. Probe stdout is diagnostic only.
000021 | pub fn run(args: &[String], edition: Edition) -> Option<i32> {
000022 |     if args.first().map(String::as_str) != Some("--installation-health") {
000023 |         return None;
000024 |     }
000025 |     let parsed = parse(args);
000026 |     let bad_arguments = parsed.is_err();
000027 |     let result = parsed.and_then(|(generation, nonce)| {
000028 |         switcher_core::installation_health::gui_probe(edition, generation, nonce)
000029 |     });
000030 |     println!(
000031 |         "{}",
000032 |         serde_json::json!({
000033 |             "ok": result.is_ok(),
000034 |             "code": result.err().unwrap_or("installation_health_reported"),
000035 |             "diagnostic_only": true,
000036 |         })
000037 |     );
000038 |     Some(if bad_arguments {
000039 |         64
000040 |     } else if result.is_ok() {
000041 |         0
000042 |     } else {
000043 |         78
000044 |     })
000045 | }

000001 | # Personal 本机广告运营
000002 | 
000003 | 用户已选择先在本机运营。当前唯一实际适配器是 `LocalObjectStore`。
000004 | 它使用固定用户私有目录，不需要 R2、S3、云账号或网络凭据。
000005 | `protocol::ObjectStore` 保留一个发布接口，没有预建多云架构。
000006 | 
000007 | ## 操作
000008 | 
000009 | 1. 在 Personal 的「广告运营」编辑三个广告位。每位最多两期，UTC 排期不能重叠。
000010 | 2. 点击「生成广告签名密钥」。此明确操作把私钥存入 macOS Keychain；打开草稿不会生成密钥。
000011 | 3. 导入 PNG/JPEG，检查图片和链接，再发布到本机预览或本机正式。
000012 | 4. 本机预览保存到隔离预览目录。两个发行的普通广告区读取本机正式目录。
000013 | 5. 暂停或恢复历史后，再发布到本机正式。历史恢复生成更高序号，不回退旧清单。
000014 | 
000015 | 两个发行仍分别保存广告开关与商家确认。需要开启广告位并确认用途，才显示广告。
000016 | 本机正式发布不向其他设备或远程用户投放。远程上线仍是 WAIT。
000017 | 
000018 | ```text
000019 | Personal 草稿 ── Keychain 签名 ── 不可变版本/素材
000020 |                                     |
000021 |                            本机 current 原子 CAS
000022 |                                     |
000023 |                             签名与素材回读验证
000024 |                                     |
000025 |                    Personal / Public 各自验证后展示
000026 | ```
000027 | 
000028 | ## 固定目录与安全边界
000029 | 
000030 | - 草稿：`~/.claude-switcher/v2/personal/publisher`。
000031 | - 本机发布：`~/.claude-switcher/v2/local-ads/{preview,production}`。
000032 | - 公共验证材料：`local-ads/trust.json`，只含 schema、固定 key_id 和公钥。
000033 | - 客户端缓存：`v2/{personal,public}/ads`。Public 不创建或修改 `local-ads` 发布树。
000034 | - 私钥：Keychain。备份密码、私钥和凭据不进入命令参数、日志或普通配置文件。
000035 | 
000036 | 「公共验证材料」指同一用户的两个发行共享的公钥。发布文件仍是 0700 目录内的 0600 私有文件。
000037 | 目录、文件所有者、链接、权限和读取上限均接受校验；IPC 不接受源路径或任意 URL。
000038 | 素材与版本用同卷 `renamex_np(RENAME_EXCL)` 原子创建；既有内容不同则冲突。
000039 | `current.json` 用文件哈希作 ETag，在同一生命周期锁内比较并原子替换。
000040 | 任何提交写盘错误均视为结果未知；重试先回查同一个 release_id。
000041 | 签名清单、不可变版本与所有素材回读全部通过后，才记录成功历史。
000042 | 客户端不建立本机 HTTP 服务，不发送本机内容网络请求。
000043 | 客户端仍检查签名、channel/key_id、最高序号、UTC、素材哈希与静态图片限制。
000044 | 坏广告只收起广告并显示原因，不阻断账号工作台。
000045 | 
000046 | ## 加密备份与恢复
000047 | 
000048 | 备份采用 Argon2id 与 XChaCha20-Poly1305，包含草稿、历史、素材及 Keychain 私钥材料。
000049 | 备份文件本身加密；请保存密码并复制到安全位置。
000050 | 错误密码或不合格备份不会切换代际。恢复到未配置密钥的新草稿目录也可导入备份内的验证公钥。
000051 | 已有不同公钥时拒绝覆盖。恢复后，正式发布先回读本机正式最高序号，再补齐素材并续发。
000052 | 恢复旧备份不会降低本机已认证最高序号。
000053 | 
000054 | ## 验证与限制
000055 | 
000056 | 最新本地证据见 `docs/acceptance/evidence/e10/local-publisher-tests.log` 和 E09 的 `local-ad-runtime-tests.log`。
000057 | 测试使用真实临时文件存储及内存 Vault，不写真实 Keychain。
000058 | 测试覆盖 CAS、不可变对象、锁替换、硬链接/符号链接/宽权限拒绝、重启、两发行读取、暂停、历史、预览隔离和加密恢复。
000059 | 真实原生窗口、实际用户明确生成 Keychain 密钥后的发布，应另记现场证据。
000060 | 真实远程 HTTPS、云端权限、CDN 传播与连续 20min 在线验收仍 WAIT。
000061 | 未来只有用户明确要求远程投放后，才选择一个服务并核对其条件写、固定 HTTPS 源和授权材料。

000001 | //! Bounded password backup using Argon2id and XChaCha20-Poly1305.
000002 | use super::{Error, Result};
000003 | use argon2::{Algorithm, Argon2, Params, Version};
000004 | use chacha20poly1305::{
000005 |     XChaCha20Poly1305, XNonce,
000006 |     aead::{Aead, KeyInit, OsRng, Payload, rand_core::RngCore},
000007 | };
000008 | use zeroize::Zeroizing;
000009 | 
000010 | pub const LIMIT: usize = 64 * 1024 * 1024;
000011 | const HEADER: usize = 8 + 4 + 4 + 4 + 16 + 24;
000012 | const MAGIC: &[u8; 8] = b"CSADBK01";
000013 | const MEMORY_KIB: u32 = 64 * 1024;
000014 | const ITERATIONS: u32 = 3;
000015 | const LANES: u32 = 1;
000016 | 
000017 | fn key(passphrase: &[u8], salt: &[u8]) -> Result<Zeroizing<[u8; 32]>> {
000018 |     if passphrase.len() < 12 || passphrase.len() > 1024 {
000019 |         return Err(Error::Invalid("backup_passphrase_length"));
000020 |     }
000021 |     let params = Params::new(MEMORY_KIB, ITERATIONS, LANES, Some(32))
000022 |         .map_err(|_| Error::Invalid("backup_kdf"))?;
000023 |     let mut key = Zeroizing::new([0u8; 32]);
000024 |     Argon2::new(Algorithm::Argon2id, Version::V0x13, params)
000025 |         .hash_password_into(passphrase, salt, &mut *key)
000026 |         .map_err(|_| Error::Invalid("backup_kdf"))?;
000027 |     Ok(key)
000028 | }
000029 | 
000030 | pub fn seal(plaintext: &[u8], passphrase: &[u8]) -> Result<Vec<u8>> {
000031 |     if plaintext.len() > LIMIT - HEADER - 16 {
000032 |         return Err(Error::Invalid("backup_size"));
000033 |     }
000034 |     let mut salt = [0; 16];
000035 |     let mut nonce = [0; 24];
000036 |     OsRng.try_fill_bytes(&mut salt).map_err(|_| Error::Random)?;
000037 |     OsRng
000038 |         .try_fill_bytes(&mut nonce)
000039 |         .map_err(|_| Error::Random)?;
000040 |     let mut header = Vec::with_capacity(HEADER);
000041 |     header.extend_from_slice(MAGIC);
000042 |     for parameter in [MEMORY_KIB, ITERATIONS, LANES] {
000043 |         header.extend_from_slice(&parameter.to_be_bytes());
000044 |     }
000045 |     header.extend_from_slice(&salt);
000046 |     header.extend_from_slice(&nonce);
000047 |     let key = key(passphrase, &salt)?;
000048 |     let cipher = XChaCha20Poly1305::new((&*key).into());
000049 |     let ciphertext = cipher
000050 |         .encrypt(
000051 |             XNonce::from_slice(&nonce),
000052 |             Payload {
000053 |                 msg: plaintext,
000054 |                 aad: &header,
000055 |             },
000056 |         )
000057 |         .map_err(|_| Error::Invalid("backup_encrypt"))?;
000058 |     header.extend_from_slice(&ciphertext);
000059 |     Ok(header)
000060 | }
000061 | 
000062 | pub fn open(bytes: &[u8], passphrase: &[u8]) -> Result<Zeroizing<Vec<u8>>> {
000063 |     if bytes.len() < HEADER + 16 || bytes.len() > LIMIT || &bytes[..8] != MAGIC {
000064 |         return Err(Error::Invalid("backup_header"));
000065 |     }
000066 |     // Exact supported parameters prevent unauthenticated memory/CPU amplification.
000067 |     for (offset, expected) in [(8, MEMORY_KIB), (12, ITERATIONS), (16, LANES)] {
000068 |         if bytes[offset..offset + 4] != expected.to_be_bytes() {
000069 |             return Err(Error::Invalid("backup_kdf_parameters"));
000070 |         }
000071 |     }
000072 |     let key = key(passphrase, &bytes[20..36])?;
000073 |     let cipher = XChaCha20Poly1305::new((&*key).into());
000074 |     cipher
000075 |         .decrypt(
000076 |             XNonce::from_slice(&bytes[36..60]),
000077 |             Payload {
000078 |                 msg: &bytes[HEADER..],
000079 |                 aad: &bytes[..HEADER],
000080 |             },
000081 |         )
000082 |         .map(Zeroizing::new)
000083 |         .map_err(|_| Error::Invalid("backup_password_or_integrity"))
000084 | }

000105 |             return Err(StoreError::Permission);
000106 |         }

000112 |             })),
000113 |             Err(error) if error.kind() == io::ErrorKind::NotFound => Ok(None),
000114 |             Err(error) => Err(failure(error)),
000115 |         }
000116 |     }
000117 | }

000145 |                 storage::sync_directory(target.parent().ok_or(StoreError::Permission)?)
000146 |                     .map_err(failure)
000147 |             } else {
000148 |                 Err(StoreError::Conflict)
000149 |             };
000150 |         }
000151 |         let temporary = target.parent().ok_or(StoreError::Permission)?.join(format!(
000152 |             ".publish-{}",
000153 |             super::random_id().map_err(|_| StoreError::Unavailable)?
000154 |         ));
000155 |         storage::atomic_write(&temporary, bytes).map_err(failure)?;
000156 |         // Same-volume exclusive rename is atomic and never exposes an nlink=2 object.
000157 |         if !self.lock.protects(&self.root) {
000158 |             let _ = fs::remove_file(&temporary);
000159 |             return Err(StoreError::Permission);
000160 |         }
000161 |         let from =
000162 |             CString::new(temporary.as_os_str().as_bytes()).map_err(|_| StoreError::Permission)?;
000163 |         let to = CString::new(target.as_os_str().as_bytes()).map_err(|_| StoreError::Permission)?;
000164 |         // SAFETY: both NUL-terminated paths remain alive; RENAME_EXCL refuses any destination.
000165 |         let result = unsafe { libc::renamex_np(from.as_ptr(), to.as_ptr(), libc::RENAME_EXCL) };
000166 |         if result == 0 {
000167 |             return storage::sync_directory(target.parent().ok_or(StoreError::Permission)?)
000168 |                 .map_err(failure);
000169 |         }
000170 |         let error = io::Error::last_os_error();
000171 |         let _ = fs::remove_file(&temporary);
000172 |         if error.kind() == io::ErrorKind::AlreadyExists {
000173 |             match self.read(key, ads::MAX_IMAGE_BYTES)? {
000174 |                 Some(existing) if existing.bytes == bytes => {
000175 |                     storage::sync_directory(target.parent().ok_or(StoreError::Permission)?)
000176 |                         .map_err(failure)
000177 |                 }
000178 |                 _ => Err(StoreError::Conflict),
000179 |             }
000180 |         } else {
000181 |             Err(failure(error))
000182 |         }
000183 |     }
000184 |     fn commit_current(
000185 |         &mut self,
000186 |         expected_etag: Option<&str>,
000187 |         bytes: &[u8],
000188 |     ) -> std::result::Result<(), StoreError> {
000189 |         if bytes.len() > ads::MAX_MANIFEST_BYTES {
000190 |             return Err(StoreError::Permission);
000191 |         }
000192 |         let current = self.current()?;
000193 |         if current.as_ref().map(|o| o.etag.as_str()) != expected_etag {
000194 |             return Err(StoreError::Conflict);
000195 |         }
000196 |         let path = self.path(&protocol::current_key(self.channel))?;
000197 |         // An fsync error may follow the rename commit point. The caller must reconcile.
000198 |         storage::atomic_write(&path, bytes).map_err(|_| StoreError::OutcomeUnknown)
000199 |     }

000168 |     let bytes = serde_json::to_vec(value).map_err(|_| Error::Invalid("local_json"))?;

000174 | fn read_private(path: &Path, limit: usize) -> Result<Vec<u8>> {
000175 |     storage::validate_no_symlinks(path.parent().ok_or(Error::Invalid("local_path"))?)?;
000176 |     let file = OpenOptions::new()
000177 |         .read(true)
000178 |         .custom_flags(libc::O_NOFOLLOW | libc::O_NONBLOCK)
000179 |         .open(path)?;
000180 |     let metadata = file.metadata()?;
000181 |     if !metadata.is_file()
000182 |         || metadata.nlink() != 1
000183 |         || metadata.uid() != fs::metadata(path.parent().ok_or(Error::Invalid("local_path"))?)?.uid()
000184 |         || metadata.mode() & 0o077 != 0
000185 |         || metadata.len() > limit as u64
000186 |     {
000187 |         return Err(Error::Invalid("unsafe_local_file"));
000188 |     }
000189 |     let mut bytes = Vec::new();
000190 |     file.take(limit as u64 + 1).read_to_end(&mut bytes)?;
000191 |     if bytes.len() > limit {
000192 |         return Err(Error::Invalid("local_size"));
000193 |     }
000194 |     Ok(bytes)

000530 |     /// Call only for an explicit operator action. Opening drafts never generates a key.
000531 |     pub fn generate_signing_key(
000532 |         &mut self,
000533 |         vault: &mut dyn Vault,
000534 |         preview_credential: Vec<u8>,
000535 |         production_credential: Vec<u8>,
000536 |     ) -> Result<[u8; 32]> {
000537 |         if self.public_key.is_some() {
000538 |             return Err(Error::Invalid("signing_key_already_configured"));
000539 |         }

000541 |             signing_seed: vec![0; 32],
000542 |             preview_credential,
000543 |             production_credential,

000547 |             .map_err(|_| Error::Random)?;

000550 |     }

000553 |     }

000557 |     fn check_signer(&self, secrets: &Secrets) -> Result<SigningKey> {
000558 |         secrets.validate()?;
000559 |         let seed: &[u8; 32] = secrets
000560 |             .signing_seed
000561 |             .as_slice()
000562 |             .try_into()
000563 |             .map_err(|_| Error::Invalid("signing_seed"))?;
000564 |         let signer = SigningKey::from_bytes(seed);
000565 |         if self
000566 |             .public_key
000567 |             .is_some_and(|key| signer.verifying_key() != key)
000568 |         {
000569 |             return Err(Error::Invalid("signing_public_key_mismatch"));
000570 |         }
000571 |         Ok(signer)
000572 |     }

000574 |     pub fn publish(
000575 |         &mut self,
000576 |         channel: AdChannel,
000577 |         now: u64,
000578 |         source: Option<&mut dyn ObjectStore>,
000579 |         vault: &dyn Vault,
000580 |     ) -> Result<Publication> {
000581 |         let source = source.ok_or(Error::MissingSource)?;
000582 |         self.publish_with(source, vault, channel, now)
000583 |     }
000584 |     fn read_remote(
000585 |         &mut self,
000586 |         source: &mut dyn ObjectStore,
000587 |         now: u64,
000588 |     ) -> Result<Option<protocol::Object>> {
000589 |         let current = source.current()?;
000590 |         let channel = source.channel();
000591 |         let mut state = self.state.clone();
000592 |         if let Some(object) = &current {
000593 |             if object.etag.is_empty()
000594 |                 || object.etag.len() > 1024
000595 |                 || object.etag.chars().any(char::is_control)
000596 |             {
000597 |                 return Err(Error::Invalid("etag"));
000598 |             }
000599 |             let (manifest, hash): (AdManifest, String) = signed::verify(
000600 |                 &object.bytes,
000601 |                 self.verifying_key()?,
000602 |                 ads::MAX_MANIFEST_BYTES,
000603 |             )
000604 |             .map_err(Error::Invalid)?;
000605 |             // Expired current still authenticates its replay watermark, never display.
000606 |             ads::validate_manifest(&manifest, channel, &self.key_id, manifest.issued_at)
000607 |                 .map_err(Error::Invalid)?;
000608 |             if manifest.issued_at > now {
000609 |                 return Err(Error::Invalid("remote_clock"));
000610 |             }
000611 |             state.sequences[channel_index(channel)]
000612 |                 .remember(manifest.content_revision, hash)
000613 |                 .map_err(Error::Invalid)?;
000614 |         } else if state.sequences[channel_index(channel)].highest != 0 {
000615 |             return Err(Error::Invalid(
000616 |                 "remote_current_missing_after_authenticated_release",
000617 |             ));
000618 |         }
000619 |         if channel == AdChannel::Production {
000620 |             state.recovery_required = false;
000621 |         }
000622 |         self.persist(state)?;
000623 |         Ok(current)
000624 |     }
000625 |     // Production publishing performs this read through publish_with. The test
000626 |     // entry isolates recovery's watermark gate without publishing a new draft.
000627 |     #[cfg(test)]
000628 |     fn reconcile_production(&mut self, source: &mut dyn ObjectStore, now: u64) -> Result<()> {
000629 |         protocol::require_scope(source, AdChannel::Production)?;
000630 |         self.read_remote(source, now)?;
000631 |         Ok(())
000632 |     }
000633 |     pub fn publish_with(
000634 |         &mut self,
000635 |         source: &mut dyn ObjectStore,
000636 |         vault: &dyn Vault,
000637 |         channel: AdChannel,
000638 |         now: u64,
000639 |     ) -> Result<Publication> {
000640 |         protocol::require_scope(source, channel)?;
000641 |         self.verifying_key()?;
000642 |         self.validate_state(&self.state)?;
000643 |         if self.state.recovery_required && channel != AdChannel::Production {
000644 |             return Err(Error::RecoveryReadRequired);
000645 |         }
000646 |         if self.state.recovery_required {
000647 |             self.read_remote(source, now)?;
000648 |         }
000649 |         if self.state.pending.is_none() {
000650 |             if self.state.history.len() >= HISTORY_LIMIT {
000651 |                 return Err(Error::Invalid("history_capacity_no_history_pruned"));
000652 |             }
000653 |             let current = self.read_remote(source, now)?;
000654 |             if let Some(object) = &current {
000655 |                 let (manifest, _): (AdManifest, String) = signed::verify(
000656 |                     &object.bytes,
000657 |                     self.verifying_key()?,
000658 |                     ads::MAX_MANIFEST_BYTES,
000659 |                 )
000660 |                 .map_err(Error::Invalid)?;
000661 |                 if manifest.expires_at > now
000662 |                     && manifest == self.state.draft
000663 |                     && self
000664 |                         .state
000665 |                         .history
000666 |                         .iter()
000667 |                         .any(|record| record.manifest == manifest)
000668 |                 {
000669 |                     let mut state = self.state.clone();
000670 |                     state.pending = Some(Pending {
000671 |                         manifest,
000672 |                         wire: object.bytes.clone(),
000673 |                         expected_etag: Some(object.etag.clone()),
000674 |                         phase: Phase::ReadbackFailed,
000675 |                     });
000676 |                     self.persist(state)?;
000677 |                     return self.finish_readback(source, now);
000678 |                 }
000679 |             }
000680 |             let secrets = vault.load(&self.generation)?;
000681 |             let signer = self.check_signer(&secrets)?;
000682 |             let credential = if channel == AdChannel::Preview {
000683 |                 &secrets.preview_credential
000684 |             } else {
000685 |                 &secrets.production_credential
000686 |             };
000687 |             if source.requires_credentials() && credential.is_empty() {
000688 |                 return Err(Error::SecretUnavailable);
000689 |             }
000690 |             let mut manifest = self.draft_read();
000691 |             manifest.channel = channel;
000692 |             if self.state.history.iter().any(|record| {
000693 |                 record.manifest.release_id == manifest.release_id
000694 |                     && record.manifest.channel == channel
000695 |             }) {
000696 |                 manifest.release_id = random_id()?;
000697 |             }
000698 |             manifest.content_revision = manifest.content_revision.max(
000699 |                 self.state.sequences[channel_index(channel)]
000700 |                     .highest
000701 |                     .checked_add(1)
000702 |                     .ok_or(Error::Invalid("revision_overflow"))?,
000703 |             );
000704 |             manifest.issued_at = now;
000705 |             manifest.expires_at = now
000706 |                 .checked_add(ads::MAX_MANIFEST_LIFETIME)
000707 |                 .ok_or(Error::Invalid("draft_time"))?;
000708 |             ads::validate_manifest(&manifest, channel, &self.key_id, now)
000709 |                 .map_err(Error::Invalid)?;
000710 |             for campaign in manifest.slots.iter().flat_map(|slot| &slot.campaigns) {
000711 |                 self.image_bytes(&campaign.image)?;
000712 |             }
000713 |             let payload = String::from_utf8(encode(&manifest, ads::MAX_MANIFEST_BYTES)?)
000714 |                 .map_err(|_| Error::Invalid("manifest_utf8"))?;
000715 |             let signature = signer.sign(payload.as_bytes()).to_bytes().to_vec();
000716 |             let wire = encode(
000717 |                 &signed::Envelope { payload, signature },
000718 |                 ads::MAX_MANIFEST_BYTES,
000719 |             )?;
000720 |             let mut state = self.state.clone();
000721 |             state.pending = Some(Pending {
000722 |                 manifest,
000723 |                 wire,
000724 |                 expected_etag: current.map(|object| object.etag),
000725 |                 phase: Phase::Prepared,
000726 |             });
000727 |             self.persist(state)?;
000728 |         }
000729 |         let pending = self
000730 |             .state
000731 |             .pending
000732 |             .clone()
000733 |             .ok_or(Error::Invalid("pending_missing"))?;
000734 |         protocol::require_scope(source, pending.manifest.channel)?;
000735 |         if pending.manifest.channel != channel {
000736 |             return Err(Error::PendingOperation);
000737 |         }
000738 |         if pending.phase == Phase::Conflict {
000739 |             return Err(Error::Store(StoreError::Conflict));
000740 |         }
000741 |         let public_current =
000742 |             source.public_read(&protocol::current_key(channel), ads::MAX_MANIFEST_BYTES)?;
000743 |         if protocol::same_object(&public_current, &pending.wire) {
000744 |             return self.finish_readback(source, now);
000745 |         }
000746 |         if matches!(pending.phase, Phase::CommitUnknown | Phase::ReadbackFailed) {
000747 |             // Resolve the ambiguous authenticated commit before another write.
000748 |             let current = source.current()?;
000749 |             if protocol::same_object(&current, &pending.wire) {
000750 |                 return self.finish_readback(source, now);
000751 |             }
000752 |             if current.as_ref().map(|object| &object.etag) != pending.expected_etag.as_ref() {
000753 |                 self.set_phase(Phase::Conflict)?;
000754 |                 return Err(Error::Store(StoreError::Conflict));
000755 |             }
000756 |             let version = source.public_read(
000757 |                 &protocol::version_key(&pending.manifest),
000758 |                 ads::MAX_MANIFEST_BYTES,
000759 |             )?;
000760 |             if !protocol::same_object(&version, &pending.wire) {
000761 |                 return Err(Error::Store(StoreError::OutcomeUnknown));
000762 |             }
000763 |         }
000764 |         self.set_phase(Phase::Uploading)?;
000765 |         for campaign in pending
000766 |             .manifest
000767 |             .slots
000768 |             .iter()
000769 |             .flat_map(|slot| &slot.campaigns)
000770 |         {
000771 |             let bytes = self.image_bytes(&campaign.image)?;
000772 |             let key = protocol::asset_key(channel, &campaign.image);
000773 |             source.put_immutable(&key, &bytes)?;
000774 |         }
000775 |         source.put_immutable(&protocol::version_key(&pending.manifest), &pending.wire)?;
000776 |         // Persist the uncertain state BEFORE sending the CAS request.
000777 |         self.set_phase(Phase::CommitUnknown)?;
000778 |         match source.commit_current(pending.expected_etag.as_deref(), &pending.wire) {
000779 |             Ok(()) => self.finish_readback(source, now),
000780 |             Err(StoreError::Conflict) => {
000781 |                 self.set_phase(Phase::Conflict)?;
000782 |                 Err(Error::Store(StoreError::Conflict))
000783 |             }
000784 |             Err(error) => Err(Error::Store(error)),
000785 |         }
000786 |     }
000787 |     fn set_phase(&mut self, phase: Phase) -> Result<()> {
000788 |         let mut state = self.state.clone();
000789 |         state
000790 |             .pending
000791 |             .as_mut()
000792 |             .ok_or(Error::Invalid("pending_missing"))?
000793 |             .phase = phase;
000794 |         self.persist(state)
000795 |     }
000796 |     fn finish_readback(&mut self, source: &mut dyn ObjectStore, now: u64) -> Result<Publication> {
000797 |         let result = self.verify_public_readback(source, now);
000798 |         if result.is_err() {
000799 |             self.set_phase(Phase::ReadbackFailed)?;
000800 |         }
000801 |         result
000802 |     }
000803 |     fn verify_public_readback(
000804 |         &mut self,
000805 |         source: &mut dyn ObjectStore,
000806 |         now: u64,
000807 |     ) -> Result<Publication> {
000808 |         let pending = self
000809 |             .state
000810 |             .pending
000811 |             .as_ref()
000812 |             .ok_or(Error::Invalid("pending_missing"))?;
000813 |         let current = source.public_read(
000814 |             &protocol::current_key(pending.manifest.channel),
000815 |             ads::MAX_MANIFEST_BYTES,
000816 |         )?;
000817 |         let current = current.ok_or(Error::Store(StoreError::Unavailable))?;
000818 |         if current.bytes != pending.wire {
000819 |             return Err(Error::Invalid("public_current_readback"));
000820 |         }
000821 |         let (manifest, hash) = ads::verify_manifest(
000822 |             &current.bytes,
000823 |             self.verifying_key()?,
000824 |             pending.manifest.channel,
000825 |             &self.key_id,
000826 |             now,
000827 |             true,
000828 |         )
000829 |         .map_err(Error::Invalid)?;
000830 |         if manifest != pending.manifest {
000831 |             return Err(Error::Invalid("readback_release"));
000832 |         }
000833 |         let version = source
000834 |             .public_read(&protocol::version_key(&manifest), ads::MAX_MANIFEST_BYTES)?
000835 |             .ok_or(Error::Store(StoreError::Unavailable))?;
000836 |         if version.bytes != pending.wire {
000837 |             return Err(Error::Invalid("public_version_readback"));
000838 |         }
000839 |         for campaign in manifest.slots.iter().flat_map(|slot| &slot.campaigns) {
000840 |             let object = source
000841 |                 .public_read(
000842 |                     &protocol::asset_key(manifest.channel, &campaign.image),
000843 |                     ads::MAX_IMAGE_BYTES,
000844 |                 )?
000845 |                 .ok_or(Error::Store(StoreError::Unavailable))?;
000846 |             ads::validate_image(&object.bytes, &campaign.image).map_err(Error::Invalid)?;
000847 |         }
000848 |         let outcome = Publication {
000849 |             release_id: manifest.release_id.clone(),
000850 |             revision: manifest.content_revision,
000851 |             channel: manifest.channel,
000852 |         };
000853 |         let mut state = self.state.clone();
000854 |         state.sequences[channel_index(manifest.channel)]
000855 |             .remember(manifest.content_revision, hash.clone())
000856 |             .map_err(Error::Invalid)?;
000857 |         if !state
000858 |             .history
000859 |             .iter()
000860 |             .any(|record| record.manifest == manifest)
000861 |         {
000862 |             state.history.push(HistoryRecord {
000863 |                 manifest: manifest.clone(),
000864 |                 published_at: now,
000865 |                 payload_hash: hash,
000866 |             });
000867 |         }
000868 |         state.draft = manifest;
000869 |         state.pending = None;
000870 |         self.persist(state)?;
000871 |         Ok(outcome)
000872 |     }

000874 |     pub fn export_backup(&self, passphrase: &[u8], vault: &dyn Vault) -> Result<Vec<u8>> {
000875 |         let secrets = vault.load(&self.generation)?;
000876 |         self.check_signer(&secrets)?;
000877 |         let assets = self
000878 |             .state
000879 |             .assets
000880 |             .iter()
000881 |             .map(|asset| {
000882 |                 self.image_bytes(asset).map(|bytes| BackupAsset {
000883 |                     asset: asset.clone(),
000884 |                     bytes,
000885 |                 })
000886 |             })
000887 |             .collect::<Result<Vec<_>>>()?;
000888 |         let snapshot = Snapshot {
000889 |             schema: 1,
000890 |             key_id: self.key_id.clone(),
000891 |             public_key: self.verifying_key()?.to_bytes(),
000892 |             state: self.state.clone(),
000893 |             assets,
000894 |             secrets,
000895 |         };
000896 |         let plaintext = Zeroizing::new(encode(&snapshot, backup::LIMIT - 76)?);
000897 |         backup::seal(&plaintext, passphrase)
000898 |     }
000899 |     pub fn restore_backup(
000900 |         &mut self,
000901 |         bytes: &[u8],
000902 |         passphrase: &[u8],
000903 |         vault: &mut dyn Vault,
000904 |     ) -> Result<()> {
000905 |         if self
000906 |             .state
000907 |             .pending
000908 |             .as_ref()
000909 |             .is_some_and(|pending| pending.phase != Phase::Conflict)
000910 |         {
000911 |             return Err(Error::PendingOperation);
000912 |         }
000913 |         let plaintext = backup::open(bytes, passphrase)?;
000914 |         let mut snapshot: Snapshot =
000915 |             signed::strict_json(&plaintext, backup::LIMIT).map_err(Error::Invalid)?;
000916 |         if snapshot.schema != 1
000917 |             || snapshot.key_id != self.key_id
000918 |             || self
000919 |                 .public_key
000920 |                 .is_some_and(|key| snapshot.public_key != key.to_bytes())
000921 |         {
000922 |             return Err(Error::Invalid("backup_scope"));
000923 |         }
000924 |         let restored_key = VerifyingKey::from_bytes(&snapshot.public_key)
000925 |             .map_err(|_| Error::Invalid("backup_public_key"))?;
000926 |         if self.check_signer(&snapshot.secrets)?.verifying_key() != restored_key {
000927 |             return Err(Error::Invalid("backup_secret_key_mismatch"));
000928 |         }
000929 |         if let Some(pending) = &snapshot.state.pending {
000930 |             ads::verify_manifest(
000931 |                 &pending.wire,
000932 |                 &restored_key,
000933 |                 pending.manifest.channel,
000934 |                 &self.key_id,
000935 |                 pending.manifest.issued_at,
000936 |                 true,
000937 |             )
000938 |             .map_err(Error::Invalid)?;
000939 |         }
000940 |         self.validate_state(&snapshot.state)?;
000941 |         if snapshot.assets.len() != snapshot.state.assets.len() {
000942 |             return Err(Error::Invalid("backup_asset_index"));
000943 |         }
000944 |         let mut hashes = std::collections::HashSet::new();
000945 |         for asset in &snapshot.assets {
000946 |             if !snapshot.state.assets.contains(&asset.asset) || !hashes.insert(&asset.asset.sha256)
000947 |             {
000948 |                 return Err(Error::Invalid("backup_asset_index"));
000949 |             }
000950 |             ads::validate_image(&asset.bytes, &asset.asset).map_err(Error::Invalid)?;
000951 |         }
000952 |         // Keep the local replay watermark when restoring an older backup.
000953 |         for index in 0..2 {
000954 |             let local = &self.state.sequences[index];
000955 |             if local.highest >= snapshot.state.sequences[index].highest {
000956 |                 snapshot.state.sequences[index] = local.clone();
000957 |             }
000958 |         }
000959 |         snapshot.state.recovery_required = true;
000960 |         if snapshot.state.pending.is_none() {
000961 |             // A previous installation may already have used this draft's ID.
000962 |             snapshot.state.draft.release_id = random_id()?;
000963 |             snapshot.state.draft.content_revision = snapshot
000964 |                 .state
000965 |                 .sequences
000966 |                 .iter()
000967 |                 .map(|sequence| sequence.highest)
000968 |                 .chain([snapshot.state.draft.content_revision])
000969 |                 .max()
000970 |                 .unwrap_or_default()
000971 |                 .checked_add(1)
000972 |                 .ok_or(Error::Invalid("revision_overflow"))?;
000973 |         }
000974 |         self.validate_state(&snapshot.state)?;
000975 |         let generation = random_id()?;
000976 |         Self::write_generation(&self.root, &generation, &snapshot.state, &snapshot.assets)?;
000977 |         // Both old active state and old Keychain item remain valid on any failure.
000978 |         // New files and the new secret item become reachable in one pointer rename.
000979 |         vault.store(&generation, &snapshot.secrets)?;
000980 |         if self.public_key.is_none() {
000981 |             storage::atomic_write(
000982 |                 &self.root.join("trust.json"),
000983 |                 &encode(
000984 |                     &Trust {
000985 |                         key_id: self.key_id.clone(),
000986 |                         public_key: restored_key.to_bytes(),
000987 |                     },
000988 |                     4096,
000989 |                 )?,
000990 |             )?;
000991 |             self.public_key = Some(restored_key);
000992 |         }
000993 |         let active = encode(
000994 |             &Active {
000995 |                 schema: 1,
000996 |                 generation: generation.clone(),
000997 |             },
000998 |             4096,
000999 |         )?;
001000 |         let committed = storage::atomic_write(&self.root.join("active.json"), &active);
001001 |         // Directory sync may fail after the rename commit point. Match the
001002 |         // on-disk generation in memory while preserving the durability error.
001003 |         if committed.is_ok()
001004 |             || read_private(&self.root.join("active.json"), 4096).is_ok_and(|bytes| bytes == active)
001005 |         {
001006 |             self.generation = generation;
001007 |             self.state = snapshot.state;
001008 |         }
001009 |         committed.map_err(Error::Io)
001010 |     }
001011 |     fn write_generation(
001012 |         root: &Path,
001013 |         generation: &str,
001014 |         state: &State,
001015 |         assets: &[BackupAsset],
001016 |     ) -> Result<()> {
001017 |         let directory = root.join(generation);
001018 |         storage::create_private_directory(&directory)?;
001019 |         let asset_directory = directory.join("assets");
001020 |         storage::create_private_directory(&asset_directory)?;
001021 |         for asset in assets {
001022 |             storage::atomic_write(&asset_directory.join(&asset.asset.sha256), &asset.bytes)?;
001023 |         }
001024 |         storage::atomic_write(&directory.join("state.json"), &encode(state, STATE_LIMIT)?)?;
001025 |         storage::sync_directory(root)?;
001026 |         Ok(())
001027 |     }
001028 | }

000001 | //! One-provider publication protocol; the actual provider is configured separately.
000002 | use super::{Error, Result};
000003 | use serde::{Deserialize, Serialize};
000004 | use switcher_domain::ads::{AdChannel, AdManifest};
000005 | 
000006 | #[derive(Clone)]
000007 | pub struct Object {
000008 |     pub bytes: Vec<u8>,
000009 |     pub etag: String,
000010 | }
000011 | 
000012 | #[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq)]
000013 | pub enum StoreError {
000014 |     Unavailable,
000015 |     Conflict,
000016 |     OutcomeUnknown,
000017 |     Permission,
000018 | }
000019 | 
000020 | /// All keys are product-relative and environment-prefixed, never user URLs.
000021 | /// A provider must enforce bounded reads, anonymous public readback, immutable
000022 | /// object create-if-absent, and CAS via If-Match / If-None-Match. Its credential
000023 | /// must have write access only to this environment's advertisement directory.
000024 | pub trait ObjectStore {
000025 |     fn channel(&self) -> AdChannel;
000026 |     fn requires_credentials(&self) -> bool {
000027 |         true
000028 |     }
000029 |     fn current(&mut self) -> std::result::Result<Option<Object>, StoreError>;
000030 |     fn public_read(
000031 |         &mut self,
000032 |         key: &str,
000033 |         limit: usize,

000019 |             || self.preview_credential.len() > 16 * 1024
000020 |             || self.production_credential.len() > 16 * 1024

000036 | /// A generation uses one atomic Keychain item for its entire secret bundle.
000037 | /// Implementations must not log, format or persist unencrypted secret bytes.
000038 | pub trait Vault {
000039 |     fn load(&self, generation: &str) -> Result<Secrets>;
000040 |     fn store(&mut self, generation: &str, secrets: &Secrets) -> Result<()>;
000041 | }

000043 | pub struct KeychainVault;
000044 | 
000045 | impl Vault for KeychainVault {
000046 |     fn load(&self, generation: &str) -> Result<Secrets> {
000047 |         #[cfg(target_os = "macos")]
000048 |         {
000049 |             let bytes = zeroize::Zeroizing::new(
000050 |                 security_framework::passwords::get_generic_password(
000051 |                     "com.claude-switcher.personal.publisher",
000052 |                     generation,
000053 |                 )
000054 |                 .map_err(|_| Error::SecretUnavailable)?,
000055 |             );
000056 |             let secrets: Secrets =
000057 |                 switcher_core::signed::strict_json(&bytes, SECRET_LIMIT).map_err(Error::Invalid)?;
000058 |             secrets.validate()?;
000059 |             Ok(secrets)
000060 |         }
000061 |         #[cfg(not(target_os = "macos"))]
000062 |         {
000063 |             let _ = generation;
000064 |             Err(Error::SecretUnavailable)
000065 |         }
000066 |     }
000067 | 
000068 |     fn store(&mut self, generation: &str, secrets: &Secrets) -> Result<()> {
000069 |         secrets.validate()?;
000070 |         #[cfg(target_os = "macos")]
000071 |         {
000072 |             let bytes = zeroize::Zeroizing::new(
000073 |                 serde_json::to_vec(secrets).map_err(|_| Error::Invalid("secret_encoding"))?,
000074 |             );

000076 |                 return Err(Error::Invalid("secret_size"));
000077 |             }

000079 |                 "com.claude-switcher.personal.publisher",
000080 |                 generation,
000081 |                 &bytes,
000082 |             )
000083 |             .map_err(|_| Error::SecretUnavailable)
000084 |         }
000085 |         #[cfg(not(target_os = "macos"))]
000086 |         {
000087 |             let _ = generation;

000088 | }
000089 | impl MemoryStore {
000090 |     fn new(channel: AdChannel) -> Self {
000091 |         Self {
000092 |             channel,
000093 |             objects: HashMap::new(),
000094 |             commits: 0,
000095 |             conflict: false,
000096 |             unknown_after_commit: false,
000097 |             unknown_before_commit: false,
000098 |             corrupt_readback: false,
000099 |             hide_current: false,
000100 |             next_etag: 0,
000101 |             accesses: vec![],
000102 |         }
000103 |     }
000104 |     fn key(&self) -> String {
000105 |         protocol::current_key(self.channel)
000106 |     }
000107 | }
000108 | impl ObjectStore for MemoryStore {
000109 |     fn channel(&self) -> AdChannel {
000110 |         self.channel
000111 |     }
000112 |     fn current(&mut self) -> std::result::Result<Option<Object>, StoreError> {
000113 |         Ok(self.objects.get(&self.key()).cloned())
000114 |     }
000115 |     fn public_read(
000116 |         &mut self,
000117 |         key: &str,
000118 |         limit: usize,
000119 |     ) -> std::result::Result<Option<Object>, StoreError> {
000120 |         self.accesses.push(key.into());
000121 |         if self.hide_current && key == self.key() {
000122 |             return Ok(None);
000123 |         }
000124 |         let mut object = self.objects.get(key).cloned();
000125 |         if object
000126 |             .as_ref()
000127 |             .is_some_and(|object| object.bytes.len() > limit)
000128 |         {
000129 |             return Err(StoreError::Unavailable);
000130 |         }
000131 |         if self.corrupt_readback
000132 |             && key.contains("/assets/")
000133 |             && let Some(object) = &mut object
000134 |         {
000135 |             object.bytes[0] ^= 1;
000136 |         }
000137 |         Ok(object)
000138 |     }
000139 |     fn put_immutable(&mut self, key: &str, bytes: &[u8]) -> std::result::Result<(), StoreError> {
000140 |         if !key.starts_with(&format!("{}/", protocol::prefix(self.channel))) {
000141 |             return Err(StoreError::Permission);
000142 |         }
000143 |         if let Some(existing) = self.objects.get(key) {
000144 |             return if existing.bytes == bytes {
000145 |                 Ok(())
000146 |             } else {
000147 |                 Err(StoreError::Conflict)
000148 |             };
000149 |         }
000150 |         self.objects.insert(
000151 |             key.into(),
000152 |             Object {
000153 |                 bytes: bytes.into(),
000154 |                 etag: "immutable".into(),
000155 |             },
000156 |         );
000157 |         Ok(())
000158 |     }
000159 |     fn commit_current(
000160 |         &mut self,
000161 |         expected_etag: Option<&str>,
000162 |         bytes: &[u8],
000163 |     ) -> std::result::Result<(), StoreError> {
000164 |         self.commits += 1;
000165 |         if self.conflict
000166 |             || self
000167 |                 .objects
000168 |                 .get(&self.key())
000169 |                 .map(|object| object.etag.as_str())
000170 |                 != expected_etag
000171 |         {
000172 |             return Err(StoreError::Conflict);
000173 |         }
000174 |         if self.unknown_before_commit {
000175 |             self.unknown_before_commit = false;
000176 |             return Err(StoreError::OutcomeUnknown);
000177 |         }
000178 |         self.next_etag += 1;
000179 |         self.objects.insert(
000180 |             self.key(),
000181 |             Object {
000182 |                 bytes: bytes.into(),
000183 |                 etag: format!("etag-{}", self.next_etag),
000184 |             },
000185 |         );
000186 |         if self.unknown_after_commit {
000187 |             self.unknown_after_commit = false;
000188 |             Err(StoreError::OutcomeUnknown)
000189 |         } else {
000190 |             Ok(())
000191 |         }
000192 |     }
000193 | }

000800 | 
000801 | fn local_tree(path: &Path) -> Vec<(PathBuf, String)> {
000802 |     let mut files = Vec::new();
000803 |     for entry in fs::read_dir(path).unwrap() {
000804 |         let entry = entry.unwrap();
000805 |         if entry.file_type().unwrap().is_dir() {
000806 |             files.extend(local_tree(&entry.path()));
000807 |         } else {
000808 |             files.push((
000809 |                 entry.path(),
000810 |                 signed::digest(&fs::read(entry.path()).unwrap()),
000811 |             ));
000812 |         }
000813 |     }
000814 |     files.sort();
000815 |     files
000816 | }

000121 |         self.v2().join(match self.edition {
000122 |             Edition::Personal => "personal",

000126 |     fn state_path(&self) -> PathBuf {

000129 |     fn lock(&self) -> io::Result<LifecycleLock> {
000130 |         storage::prepare_data_root(&self.root)?;
000131 |         storage::create_private_directory(&self.v2())?;
000132 |         let lock = LifecycleLock::try_acquire(&self.v2())?;
000133 |         storage::create_private_directory(&self.directory())?;
000134 |         Ok(lock)
000135 |     }
000136 |     fn load(&self, sample: &ClockSample) -> io::Result<Persistent> {
000137 |         let mut state = match storage::read_private_bytes(&self.state_path(), updates::STATE_LIMIT)
000138 |         {
000139 |             Ok(bytes) => {
000140 |                 let state: Persistent =
000141 |                     signed::strict_json(&bytes, updates::STATE_LIMIT).map_err(io::Error::other)?;
000142 |                 if state.schema_version != 1
000143 |                     || state.edition != self.edition
000144 |                     || state.schedule.edition != self.edition
000145 |                     || state.status.len() > 64
000146 |                     || state.message.len() > 2048
000147 |                 {
000148 |                     return Err(io::Error::other("update_state_context"));
000149 |                 }
000150 |                 // Apply the same bounded replay/failure validation as core restoration.
000151 |                 UpdateState::decode(&state.updates.encode().map_err(io::Error::other)?)
000152 |                     .map_err(io::Error::other)?;
000153 |                 state
000154 |             }
000155 |             Err(error) if error.kind() == io::ErrorKind::NotFound => {
000156 |                 Persistent::new(self.edition, utc(sample)?)
000157 |             }
000158 |             Err(error) => return Err(error),
000159 |         };
000160 |         state.clock =
000161 |             match storage::read_private_bytes(&self.directory().join("clock.json"), 64 * 1024) {
000162 |                 Ok(bytes) => signed::strict_json(&bytes, 64 * 1024).map_err(io::Error::other)?,
000163 |                 Err(error) if error.kind() == io::ErrorKind::NotFound => state.clock,
000164 |                 Err(error) => return Err(error),
000165 |             };
000166 |         state.clock.observe_passive(sample.clone());
000167 |         // The lifecycle lock proves no updater is currently working in another process.
000168 |         state.schedule.recover_process();
000169 |         if state.updates.recover_interrupted() {
000170 |             state.status = "recovery_required".into();
000171 |             state.message = "检测到中断的更新事务。请核验已安装组件及兼容回退工件。".into();
000172 |         }
000173 |         Ok(state)
000174 |     }
000175 |     fn save(&self, state: &Persistent) -> io::Result<()> {

000177 |         if bytes.len() > updates::STATE_LIMIT {
000178 |             return Err(io::Error::other("update_state_too_large"));
000179 |         }
000180 |         write_changed(&self.state_path(), &bytes)?;
000181 |         write_changed(

000247 |     /// UI actions are individually initiated by the local user. Consent is never persisted.
000248 |     pub fn act(&self, action: UpdateAction) -> OperationOutcome {
000249 |         match action {
000250 |             UpdateAction::Check => self.run_task(updates::UpdateAction::Check, true),
000251 |             UpdateAction::Download => self.run_task(updates::UpdateAction::Download, true),
000252 |             UpdateAction::Install => self.run_task(updates::UpdateAction::Install, true),
000253 |             _ => self.change_schedule(action),

000256 |     /// Guardian/CLI use an enum. This entry never accepts a URL, candidate path, or shell text.
000257 |     pub fn run_task(&self, action: updates::UpdateAction, manual: bool) -> OperationOutcome {
000258 |         let result = (|| -> io::Result<OperationOutcome> {
000259 |             let lock = self.lock()?;
000260 |             let sample = time::sample().map_err(io::Error::other)?;
000261 |             self.run_locked(action, manual, &sample, &lock)
000262 |         })();
000263 |         result.unwrap_or_else(outcome_error)
000264 |     }
000265 |     fn run_locked(
000266 |         &self,
000267 |         action: updates::UpdateAction,
000268 |         manual: bool,
000269 |         sample: &ClockSample,
000270 |         lock: &LifecycleLock,
000271 |     ) -> io::Result<OperationOutcome> {
000272 |         if action == updates::UpdateAction::Install
000273 |             && let Err(reason) = updates::ensure_installation_idle(&self.v2(), lock)
000274 |         {
000275 |             return Ok(outcome(
000276 |                 false,
000277 |                 "地区或配置修复尚未恢复完成，暂不能准备或安装更新。",
000278 |                 Some(reason),
000279 |             ));
000280 |         }
000281 |         let mut state = self.load(sample)?;
000282 |         if manual {
000283 |             state.clock.observe(sample.clone());
000284 |         }
000285 |         let now = utc(sample)?;
000286 |         if !state.clock.allows_verified_refresh()
000287 |             || (action != updates::UpdateAction::Check && !state.clock.trusted())
000288 |         {
000289 |             self.save(&state)?;
000290 |             return Ok(outcome(
000291 |                 false,
000292 |                 "系统时间需要恢复。修正时间后点击恢复，再完成固定源验签刷新。",
000293 |                 Some("clock_recovery_required"),
000294 |             ));
000295 |         }
000296 |         match state.schedule.begin(action, manual, now) {
000297 |             Ok(true) => (),
000298 |             Ok(false) => {
000299 |                 return Ok(outcome(
000300 |                     false,
000301 |                     "相同更新任务已经在执行。",
000302 |                     Some("update_in_progress"),
000303 |                 ));
000304 |             }
000305 |             Err(reason) => {
000306 |                 self.save(&state)?;
000307 |                 let message = match reason {
000308 |                     "personal_requires_user_action" => {
000309 |                         "Personal 的每次检查、下载和安装均需本人操作。"
000310 |                     }
000311 |                     "updates_paused" => "自动更新已暂停。",
000312 |                     "installation_deferred" => "本次安装已延后。",
000313 |                     "check_not_due" => "尚未到达下次检查时间。",
000314 |                     _ => "更新任务目前不可执行。",
000315 |                 };
000316 |                 return Ok(outcome(false, message, Some(reason)));
000317 |             }
000318 |         }
000319 |         if let Some(pins) = &self.pins {
000320 |             state.clock.observe(sample.clone());
000321 |             self.save(&state)?; // Reserve the task before network or staging side effects.
000322 |             let result = self.execute_pinned(action, manual, sample, &mut state, pins, lock);
000323 |             match result {
000324 |                 Ok(result) => {
000325 |                     self.save(&state)?;
000326 |                     return Ok(result);
000327 |                 }
000328 |                 Err(reason) => {
000329 |                     if matches!(reason, "update_network" | "update_http_status_or_redirect") {
000330 |                         state.schedule.transient_failure(now);
000331 |                     } else {
000332 |                         state.schedule.authorization_cancelled();
000333 |                     }
000334 |                     state.status = "update_failed".into();
000335 |                     state.message = if reason == "source_local_rebuild_required" {
000336 |                         SOURCE_LOCAL.into()
000337 |                     } else {
000338 |                         format!("更新未完成：{reason}。请按更新状态检查或恢复组件。")
000339 |                     };
000340 |                     self.save(&state)?;
000341 |                     return Ok(outcome(false, &state.message, Some(reason)));
000342 |                 }
000343 |             }
000344 |         }
000345 |         // No transport is created while production materials are absent.
000346 |         state.schedule.authorization_cancelled();
000347 |         if action == updates::UpdateAction::Check {
000348 |             state.schedule.next_check_at = now.saturating_add(updates::CHECK_INTERVAL);
000349 |         }
000350 |         if !matches!(
000351 |             state.status.as_str(),
000352 |             "recovery_required"
000353 |                 | "update_failed"
000354 |                 | "wait_recovery_materials"
000355 |                 | "failed_artifacts_suppressed"
000356 |         ) {
000357 |             state.status = "source_local_rebuild_required".into();
000358 |             state.message = SOURCE_LOCAL.into();
000359 |         }
000360 |         self.save(&state)?;
000361 |         Ok(outcome(
000362 |             false,
000363 |             &state.message,
000364 |             Some(match state.status.as_str() {
000365 |                 "recovery_required" => "update_recovery_required",
000366 |                 "update_failed" => "update_failed",
000367 |                 "wait_recovery_materials" => "wait_update_recovery_pkg",
000368 |                 "failed_artifacts_suppressed" => "failed_artifacts_suppressed",
000369 |                 _ => "source_local_rebuild_required",
000370 |             }),
000371 |         ))
000372 |     }
000373 |     fn execute_pinned(
000374 |         &self,
000375 |         action: updates::UpdateAction,
000376 |         manual: bool,
000377 |         sample: &ClockSample,
000378 |         state: &mut Persistent,
000379 |         pins: &updates::ValidatedReleasePins,
000380 |         lock: &LifecycleLock,
000381 |     ) -> Result<OperationOutcome, &'static str> {
000382 |         if pins.edition() != self.edition {
000383 |             return Err("release_context");
000384 |         }
000385 |         let record = pinned_installation(
000386 |             switcher_core::install::validate_installed(self.edition, unsafe { libc::geteuid() }),
000387 |             self.edition,
000388 |         )?;
000389 |         let may_recover = match updates::ensure_installation_idle(&self.v2(), lock) {
000390 |             Ok(()) => true,
000391 |             Err("repair_recovery_pending") if action != updates::UpdateAction::Install => false,
000392 |             Err(reason) => return Err(reason),

000401 |         }
