000405 |         let now = utc(sample).map_err(|_| "utc_before_epoch")?;
000406 |         let transport = updates::ReleaseTransport::new(pins.clone())?;
000407 |         let candidate = match action {
000408 |             updates::UpdateAction::Check => {
000409 |                 let candidate = transport.check_blocking(
000410 |                     &state.updates,
000411 |                     &app,
000412 |                     Some(&helper),
000413 |                     now,
000414 |                     state.clock.allows_verified_refresh(),
000415 |                 )?;
000416 |                 let refreshed = time::sample()?;
000417 |                 state.clock.observe(refreshed.clone());
000418 |                 if !state.clock.allows_verified_refresh() {
000419 |                     return Err("clock_recovery_required");
000420 |                 }
000421 |                 let fresh_now = utc(&refreshed).map_err(|_| "utc_before_epoch")?;
000422 |                 if candidate.metadata().expires_at <= fresh_now
000423 |                     || candidate.metadata().issued_at > fresh_now
000424 |                 {
000425 |                     return Err("metadata_expired");
000426 |                 }
000427 |                 let accepted = state.updates.accept(&candidate, false)?;
000428 |                 state.clock.record_verified_success(refreshed)?;
000429 |                 state.schedule.success(action, now)?;
000430 |                 self.save(state).map_err(|_| "update_state_write")?;
000431 |                 if !accepted {
000432 |                     state.status = "failed_artifacts_suppressed".into();
000433 |                     state.message =
000434 |                         "该 app/helper 工件组合此前失败。请完成恢复后再显式重试。".into();
000435 |                     return Ok(outcome(
000436 |                         false,
000437 |                         &state.message,
000438 |                         Some("failed_artifacts_suppressed"),
000439 |                     ));
000440 |                 }
000441 |                 if manual {
000442 |                     state.status = "authenticated".into();
000443 |                     state.message = format!(
000444 |                         "已验签更新 {}。下载需再次操作。",
000445 |                         candidate.metadata().version
000446 |                     );
000447 |                     return Ok(outcome(true, &state.message, None));
000448 |                 }
000449 |                 // Public may download automatically; Personal cannot enter this branch.
000450 |                 state
000451 |                     .schedule
000452 |                     .begin(updates::UpdateAction::Download, false, now)?;
000453 |                 self.download_candidate(&transport, &candidate, state, now)?;
000454 |                 let sample = time::sample()?;
000455 |                 let fresh_now = utc(&sample).map_err(|_| "utc_before_epoch")?;
000456 |                 state.clock.observe(sample.clone());
000457 |                 if !state.clock.trusted() {
000458 |                     return Err("clock_recovery_required");
000459 |                 }
000460 |                 if let Err(reason) =
000461 |                     state
000462 |                         .schedule
000463 |                         .begin(updates::UpdateAction::Install, false, fresh_now)
000464 |                 {
000465 |                     return Ok(outcome(
000466 |                         true,
000467 |                         "更新已暂存。自动安装正在暂停或延后。",
000468 |                         Some(reason),
000469 |                     ));
000470 |                 }
000471 |                 self.save(state).map_err(|_| "update_state_write")?;
000472 |                 return self.execute_pinned(
000473 |                     updates::UpdateAction::Install,
000474 |                     false,
000475 |                     &sample,
000476 |                     state,
000477 |                     pins,
000478 |                     lock,
000479 |                 );
000480 |             }
000481 |             _ => pins.restore(
000482 |                 &state.updates,
000483 |                 &app,
000484 |                 Some(&helper),
000485 |                 now,
000486 |                 state.clock.allows_verified_refresh(),
000487 |             )?,
000488 |         };
000489 |         if action == updates::UpdateAction::Download {
000490 |             if manual {
000491 |                 state.updates.accept(&candidate, true)?;
000492 |             }
000493 |             self.download_candidate(&transport, &candidate, state, now)?;
000494 |             return Ok(outcome(true, "已验证并暂存更新。安装需再次操作。", None));
000495 |         }
000496 |         updates::ensure_installation_idle(&self.v2(), lock)?;
000497 |         let staging = self
000498 |             .directory()
000499 |             .join("update-staging")
000500 |             .join(candidate.payload_hash());
000501 |         let app_bytes = storage::read_private_bytes(
000502 |             &staging.join("app.tar.gz"),
000503 |             updates::MAX_ARTIFACT_SIZE as usize,
000504 |         )
000505 |         .map_err(|_| "cached_app_missing")?;
000506 |         let app_proof =
000507 |             transport.verify_cached(&candidate, updates::ArtifactKind::App, &app_bytes)?;
000508 |         let helper_proof = if candidate.metadata().helper.is_some() {
000509 |             let bytes = storage::read_private_bytes(
000510 |                 &staging.join("helper.pkg"),
000511 |                 updates::MAX_ARTIFACT_SIZE as usize,
000512 |             )
000513 |             .map_err(|_| "cached_helper_missing")?;
000514 |             Some(transport.verify_cached(&candidate, updates::ArtifactKind::Helper, &bytes)?)
000515 |         } else {
000516 |             None
000517 |         };
000518 |         let serial = std::time::SystemTime::now()
000519 |             .duration_since(std::time::UNIX_EPOCH)
000520 |             .map_err(|_| "utc_before_epoch")?
000521 |             .as_nanos();
000522 |         let expanded = staging.join(format!("app-expanded-{}-{serial}", std::process::id()));
000523 |         let app_path = updates::stage_app_archive(&candidate, &app_proof, &app_bytes, &expanded)?;
000524 |         let helper_path = staging.join("helper.pkg");
000525 |         let prepared = updates::assess_staged_installation(
000526 |             candidate,
000527 |             &app_proof,
000528 |             &app_path,
000529 |             helper_proof
000530 |                 .as_ref()
000531 |                 .map(|proof| (proof, helper_path.as_path())),
000532 |         );
000533 |         match prepared {
000534 |             Err(reason) => {
000535 |                 let _ = std::fs::remove_dir_all(&expanded);
000536 |                 // Apple failure is not successful installation. Quarantine this candidate's
000537 |                 // bytes by removing the private staging tree; retain failure and sequence.
000538 |                 let restored = pins.restore(&state.updates, &app, Some(&helper), now, true)?;
000539 |                 state.updates.record_failure(&restored, reason, now)?;
000540 |                 let _ = std::fs::remove_dir_all(&staging);
000541 |                 Err(reason)
000542 |             }
000543 |             Ok(prepared) => {
000544 |                 use updates::UpdateInstallCoordinator;
000545 |                 let installed = coordinator.install(&prepared, &mut state.updates);
000546 |                 let _ = std::fs::remove_dir_all(&expanded);
000547 |                 if let Err("wait_update_recovery_pkg") = installed {
000548 |                     state.schedule.authorization_cancelled();
000549 |                     state.status = "wait_recovery_materials".into();
000550 |                     state.message = "等待已验证的上一兼容版本恢复 PKG；尚未开始安装。".into();
000551 |                     return Ok(outcome(
000552 |                         false,
000553 |                         &state.message,
000554 |                         Some("wait_update_recovery_pkg"),
000555 |                     ));
000556 |                 }
000557 |                 installed?;
000558 |                 if !state
000559 |                     .updates
000560 |                     .candidate
000561 |                     .as_ref()
000562 |                     .is_some_and(|pending| pending.stage == updates::InstallStage::Healthy)
000563 |                 {
000564 |                     return Err("update_health_unconfirmed");
000565 |                 }
000566 |                 state
000567 |                     .schedule
000568 |                     .success(updates::UpdateAction::Install, now)?;
000569 |                 state.status = "installed".into();
000570 |                 state.message =
000571 |                     "更新已安装，组件身份和后台健康检查已通过。请重新打开切换器。".into();
000572 |                 Ok(outcome(true, &state.message, None))
000573 |             }
000574 |         }
000575 |     }
000576 |     fn download_candidate(
000577 |         &self,
000578 |         transport: &updates::ReleaseTransport,
000579 |         candidate: &updates::Candidate,
000580 |         state: &mut Persistent,
000581 |         now: u64,
000582 |     ) -> Result<(), &'static str> {
000583 |         let download = |kind| transport.download_blocking(candidate, kind, now);
000584 |         let record_failure = |state: &mut Persistent, reason| {
000585 |             if matches!(
000586 |                 reason,
000587 |                 "artifact_size"
000588 |                     | "artifact_sha256"
000589 |                     | "update_response_too_large"
000590 |                     | "minisign_shape"
000591 |                     | "minisign_signature"
000592 |                     | "minisign_signed_version"
000593 |             ) {
000594 |                 state.updates.record_failure(candidate, reason, now)?;
000595 |             }
000596 |             Err::<_, &'static str>(reason)
000597 |         };
000598 |         let (app, app_proof) = match download(updates::ArtifactKind::App) {
000599 |             Ok(value) => value,
000600 |             Err(reason) => return record_failure(state, reason),
000601 |         };
000602 |         let helper = if candidate.metadata().helper.is_some() {
000603 |             Some(match download(updates::ArtifactKind::Helper) {
000604 |                 Ok(value) => value,
000605 |                 Err(reason) => return record_failure(state, reason),
000606 |             })
000607 |         } else {
000608 |             None
000609 |         };
000610 |         let sample = time::sample()?;
000611 |         state.clock.observe(sample.clone());
000612 |         if !state.clock.trusted() {
000613 |             return Err("clock_recovery_required");
000614 |         }
000615 |         let fresh_now = utc(&sample).map_err(|_| "utc_before_epoch")?;
000616 |         if fresh_now >= candidate.metadata().expires_at
000617 |             || fresh_now < candidate.metadata().issued_at
000618 |         {
000619 |             return Err("metadata_expired");
000620 |         }
000621 |         let parent = self.directory().join("update-staging");
000622 |         storage::create_private_directory(&parent).map_err(|_| "staging_directory")?;
000623 |         let staging = parent.join(candidate.payload_hash());
000624 |         storage::create_private_directory(&staging).map_err(|_| "staging_directory")?;
000625 |         let written = (|| {
000626 |             storage::atomic_write(&staging.join("app.tar.gz"), &app)
000627 |                 .map_err(|_| "staging_write")?;
000628 |             if let Some((bytes, _)) = &helper {
000629 |                 storage::atomic_write(&staging.join("helper.pkg"), bytes)
000630 |                     .map_err(|_| "staging_write")?;
000631 |             }
000632 |             state.updates.mark_downloaded(
000633 |                 candidate,
000634 |                 &app_proof,
000635 |                 helper.as_ref().map(|(_, proof)| proof),
000636 |             )?;
000637 |             Ok::<_, &'static str>(())
000638 |         })();
000639 |         if written.is_err() {
000640 |             let _ = std::fs::remove_dir_all(&staging);
000641 |         }
000642 |         written?;
000643 |         state
000644 |             .schedule
000645 |             .success(updates::UpdateAction::Download, now)?;
000646 |         state.status = "downloaded".into();
000647 |         state.message = "工件已通过 SHA256、Minisign 和签名版本验证。尚未安装。".into();
000648 |         Ok(())
000649 |     }
000650 |     fn change_schedule(&self, action: UpdateAction) -> OperationOutcome {
000651 |         let result = (|| -> io::Result<OperationOutcome> {
000652 |             let _lock = self.lock()?;
000653 |             let sample = time::sample().map_err(io::Error::other)?;
000654 |             let now = utc(&sample)?;
000655 |             let mut state = self.load(&sample)?;
000656 |             state.clock.observe(sample.clone());
000657 |             let message = match action {
000658 |                 UpdateAction::Pause => {
000659 |                     state.schedule.paused = true;
000660 |                     "已暂停自动检查、下载和安装。"
000661 |                 }
000662 |                 UpdateAction::Resume => {
000663 |                     state.schedule.paused = false;
000664 |                     if !state.clock.trusted() {
000665 |                         state.clock.establish_baseline(sample);
000666 |                         "已建立本地时间基线。等待固定更新源验签刷新。"
000667 |                     } else {
000668 |                         "已恢复更新调度。"
000669 |                     }
000670 |                 }
000671 |                 UpdateAction::Defer => {
000672 |                     state.schedule.deferred_until = Some(now.saturating_add(24 * 60 * 60));
000673 |                     "已将自动安装延后 24 小时。"
000674 |                 }
000675 |                 _ => return Err(io::Error::other("unsupported_schedule_action")),
000676 |             };
000677 |             self.save(&state)?;
000678 |             Ok(outcome(true, message, None))
000679 |         })();
000680 |         result.unwrap_or_else(outcome_error)
000681 |     }
000682 | }
000683 | // This gate consumes the existing installed-identity validator's result. It never
000684 | // substitutes a writable record or a branch flag for native identity validation.
000685 | fn pinned_installation(
000686 |     installed: Result<switcher_domain::system::InstallRecord, &'static str>,
000687 |     edition: Edition,
000688 | ) -> Result<switcher_domain::system::InstallRecord, &'static str> {
000689 |     let record = installed.map_err(|_| "installed_identity_required")?;
000690 |     record
000691 |         .validate()
000692 |         .map_err(|_| "installed_identity_required")?;
000693 |     if record.edition != edition {
000694 |         return Err("installed_identity_required");
000695 |     }
000696 |     record.developer_team()?;
000697 |     Ok(record)
000698 | }
000699 | fn source_local_view(result: &mut UpdateView) {
000700 |     if matches!(
000701 |         result.state.as_str(),
000702 |         "wait_materials" | "source_local_rebuild_required" | "checked"
000703 |     ) {
000704 |         result.state = "source_local_rebuild_required".into();
000705 |         result.message = SOURCE_LOCAL.into();
000706 |     } else if !result.message.contains("源码构建版本") {
000707 |         result.message.push(' ');
000708 |         result.message.push_str(SOURCE_LOCAL);
000709 |     }
000710 |     result.next_check_at = None;
000711 |     result.candidate_version = None;
000712 |     result.can_download = false;
000713 |     result.can_install = false;
000714 | }
000715 | fn utc(sample: &ClockSample) -> io::Result<u64> {
000716 |     sample
000717 |         .utc_secs
000718 |         .try_into()
000719 |         .map_err(|_| io::Error::other("utc_before_epoch"))
000720 | }
000721 | fn write_changed(path: &Path, bytes: &[u8]) -> io::Result<()> {
000722 |     match storage::read_private_bytes(path, updates::STATE_LIMIT) {
000723 |         Ok(old) if old == bytes => return Ok(()),
000724 |         Ok(_) => (),
000725 |         Err(error) if error.kind() == io::ErrorKind::NotFound => (),
000726 |         Err(error) => return Err(error),
000727 |     }
000728 |     storage::atomic_write(path, bytes)
000729 | }
000730 | fn view(state: &Persistent) -> UpdateView {
000731 |     let (status, message) = if !state.clock.trusted() {
000732 |         (
000733 |             "clock_recovery_required",
000734 |             "系统时间需要恢复。修正时间后点击恢复，再完成固定源验签刷新。",
000735 |         )
000736 |     } else if state.schedule.paused {
000737 |         ("paused", "自动更新已暂停。")
000738 |     } else {
000739 |         (state.status.as_str(), state.message.as_str())
000740 |     };
000741 |     UpdateView {
000742 |         paused: Some(state.schedule.paused),
000743 |         state: status.into(),
000744 |         message: message.into(),
000745 |         next_check_at: if state.edition == Edition::Public {
000746 |             Some(state.schedule.next_check_at)
000747 |         } else {
000748 |             None
000749 |         },
000750 |         candidate_version: None,
000751 |         can_download: false,
000752 |         can_install: false,
000753 |     }
000754 | }
000755 | fn outcome(completed: bool, message: &str, recovery: Option<&str>) -> OperationOutcome {
000756 |     OperationOutcome {
000757 |         completed,
000758 |         message: message.into(),
000759 |         recovery: recovery.map(str::to_owned),
000760 |     }
000761 | }
000762 | fn error_code(error: &io::Error) -> &'static str {
000763 |     if error.kind() == io::ErrorKind::WouldBlock {
000764 |         "lifecycle_busy"
000765 |     } else {
000766 |         "update_storage_error"
000767 |     }
000768 | }
000769 | fn error_message(error: &io::Error) -> String {
000770 |     if error.kind() == io::ErrorKind::WouldBlock {
000771 |         "账号或更新任务持有生命周期锁。请稍后重试。".into()
000772 |     } else {
000773 |         "无法安全读取或保存更新状态。请检查 v2 更新目录的权限和恢复记录。".into()
000774 |     }
000775 | }
000776 | fn outcome_error(error: io::Error) -> OperationOutcome {
000777 |     outcome(false, &error_message(&error), Some(error_code(&error)))
000778 | }

001121 |             // missing-materials guard instead of inheriting any earlier consent.

000008 | #[test]
000009 | fn desktop_log_privacy_roundtrip() {
000010 |     if std::env::var_os("SWITCHER_E11_LOG_CHILD").is_some() {
000011 |         let state = bridge::DesktopState::new(switcher_domain::Edition::Personal).unwrap();
000012 |         let raw = "出口203.0.113.9 [2001:db8::4]\nCookie: E11_SYNTHETIC_LOGIN_COOKIE_9ef0721a\nhttps://user:E11_SYNTHETIC_ACCOUNT_A_7df3502b@private.example:443/path";
000013 |         let expected = switcher_core::diagnostics::redact(raw);
000014 |         state.log("info", raw).unwrap();
000015 |         let persisted = switcher_core::storage::read_private_bytes(
000016 |             &state.directory().join("activity.json"),
000017 |             65536,
000018 |         )
000019 |         .unwrap();
000020 |         let preview = state.activity().unwrap();
000021 |         assert_eq!(preview.len(), 1);
000022 |         assert_eq!(preview[0].message, expected);
000023 |         // App.svelte exports this same activity array with JSON.stringify.
000024 |         let exported = serde_json::to_vec_pretty(&preview).unwrap();
000025 |         let stored: serde_json::Value = serde_json::from_slice(&persisted).unwrap();
000026 |         let output: serde_json::Value = serde_json::from_slice(&exported).unwrap();
000027 |         assert_eq!(stored, output);
000028 |         for bytes in [&persisted, &exported] {
000029 |             let text = String::from_utf8_lossy(bytes);
000030 |             for secret in [
000031 |                 "203.0.113.9",
000032 |                 "2001:db8::4",
000033 |                 "E11_SYNTHETIC_LOGIN_COOKIE_9ef0721a",
000034 |                 "E11_SYNTHETIC_ACCOUNT_A_7df3502b",
000035 |                 "private.example",
000036 |             ] {
000037 |                 assert!(!text.contains(secret));
000038 |             }
000039 |         }
000040 |         // A historical unredacted message also receives the shared rule on read.
000041 |         let entries = serde_json::json!([{"observed_at":1,"level":"info","message":raw}]);
000042 |         switcher_core::storage::atomic_json(&state.directory().join("activity.json"), &entries)

000049 |         .unwrap()
000050 |         .join(format!("switcher-e11-desktop-log-{}", std::process::id()));
000051 |     switcher_core::storage::create_private_directory(&root).unwrap();
000052 |     let output = std::process::Command::new(std::env::current_exe().unwrap())

000060 |         output.status.success(),
000061 |         "isolated desktop log test failed: {}",

000001 | /** Local editing uses the live system zone; UTC editing never depends on it. */
000002 | export function systemTimeZone(): string {
000003 |   return Intl.DateTimeFormat().resolvedOptions().timeZone;
000004 | }
000005 | 
000006 | export function dateInput(seconds: number, timeZone: string): string {
000007 |   const parts = new Intl.DateTimeFormat('en-CA', {
000008 |     timeZone, year: 'numeric', month: '2-digit', day: '2-digit',
000009 |     hour: '2-digit', minute: '2-digit', hourCycle: 'h23',
000010 |   }).formatToParts(new Date(seconds * 1000));
000011 |   const part = (type: Intl.DateTimeFormatPartTypes) => parts.find(p => p.type === type)!.value;
000012 |   return `${part('year')}-${part('month')}-${part('day')}T${part('hour')}:${part('minute')}`;
000013 | }
000014 | 
000015 | type ParsedDate = {status: 'ok'; value: number} | {status: 'zone_changed'} | {status: 'invalid'};
000016 | 
000017 | export function parseDate(input: string, displayedZone: string, utc: boolean): ParsedDate {
000018 |   // Check the input's rendered zone, including changes queued before a refresh.
000019 |   if (!utc && displayedZone !== systemTimeZone()) return {status: 'zone_changed'};
000020 |   const milliseconds = new Date(input + (utc ? 'Z' : '')).getTime();
000021 |   if (!utc && displayedZone !== systemTimeZone()) return {status: 'zone_changed'};
000022 |   return Number.isFinite(milliseconds)
000023 |     ? {status: 'ok', value: Math.floor(milliseconds / 1000)}
000024 |     : {status: 'invalid'};
000025 | }

000047 | /** Keep keyboard focus inside a modal, then restore the original control. */
000048 | export function dialogFocus(node: HTMLElement, close: () => void) {
000049 |   const previous = document.activeElement as HTMLElement | null;
000050 |   const controls = () => Array.from(node.querySelectorAll<HTMLElement>('button:not(:disabled),input:not(:disabled),select:not(:disabled),textarea:not(:disabled),a[href]'));
000051 |   queueMicrotask(() => (controls()[0] ?? node).focus());
000052 |   const keydown = (event: KeyboardEvent) => {
000053 |     if (event.key === 'Escape') { event.preventDefault(); close(); }
000054 |     if (event.key !== 'Tab') return;
000055 |     const items=controls(), first=items[0]??node, last=items.at(-1)??node;
000056 |     if (event.shiftKey && (document.activeElement===first || document.activeElement===node)) { event.preventDefault();last.focus(); }
000057 |     else if (!event.shiftKey && document.activeElement===last) { event.preventDefault();first.focus(); }
000058 |   };
000059 |   node.addEventListener('keydown', keydown);
000060 |   return { destroy() { node.removeEventListener('keydown', keydown);previous?.focus(); } };
000061 | }

000024 | fn read_json<T: DeserializeOwned>(path: &Path, owner: u32, mode: u32) -> Result<T, &'static str> {
000025 |     let file = OpenOptions::new()
000026 |         .read(true)
000027 |         .custom_flags(libc::O_NOFOLLOW | libc::O_NONBLOCK | libc::O_CLOEXEC)
000028 |         .open(path)
000029 |         .map_err(|_| "installation_health_file")?;
000030 |     let metadata = file.metadata().map_err(|_| "installation_health_file")?;
000031 |     if !metadata.is_file()
000032 |         || metadata.uid() != owner
000033 |         || metadata.mode() & 0o7777 != mode
000034 |         || metadata.nlink() != 1
000035 |         || metadata.len() > 16384
000036 |     {
000037 |         return Err("installation_health_permissions");
000038 |     }
000039 |     let mut bytes = Vec::new();
000040 |     file.take(16385)
000041 |         .read_to_end(&mut bytes)
000042 |         .map_err(|_| "installation_health_read")?;
000043 |     if bytes.len() > 16384 {
000044 |         return Err("installation_health_size");
000045 |     }
000046 |     serde_json::from_slice(&bytes).map_err(|_| "installation_health_schema")

000107 | fn atomic_receipt(path: &Path, bytes: &[u8]) -> Result<(), &'static str> {
000108 |     // Same-directory exclusive inode, private before writing, fsync before and after rename.
000109 |     let temp = path.with_extension(format!("{}.next", Platform.random_token()?));
000110 |     let result = (|| {
000111 |         let mut file = OpenOptions::new()
000112 |             .write(true)
000113 |             .create_new(true)
000114 |             .mode(0o600)
000115 |             .custom_flags(libc::O_NOFOLLOW | libc::O_CLOEXEC)
000116 |             .open(&temp)
000117 |             .map_err(|_| "installation_health_receipt_create")?;
000118 |         file.write_all(bytes)
000119 |             .and_then(|_| file.sync_all())
000120 |             .map_err(|_| "installation_health_receipt_write")?;
000121 |         fs::rename(&temp, path).map_err(|_| "installation_health_receipt_commit")?;
000122 |         File::open(path.parent().ok_or("installation_health_path")?)
000123 |             .and_then(|f| f.sync_all())
000124 |             .map_err(|_| "installation_health_receipt_sync")
000125 |     })();
000126 |     if result.is_err() {
000127 |         let _ = fs::remove_file(temp);
000128 |     }
000129 |     result
000130 | }

000001 | //! Authorization Services boundary. External forms are secrets: never persist or log them.
000002 | //! Uses the SDK Authorization.h ABI and the built-in, non-shared administrator right.
000003 | use std::{ffi::c_void, ptr};
000004 | 
000005 | #[repr(C)]
000006 | struct Item {
000007 |     name: *const std::ffi::c_char,
000008 |     length: usize,
000009 |     value: *mut c_void,
000010 |     flags: u32,
000011 | }
000012 | #[repr(C)]
000013 | struct Rights {
000014 |     count: u32,
000015 |     items: *mut Item,
000016 | }
000017 | #[repr(C)]
000018 | struct ExternalForm {
000019 |     bytes: [u8; 32],
000020 | }
000021 | #[link(name = "Security", kind = "framework")]
000022 | unsafe extern "C" {
000023 |     fn AuthorizationCreate(
000024 |         rights: *const Rights,
000025 |         environment: *const Rights,
000026 |         flags: u32,
000027 |         auth: *mut *mut c_void,
000028 |     ) -> i32;
000029 |     fn AuthorizationCopyRights(
000030 |         auth: *mut c_void,
000031 |         rights: *const Rights,
000032 |         environment: *const Rights,
000033 |         flags: u32,
000034 |         authorized: *mut *mut Rights,
000035 |     ) -> i32;
000036 |     fn AuthorizationMakeExternalForm(auth: *mut c_void, form: *mut ExternalForm) -> i32;
000037 |     fn AuthorizationCreateFromExternalForm(
000038 |         form: *const ExternalForm,
000039 |         auth: *mut *mut c_void,
000040 |     ) -> i32;
000041 |     fn AuthorizationFree(auth: *mut c_void, flags: u32) -> i32;
000042 | }
000043 | fn admin_right() -> Item {
000044 |     Item {
000045 |         name: c"system.privilege.admin".as_ptr(),
000046 |         length: 0,
000047 |         value: ptr::null_mut(),
000048 |         flags: 0,
000049 |     }
000050 | }
000051 | /// A fresh reference per operation. Never cache this object between repairs.
000052 | pub struct Authorization(*mut c_void);
000053 | impl Drop for Authorization {
000054 |     fn drop(&mut self) {
000055 |         // Destroy shared external-form rights as well as our reference, including error paths.
000056 |         unsafe {
000057 |             AuthorizationFree(self.0, 1 << 3);
000058 |         }
000059 |     }
000060 | }
000061 | impl Authorization {
000062 |     pub fn acquire() -> Result<Self, &'static str> {
000063 |         let mut auth = ptr::null_mut();
000064 |         let status = unsafe { AuthorizationCreate(ptr::null(), ptr::null(), 0, &mut auth) };
000065 |         if status != 0 || auth.is_null() {
000066 |             return Err("authorization_unavailable");
000067 |         }
000068 |         let owned = Self(auth);
000069 |         let mut item = admin_right();
000070 |         let rights = Rights {
000071 |             count: 1,
000072 |             items: &mut item,
000073 |         };
000074 |         let status =
000075 |             unsafe { AuthorizationCopyRights(auth, &rights, ptr::null(), 1 | 2, ptr::null_mut()) };
000076 |         match status {
000077 |             0 => Ok(owned),
000078 |             -60006 => Err("authorization_cancelled"),
000079 |             _ => Err("authorization_denied"),
000080 |         }
000081 |     }
000082 |     pub fn external_form(&self) -> Result<Vec<u8>, &'static str> {
000083 |         let mut form = ExternalForm { bytes: [0; 32] };
000084 |         if unsafe { AuthorizationMakeExternalForm(self.0, &mut form) } != 0 {
000085 |             return Err("authorization_external_form");
000086 |         }
000087 |         Ok(form.bytes.to_vec())
000088 |     }
000089 | }
000090 | /// Root must only inspect granted rights: never extend rights or allow UI here.
000091 | /// Destroying the imported reference consumes this native credential, preventing replay.
000092 | pub fn consume(form: &[u8]) -> Result<(), &'static str> {
000093 |     let bytes: [u8; 32] = form.try_into().map_err(|_| "authorization_invalid")?;
000094 |     let mut auth = ptr::null_mut();
000095 |     if unsafe { AuthorizationCreateFromExternalForm(&ExternalForm { bytes }, &mut auth) } != 0
000096 |         || auth.is_null()
000097 |     {
000098 |         return Err("authorization_invalid");
000099 |     }
000100 |     let _owned = Authorization(auth);
000101 |     let mut item = admin_right();
000102 |     let rights = Rights {
000103 |         count: 1,
000104 |         items: &mut item,
000105 |     };
000106 |     if unsafe { AuthorizationCopyRights(auth, &rights, ptr::null(), 0, ptr::null_mut()) } != 0 {
000107 |         return Err("authorization_denied");
000108 |     }
000109 |     Ok(())
000110 | }

000050 |                 let _ = child.wait();
000051 |                 return Err("system_command_timeout");
000052 |             }

000054 |     }

000056 | pub fn validate_timezone(zone: &str) -> Result<(), &'static str> {
000057 |     if zone.is_empty()
000058 |         || zone.len() > 128
000059 |         || zone.starts_with('/')
000060 |         || zone
000061 |             .split('/')
000062 |             .any(|p| p.is_empty() || p == "." || p == "..")
000063 |         || !zone
000064 |             .bytes()
000065 |             .all(|b| b.is_ascii_alphanumeric() || b"/_+-".contains(&b))
000066 |     {
000067 |         return Err("timezone_invalid");
000068 |     }
000069 |     let root = Path::new("/usr/share/zoneinfo")
000070 |         .canonicalize()
000071 |         .map_err(|_| "timezone_database")?;
000072 |     let path = root
000073 |         .join(zone)
000074 |         .canonicalize()
000075 |         .map_err(|_| "timezone_unknown")?;
000076 |     if !path.starts_with(root) || !path.is_file() {
000077 |         return Err("timezone_invalid");
000078 |     }
000079 |     Ok(())
000080 | }
000081 | fn route_uses_tunnel(output: &str) -> bool {

000083 |         .lines()
000084 |         .filter_map(|line| line.trim().strip_prefix("interface:"))
000085 |         .map(str::trim);
000086 |     matches!((interfaces.next(), interfaces.next()), (Some(name), None) if name.strip_prefix("utun").is_some_and(|n| !n.is_empty() && n.bytes().all(|b| b.is_ascii_digit())))
000087 | }
000088 | fn require_tunnel() -> Result<(), &'static str> {

000200 |     fn apply_plan(&self, p: &RepairPlan) -> Vec<RepairItemResult> {
000201 |         if let Err(code) = require_tunnel() {
000202 |             let code = self.plan_not_started(p).err().unwrap_or(code);
000203 |             return vec![RepairItemResult {
000204 |                 item: "tun_route".into(),
000205 |                 changed: false,
000206 |                 restored: false,
000207 |                 error: Some(code.into()),
000208 |             }];
000209 |         }
000210 |         if let Err(code) = persist_repair(p) {
000211 |             return vec![RepairItemResult {
000212 |                 item: "transaction".into(),
000213 |                 changed: false,
000214 |                 restored: false,
000215 |                 error: Some(code.into()),
000216 |             }];
000217 |         }
000218 |         let mut results = Vec::new();
000219 |         for (item, changed) in [
000220 |             ("timezone", p.original.timezone != p.target.timezone),
000221 |             ("ipv6", p.original.ipv6 != p.target.ipv6),
000222 |         ] {
000223 |             if !changed {
000224 |                 results.push(RepairItemResult {
000225 |                     item: item.into(),
000226 |                     changed: false,
000227 |                     restored: false,
000228 |                     error: None,
000229 |                 });
000230 |                 continue;
000231 |             }
000232 |             let result = require_tunnel().and_then(|()| {
000233 |                 if item == "timezone" {
000234 |                     command(
000235 |                         "/usr/sbin/systemsetup",
000236 |                         &["-settimezone", &p.target.timezone],
000237 |                     )
000238 |                 } else {
000239 |                     command(
000240 |                         "/usr/sbin/networksetup",
000241 |                         &[
000242 |                             if p.target.ipv6 == Ipv6Policy::Off {
000243 |                                 "-setv6off"
000244 |                             } else {
000245 |                                 "-setv6automatic"
000246 |                             },
000247 |                             &p.target.network_service,
000248 |                         ],
000249 |                     )
000250 |                 }
000251 |             });
000252 |             results.push(RepairItemResult {
000253 |                 item: item.into(),
000254 |                 changed: result.is_ok(),
000255 |                 restored: false,
000256 |                 error: result.err().map(str::to_string),
000257 |             });
000258 |             if results.last().is_some_and(|r| r.error.is_some()) {
000259 |                 break;
000260 |             }
000261 |         }
000262 |         let verified = results.iter().all(|r| r.error.is_none())
000263 |             && self
000264 |                 .read_state(&p.target.network_service)
000265 |                 .is_ok_and(|s| s.timezone == p.target.timezone && s.ipv6 == p.target.ipv6);
000266 |         // A cache refresh is transient. On failure retain the journal and report the
000267 |         // already-applied system items; recovery can restore configuration, not cache contents.
000268 |         if verified && !dns_cache::refresh_after_changes(&mut results, command) {
000269 |             return results;
000270 |         }
000271 |         if verified && let Err(code) = remember_managed(p) {
000272 |             results.push(RepairItemResult {
000273 |                 item: "system_backup".into(),
000274 |                 changed: false,
000275 |                 restored: false,
000276 |                 error: Some(code.into()),
000277 |             });
000278 |             return results;
000279 |         }
000280 |         if !verified {
000281 |             for result in &mut results {
000282 |                 if result.changed {
000283 |                     let rollback = if result.item == "timezone" {
000284 |                         command(
000285 |                             "/usr/sbin/systemsetup",
000286 |                             &["-settimezone", &p.original.timezone],
000287 |                         )
000288 |                     } else {
000289 |                         command(
000290 |                             "/usr/sbin/networksetup",
000291 |                             &[
000292 |                                 if p.original.ipv6 == Ipv6Policy::Off {
000293 |                                     "-setv6off"
000294 |                                 } else {
000295 |                                     "-setv6automatic"
000296 |                                 },
000297 |                                 &p.original.network_service,
000298 |                             ],
000299 |                         )
000300 |                     };
000301 |                     result.restored = rollback.is_ok();
000302 |                 }
000303 |                 if result.error.is_none() {
000304 |                     result.error = Some("repair_verification_failed".into());
000305 |                 }
000306 |             }
000307 |         }
000308 |         let restored = self
000309 |             .read_state(&p.original.network_service)
000310 |             .is_ok_and(|s| s.timezone == p.original.timezone && s.ipv6 == p.original.ipv6);
000311 |         if (verified || restored)
000312 |             && remember_repair_completion(
000313 |                 p,
000314 |                 if verified {
000315 |                     "repair_applied"
000316 |                 } else {
000317 |                     "repair_restored"
000318 |                 },
000319 |             )
000320 |             .and_then(|()| clear_repair())
000321 |             .is_err()
000322 |         {
000323 |             results.push(RepairItemResult {
000324 |                 item: "transaction".into(),
000325 |                 changed: false,
000326 |                 restored: false,
000327 |                 error: Some("repair_journal_cleanup".into()),
000328 |             });
000329 |         }
000330 |         results
000331 |     }

000335 |     fn commit_installation(&self, uid: u32) -> Result<(), &'static str> {
000336 |         use std::os::unix::fs::MetadataExt;
000337 |         self.guardian_status(uid)?;
000338 |         let base = Path::new(SYSTEM_ROOT);
000339 |         let backup = base.join("component-backup");
000340 |         let metadata =
000341 |             std::fs::symlink_metadata(&backup).map_err(|_| "installation_backup_missing")?;
000342 |         if !metadata.is_dir() || metadata.uid() != 0 || metadata.mode() & 0o077 != 0 {
000343 |             return Err("installation_backup_permissions");
000344 |         }
000345 |         let allowed = [
000346 |             "local.claudeswitcher.helper",
000347 |             "local.claudeswitcher.helper.plist",
000348 |             "local.claudeswitcher.guardian.plist",
000349 |             "switcher-guardian",
000350 |             "install.json",
000351 |         ];
000352 |         for entry in std::fs::read_dir(&backup).map_err(|_| "installation_backup_read")? {
000353 |             let entry = entry.map_err(|_| "installation_backup_read")?;
000354 |             let name = entry.file_name();
000355 |             let metadata =
000356 |                 std::fs::symlink_metadata(entry.path()).map_err(|_| "installation_backup_read")?;
000357 |             if !allowed.iter().any(|v| name == *v)
000358 |                 || !metadata.is_file()
000359 |                 || metadata.uid() != 0
000360 |                 || metadata.mode() & 0o022 != 0
000361 |             {
000362 |                 return Err("installation_backup_permissions");
000363 |             }
000364 |         }
000365 |         use std::{io::Write, os::unix::fs::OpenOptionsExt};
000366 |         let record = load_root_record(Path::new(INSTALL_RECORD))?;
000367 |         if record.owner_uid != uid {
000368 |             return Err("installation_owner_uid");
000369 |         }
000370 |         let temporary = base.join(".component-committed.next");
000371 |         let mut file = std::fs::OpenOptions::new()
000372 |             .write(true)
000373 |             .create_new(true)
000374 |             .mode(0o600)
000375 |             .custom_flags(libc::O_NOFOLLOW | libc::O_CLOEXEC)
000376 |             .open(&temporary)
000377 |             .map_err(|_| "installation_commit_create")?;
000378 |         let bytes = serde_json::to_vec(&record).map_err(|_| "installation_commit_encode")?;
000379 |         file.write_all(&bytes)
000380 |             .and_then(|_| file.sync_all())
000381 |             .map_err(|_| "installation_commit_write")?;
000382 |         std::fs::rename(temporary, base.join("component-committed.json"))
000383 |             .map_err(|_| "installation_commit_rename")?;
000384 |         std::fs::File::open(base)
000385 |             .and_then(|f| f.sync_all())
000386 |             .map_err(|_| "installation_commit_sync")?;
000387 |         // The marker is the commit point. Keep the rollback snapshot until the next transaction.
000388 |         let _ = std::fs::remove_file(base.join("component-pending"));
000389 |         Ok(())
000390 |     }

000392 |         command(
000393 |             "/bin/launchctl",
000394 |             &["print", &format!("gui/{uid}/{GUARDIAN_LABEL}")],
000395 |         )
000396 |         .map(|_| ())
000397 |     }
000398 | }

000400 | pub fn load_root_record(path: &Path) -> Result<InstallRecord, &'static str> {
000401 |     use std::os::unix::fs::{MetadataExt, OpenOptionsExt};
000402 |     let mut parent = path.parent();
000403 |     while let Some(p) = parent {
000404 |         let m = std::fs::symlink_metadata(p).map_err(|_| "install_record_parent")?;
000405 |         if !m.is_dir() || m.uid() != 0 || m.mode() & 0o022 != 0 {
000406 |             return Err("install_record_parent_permissions");
000407 |         }
000408 |         parent = p.parent();
000409 |     }
000410 |     let file = std::fs::OpenOptions::new()
000411 |         .read(true)
000412 |         .custom_flags(libc::O_NOFOLLOW | libc::O_NONBLOCK | libc::O_CLOEXEC)
000413 |         .open(path)
000414 |         .map_err(|_| "install_record_missing")?;
000415 |     let m = file.metadata().map_err(|_| "install_record_metadata")?;
000416 |     if !m.is_file() || m.uid() != 0 || m.mode() & 0o022 != 0 || m.len() > 16384 {
000417 |         return Err("install_record_permissions");
000418 |     }
000419 |     use std::io::Read;
000420 |     let mut bytes = Vec::new();
000421 |     file.take(16385)
000422 |         .read_to_end(&mut bytes)
000423 |         .map_err(|_| "install_record_read")?;
000424 |     let record: InstallRecord =
000425 |         serde_json::from_slice(&bytes).map_err(|_| "install_record_invalid")?;
000426 |     record.validate()?;
000427 |     Ok(record)
000428 | }

000598 | fn persist_repair(plan: &RepairPlan) -> Result<(), &'static str> {
000599 |     #[cfg(test)]

000635 | fn repair_result_path(plan_id: &str, create: bool) -> Result<std::path::PathBuf, &'static str> {
000636 |     use std::os::unix::fs::{DirBuilderExt, MetadataExt};
000637 |     if plan_id.len() != 64 || !plan_id.bytes().all(|b| b.is_ascii_hexdigit()) {
000638 |         return Err("repair_plan_id");
000639 |     }
000640 |     let directory = Path::new(SYSTEM_ROOT).join("repair-results");
000641 |     if create {
000642 |         match std::fs::DirBuilder::new().mode(0o700).create(&directory) {
000643 |             Ok(()) => (),
000644 |             Err(e) if e.kind() == std::io::ErrorKind::AlreadyExists => (),
000645 |             Err(_) => return Err("repair_results_directory"),
000646 |         }
000647 |     }
000648 |     if create {
000649 |         std::fs::File::open(SYSTEM_ROOT)
000650 |             .and_then(|file| file.sync_all())
000651 |             .map_err(|_| "repair_results_sync")?;
000652 |     }
000653 |     let m = std::fs::symlink_metadata(&directory).map_err(|_| "repair_results_directory")?;
000654 |     if !m.is_dir() || m.file_type().is_symlink() || m.uid() != 0 || m.mode() & 0o077 != 0 {
000655 |         return Err("repair_results_permissions");
000656 |     }
000657 |     Ok(directory.join(format!("{plan_id}.json")))
000658 | }
000659 | fn write_completion_at(
000660 |     path: &Path,
000661 |     plan: &RepairPlan,
000662 |     code: &str,
000663 |     replace: bool,
000664 |     owner_uid: u32,
000665 | ) -> Result<(), &'static str> {
000666 |     use std::{io::Write, os::unix::fs::OpenOptionsExt};
000667 |     // A unique private temporary inode avoids a stale pre-rename file blocking recovery.
000668 |     let temp = path.with_extension(format!("{}.next", Platform.random_token()?));
000669 |     let target = if replace { temp.as_path() } else { path };
000670 |     let mut file = std::fs::OpenOptions::new()
000671 |         .write(true)
000672 |         .create_new(true)
000673 |         .mode(0o600)
000674 |         .custom_flags(libc::O_NOFOLLOW)
000675 |         .open(target)
000676 |         .map_err(|_| "repair_completion_create")?;
000677 |     let data = serde_json::to_vec(&RepairCompletion {
000678 |         owner_uid,
000679 |         code: code.into(),
000680 |         plan: plan.clone(),
000681 |     })
000682 |     .map_err(|_| "repair_completion_encoding")?;
000683 |     file.write_all(&data)
000684 |         .and_then(|()| file.sync_all())
000685 |         .map_err(|_| "repair_completion_write")?;
000686 |     if replace {
000687 |         std::fs::rename(temp, path).map_err(|_| "repair_completion_commit")?;
000688 |     }
000689 |     std::fs::File::open(path.parent().ok_or("repair_results_directory")?)
000690 |         .and_then(|f| f.sync_all())
000691 |         .map_err(|_| "repair_completion_sync")
000692 | }

000704 | fn read_repair_file<T: serde::de::DeserializeOwned>(name: &str) -> Result<Option<T>, &'static str> {
000705 |     use std::{
000706 |         io::Read,
000707 |         os::unix::fs::{MetadataExt, OpenOptionsExt},
000708 |     };
000709 |     let file = match std::fs::OpenOptions::new()
000710 |         .read(true)
000711 |         .custom_flags(libc::O_NOFOLLOW | libc::O_NONBLOCK)
000712 |         .open(Path::new(SYSTEM_ROOT).join(name))
000713 |     {
000714 |         Ok(file) => file,
000715 |         Err(e) if e.kind() == std::io::ErrorKind::NotFound => return Ok(None),
000716 |         Err(_) => return Err("repair_status_read"),
000717 |     };
000718 |     let m = file.metadata().map_err(|_| "repair_status_metadata")?;
000719 |     if !m.is_file() || m.uid() != 0 || m.mode() & 0o077 != 0 || m.nlink() != 1 || m.len() > 16384 {
000720 |         return Err("repair_status_permissions");
000721 |     }
000722 |     let mut bytes = Vec::new();
000723 |     file.take(16385)
000724 |         .read_to_end(&mut bytes)
000725 |         .map_err(|_| "repair_status_read")?;
000726 |     serde_json::from_slice(&bytes)
000727 |         .map(Some)
000728 |         .map_err(|_| "repair_status_schema")
000729 | }
000730 | fn status_response(
000731 |     plan_id: &str,
000732 |     pending: Option<RepairPlan>,
000733 |     completion: Option<RepairCompletion>,
000734 |     system: &impl SystemActions,
000735 |     owner_uid: u32,
000736 | ) -> Result<HelperResponse, &'static str> {
000737 |     if completion
000738 |         .as_ref()
000739 |         .is_some_and(|receipt| receipt.owner_uid != owner_uid)
000740 |         || (pending.is_some() && completion.is_none())
000741 |     {
000742 |         return Err("repair_result_owner");
000743 |     }
000744 |     if completion
000745 |         .as_ref()
000746 |         .is_some_and(|receipt| receipt.plan.id != plan_id)
000747 |     {
000748 |         return Ok(HelperResponse::status("repair_unknown", false));
000749 |     }
000750 |     let (code, plan) = if let Some(plan) = pending {
000751 |         ("repair_recovery_required", plan)
000752 |     } else if let Some(receipt) = completion {
000753 |         if !matches!(
000754 |             receipt.code.as_str(),
000755 |             "repair_applied" | "repair_restored" | "repair_not_started"
000756 |         ) {
000757 |             return Err("repair_status_schema");
000758 |         }
000759 |         (
000760 |             if receipt.code == "repair_applied" {
000761 |                 "repair_applied"
000762 |             } else if receipt.code == "repair_not_started" {
000763 |                 "repair_not_started"
000764 |             } else {
000765 |                 "repair_restored"
000766 |             },
000767 |             receipt.plan,
000768 |         )
000769 |     } else {
000770 |         return Ok(HelperResponse::status("repair_unknown", false));
000771 |     };
000772 |     if plan.id != plan_id {
000773 |         return Ok(HelperResponse::status("repair_unknown", false));
000774 |     }
000775 |     let state = system.read_state(&plan.target.network_service)?;
000776 |     let mut response = HelperResponse::status(code, code != "repair_not_started");
000777 |     response.state = Some(state);
000778 |     response.plan = Some(plan);
000779 |     Ok(response)
000780 | }
000781 | fn read_repair_status(plan_id: &str) -> Result<HelperResponse, &'static str> {
000782 |     if plan_id.len() != 64 || !plan_id.bytes().all(|b| b.is_ascii_hexdigit()) {
000783 |         return Err("repair_plan_id");
000784 |     }
000785 |     let pending = read_repair_file("repair-journal.json")?;
000786 |     let path = repair_result_path(plan_id, false)?;
000787 |     let name = path
000788 |         .strip_prefix(SYSTEM_ROOT)
000789 |         .map_err(|_| "repair_results_directory")?
000790 |         .to_str()
000791 |         .ok_or("repair_plan_id")?;
000792 |     let completion = read_repair_file(name)?;
000793 |     status_response(plan_id, pending, completion, &Platform, repair_owner()?)
000794 | }

000806 | /// Resume only a root-protected repair journal. External changes cause a conflict, never overwrite.
000807 | pub fn recover_pending_repair() -> Result<(), &'static str> {
000808 |     #[cfg(test)]
000809 |     if let Some(pending) = dns_cache::test_io::pending_plan() {
000810 |         return pending.as_ref().map_or(Ok(()), recover_saved_plan);
000811 |     }
000812 |     use std::{
000813 |         io::Read,
000814 |         os::unix::fs::{MetadataExt, OpenOptionsExt},
000815 |     };
000816 |     let path = Path::new(SYSTEM_ROOT).join("repair-journal.json");
000817 |     let file = match std::fs::OpenOptions::new()
000818 |         .read(true)
000819 |         .custom_flags(libc::O_NOFOLLOW | libc::O_NONBLOCK | libc::O_CLOEXEC)
000820 |         .open(path)
000821 |     {
000822 |         Ok(file) => file,
000823 |         Err(e) if e.kind() == std::io::ErrorKind::NotFound => return Ok(()),
000824 |         Err(_) => return Err("repair_recovery_read"),
000825 |     };
000826 |     let m = file.metadata().map_err(|_| "repair_recovery_metadata")?;
000827 |     if !m.is_file() || m.uid() != 0 || m.mode() & 0o077 != 0 || m.len() > 16384 {
000828 |         return Err("repair_recovery_permissions");
000829 |     }
000830 |     let mut bytes = Vec::new();
000831 |     file.take(16385)
000832 |         .read_to_end(&mut bytes)
000833 |         .map_err(|_| "repair_recovery_read")?;
000834 |     let p: RepairPlan = serde_json::from_slice(&bytes).map_err(|_| "repair_recovery_schema")?;
000835 |     recover_saved_plan(&p)
000836 | }
000837 | fn recover_saved_plan(p: &RepairPlan) -> Result<(), &'static str> {
000838 |     let system = Platform;
000839 |     system.validate_policy(&p.target)?;
000840 |     validate_timezone(&p.original.timezone)?;
000841 |     if p.target.network_service != p.original.network_service {
000842 |         return Err("repair_recovery_service");
000843 |     }
000844 |     let current = system.read_state(&p.target.network_service)?;
000845 |     if ![p.original.timezone.as_str(), p.target.timezone.as_str()]
000846 |         .contains(&current.timezone.as_str())
000847 |         || ![p.original.ipv6, p.target.ipv6].contains(&current.ipv6)
000848 |     {
000849 |         return Err("repair_recovery_conflict");
000850 |     }
000851 |     if current.timezone != p.original.timezone {
000852 |         command(
000853 |             "/usr/sbin/systemsetup",
000854 |             &["-settimezone", &p.original.timezone],
000855 |         )?;
000856 |     }
000857 |     if current.ipv6 != p.original.ipv6 {
000858 |         command(
000859 |             "/usr/sbin/networksetup",
000860 |             &[
000861 |                 if p.original.ipv6 == Ipv6Policy::Off {
000862 |                     "-setv6off"
000863 |                 } else {
000864 |                     "-setv6automatic"
000865 |                 },
000866 |                 &p.original.network_service,
000867 |             ],
000868 |         )?;
000869 |     }
000870 |     let restored = system.read_state(&p.original.network_service)?;
000871 |     if restored.timezone != p.original.timezone || restored.ipv6 != p.original.ipv6 {
000872 |         return Err("repair_recovery_verification");
000873 |     }
000874 |     remember_repair_completion(p, "repair_restored")?;
000875 |     clear_repair()
000876 | }

000914 | fn remember_managed(plan: &RepairPlan) -> Result<(), &'static str> {
000915 |     #[cfg(test)]
000916 |     if dns_cache::test_io::journal("managed", None) {
000917 |         return Ok(());
000918 |     }

000921 |         timezone_original: plan.original.timezone.clone(),
000922 |         timezone_last: plan.original.timezone.clone(),
000923 |         timezone_guard_plan_id: None,
000924 |         services: Default::default(),
000925 |     });
000926 |     state.timezone_last = plan.target.timezone.clone();
000927 |     state.timezone_guard_plan_id = Some(plan.id.clone());
000928 |     let item = state
000929 |         .services

000931 |         .or_insert((plan.original.ipv6, plan.original.ipv6));
000932 |     item.1 = plan.target.ipv6;
000933 |     let base = Path::new(SYSTEM_ROOT);
000934 |     let temporary = base.join(".system-original.next");
000935 |     let mut file = std::fs::OpenOptions::new()
000936 |         .write(true)

000938 |         .mode(0o600)
000939 |         .custom_flags(libc::O_NOFOLLOW | libc::O_CLOEXEC)
000940 |         .open(&temporary)
000941 |         .map_err(|_| "system_backup_create")?;
000942 |     let bytes = serde_json::to_vec(&state).map_err(|_| "system_backup_encode")?;
000943 |     file.write_all(&bytes)
000944 |         .and_then(|_| file.sync_all())
000945 |         .map_err(|_| "system_backup_write")?;

000947 |         .map_err(|_| "system_backup_commit")?;

000952 | fn restore_managed(system: &Platform) -> Result<(), &'static str> {
000953 |     let Some(state) = read_managed()? else {
000954 |         return Ok(());
000955 |     };
000956 |     validate_timezone(&state.timezone_original)?;
000957 |     validate_timezone(&state.timezone_last)?;
000958 |     if state.services.is_empty() || state.services.len() > 32 {
000959 |         return Err("system_backup_services");
000960 |     }
000961 |     let mut originals = Vec::new();
000962 |     for (service, (original, last)) in &state.services {
000963 |         let current = system.read_state(service)?;
000964 |         if current.timezone != state.timezone_last && current.timezone != state.timezone_original {
000965 |             return Err("uninstall_timezone_conflict");
000966 |         }
000967 |         if current.ipv6 != *last && current.ipv6 != *original {
000968 |             return Err("uninstall_ipv6_conflict");
000969 |         }
000970 |         originals.push((current, *original));
000971 |     }
000972 |     for (current, ipv6) in originals {
000973 |         let plan = RepairPlan {
000974 |             id: system.random_token()?,
000975 |             original: current.clone(),
000976 |             target: RegionPolicy {
000977 |                 timezone: state.timezone_original.clone(),
000978 |                 network_service: current.network_service.clone(),
000979 |                 ipv6,
000980 |             },
000981 |             expires_at: 0,
000982 |         };
000983 |         persist_repair(&plan)?;
000984 |         if current.timezone != plan.target.timezone {
000985 |             command(
000986 |                 "/usr/sbin/systemsetup",
000987 |                 &["-settimezone", &plan.target.timezone],
000988 |             )?;
000989 |         }
000990 |         if current.ipv6 != ipv6 {
000991 |             command(
000992 |                 "/usr/sbin/networksetup",
000993 |                 &[
000994 |                     if ipv6 == Ipv6Policy::Off {
000995 |                         "-setv6off"
000996 |                     } else {
000997 |                         "-setv6automatic"
000998 |                     },
000999 |                     &current.network_service,
001000 |                 ],
001001 |             )?;
001002 |         }
001003 |         let verified = system.read_state(&current.network_service)?;
001004 |         if verified.timezone != plan.target.timezone || verified.ipv6 != ipv6 {
001005 |             return Err("uninstall_restore_verification");
001006 |         }
001007 |         clear_repair()?;
001008 |     }
001009 |     std::fs::remove_file(Path::new(SYSTEM_ROOT).join("system-original.json"))
001010 |         .map_err(|_| "system_backup_remove")?;
001011 |     std::fs::File::open(SYSTEM_ROOT)
001012 |         .and_then(|f| f.sync_all())
001013 |         .map_err(|_| "system_backup_sync")
001014 | }
001015 | 
001016 | // These scoped boundaries exist only in the unit-test binary. No environment or IPC switch.
001017 | #[cfg(test)]
001018 | mod no_tun_test_io {
001019 |     use super::*;
001020 |     use std::cell::RefCell;
001021 | 
001022 |     #[derive(Default)]
001023 |     struct Case {
001024 |         route: Option<Result<String, &'static str>>,
001025 |         commands: Vec<(String, Vec<String>)>,
001026 |         not_started: Vec<String>,
001027 |         persist_attempts: usize,
001028 |     }
001029 |     thread_local! {
001030 |         static CASE: RefCell<Option<Case>> = const { RefCell::new(None) };
001031 |     }
001032 |     struct Reset;
001033 |     impl Drop for Reset {
001034 |         fn drop(&mut self) {
001035 |             CASE.with(|case| *case.borrow_mut() = None);
001036 |         }
001037 |     }
001038 |     fn scoped(route: Option<Result<String, &'static str>>, run: impl FnOnce()) -> Case {
001039 |         CASE.with(|case| {
001040 |             assert!(
001041 |                 case.borrow().is_none(),
001042 |                 "no-TUN test boundary must not nest"
001043 |             );
001044 |             *case.borrow_mut() = Some(Case {
001045 |                 route,
001046 |                 ..Default::default()
001047 |             });
001048 |         });
001049 |         let _reset = Reset;
001050 |         run();
001051 |         CASE.with(|case| case.borrow_mut().take().unwrap())
001052 |     }
001053 |     pub(super) fn command(program: &str, args: &[&str]) -> Option<Result<String, &'static str>> {
001054 |         CASE.with(|case| {
001055 |             let mut case = case.borrow_mut();
001056 |             let case = case.as_mut()?;
001057 |             case.commands.push((
001058 |                 program.into(),
001059 |                 args.iter().map(|arg| (*arg).into()).collect(),
001060 |             ));
001061 |             assert_eq!(
001062 |                 program, "/sbin/route",
001063 |                 "unexpected command blocked before spawn"
001064 |             );
001065 |             assert_eq!(
001066 |                 args,
001067 |                 ["-n", "get", "1.1.1.1"],
001068 |                 "unexpected argv blocked before spawn"
001069 |             );
001070 |             Some(
001071 |                 case.route
001072 |                     .clone()
001073 |                     .expect("unconfigured route boundary blocked before spawn"),
001074 |             )
001075 |         })
001076 |     }
001077 |     pub(super) fn not_started(plan: &RepairPlan) -> bool {
001078 |         CASE.with(|case| {
001079 |             let mut case = case.borrow_mut();
001080 |             let Some(case) = case.as_mut() else {
001081 |                 return false;
001082 |             };
001083 |             case.not_started.push(plan.id.clone());
001084 |             true
001085 |         })
001086 |     }
001087 |     pub(super) fn persist_tripwire() {
001088 |         CASE.with(|case| {
001089 |             if let Some(case) = case.borrow_mut().as_mut() {
001090 |                 case.persist_attempts += 1;
001091 |                 panic!("journal tripwire blocked before any filesystem access");
001092 |             }
001093 |         });
001094 |     }
001095 |     fn plan() -> RepairPlan {
001096 |         RepairPlan {
001097 |             id: "a".repeat(64),
001098 |             original: SystemState {
001099 |                 timezone: "UTC".into(),
001100 |                 network_service: "Wi-Fi".into(),
001101 |                 ipv6: Ipv6Policy::Automatic,
001102 |             },
001103 |             target: RegionPolicy {
001104 |                 timezone: "Asia/Tokyo".into(),
001105 |                 network_service: "Wi-Fi".into(),
001106 |                 ipv6: Ipv6Policy::Off,
001107 |             },
001108 |             expires_at: 100,
001109 |         }

000003 | /// Refresh only after a verified administrator repair changed persistent system settings.
000004 | /// Caller retains its repair journal when this returns false.
000005 | pub(super) fn refresh_after_changes(
000006 |     results: &mut Vec<RepairItemResult>,
000007 |     mut run: impl FnMut(&str, &[&str]) -> Result<String, &'static str>,
000008 | ) -> bool {
000009 |     if !results
000010 |         .iter()
000011 |         .any(|item| matches!(item.item.as_str(), "timezone" | "ipv6") && item.changed)
000012 |     {
000013 |         return true;
000014 |     }
000015 |     for (item, program, args) in [
000016 |         (
000017 |             "dns_cache_flush",
000018 |             "/usr/bin/dscacheutil",
000019 |             &["-flushcache"][..],
000020 |         ),
000021 |         (
000022 |             "dns_responder_reload",
000023 |             "/usr/bin/killall",
000024 |             &["-HUP", "mDNSResponder"][..],
000025 |         ),
000026 |     ] {
000027 |         let outcome = run(program, args);
000028 |         let success = outcome.is_ok();
000029 |         results.push(RepairItemResult {
000030 |             item: item.into(),
000031 |             changed: success,
000032 |             restored: false,
000033 |             error: outcome.err().map(str::to_string),
000034 |         });
000035 |         if !success {
000036 |             return false;
000037 |         }
000038 |     }
000039 |     true
000040 | }

000048 |     struct Case {
000049 |         timezone: String,
000050 |         ipv6: Ipv6Policy,
000051 |         failure: Option<&'static str>,
000052 |         commands: Vec<(String, Vec<String>)>,
000053 |         journal: Vec<String>,
000054 |         plan: RepairPlan,
000055 |         pending: bool,
000056 |     }
000057 |     thread_local! {
000058 |         static CASE: RefCell<Option<Case>> = const { RefCell::new(None) };
000059 |     }
000060 |     struct Reset;
000061 |     impl Drop for Reset {
000062 |         fn drop(&mut self) {
000063 |             CASE.with(|case| *case.borrow_mut() = None);
000064 |         }
000065 |     }
000066 |     fn scoped(changed: bool, failure: Option<&'static str>, run: impl FnOnce()) -> Case {
000067 |         CASE.with(|case| {
000068 |             assert!(case.borrow().is_none());
000069 |             *case.borrow_mut() = Some(Case {
000070 |                 timezone: if changed { "UTC" } else { "Asia/Tokyo" }.into(),
000071 |                 ipv6: Ipv6Policy::Off,
000072 |                 failure,
000073 |                 commands: Vec::new(),
000074 |                 journal: Vec::new(),
000075 |                 plan: plan(changed),
000076 |                 pending: false,
000077 |             });
000078 |         });
000079 |         let _reset = Reset;
000080 |         run();
000081 |         CASE.with(|case| case.borrow_mut().take().unwrap())
000082 |     }
000083 |     pub(crate) fn command(program: &str, args: &[&str]) -> Option<Result<String, &'static str>> {
000084 |         CASE.with(|slot| {
000085 |             let mut slot = slot.borrow_mut();
000086 |             let case = slot.as_mut()?;
000087 |             case.commands
000088 |                 .push((program.into(), args.iter().map(|s| (*s).into()).collect()));
000089 |             Some(match (program, args) {
000090 |                 ("/sbin/route", ["-n", "get", "1.1.1.1"]) => Ok("interface: utun5".into()),
000091 |                 ("/usr/sbin/networksetup", ["-listallnetworkservices"]) => {
000092 |                     Ok("Services\nWi-Fi".into())
000093 |                 }
000094 |                 ("/usr/sbin/networksetup", ["-getinfo", "Wi-Fi"]) => Ok(format!(
000095 |                     "IPv6: {}",
000096 |                     if case.ipv6 == Ipv6Policy::Off {
000097 |                         "Off"
000098 |                     } else {
000099 |                         "Automatic"
000100 |                     }
000101 |                 )),
000102 |                 ("/usr/sbin/systemsetup", ["-gettimezone"]) => {
000103 |                     Ok(format!("Time Zone: {}", case.timezone))
000104 |                 }
000105 |                 ("/usr/sbin/systemsetup", ["-settimezone", zone @ ("Asia/Tokyo" | "UTC")]) => {
000106 |                     case.timezone = (*zone).into();
000107 |                     Ok(String::new())
000108 |                 }
000109 |                 ("/usr/bin/dscacheutil", ["-flushcache"])
000110 |                 | ("/usr/bin/killall", ["-HUP", "mDNSResponder"]) => {
000111 |                     if case.failure == Some(program) {
000112 |                         Err("system_command_timeout")
000113 |                     } else {
000114 |                         Ok(String::new())
000115 |                     }
000116 |                 }
000117 |                 _ => panic!(
000118 |                     "unconfigured DNS repair command blocked before spawn: {program} {args:?}"
000119 |                 ),
000120 |             })
000121 |         })
000122 |     }
000123 |     pub(crate) fn journal(operation: &str, code: Option<&str>) -> bool {
000124 |         CASE.with(|slot| {
000125 |             let mut slot = slot.borrow_mut();
000126 |             let Some(case) = slot.as_mut() else {
000127 |                 return false;
000128 |             };
000129 |             match operation {
000130 |                 "persist" => case.pending = true,
000131 |                 "clear" => case.pending = false,
000132 |                 _ => {}
000133 |             }
000134 |             case.journal.push(code.unwrap_or(operation).into());
000135 |             true
000136 |         })
000137 |     }
000138 |     pub(crate) fn pending_plan() -> Option<Option<RepairPlan>> {
000139 |         CASE.with(|slot| {
000140 |             slot.borrow()
000141 |                 .as_ref()
000142 |                 .map(|case| case.pending.then(|| case.plan.clone()))
000143 |         })
000144 |     }

000013 | fn reconcile_target(
000014 |     expected: &str,
000015 |     mut run: impl FnMut(&str, &[&str]) -> Result<String, &'static str>,
000016 | ) -> Result<HelperResponse, &'static str> {
000017 |     validate_timezone(expected)?;
000018 |     let read_timezone = |output: String| -> Result<String, &'static str> {
000019 |         let zone = output
000020 |             .trim()
000021 |             .strip_prefix("Time Zone: ")
000022 |             .ok_or("timezone_unreadable")?;
000023 |         validate_timezone(zone)?;
000024 |         Ok(zone.into())
000025 |     };
000026 |     let current = read_timezone(run("/usr/sbin/systemsetup", &["-gettimezone"])?)?;
000027 |     let changed = current != expected;
000028 |     if changed {
000029 |         run("/usr/sbin/systemsetup", &["-settimezone", expected])?;
000030 |         if read_timezone(run("/usr/sbin/systemsetup", &["-gettimezone"])?)? != expected {
000031 |             return Err("timezone_guard_verification");
000032 |         }
000033 |     }
000034 |     let mut response = HelperResponse::status(
000035 |         if changed {
000036 |             "timezone_guard_restored"
000037 |         } else {
000038 |             "timezone_guard_unchanged"
000039 |         },
000040 |         true,
000041 |     );
000042 |     response.items.push(RepairItemResult {
000043 |         item: "timezone".into(),
000044 |         changed,
000045 |         restored: false,
000046 |         error: None,
000047 |     });
000048 |     Ok(response)
